tei:div.tei:p: da༅༅//go kyi nang bstan dpe tshogs lte gnas//7/ 60/3ba57777/3/703070000ba/010 30'i / khya5 jaXl1/ /0batha90
༷ 4 ༷ ༷ ) 4) ) ༷she / ༷ // / / / / / 7 4 rigani 5 ra rta 0 /ring 4 ༄ 4nā〉ga 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 tsho 4 ༄ mi — ོ ༷ sdu sngo tsho ༄༄ ‘ ༄ rsha 'gyu 0 ༷ 4

————— ——— —— — — — — — —— ——— — — — — ————— — —— 4 lo 4 po dza 'a ma glang rgyus kya ra/ ga gri nye lo kyi dza / — 'a ma nga rabs rgyus gtam rgyud/ ཿ tso sgri na yang hwas ma ga byas/ ༄ go po kyi ma na skyabs sa bsgyur/ miri ra gsadapa skrun khang / —— — — — —— —— — —— — — —————— —— ——— —— —— ——

dkar chagadang po/ yo rob pas 8 a me ri kha ri shes mgo brtsams pa 1gnyis pa/ mi rgyud dmar po'i las skal/ 11gsum pa/ hphe gling gi mi nag me gling du slebs pa/ 19bzhi pa/ rgyal po'i bzhugs khri g.yo mgo brtsams pa 29lnga pa/ khi rom wel gyis lcags dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas te gnam 'og blangs pa/ 40drug pa/ mag pas rgyal po'i khri la 'khod/ 50bdun pa/ dbyin ji'i mnga' 'bangs a ri bar gyur pa/ 55brgyad pa/ a ri mnyam 'brel rgyal khab byung ba/ 61dgu pa/ mi rnams la blo bskyed sbyin pa'i mi/ 72bcu pa/ ‘6'di na pa si thil btson khang dur du bcug yod’ 86bcu gcig pa/ 88rgyal po'i mgo bo kho pa tshor 'phangs pa’’ 94bcu gnyis pa/ lhan skyes kyi 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi ya mtshan can zhig dang / ham sems can zhig chab srid pa zhigadamag don mkhas mchog pa zhig 'khrungs pa/ 106—bcu gsum pa/ nā pho lun rgyal por bzhugs pa/ 115bcu bzhi pa/ ‘4'das don de yi kho pa'i bzhugs khri ru g.yug shog pa/’nya 128bco lnga pa/ zar rgyal gnyis/ 139bcu drug pa/ la ting a me ri kha yongs su btums pa'i rlung 'tshab cig 153༄ 1

bcu bdun pa/ 'khor los sna drangs pa'i gsar brje zhig 165bco brgyad pa/ yo rob kyi nye rabs lo rgyus steng gi gzhi rgya ches che ba'i gsar brje'i drag rlung shig 174bcu dgu pa/ mar khe si dang / en ke si/ tshan rig gung khran ring lugs kyi byung ba/ 186nyi shu pa/ stod lwa dmar po can gyi dpa' bo/ 197nyer gcig pa/ jon pu ron gyi las don/ 206nyer gnyis pa/ lin khon /deskye khungs ches dman pa'i a ri'i tsung thung / 215nyer gsum pa/ u ru si'i zhing bran lam lugs med par btang ba/ 227nyer bzhi pa/ 'jar pan gyi ming kri khri lo'i gsar bcos las — 'gul/ 235nyer lnga pa/ pab dang pab chos pa'i 'os langs 248nyer drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mi rigs 'os langs chen po/ 257nyer bdun pa/ mā ha di'i 'os langs dang kor ton gyi mtha' 'bras 268nyer brgyad pa/ pi si mar gyis ras dmar g.yob pa yis/ glang rgod nā pho lun gsum par khro ba bslangs/ 275nyer dgu pa/ pha ri si kung hre'i gsar brje/ 285sum cu pa/ rgyal spyi dang po dang rgyal spyi gnyis pa/ 297so gcig pa/ 8 men rtags can gyi dmag gru gas gtor byung ba las bslangs pa'i g.yul 'thab shig 307so gnyis pa/ dbyin por g.yul 'thab/ 314so gsum pa/ kho ri ya'i shing rta lo'i zhing pa'i 'os langs dang 2

krung go dang 'jar pan gyi shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrug 320so bzhi pa/ we the nam gyi hpha rgol dpa' bo hong hwa than/ 328so lnga pa/ jag rkun gnyis kyis krung go'i mnga' khongs su khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab mo thengs shig bgyis pa/ 335so drug pa/ ‘8khrag bzhur ba'i gza' nyi ma mi’yis gsar brje'i drag rlung zhig bslangs pa/ 344so bdun pa/ dgra zla'i dpung tshogs gnyis kyi grub tshul/ 353so brgyad pa/ mi'i rigs lo rgyus steng gi gsod 'thab chen po snga na med pa zhig 366so dgu pa/ zar rgyal tha ma khri las pha ba pa 381bzhi bcu pa/ mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar ba'i mgo brtsams pa 390zhe gcig pa/ lo ngo nyi shur dmag mtshams bzhag pa/ 412 3

dang po/ yo rol pas ((a me ri kha mishes mgo4brtsams pa/'dzam gling gi nye rabs lo rgyus ni thog mar yo rob gling (2070༅ 'i snya6)nas mgo brtsams pa yin/ gna' dus su/ 'dzam gling gi rig gnas kyi lte ba ni gling chen a hphe ri kha ( 1 103 4khrisnyosko)dang gling chen e sha ya ( 313 sgrom)na mchis shing / yo rob gling ni gna' snga mo'i dus suljon thon zhig min te/ nye rabs su slebs tshe da gzod 'dzam gling steng go gnas gal chen zin par gyur/ nga tshos lo rgyus kyi deb ther la phyi mig re bltas na/ nye rabs lo rgyus kyi stegs bur 'khrab ston pa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim zhes pa'i gsar skyes kyi byis pa 'di ni/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi skyed ma'i mngal du sbrum pa zhig yin tshul rtogs par 'gyur ro//dus rabs bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga par/ sa dbus rgya mtsho'i (5061 07 3ba03salo༅pho)'gram rgyud dang yo rob nub khul gyi rgyal khab skor zhig gi tshong las dpal 'byor ha cang dar rgyas yin la/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi myug mgo 'bus yod/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshong zog dang dngul lor gyi 'brel ba yis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi la g.yo 'gul gtong mgo brtsams/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'du shes kyis rim bzhin bkas bkod khyim rgyud kyi 'du shes kyi tshab byas te/ rig rtsal bskyar dar (5 4tshozo༅)gyi 'gul skyod ces pa bslangs/ rig rtsal bskyar (310/tshu11rngon(stashā /sa (tshe() ra 1/

dar gyi snying po ni mi chos ring lugs (55yi3sa1 bya4 ma41 4)yin la/ de'i rlabs che ba'i grub 'bras ni rang byung khams dang mi la nges rtogs byung ba de yin/ rig rtsal bskyar dar ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam blo bcings 'grol gtong ba'i snga dus kyi 'gul skyod thengs shig yin zhing / des ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thog ma'i dar rgyas la bsam blo'i phyogs kyi gegs rkyen sel la/nye rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal 'byung ba la'ang bsam blo'i gegs rgya med par btang ngo // skabs der yo rob gling tu tshong las gtsigs 'dzin ring lugs dar mched chen po yod/ rgyal khab cig la gser dngul 'bor chen yod pa na rgyal khab de 'byor phyug ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur thub par snyam pas/ tshong pa rnams la rgyu 'byor gnyer 'dun che zhing / dbang sgyur pa rnams la mnga' dbang bsgyur 'dod che la/ chos spel mkhan rnams la 'dzam gling hril bo ye shu chos lugs par bsgyur re che/ de bas mi la las 88yo rob bkres skom gyis gdung nya zhes brjod pa la yang rgyu mtshan med pa zhig min no// yin na'ang skabs der chos spel mkhan mi nyung ba zhig 'jig rten byed por skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus mtshungs su dngul lor la'ang lhag par dang dad byed/ kho pa tsho rgyun du tshong pa dang lhan du yo rob nas phyir bskyod la/ tha na mtshams rer tshong pa las kyang snga bar phyir thon par ma zad/ nyen mchong gi snying stobs kyang mi chung ba zhig ldan/skabs der yo rob pa'i 'jig rten gyi ngos zin ni cung rab rib ci zhig yin/ kho tshos rgyang ring gi shar phyogs na krung go zhes pa zhig dang / rgya gar zhes pa zhig 'jar pan zhes pa zhig yod la/ de na ga sa gar gser dngul dang nor bus gang yod pa tsam las mi shes/ kho pa tshos shar phyogs la re dad byed cing / shar phyogs kyi gser dngul dang dar gos/ zhim rdzas bcas 2

'thob re 'chang / rgyu 'byor la 'dod 'dun gnon thabs med pa zhig skyes pa de las kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mi nyung ba zhig la mtsho lam nas shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i nye lam zhig 'tshol 'dod skyes/ shar phyogs su/ phor thi'u gal (snga0 53tsha spyosapho〉ta)gyi mi rnams hphe gling gi nub mtsho'i 'gram rgyud ded de lam thag mi thung ba zhig la phyin yod la/ kho tshos de ltar mu mthud du shar bskyod byas na shar phyogs su bsleb thub nges can yin par 'dod do// nub phyogs su/ nub kyi rgya mtsho chen po ( 60 /thas 10 000thab rkiyo 9)brtol te mtsho bzhud byed mkhan byung med/ 'on kyang / skabs der yo rob kyi mi skor zhig sa'i go la ril po yin par yid ches pas/ nub phyogs nas nub mtsho chen mo brtol ba na shar phyogs su bsleb kyang srid snyam pa byung / yin na'ang skabs der kho tshos yo rob dang e sha ya'i bar du me gling ( 0110tha zaskyo5)skam sa chen pos bcad yod pa mi shes so//dbyi tha li'i (1 ma7 rsāmalko1)gregiwe (00 0 tha༅smokhya༅)yi gru ba khu re thi)11ce 9tho'o/ma pa ( /chatshe'ilha'i)duspubasdo shazase(1gabasdo05duspudapha ༄ ༄ 95 13 0956 0015216 tsho smon byed cing / nub phyogs su bskyod nas nub mtsho chen mo brtol te shar phyogs su bgrod lhag par sla ba'i mtsho lam zhig btod 'dod skyes/ kho ni bal shad rgyag pa'i khyim rgyud cig tu skyes shing / mtsho bzhud la shin tu spro ba zhig yin la/ hphe gling nub khul gyi ki ne ya(051203 ༅la༅)dang sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar rgyud/ dbyin ji sogs la bslebs myong / kho blo spobs brtan zhing nyen mchong la spro bar ma zad/ thung myur du phyug por 'gyur ba'i rmi lam rmi mkhan zhig kyang yin/ khos mos pa chen po'i ngang nas mar kho pho lo (5tha 00 2010bralo yotsho)yi ljongs rgyu'i zin tho'i deb bshus ma bklags la zur mchan yang mang po btab myong / kho la shar phyogs su bgrod de rgyu nom 3btsal

'dod shin tu che ste/ kho'i nyin thor bris pa ltar na khos nyin mtshan re re bzhin dkon mchog la gser thon pa'i sa khul zhig btsal ba'i gsol ba btab zer/ kho yang sa'i go ril bo yin par yid ches shing / rgya mtsho brgal ba na ‘8zhim rdzas dang nor bu sna tshogs phyur bur thon sa'i rgyal khab tu bsleb thub par ’ 'dod pas/ snga rabs pa rnams bgrod ma myong ba'i lam zhig btod rgyu'i blo thag bcad do// kho nub mtsho chen mo ru thengs du mar tshod lta'i tshul du bzhud bskyod byas/ 1483lor/ kho lum pu yis phor thi'u gal gyi rgyal po jon sku rabs gnyis pa (/05ba khya tram̐gi༅ngatsho)la rogs skyor gnang rgyu'i snyan skul zhus/ jon sku rabs gnyis pa ni shin tu g.yo thabs can zhig yin pas/ ngos thog nas kho lum pu yi gtam la yid mi ches khul byas shing / lkog nas phor thi'u 2la rang gi gru gzings ru khag rgyang skyod byed du bcug mod/'on kyang rgya mtshor bskyod nas ring po ma song bar gru ba rnams srog 'chor bar skrag ste gyen rgol byas pas ded dpon gyis kyang gzings kha phyir mi bsgyur thabs med byung ngo //kho lum pu phor thi'u skal nas gdong thug phog rjes/ khos si phen (39tha1ba yolkopo)gyi rgyal po hpher ti nan sku rabs gnyis pa (20 61ba3sa6 khu༅7ongatsho)dang btsun mo la rgyab rogs zhus la/ rgyal po dang btsun mor phul ba'i 'phrin yig tu 88gser ni mi rnams ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i dngos po zhig yin te/ su zhig la de yod pa na rang gi ci 'dod thams cad dbang du 'du bar nus/ gser yod pa na/ rnam shes lha khams su skyel yang nus so mi zhes bris yod/ kyag kyog du ma zhig brgyud mthar/ kho'i chos lugs la 'dzin pa'i spro mos dang mi gshis kyis btsun mo'i yid drangs pa la brten nas/mthar rgyal po'ang kho lum pur rgyab skyor byed rgyur 'thad du bcug pa dang /4

re ba'i 'od snang shar ro// 1492lo'i zla 10tshes 11nyin gyi dgong mor/ kho lum pu yis rgyang thag ring po na gsal la mi gsal ba'i me 'od 'phro ba mthong /phyi nyin zhogs par/ so stegs kyi gru bas glo bur du ‘8skam sa/ skam sa nya zhes 'ur brgyab byung / skya rengs kyi 'od snang rab rib ngogs kho tsho gling phran zhig gi steng du phyin la/ der ‘8zal lba tor rta (5tha153607 carṣalayo7)zhes btags/ de ni deng skabs kyi bha ha ma gling tshom (3'i537ཿ ༅khyabra9yi)gyi wa thi len gling phran (8juṅgersharnyekhriyam̐)zhes pa de yin/ mtsho bskyod thengs der nyin bdun cu 'gor/ de nas cung ngal gsos rjes/ kho tsho mu mthud du lho bskyod byas te deng skabs kyi khu pa (056'i 11 ༅)dang he thi (521 1 nyonayo'i)la bslebs/ kho tshos rgya gar du bslebs byung ngo snyam nas sa de'i sdod mi la 88dbyin ti an pa ’ (1ba613ba khyalozom)zhes btags/ don dngos thog de nas da dung rgya gar la lam thag ring po yod mod/ 'on kyang nor 'khrul gyi ming de da lta'i bar du rgyun 'byams byung ba 'di yang lo rgyus kyi bshul rjes shig tu bltas chog go/ phyis su de ni yo rob pa rnams 'gro ma myong ba'i skam sa gzhan zhig yin pa shes rjes da gzod gsar du rnyed pa'i sa gnas de la ‘ hin rdu gling tshom nub ma ’ zhes btags te/ shar phyogs kyi rgya gar dngos dang khyad par phyes so//rjes su ches che ba'i gru gzings 88san me re'u ’ rtags can bye mar zug ste mu mthud rgya mtshor bskyod thabs bral bas/ kho lum pu yis mi skor zhig gling phran srung du bzhag ste rang nyid kyis lhag ma rnams khrid nas gru gzings chung ba gnyis la bsdad de/ gser dang sring bal/ 'dab chags dkon po dang sder chags ya mtshan can khyer zhing / lus la ris rtags bkod pa'i dbyin ti an pa gnyis khrid de/ 1493lo'i zla 3par si phen la phyir 'byor/6

khos rgyal po hpher ti nan dang btsun mo gnyis la hin rdu gling tshom rnyed tshul snyan seng zhus/ phyis su/ 1493lo dang 1498lo/ 1502lo bcas kho thengs gsum la me gling du song zhing / mi ser spel mkhan dang nyen mchong pa mang po zhig kyang kho dang lhan du bskyod/ 1502lo'i thengs der khos da dung rang gi bu gnyis kyang khrid la/ mu mthud du krung go dang rgya gar la bgrod pa'i mtsho lam btsal 'dod skyes/ 1504lor thengs bzhi par me gling la bzhud bskyod byas nas phyir log pa na kho lum pu la nad lci mos phog shing / 1506lo'i zla 5par tshe las 'das la/ skabs der rang lo 55yin /kho lum pu yi rgyang bzhud la grub 'bras byung ba des yo rob hril bor grags 'gul chen po byung zhing / mtsho skyod pa lhag par mang po zhig gi spro ba rgyas su bcug phor thi'u gal gyi gru ba lba si kho tā ga ma (5ཿ00 62 63yothaḥ༅pho ca oṃphyo)zhes pa 1497lor yo rob dang gyes te me gling lho ma'i kha dro gling zur (0390 01 rtsa006 5090 yiṇalha3po)bskor nas hin rdu rgya mtsho (10613ba0003ba goṭha ཿ)brtol te/ 1498lor rgya gar du 'byor/ de'i rjes su phor kho lum pu/thi'u gal gyis rgya gar gyi ko a (003 shirgo khu1)zhes pa ru kho pa tsho'i shar phyogs kyi ches snga ba'i mi ser spel yul btsugs/ 7

1499lo nas 1502lo'i bar/ dbyi tha li'i hphu lo ren si'i (ba10 6sa00oṃtshokhyarṣa)ming la a me ri khu wes si phu chi (azalko1po calostsarsha)zer ba zhig kyang si phen gyi skam sa gsar 'tshol byed du 'gro mkhan khrod zhugs shing /kho phyir log rjes 'grul bzhud zin tho zhig bris pa de par du bskrun rjes yo rob tu dar khyab chen po byung / kho ni skam sa gsar pa dpe char 'bri mkhan thog ma yin pas skam sa gsar pa de'i ming la yang ‘4a me ri kha ’ thogs shing /bsdus ming la ‘ me gling ’ zer ro//yo rob pa rnams kyis me gling skam sa chen po de a she ya ma yin pa'i skam sa gsar pa zhig yin pa ni/ me je lan (70161 3sa6 5thartsa053ba chosto1lo〉)dang kho'i bzhud grogs tshos sa'i go lar skor ba zhig brgyab pa'i rjes su da gzod yongs su rtogs pa yin no// me je lan gyis 1519lor si phen nas nub bskyod byed mgo brtsams te/ nub mtsho chen mo brtol zhing / me gling lho ma bskor la/ zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po yang brtol nas e sha ya'i hphi li phen (ba6111991sa03ཿཿza)la 'byor/ me je lan rang nyid gling phran de'i yul mis bsad la/ bzhud grogs tsho mu mthud nub bskyod byas/ kho tsho dka' sdug sna tshogs la 'phrad kyin hin rdu rgya mtsho brtol zhing kha dro gling zur bskor nas hphe gling mtsho rgyud ded de/ 1522lor gzhi nas phyir si phen la log thub pa byung / me je lan dang bzhud grogs dag gis sa'i go lar skor ba gcig brgyab pa'i mtsho bzhud des lag len gyi steng nas sa'i go la ril bo yin pa'i bshad tshul la bden dpang byas so//kho lum pu yis skam sa chen po gsar rnyed byung ba zhes pa ni/ yo rob kyi mis sngon chad me gling la cha rgyus ci yang med pa'i ngos nas bshad pa zhig yin/don dngos thog kho lum pu me gling du ma bslebs pa'i sngon du'ang me gling skam 8

sa chen po ru snga mo nas sa gnas de'i yul mi dbyin ti an pa 'tsho gzhis byas yod la/ kho tshos gna' bo'i rig gnas 'od stong ldan pa zhig kyang gsar bskrun byas yod/ yo rob kyi mi me gling gi mi dang 'brel gtug 'byung lo ni 1492lo yin zhes brjod na shin tu 'tsham po 'dug kyang / nga tshos 'dir 88gsar rnyed ’ ces pa'i tha snyad 'di spyad pa ni goms srol gyi dbang du byas te lo rgyus kyi brjod stangs shig spyad pa tsam yin no//me gling skam sa chen mo gsar rnyed byung tshul de dus rabs 18pa'i dkyil nas bzung nub gling gi mkhas pa rnams kyis gleng mgo brtsams la/ kho lum pu ni me gling du slebs mkhan thog ma min kyang srid de/ mi la las dus rabs 10dang 11pa'i skabs su/ yo rob byang ma'i si khan ti no we'u (bya03ba6123518skoyo41yosmo6rdzokhri12) yi mtsho jag ke run lan (0 1 6 81〉〉 ༅))la sna —— 1saspre'u)(55sdus /spro 1khu —55pabaslebs myong yod de/ skabs der de'i ming la win lan ḍi (rsā༅)zer zhes brjod pa dang / mi la las ches thog mar me gling rnyed mkhan ni rgya gar gyi btsun pa zhig yin zer ba dang / er lan kyi (1101thab6 tshopo༅)mi yis er lan kyi dka' thub pa zhig dus rabs 7pa'i sngon la nub mtsho chen mor bzhud bskyod byed skying srid do zhes zer/ nga tsho'i krung go'i mkhas pa yang bgro gleng der zhugs te/ mkhas pa la las dus rabs 5pa'i skabs su krung go'i btsun pa nyes hrin (hrūlko)zhes hphu sang (ṣṭha4)du bzhud myong zer la/ hphu sang ni da lta'i mo zhi kho ( 0 100 ༅lo6)yin no// rtsod gleng thengs de shin tu dza drag che bas mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi gleng stegs su'ang thon/ 1982lo'i zla 12par/ si phen dang a ri sogs rgyal khab sum cu lhag gis 1992lo ni kho lum pus me gling gsar rnyed byung ste lo 'khor lnga brgya lon pa'i rjes dran nyin mo yin par bsgrags rgyu'i gros gzhi'i phyi mo zhig bton/ er laṭwāṃ dang

'khyags gling (10013ba6 oṃyam̐)sogs rgyal khab skor zhig kho lum pu la me gling rnyed mkhan thog ma'i mtshan snyan 'dogs rgyur 'thad pa ma byung / don dngos thog me gling la thog dang por slebs mkhan gyi mtshan snyan rtsod pa'i bgro gleng dang kho lum pus 88skam sa gsar ba rnyed pa'i mi bar 'brel ba chen po med de/ rgyu mtshan ni kho lum pu'i sngon gyi mtsho bzhud gang zhig gis kyang shugs rkyen rgya chen po zhig thebs myong med la/ kho lum pu yi mtsho bzhud des da gzod 'dzam gling la shugs rkyen shin tu chen po thebs pa yin te/des mi rnams kyi mig rgya bskyed cing sa rgyus kyi don spyi gsar ba zhig grub la/yo rob skam sa dang me gling skam sa 'brel du bcug pa dang / de las 'dzam gling hril bo'ang 'brel du bcug de nas bzung me gling dang / ya gling / hphe gling gi mi ser spel ba'i 'phrog rtsod kyi mgo bslangs shing / de las tshong las dang bzo las/ mtsho bzhud kyi las sgo bcas la 'phel rgyas chen po byung ste/'dzam gling gi tshong ra grub pa bcas kyis so// 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉du'ang / ‘4me gling gsar rnyed dang hphe gling bskor ba'i mtsho bzhud kyis/ gsar dar gyi 'byor ldan gral rim la las sgo spel ba'i sa khongs gsar ba bskyed ’ ces bkod pa ltar yin la/ gong smros 'di dag thams cad kyis/nyams rgud du 'gro bzhin pa'i bkas bkod spyi tshogs nang khul gyi gsar brje'i grub cha la'ang 'phel rgyas mgyogs po 'byung du bcug go/ 10

la/ nyen 'tshe de'i tshabs chen rang bzhin ni kho tsho'i blo yul las 'gongs so//'dir nga tshos thog mar dngos su byung ba'i gtam rgyud cig 'chad par bya/si phen gyi mi ser spel mkhan me gling lho ma'i sa khul du spos nas ring po ma 'gor bas/ kho tshos me gling lho ma na ‘ gser gyi rgyal khams ’ shig yod tshul thos la/ de'i gtsug lag khang ni gser gyi rdza g.yam dang gser gyi so phag las grub cing / rgyal pos mnabs pa ni gser leb kyis spras pa'i gser lwa yin la phebs byams kyang gser las grub pa yin tshul gyi ngag rgyun thos/ngag rgyun des si phen gyi mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs pa rnams 'gram chu ldang zhing sdod thabs med par gyur te/ tshe srog gi nyen tshabs la'ang mi 'dzem par ngo mtshar zhing lkog gyur gyi 8 gser gyi rgyal khams ’ de 'tshol 'dod skyes/1528lor mi ser spel mkhan phis sa lo (7 3 01300 21231 0 tshorṣatsho)yis g.yor gru gsum khrid nas phe ru (90go rko 4hāzlo)byang phyogs kyi thong pe si (15 ༅3 skyoyo76)la 'byor/ phis sa lo gnas de'i yul nyams la shin tu ya mtshan par gyur/ rgyu mtshan ni yul de'i lha khang rnams gzab rgyas che la/ga sa gar ldebs gdan khra bo dang gser 'dzar bkal yod pas/ ngag rgyun gyi gser gyi rgyal khams dang mtshungs pas so// de ni dbyin ti yan pa'i yan lag cig ste/ dbyin ka btsan rgyal (1ba03 ༅491 0 ༅mekhyalo1༅)gyi mnga' khongs yin/ skabs der dbyin ka btsan rgyal gyi dbang sgyur mnga' khongs deng skabs kyi phe ru dang kri li/ (06110 ljolko/) sgolilbi ya/ (3011sa1 tha yoyilko1ཿ༅) okhoḍor (༅00360 khyaloza7)sogs su bskyed yod/ phis sa lo dbyin ku'i mi la nang rgyus med pas dus yun nges can zhig nang rang mos ci 'dod byed ma phod/1532lo'i zla 9par/ phis sa lo yis dbyin ka btsan rgyal nang khul du 12

phu nu gnyis kyis rgyal po'i go sa brtsad pa las nang 'khrug byung tshul shes pas/zla 11par mi nyis brgya lhag dang / dmag rta nga bzhi khrid cing / me spyogs gnyis thogs nas phe ru'i nang khul du phyin te dbyin ga'i rgyal por mjal zhu byas par/ rgyal po gsar ba a tha hāl pha ( tha65793 a1thoyolo khri)yis mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu byas/ phis sa lo yis snga mo nas skung dmag bkod sgrig gis dbyin ga'i rgyal po phebs par bsgug zla 11pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi phyi drod/ dbyin ga'i rgyal po gser leb kyis yongs su spras pa'i 'gyogs byams su srung dmag gis bskor gyin thang chen zhig la thon pa na/ si phen gyi chos spel mkhan zhig gis sngun bsun te 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉bkrugs nas dbyin ku'i rgyal po gnam bdag la dad dgos par gdams tshe/ dbyin ga'i rgyal pos 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉tshur blangs nas/ 88ngas gnam sa skrun mkhan gyi mi dang ye shu zer ba mi shes la/ nga tsho'i yod tshad ni nyi mas gnang ba yin pa kho na shes ’nyazhes lan btab cing / nyi ma ston gyin 88nga yi mgon skyabs ni rtag brtan yin ’’zhes brjod rjes/ 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉sa la dor/ phis sa lo yis bslu brid byed mi nus par mthong rjes lag phyis dkar po zhig g.yob pa na/ phyogs bzhi'i skung dmag gis rub rgol byas pas/ de ma nyid du thang chen hril bo ru mtshon gyi rngam 'od dang gsod sgras khengs par gyur/ gshis drang pa'i dbyin ka pa rnams la gra sgrig ci yang med pas/ glo bur gyi 'jab rgol des ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas zang zing lang long du gyur la/ rang gi rgyal po srog bsdos kyi srung / skabs der me mda' grags byung bas/ dbyin ka pa la la sar 'gyel zhing la la dngangs skrag gis phyogs bzhir 'thor/ phis sa lo yis skabs de dang bstun nas dbyin ga'i rgyal po bzung ste mi gta' ru btsan nyar byas/ 13

dbyin ku'i rgyal pos rang nyid phyir blu ched/ gser gyis kho btson du 'jug sa'i khang pa de bkang rgyu dang / dngul gyis logs kyi khang pa gnyis bkang rgyur khas blangs/ kho'i mnga' 'bangs rnams kyis lo ngo phyed lhag la 'bad pa byas nas/ pho brang dang sa gnas so so'i lha khang gi gser dngul gyi bang mdzod dang / gser dngul gyi rgyan cha/ gser dngul gyi mchod rdzas dbor skyel byas mthar/ khang pa gsum po de da gzod gang thub pa byung /1533lo'i zla 6tshes 13nyin gyi zin bris ltar na/ dbyin ga'i rgyal sa khu si kha'o (00200 sgolo༈4)gcig pu'i dbyin ga'i mi rnams nas gser khal ④nyis brgya dang / dngul khal nyer lnga bskyal yong /zol med kyi dbyin ga'i rgyal pos rang gi kha dan 'grub par byas na/ kho rang phyir gtong bar snyam mod/ 'on kyang g.yo sgyu dang gtum drag che ba'i mi ser spel mkhan gyi mi rgyud dkar po rnams kyis kha bshad don la mi gnas pa'i sgo nas kho pa bsad/ de'i rjes su phis sa lo yis skabs glags dang bstun nas dbyin ku'i rgyal sa blangs/ dbyin ga'i mi rnams kyis jag tshogs de dag gi gtum spyod gsal rjen du mthong rjes ngo rgol mtha' 'khyol byas te ches mtha' ma'i mi de 'chi reg tu 'thab la/ mi ser spel mkhan rnams la rdung rdeg tsha nan btang / yin na'ang mjug mthar spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas da dung tshad dma' mor gnas pa'i khar/ mtshon cha rjes lus yin pa dang / stobs shugs tha thor yin pa'i rkyen gyis dbyin ka btsan rgyal nub par gyur ro//me gling lho ma'i dbyin kya'i mi yi las skal ni me gling hril bo'i dbyin ti an pa'i las skal gyi bsdus gzugs shig yin/ dbyin ti an pa'i tsho sde ① khal gcig ni mi zhig gi khur nus pa'i ljid tshad do/14

gzhan dag la'ang de mtshungs kyi las skal myong ste/ dper na ye ro khu'i mi (1 0zhwa0013 skya༈slom ma)dang / mā ya'i mi(5tha7ཿ poḥm)/ a zi the khi'i mi( 2 00bya ༅polkom〉)/ chi khru ya'i mi (rsha༅༅ma)sogs lta bu yin zhing /la la de las kyang ya nga bar 'dug me gling byang ma'i dbyin ki lan ḍi (༅brtsa1thas6 ༅ṣṭha༅)gsar ba'i mi ser spel mkhan dbang 'dzin pas dbyin ti an pa'i klad skogs phyes pa'am mi dmar po zhig 'dzin thub pa byung na dbyin pung bzhi bcu'i bya dga' yod pa'i bsgrags yig bkram la/ rjes su dbyin pāng brgya dang / brgya dang nyi shu la 'phar snon btang / mi ser spel mkhan la las 'dzin bzung byas pa'i dbyin ti an pa bud shing steng bzhag nas gson sreg byed pa'am shi bo'i mgo lpags dmar bshu byas/ me gling byang ma'i dbyin ti an pa'i mgo pa zhig mi ser spel mkhan gyis bzung rjes mgo bo bcad de khrom ston byas la/ phyis su chos spel mkhan zhig gis kho'i mgal rus blangs te dran rten bzos/ yo rob kyi mi ser spel mkhan gyi ya nga ba'i dmar gsod kyis dbyin ti an pa'i mi grangs ches cher nyung du phyin/ tshod brtsis byas pa ltar na lo ngo de dag tu dmar gsod btang ba'i mi grangs khri phrag chig stong nyis brgya'am khri phrag chig stong lnga brgya lhag yod/ mi rgyud dkar po ma bslebs pa'i sngon la he khri na dbyin ti an pa khri phrag drug lhag yod la/1548lor bslebs tshe mi lnga brgya tsam las lhag med pa dang / khi'u bha dang ca me kha'i (1thayo3103po༅7khya)dbyin ti an pa ha lam rtsa med du gyur/ a me ri kha na lus yod pa'i dbyin ti yan pa rnams mtha' 'khob kyi ra zur bzhag sa khul ’ du bskrad de sdogs rgyud rtsa med du gtong nye bar gtugs shing / 'dzin bzung thebs pa'i dbyin ti an pa skor zhig bran g.yog tu gyur ro//de ltar/ lo ngo mang po ma phyin par rang dbang can gyi me gling skam sa 15

chen po de yo rob pa'i mi ser spel yul du gyur te/ me gling lho ma ni si phen dang phor thi'u gal gyis bzung ba dang / me gling byang ma gtso cher dbyin ji dang hpha ran sis bzung ngo // yo rob kyi mi ser spel mkhan tshos dbyin ti an pa'i rgyal khab nyams 'thor dang / grong khyer bcom brlag mi rigs rtsa med du 'gro nyer gtugs pa'i dus mtshungs su/ kho pa tshos me gling nas gser dngul nom rdzas gru gzings re re bzhin dbor 'dren byas/ sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ 1521lo nas 1544lo'i bar si phen gyi gru gzings ru khag gis me gling nas lo rer cha snyoms gser spyi rgya nyis stong dgu brgya dang / 1545lo nas 1560lo'i bar lo rer cha snyoms gser spyi rgya lnga stong lnga brgya dbor 'dren byas/ me gling nas 'phrog 'dren byas pa'i dngul ni de las kyang mang ste/ si phen gcig pus kyang dus rabs gsum gyi dus yun nang dngul spyi rgya dung phyur gcig 'phrog song ngo // dus rabs 16pa gcig pu'i nang du/ yo rob la mnga' ba'i gser de spyi rgya lnga khri lnga stong nas spyi rgya khri phrag bcu gnyis la 'phar/dngul lor gyi sgyu mas bslu skul byas par brten yo rob kyi 'byor ldan pa rnams mi ser spel mkhan zhes pa'i 'khrab ston pa zhig gi ngang tshul du lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su 'gos so//yo rob kyi mi ser spel mkhan gyis ya nga snying rje med pa'i sgo nas dbyin ti an pa dmar gsod btang mod/ 'on kyang des dbyin ti an pas gsar gtod byas pa'i tshad mtho ba'i dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon med brlag tu gtong ga la nus/ deng dus kyang 'dzam gling gi sa khul so sor dar mched che la/ mi'i rigs yongs༅ dbang zhing longs spyod du che ba'i sring bal dang / shing mngar/ zhog khog ma rmos lo tog khi khu/ kha'o hphe/kro ma kru ( 018 0ma༅oṃ)sogs lo tog bcu phrag 'ga' ni dbyin ti an pa 16

rnams kyis dus yun ring po brgyud de ri skyes skye dngos khrod nas gso spel byas pa yin/ mā ya'i mi yis 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten de e cib (༅phya79 ṣṭhalo)kyi gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi do zlar nus pa zhig yin/ kho tsho'i dus tshod brtsi stangs thad kyang 44klad gor nya gyi don spyi spyad yod la/ de yo rob pa dag las lo ngo brgya phrag lhag gis snga/ kho tshos skar ma pa sangs brtsi lugs kyi lo rtsis la nor 'khrul chung ba ha las pa'i tshad du bslebs yod/ dbyin ga'i mis lo rtsis nges tshad ni skabs de'i yo rob pa las da dung zhib tshags chen po yin/ pe ru'i cha wen (05351 ba nga4 zo༅)sde ba'i rgyab ngos kyi ri tshogs khrod du da dung spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 1500nas spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 1000bar gyi rdo'i bzo bkod 'gying nger mchis la/ der rngam brjid shin tu chen po ldan/ rdo ngos kyi rko bzhengs zhib tshags che zhing snang brnyan la gson nyams ldan/ cha wen gyi shul rjes khrod/ mi rnams kyis da dung gna' bo'i dbyin ti an pa rnams kyis skar rtsis zhib 'jug byed mgo brtsams yod pa shes thub/ mdor na/ krung go'i gna' dpyad mkhas pa zha ne (za༅)yis ‘4gna' bo'i cha wen rig gnas kyis mi la ngo mtshar bskyed do ’ zhes gsungs pa ji bzhin no//mā ya'i mi yi gtor gzugs mchod rten/

yin na'ang / de lta bu'i gna' bo'i rig gnas dang ldan pa'i dbyin ti an mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rgyun ldan gyi mdun lam ni dus rabs 15pa'i mjug dang dus rabs 16pa'i skabs su yo rob kyi btsan 'dzul pas de ltar ya nga ba'i sgo nas dum bur bcad do// de ni lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su ma rtsa ring lugs thog mar 'dzeg skabs me gling skam sa chen por bsnams pa'i 6 legs skyes ’’ red/ de na des hphe gling skam sa chen por bsnams pa ni yang snying ci zhig yin nam zhe na/ hphe gling skam sa chen po'i ya nga ba'i gnas tshul ni gsham du brjod par 'gyur ro//

gsum pa/ the gling gi mi nag me gling du slebs pa/a me ri khar rgyug shin tu che ba'i dpe cha 〈〈cod pa 〉〉zhes pa zhig par du bskrun myong la/ de ni rtsom pa po a li khi si ha li (khu1sto/11146 ṣā21)rang nyid kyi mi rabs bdun gyi khyim rgyud lo rgyus rgyab ljongs byas te/ mi nag cig gis dka' nyen mang du myangs nas rang nyid kyi khyim rgyud btsal zhing / kho'i mes po ni bran g.yog cig yin pa dang / pha yul gyi rtsad pa ni hphe gling gi gam peya ( 60 03461tha ༅ khukhu༅)yin par rtogs pa'i myong brgyud de gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas bkod cing / rtsom rig gi rnam pas me gling mi nag gi dka' sdug gi lo rgyus yang bskyar mtshon yod do// des na mi nag khri phrag mang po ji ltar rgya mtsho brgal nas me gling du bslebs pa yin zer na/ de yang yo rob pas rang dbang ldan pa'i me gling skam sa chen po de mi ser spel yul du bsgyur ba'i dus rabs de la phyir 'ded dgos so//yo rob kyi mi ser spel mkhan rnams me gling skam sa chen po 'byor nas ring po ma 'gor bar/ skam sa chen po de sa rgya che ba'i khar da dung sa bcud 'dzoms pas/ shing mngar dang rdo tha/ sring bal sogs rin thang che ba'i son las la 'tshams pa shes par ma zad/ phar tsir (3 tha211 ༅yo)dang / mo zhi kho (50zo100 chayopo) phe ru sogs nas gser gter chen po dang dngul gter chen po bstud mar rnyed pas/ yo rob kyi nyen mchong pa rnams sbrang nag sha la 'khor ba ltar gser sngog 'don la brten nas 'byor phyug rgyas ched dang /'debs 'dzags ra ba chang nga nas che ru bskyed pa'i ched du/ mgyogs myar rag ri ba zirab 18) ra me

ngang me gling hril bor khyab la/ lhing 'jags kyi skam sa de skad cig ring 'ur zing du btang / 'on kyang / mi ser spel mkhan rnams ring po ma thogs par dka' khag cig la 'phrad pa ni/ ngal rtsol nus shugs ches cher dkon pa de yin/ de bas kho pa tshos gtum drag la brten nas ngal rtsol nus pa thob thabs byas te/ yo rob nub mar snga mo nas rtsa med du btang zin pa'i bran g.yog lam lugs de me gling nas slar gso byas/ thog mar sdug la sbyar ba ni sa de ga'i dbyin ti an pa yin mod/ 'on kyang dbyin ti an pa dpa' snying che zhing drag shugs ldan pas bran khol mi 'khur ba'i khar/ mi grangs mang shos rtsa med du btang zin pas/ bran g.yog gi yong khungs la dka' khag byung /de'i phyir yo rob kyi mi ser spel yul mkhan rnams kyis g.yo ham gyi mig mdangs hphe gling skam sar gtad de/ hphe gling shar nub nas bran nag 'bor chen me gling du tshong 'dren byas/hphe gling ni yo rob pas 8 rnyed pa'i ’ skamu sa chen po gsar pa ni gtan nas ma yin te/ gdod ma'i dus skabs dang dus rabs bar ma'i (506165ma907106 8tsho༅)skabs su'ang de dang 'dzam gling la 'brel ba rgya chen po yod/hphe gling shar mar snga shos su 'byor mkhan ni a rab pa ( cha1thab layo4khrim)dang rgya gar ba yin/ dus rabs bar ma'i tshe/ krung go ba rgyun chad med par hphe gling shar ma'i mtsho rgyud du bslebs/ de ga'i gna' dpyad 'tshol sngog las krung go'i sung dang yon/ ming / ching bcas rgyal rabs skabs kyi rdza chas 'bor chen rnyed pas/ phyi rgyal gyi gna' dpyad pa zhig gis ‘8dus rabs bar ma'i hphe gling shar khul gyi lo rgyus de krung go'i rdza chas kyis bris yod ces brjod rung ngo ’ zhes bshad pa ltar yin/ hphe gling nub mar mtshon na/ sā ha ra bye thang (53687thalo677/ ༅)gi bar chod yod pas phyi khul dang 'gro 'ong cung 20

nyung / yin na'ang de gser thon pa'i cha nas skad grags shin tu che bas/ a rab kyi chong ba skor zhig gis tshong ru rtsa 'dzugs byas te dka' nyen la mi 'dzem par bye thang chen po 'phred kyis bcad nas der song ste tshong gnyer/dus rabs 10pa'i skabs su/ gag na (058batha mekhriwa)sogs hphe gling nub ma'i rgyal khab tu da dung 88mi smra ba'i nyo tshong ’ rgyug che ste/ de'i gnas tshul rags tsam brjod na/ tshong ba tshong rgyag sar song ste/ rang gi tshong zog dang ras yug cig thang la bsham ste gyes 'gro/ de nas mi nag gis gser khyer yong nas tshong zog gi logs su bzhag nas gyes rjes/ tshong ba slar tshong zog gi 'gram du song ste gser khyer nas 'gro ba ni nyo tshong grub pa'i rtags yin la/gal te tshong zog gi bdag pos gser nyung bar bsam na kho yang bskyar phyir gyes 'gro zhing mi nag slar yong nas gser bsnan te tshong grub par byed do//'grim 'grul gyi gegs rkyen gyis snga dus kyi yo rob pa dang hphe gling gi 'brel 'dris ni kri pu rol tho mtsho 'gag (bya 01 0161ma 3 zo.oṃ༅khya6loḥ)gis bar du chod kyin yo rob la kha gtad pa'i hphe gling byang ma'i 'gram rgyud tsam du zad la/ kho tsho hphe gling shar ma dang / lho ma/ nub mar 'byor ba'i dus tshod ni cung 'phyi ba yin/dus rabs 15pa'i tshe/ phor thi'u gal gyi stobs shugs hphe gling nub rgyud du bskyed mgo brtsams/ tā ga ma yis kha dro gling zur bskor te rgya gar la slebs thub pa rtogs rjes su/ phor ju ghal gyi stobs shugs hphe gling shar dang lho dang nub tu'ang mched par gyur/ de'i rjes su ho lan (༅05thab6 lo༅)dang / si phen/ hpha ran se/ dbyin ji sogs kyi mi gcig rjes gnyis mthud du yong ste hphe gling gi mtsho rgyud du rang rang gi nyo tshong gnas gzhi btsugs/dang thog yo rob kyi mi'i dmigs sa gtso bo ni gser thob pa dang / de'i 'phro 21

nyo tshong ba'i lag nas sdeb nyo byed par gyur la/ dang thog tshong pa dang thun mong rtsa 'dzugs re 'gas tshong 'dren byed pa de phyis su rgyal khab kyi bran g.yog ched gnyer nyo tshong kung sis rtsa 'dzugs byed par gyur te/ dper na/ dbyin ji'i gong ma tshang gi hphe gling kung si dang / hpha ran se'i hin rdu nub ma'i kung si lta bu'o//yo rob kyi bran g.yog nyo tshong ba rnams kyis bran g.yog lhag par mang po zhig thob ste me gling gi dgos mkho dang 'tsham po yong ched/ rgyun chad med par bran g.yog 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug bslangs/ hphe gling gi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas ni do snyoms po zhig gtan nas min/ skabs der/ hphe gling nub dang shar gyi sa khul shin tu mang po zhig da dung bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs dus rim du gnas/ hphe gling rang sa'i bran g.yog mang shos ni rmo 'debs pa dang lag shes bzo las pa/ khyim g.yog dmag mi'am yang na mtshun rdzas byed pa tsam las ma 'das/ nub mtsho chen mo'i bran g.yog nyo tshong dar rgyas byung ba yis bran g.yog ni shin tu rgyug che zhing khe spogs mtho ba'i tshong zog cig tu gyur/ de bas/ tsho ba dang tsho ba'i bar bran g.yog 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug shin tu mang po byung / bran g.yog 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug byung yul du/ sde ba re re byas nas rtsa med du song zhing / sde mi rnams yang na gson bzung dang yang na gsod pa las gzhan med par gyur ro// skabs der hphe gling gi nang logs nas mtsho rgyud sa khul du bgrod pa'i lam du ga sa gar 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul ya nga ba zhig mthong bar 'gyur te/mdun du lam khrid pa dang / de'i phyi rgyab tu bran g.yog gi bstar phreng ring po zhig 'gro la/ kho tsho bran g.yog bdag pos thag pas star gcig tu bcings yod la/ mgo thog tu ba so dang bza' bca' sogs bzhag yod pa dang /23

gral phreng gi mjug tu 'gro mkhan ni drag chas yongs su spras pa'i bran g.yog tshong 'dren pa yin/ mtsho 'gram gyi yo rob bran g.yog nyo tshong gnas gzhi ru slebs pa na/ bran g.yog dang ba so rnams bran g.yog nyo tshong ba gzhan dag la 'tshong bar byed/ yo rob kyi bran g.yog nyo tshong pa dag gis ba so la ba so dkar po dang / hphe gling gi bran nag la 6‘ba so nag po ’ 'am yang na ‘ shing nag ’ ces smad do// kho pa tsho'i snang ngor/ bran g.yog dang ba so/ shing cha rnams rang nyid kyi tshong zog dang rgyu nom yin pa 'dra mtshungs su 'dzin no//88shing nag ’ nyar gsog byed ched/ yo rob kyi bran g.yog nyo tshong pas hphe gling gi mtsho rgyud du bran 'jug mkhar rdzong re re bzhin bskrun yod de/ hphe gling nub ma'i mtsho rgyud gcig pur yang de lta bu'i mkhar rdzong lnga bcur nye ba zhig bskrun yod/ nang khul nas 'phrog thob byas pa'i bran g.yog rnams der bsdu bcug byas rjes/ nub mtsho chen mo'i phar 'gram du dbor 'dren byed do//bran 'jug mkhar rdzong ni mi yul gyi dmyal khams yin te/ ya nga ba'i snang tshul la mig gis lta mi bzod pa zhig yin/ deng sang hphe gling mtsho rgyud na da dung skabs der 88shing nag ’ btson 'jug byed sa'i bran 'jug mkhar rdzong mang du mthong rgyu yod/ de'i nang nas sen kyal (5003lo ཿlome0lo)gyi wer te gling zur (03༅ 50166 oṃ1byu6)na yod pa'i sgo re gling phran (00 60༅ sproyi)gyi bran 'jug mkhar rdzong ni cung 'thus tshab rang bzhin can zhig yin te/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi slob gso tshan rig rig gnas rtsa 'dzugs kyis de dmigs bsal gyis srung skyob bya dgos pa'i 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus rig dngos kyi gras su bzhag bran g.yog btson 'jug byed sa'i btson khang ni mkhar rdzong rim pa 'og mar btsugs yod la/ skyes pa dang bud med/byis pa'i btson khang gsum du phyes yod/ pho bran btsong khang ni smis gnyis 24

dang phyed ga'i tshad du gru bzhi mar yod la khang pa re rer thengs rer bran g.yog bco lnga nas nyi shu 'jug rung zhing / kho tsho rkang sgrog dang bcas nyin mtshan med par sa rlon steng tsog 'dug dgos/ ‘ bu mo'i btson khang ’ la dri chu gtong sa'i sa dong zhig lhag mar yod cing / rgya yang cung che ste bu mo rnams kyi rin gong spyir btang gi bud med bran g.yog las mtho ba'i phyir ro// byis pa'i btson khang ni zheng tshad la smis gcig tsam yod pa'i khyams ring gi rnam pa can zhig yin la/ nyin gang bor nyi 'od mthong rgyu med par nya hra ting (7/ 1༅)dang 'dra bar gcig gcig la bcar te nyal dgos/ gzhan da dung 88tsho gsog khang ’nyazhig yod de/ ming de'i thog nas bran g.yog bdag pos bran g.yog dang dud 'gro gcig mtshungs su lta ba mngon par mtshon yod de/ nyo tshong khrod pho bran gyi lus ljid spyi rgya drug cu la bud na da gzod rin gong mthon po khugs pas/ ljid tshad mi long pa'i pho bran rnams tsho gsog khang du bcug ste tsho gso ga byed kyi zas khyad par can byin nas dus thung nang tshad ldan gyi ljid tshad du long thabs byed do// bran g.yog la rin gong gcod pa'i tshad gzhi ni/ pho bran gyi lus ljid sha stobs dang byis pa'i so/ mo bran gyi nu ma'i dbyibs la bltas te gong tshod gcod/ nam rgyun lus ljid spyi rgya drug cu can gyi pho bran zhig gam/ gnyen sgrig ma byas pa'i bu mo zhig chang zo ba gang la brje thub cing / byis pa zhig gis ngo lta'i me long tsam las mi khugs/ bran tshong ba rnams tshong 'grig rjes bran g.yog re re'e rkang lag bzhi'am yang na brang ngos su lcags sreg gis tham rtags btab ste kho tsho bdag po su la dbang ba mtshon pa dang / de nas kho tsho mtsho la gtad pa'i sgo dong nas g.yor gru'i steng ded de me gling la dbor 'dren byed/ skabs de'i g.yor gru bskyod pa la rlung dang chu yi rgyu phyogs kyis shugs rkyen gtong bas/ gser gyi mtsho rgyud nas shar phyogs 25

su bskyod pa'i gru gzings de mtsho rgyud ded nas hphe nan to po gling phran (༅tsheza༅khri) la thon rjes da gzod me gling du bskyod dgos/ bran skyel gru gzings mi nyung ba zhig lam de nas 'gro la/ lam de ni bran g.yog nyo tshong cung 'du che ba'i sa khul zhig kyang yin pas/ wol thi (50/ 0 yolo rsha)gtsang bo'i 'dres mdo nas lā ko si'i (23rtsa03 4kṣalo)bar gyi 'gram rgyud der 88bran g.yog mtsho 'gram ’ zer/ bran g.yog mtsho 'gram las gzhan da dung gser gyi mtsho 'gram dang ghi ni mtsho khug kyang bran g.yog nyo tshong shin tu dar che sa zhig yin/bran g.yog nyo tshong gis yo rob dang me gling / hphe gling bcas kyi spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor la shugs rkyen gting zab thebs/ me gling du/ bran nag rim bzhin du ngal rtsol nus shugs gtso bor gyur/ dper na/1645lor/ bhar bhe ḍo si'i (63 6tha603 ༅༅zalo)'debs 'dzugs ra ba la bran nag lnga stong drug brgya brgyad cu yod pa dang / cha snyoms zhing ra'i bdag po gnyis kyis bran nag gcig re bkol ba dang / 1667lor de ga'i bran nag brgyad khri nyis stong dang nyer gsum la 'phar te cha snyoms 'debs 'dzugs ra ba rer bran nag brgya dang bcu re yod/ lo ngo nyer gnyis nang bran nag ldab bcu bzhi 'phar/ bhar dzil gyi 88gser nag mkhar ’ gyis gser sngog 'don byas pa las dar rgyas su phyin zhing / mi 'bor khri nyer lnga'i khrod kyi khri lnga ni mi nag yin/ skabs de'i he khri la mtshon na/ mi 'bor khri nga gsum las khri zhe brgyad ni bran nag yin/ gal te bran g.yog gi ngal rtsol nus shugs med na me gling gi mi ser spel yul des yo rob la phan pa ci yang med do// de'i mtshungs su/ yo rob kyi rin thang ches che ba'i tshong rdzas shing mngar dang tha ma kha/ sring bal sogs kyang me gling gi mi ser spel yul la 26

brten dgos/ bran g.yog nyo tshong de yo rob spyi tshogs kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi phyogs so sor rag las yod/ des mtsho 'grul dang tshong las lhag par je rgyas su btang zhing / de las 'dzam gling gi nyo tshong yang byung ngo //'dzam gling gi nyo tshong ni bzo las chen po grub pa'i dgos nges kyi cha rkyen yin/mi mang po zhig gis bran g.yog nyo tshong ngam yang na bran g.yog rgya cher bkol nas 'debs 'dzags ra ba gnyer te 'dzam gling gi ches 'byor phyag can gyi raX/ga zi pa (1) chag rwar zingatsho char ra༅zi pa'atshosnaspyoragras su chud par byad/ kha lum pu bu ḍa ma kha lum pu zhas pa sang ba ta mang ko yi spyi dpon ( khyo ljo)la bsdad de/ bran g.yog nyo tshong dang 'debs 'dzugs ra chen gnyer ba la brten nas bran g.yog bdag po chen po zhig tu gyur/bran g.yog gi rngul khrag gzhibs te mgyogs myur rgyags por gyur pa'i 'byor ldan de dag gis chab srid dang gleng phyogs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar byed/dbyin ji'i jor je sku rabs gsum pa'i (000 50 khya lko chozatsho)skabs kyi dbu blon no si ( oṃ 4 )zhes pas/ 88yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so mang nyung ci rigs kyi sgo nas nyo tshong 'di rigs dang nyalam 'bral thabs med/ rgyal khab de dag la nyo tshong de rigs 'dor du 'jug gtan nas mi nus so ’ zhes brjod yod/ hpha ran si'i rgyal po lu'e zi bcu bzhi pas ( 0013 1 sa ༅skya/a)thad kur du dbu blon la 〈〈mi nag bca' khrims 〉〉'god du bcug ste bran g.yog nyo tshong la srung skyob byas/ skabs de'i chos tshogs ni bran g.yog bdag po'i g.yog por gyur yod de/ kho tshos bran g.yog 'dren tshong byas pa yis rnam shes la thar ba thob par mi gnod ces smra'o// si phen gyi chos gtsos thog drangs te 1517lor me gling la bran g.yog gtong rgyur chog mchan bkod la/meg si ko'i chos gtso dang pos kyang bran g.yog nyo tshong la rgyab skyo~X ༵ nus

bgyis/ shugs chen po'i sgo nas bran g.yog nyo tshong byed pa sgrog spel dang srung skyob/don gnyer byed mkhan gyi mi 'di dag la ci ltar brjod 'os sam zhe na/phyi rgyal gyi hphe gling lo rgyus smra ba zhig gis/ kho pa tsho ni 8 dngos gnas mi'i rigs lo rgyus steng gi ches ya nga bral ba'i gcan gzan red ’ ces brjod myong ngo //nub mtsho chen mo'i bran g.yog nyo tshong gis hphe gling la thebs pa'i ngan 'bras ni shin tu skyi g.ya' ba zhig yin/ des yun ha cang ring bo zhig gi nang hphe gling spyi tshogs kyi nang 'gal dza drag tu btang / rgyun chad med pa'i 'thab 'khrug gis sa khul mang po zhig nyams stongs su gyur/ bran g.yog nyo tshong gis da dung hphe gling bran g.yog lam lugs je sdug tu 'gro 〈〈rtsad pata〉bar shugs snon dang skul lcag byas la/ de las kyang tshabs che ba ni hphe gling gi mi grangs ches cher je nyung du btang / nub mtsho chen mo'i bran g.yog nyo tshong hril bo'i khrod du don dam hphe gling gi mi nag ga tsam zhig me gling du 'dren tshong byas sam zer na/ de la rgyal kha4so so'i mkhas pa rnams kyi tshod rtsis byed tshul mi 'dra bar ma zad/ tha na khyad par shin tu chen po yang yod pas/ nges gtan gyi tshod rtsis shig byed dka' bar snang / spyir btang khyon bsdoms ha lam bran nag khri phrag chig stong lnga brgya 'dren tshong byas par 'dod/ grangs ka 'di'i khrod bran g.yog ham thob kyi g.yul 'khrug khrod dang dbor 'dren gyi lam skabs su shi ba'i mi grangs ldab 'gyur gyis mang ba de dag 'dus med do//branagayog nyo tshong gis mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus deb ther steng ches ya nga ba'i shog lhe zhig bsnan/ yin na'ang des hphe gling dang me gling gi spyi tshogs 'tsho bar deng skabs kyi bar du'ang shugs rkyen zab mo thebs bzhin mchis so// 28

bzhi pa/ rgyal po'i bzhugs khri g.yo mgojartsams pa/me gling skam sa chen po rnyed pa dang / 'dzam gling gi mtsho lam gsar ba phyes pa/ gzhis sdod mi ser skor bcom byas pa/ nub mtsho chen mo'i bran g.yog nyo tshong la sogs pa gang zhig yin kyang / skabs de'i yo rob kyi nyen mchong ba rnams kyis rang rang tsho'i mnga' bdag gi dar cha sgreng gin bgyis pa yin/ kho pa tshos me gling dang hphe gling / ya gling bcas la tshur khyer 'ong ba ni gnod 'tshe bgrang las 'das pa yin la/ phar khyer song ba ni gser dngul rgyu nom bgrang las 'das pa yin/ yo rob kyi mnga' bdag rnams kyis 'bor che ba'i gser dngul rgyu nom yo rob tu rgyug yong ba dang pho brang la bskyal 'ong tshul de dga' spro'i ngang nas mthong ba'i skabs der/ kho pa tsho'i dbang sgyur gyi rmang gzhi'ang shes med tshor med ngang nyams 'thor du 'gro mgo brtsams pa dang / rgyal po'i bzhugs khri g.yo mgo brtsams tshul ni su zhig gis rtogs par nus/ yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur gral rim gyi gdong thad du gson nyams kun nas rgyas pa'i gsar byung gi 'byor ldan gral rim krong nger langs la/ ham par gang mtha' med pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag de dag lo rgyus kyi ldog lam du zhugs par gyur/yo rob mi ser spel mkhan gyis me gling dang hphe gling / ya gling bcas nas 'phrog pa'i gser dngul rgyu nom dang bran g.yog gi nyo tshong las thob pa'i ha las pa'i khe spogs kyis/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed la thog ma'i ma rtsa 'bor chen po gsog 'jog byas shing / mtsho lam gsar ba btod pa dang / 29

'dzam gling tshong ra rim bzhin grub pa yis bzo las chen po'i thon skyed la skul 'ded thebs/ ma rtsa ring lugs mgyogs myur dar ba'i dus mtshungs su/ yo rob la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur pa dag gi blo yul las 'das pa'i 'gyur ldog byung /thog mar/ ma gnas dma' ba'i gser dang dngul 'bor chen yo rob tu rgyug pa ④yis/ sngon gyi lo ngo brgya phrag du mar cung brtan chags yin pa'i dngos gong yang de bstun gyis 'phar du bcug de ni rin gong gi gsir brje zhes pa de red/ skabs der si phen la me gling nas thob pa'i gser dngul ches mang bas/ rin gong 'phar ba yang ches snga zhing ches mgyogs pa yin/dus rabs 16pa'i dus mjug tu bslebs pa na/ lo tog gi rin gong ldab lnga 'phar/ dngos gong yar 'phar ba des ngal rtsol mi dmangs la gnod tshabs ches che ba ma zad/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag la yang rdung rdeg tsha nan thebs/ rgyu mtshan ni skabs der rgyal khab mang po zhig la grangs bcad dngul lor lugs kyi zhing bogs rgyug che bas/ dngul grangs 'dra mtshungs shig tshur thob kyang / des nyo thub pa'i dngos po sngar dang bsdur na je nyung du ches cher song yod pas so// yong nyung gtong mang gis sa bdag dang sku drag mang po zhig rim gyis dbul por btang ste/ kho tsho'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su song ngo //sa khams gsar rnyed chen po'i rjes su yo rob la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen zab mo gzhan zhig ni zhing sde'i 'byor ldan gral rim du 'gyur tshad je mgyogs su btang ba de yin/ dus rabs 16pa'i stod du/ dbyin ji'i stong bsam spyi ④ lo ngo brgya yi ring yo rob kyi gser 1177dang / dngul 2yoslo'aphar snon byung /30

tshogs ring lugs pa ma'o ar (160 ཿ 50 0 zalo)gyis skad grags che ba'i dpe cha 〈〈wo tho pung〉〉(ga 0913 hpha༅༅)zhes pa brtsams la/ der skabs de'i zhing sde'i gnas tshul 'di ltar bris yod de/ ‘ khyod tsho'i lug de ma gzhir shin tu zhi dul zhig yin la/ cung zad tsam zos pas tshim 'gro na yang /da ni ham sems gang med cig tu gyur zin la/ gtum drag shin tu che bas tha na mi yang bza'o ’ zhes bkod yod/ lug gis mi bza' ci la srid dam/'dzam gling tshong ra rim bzhin rgya bskyed pa yis dbyin ji dang ne zi lan (sa0 60 13263 laḥ4)sogs yo rob nub ma'i rgyal khab kyi bal las dar rgyas sngar las che ba 'byung du bcug pas yin te/ dus rabs 16pa'i skabs su bal btags thon rdzas kyi thon skyed gnas tshul de sgyu rtsal brtsams chos mang po'i nang mtshon yod de/ gsham gyi snyan tshig 'dir/ 66khang pa yangs shing che zhig tu// 'thag 'khor nyis brgya lhag cig 'dug/ 'thag mkhan bzo pa nyis brgya tsam// gral bstar ring po zhig tu bsgrigs// 'gram gyi khang chen zhig nang du// bzo mo brgya kha long pa yis// dgod cing bsed cing snyan pa'i glu// dgong gi sprin pa'i phang bar zug/ nye 'gram khang pa gzhan zhig nang //gzhon nu ma ni nyis brgya bo// phyu pa dmar zhing me tog 'dra// mgo dkris bad dkar brgyab dang mtshungs//’’zhes bkod yod/ bshu gzhog myong ba'i bzo pa rnams snyan ngag pas bris pa ltar gyi spro bag che ba zhig gtan nas ma yin mod/'on kyang de las bal 'thag bzo grwa'i gzhi rgya'i che chung rtogs nus so// de ltar/ bal gyi dgos mkho ches cher 'phar snon byung zhing / bal gyi rin gong rgyun chad med par 'phar bas/ lug 'tsho ba ni khe thob ha cang mtho ba'i las 31

rigs shig tu gyur/ khe mthong tshe mig dmar por 'gyur ba'i ④sa bdag dang sku drag rnams kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud sgos sa chen po chen po byas te ra bas bskor nas phyugs rar byas shing / bzo pa nyung shas shig glas te lug 'tsho ru bcug de ni lo rgyus steng brjod pa'i ra bskor las 'gul ( lo rme7)zhes pa de yin zhing / dbyin ji ni ches dpe thub rang bzhin dang ldan pa zhig yin/ dang thog kho tshos nags tshal dang sa rgod/ na 'dam sogs spyi sa bzung zhing / rjes su zhing pa bskrad de kho tsho'i zhing sa btsan 'dzin byas/bskrad pa'i zhing pa rnams pha yul dang gyes te yul gyar 'khyam ldom gyi 'tsho ba mi rol ka med byung / la la zhig thabs zad nas jag pa byas pa la nam rgyun mtha' mjug srog chad myong gin yod pa dang / mang che shos khyim sgo ded de slong mo byed dgos pa byung / 88lug gis mi za ’ zer ba ni de la zer ba yin/‘ lug gis mi za ba'i ’ las 'gul gyi mjug 'bras ni zhing sde'i sa bdag dang sku drag nyin re bzhin 'byor ldan gral rim du gyur pa yin te/ kho tsho'i khe phan de ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed dang 'brel ba byed rgyu je dam je dam du gyur/ sngar sa zhing la brten pa'i zhing pa rnams ci yang med par gyur te mi gzhan gyis gla ba'i rang dbang can gyi ngal rtsol stobs shugs su gyur ro//'gyur ldog 'di rigs kyis gzhi rtsa'i steng nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi rmang gzhir g.yo 'gul btang zhing / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed 'phel rgyas la gzhogs 'degs chen po thebs/dus rabs 15pa dang 16par/ yo rob tu da dung snang tshul ya mtshan can zhig byung ba ni/ chos lugs kyang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang bzhin can ① ham pa skye ba'i don no/32

du gyur pa de yin la/ de yang yo rob kyi ye shu chos lugs la yang bskyar gyes bral chen po 'byung ba dang spyi tshogs la 'gul zing chen po'abyung ba'i mthar thug gi rkyen du gyur ro//ye shu'i chos lugs ni rom btsan rgyal (5040 7bra.ozla)gyi skabs su byung zhing / dus rabs 11par gyes bral chen po thengs shig byung ste/ shar brgyud rnal ma'i chos lugs dang gnam bdag chos lugs zhes pa gnyis su grub/ u ru si sogs yo rob shar ma'i rgyal khab skor zhig shar brgyud rnal ma'i chos lugs la dad pa dang / yo rob nub byang gi mang shos gnam bdag chos lugs la dad/ dus rabs 16par/ yo rob nub byang gi gnam bdag chos lugs las chos lugs grub mtha' zhig gsar du gyes pa la/ chos gsar zer/ de nas bzung ye shu'i chos lugs la grub mtha' chen po gsum ste/chos gsar dang gnam bdag chos lugs/ shar brgyud rnal ma'i chos lugs bcas gsum kha gtad du mchis par gyur/ chos gsar ni gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dgos pa dang bstun nas byung ba yin te/ skabs der yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la rgol ba'i 'thab rtsod gang zhig yin kyang tshang mar chos lugs kyi phyi shun g.yogs dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni dus rabs bar mar gnam bdag chos lugs kyis nub gling spyi tshogs la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod cing / de'i dbang stobs che tshul ni deng rabs kyi mi'i blo ngor 'char dka' tshod du 'dug ste/ skabs de'i mi zhig la gal te 8 chos la smad pa ’ 'am yang na 66log lta can ’ zhes brjod pa ni de la nyes skyon sreg khrims sbyor 'os pa zhig yod rtags yin/ chos tshogs kyis mi'i rnam shes la bdag byed par ma zad/ da dung rgyal khab kyi chab srid dang dmag don/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas la'ang kha lo bsgyur la/ tha na rgyal khab so so'i 33

rgyal por yang chos rgyal gyis cod pan bsgos pa na da gzod rgyal khri la 'dug rung ba yin/ dper na/ dus rabs 11par/ 'jar man gyi rgyal po hen re bzhi pa (za0basmo7 sa storko/atsho)yis chos rgyal dang chos rtsod dbang rtsod byas pa lta bu ste/ chos rgyal gyis hen re bzhi pa chos khongs nas phud pa bsgrags pa'i tshe/ de ma nyid du kho la 'bangs log cing gnyen gyes pas/ mthar hen re bzhi pa mgo bo mi 'dud thabs med byung ste/ rang gi btsun mo khrid nas i ṭa li'i khan no sa (03sab033tshetsho༅/ )ru yong ste/ rkang rjen du zhwa mo phud nas chos rgyal gyi sgo phyir langs te 'gyod bshags byed pa la brten nas chos khongs slar gso yong re bton pa lta bu yin la/ de las chos rgyal gyi dbang thang ci 'dra che tshul rtogs par nus so//de bas/ dus rabs 15pa dang 16pa'i chos gsar las 'gul gyi mdung rtse ni thog mar rom gyi chos gzhis (ma༅)la gtad dgos pa byung /thog dang por yar langs te rgol mkhan ni 'jar man gyi mar tin lu der (537 1sa 65 607 bra1 phoḥ)yin/ mar tin lu rder ni we ten pa'o (yo5 0ba60 rtsatram̐khrizo༅)slob chen gyi lha rig pa'i slob dpon chen mo yin la/shes sgo yangs shing smra mkhas ldan pa zhig yin/ kho rom la yong myong zhing chos rgyal dang chos gzhis kyi chos pa dag gi rgyas spros thal drags pa'i 'tsho thabs la khong khro rab tu 'bar/ khos chos lugs dad mos ni mi rang nyid dang dam pa'i mgon skyabs bar gyi don zhig yin pas/ mi zhig gal te mgon skyabs la dad na rnam shes grol bar nus/ mi so sor rang nyid kyis 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉bklags sbyang byas pa'i myong rtogs gzhir bzung nas rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba bkod sgrig byed dbang yod la/ chos gzhis kyis 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉'grel 'chad byed pa'i dbang cha sger sdom byed mi 'os pa dang /34

gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi gtos su che ba'i sgrig 'dzugs de dgos pa med par smras/ mar tin lu rder gyi chos lugs lta ba gsar ba 'dis chos rgyal gyi bla na 'phags pa'i go gnas la dgag cing / chos pa dag gi bar smyan pa'i nus pa'ang khas mi len/ 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉de mi dmangs la 'thab 'dzing gi drag chas su thad kur sprod ched/ khos 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉'jar man gyi yi ger bsgyur te/ chos la dad mkhan rnams rang nyid kyis thad kur du 〈〈'phags pa'i gsung rab 〉〉klog sbyong byed pa dang / de las rang nyid la sdom tshig thob rung bar byas/ khos mi dmangs rnams la 'jar man 'di i ṭa li'i bran bkol las bcing 'grol gtong rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / kho'i lta ba des thog rgod bzhin 'jar man gyi mi dmangs gnyid las sad du bcug1517lor/ chos rgyal gyis chos pa phyogs bzhir mngags te nyes bshags srung 'khor btsong zhing / ‘ nyes bshags srung 'khor blu nyo byed spyad kyi dong tse'i ting sgra grag pa tsam gyis khyim de'i gshin po'i rnam shes sbyang khams nas lha khams su 'phar nges mi zhes g.yo gtam 'ud sgrog byas/ 1517lo'i zla 10par/ mar tin lu rder gyis we ten pa'o chos khang chen mo'i sgo klad du 〈〈rtsa 'dzin go lnga pa 〉〉zhes pa sbyar te/ rang nyid kyi chos lugs dgongs don sgrog 'grel byas nas nyes bshags srung 'khor la sun 'byin byas shing / chos rgyal gyi re ba sna tshogs la ngo rgol byas/ chos rgyal khong khro 'bar te mar tin lu der la khrims chad gcod rgyu'i re ba bton/ yin na'ang mar tin lu rder la mi dmangs kyis rgong bkur byas shing / rgyal phran kha shas kyis kyang kho la rgyab skyor byas/ 1520lor/ chos rgyal gyis kho chos khongs nas phud pa khyab bsgrags byas tshe/ khos mi tshogs kyi mdun nas bka' yig me ru bsregs pa na/35

mi rnams kyis dga' 'bod bsgragasal/ maratin lu rder ni dpa' bo zhig tu bsngags so//'jar man mi dmangasamagazhinas rom gyi chos gzhis la dga' bo med pa'i khar/ maratin luder gyi 'bod skul la brten nas/ zhing pa dang grong khyer gyi mi ser phal ba'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing de mthar rgyal yongs la khyab pa'i zhing pa'i 'thab 'dzing zhig tu 'phel rgyas byung / zhing pa'i 'thab 'dzing de'i gtso 'dzin ni rmun tsher (loṭhang/ 1604ཿ 57ba 20 )zhes pa yin/ rmun tsher gyi bsam blo ni lu rder las kyang drag po yin te/ khos 'go khrid pa'i zhing pa'i 'thab 'dzing der bkas bkod la ngo rgol byed pa'i kha phyogs gsal po ldan/ skabs de'i mar tin lu rder ni bya spyod kyi thad nas nyam thag par gyur te dbang sgyur gral rim gyi phyogs su lhung yod pas/ zhing pa'i 'thab 'dzing la kha rdung drag po btang nas/ 8 bong bur lcag gis brabs dgos la/ mi dmangs la drag chas kyis dbang bsgyur dgos ’ zhes smras/khos dbang sgyur gral rim la zhing pa'i 8 smyo spyod ’ 'gog rgyu'i re ba zhus shing /gal te zhing pa rnams nyan mi spro na/ 88kho tshor mdel char gyi bro ba myong du 'jug 'os ’ zhes pa'i re ba bton/ de ltar yin na'ang / bzo las cung dar rgyas che ba'i 'jar man byang khul gyi mnyam 'brel rgyal phran khag dang yo rob byang khul gyi rgyal khab so sor lu der chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen chen po yod/mar tin lu rder gyi rjes su/ hpha ran si'i jon khal win (/06ba0mam1 batram̐ 16gle mekhyalotsang)gyis grub mtha' gsar ba zhig ste/ khal yin chos lugs zhes pa'i srol btodal/ de'i shugs rkyen lu der grub mtha' las kyang lhag par che'o// khal blun gyis 〈〈ye shu chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa 〉〉zhes 36

yin/ khos dbyin ji'i gnam bdag chos lugs la an li gan ( 021103bzo༅ོ)zhes ming bsgyur te rgyal yongs kyi mi tshang mas dad dgos pa'i re ba bton pas/ rgyal chos zhes kyang zer/ khos gnam bdag chos tshogs kyi rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byas shing / mang che shos rang nyid la dbang ba phud/ blon chen dang sku drag sogs la'ang cung re bgos/ de bas hen re brgyad pa'i bcos bsgyur de sku drag gsar ba'i khe phan dang yang mthun pa ni smros ma dgos pa zhig red/yo rob kyi chos pa gsar ba rnams rom gyi chos gzhis la rgol ba ma zad/rang gi rgyal khab kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur pa dang yang 'gal ba dza drag yod/ kho tshos chos tshogs la tshod 'dzin dang / bkas bkod sger gcod dang lci che ba'i khral 'ul la yang tshod 'dzin byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/skabs der yo rob kyi rgyal khab dag gi chab srid gcig gyur ni tshad nges can zhig gi cha nas bshad na chos lugs kyi gcig gyur la brten yod pas/ rgyal khab mang po zhig tu gnam bdag chos lugs dang chos gsar gyi 'gal 'du dza drag byung zhing / chos lugs kyi gnod 'tshe la yang ya nga dang snying rje gtan nas med do// si phan gyis chos gsar pa stong phrag 'ga' gsod khrims la sbyar zhing / dbyin jis hen re brgyad pa'i skabs lu rder chos lugs pa dang gnam bdag chos lugs pa la gnod 'tshe dang sreg khrims sbyar/ ma re'u thu tor ( 3 7 156077o oṃ9)gyi skabs su slebs pa na gnam bdag chos lugs kyi dbang sgyur slar gso byas shing / phyir ldog ste rgyal chos pa dag la sreg khrims sbyar/ 'jar man gyi gnam bdag chos lugs pa dang chos gsar pas lo ngo sum cu lhag ring la chos lugs 'thab 'dzing byas pa dang / hpha ran si'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyis drag chas la brten nas chos gsar gyi log ltar 38

drag gnon byas/ ne zi lan ḍi nas chos lugs kyi 'thab rtsod de mthar thug gsar brje zhig tu gyur la/ o ran ṭi (013brtsa0 tsho༅ 7)chin wang gtso byas pa'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob ste/ 'dzam gling gi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab thog ma btsugs/de las/ dus rabs 15pa dang 16pa'i skabs su yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i chos lugs kyi phyi shun g.yogs pa'i 'thab rtsod de dag don dngos thog gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim dang nyams rgud du 'gro bzhin pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gral rim bar gyi khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing zhig yin pa shes thub/ de ltar yo rob kyi sa gzhi 'dar yom byed cing / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i skya rengs 'char mgo brtsams so//

lnga pa/ khi rom wel gyis lcags dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas te gnam 'og blangs pa/yo rab 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje de thog mar ne zi lan ḍi nas legs grub byung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling nye rabs lo rgyus kyi dbu nispyir btang dbyin ji'i gsar brje nas brtsams par brtsi ste/ ne zi lan ḍi'i gsar brje ni dbyin ji'i gsar brje ltar gyi shugs rkyen zab cing che ba zhig med phyir ro// dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mnga' thang ni gtso cher ming la o le wu khi rom wel(011 0smo 0 0lam011mkhyalolo)zhes pa zhig gis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i ‘4lcags dmag ’ gis blangs shing / des rgyal po ske gcod stegs bur bskyal ba yin no// yin na'ang dbyin ji'i gsar brje ni thog dang por drag po'i mdung rtse sprod pa nas mgo brtsams pa ma yin par/gros tshogs nang gi rtsod gleng nas mgo brtsams pa yin/ de bas/ thog mar dbyin ji'i gros tshogs kyi byung ba dang lo rgyus la nges par du phyir gzhigs rags tsam bya dgos/dus rabs 13pa'i dus mgor/ dbyin ji'i srid dbang 'dzin mkhan ni khrel gzhung dang yid rton med par ma zad/ 'jon thang yang med pa'i rgyal po jon yin zhing / sku drag gzhis ku'i bdag po rnams kho par shin tu mi mos/1215lor jon la skam sa'i g.yul 'khrug khrod pham kha rag ste phyir log pas lhag par du mtshan grags sa la lhung par gyur/ sku drag rnams mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas kho la 〈〈rtsa khrims chen mo 〉〉zhes pa phul te btsan thabs kyis dang len 40

byed du bcug pa dang / rjes su gros tshogs kyi chog mchan ma thob par rgyal pos gang 'dod ltar sku drag la khral lhag dang gron dngul sdud mi chog pa byas/jon gyi bu ten re sku rabs gsum pa'i (50sa17 khya stolko/ngakhri)skabs su dbyin ji'i lo rgyus thog gi gros tshogs thengs dang po 'tshogs/ gros mi'i khrod chos gtso dang sku drag 'dus par ma zad/ po jo rim pa'i sku drag gi mnga' khongs re re nas 'dems thon byung ba'i skya rgod gnyis re yod la/ grong khyer re res sdod dmangs gnyis re 'dems zhugs byed chog phyis su rgyal po rim byung gis dgos nges kyi gron dngul thob ched gros tshogs de rigs rgyun du 'tshogs pas/ rim bzhin lam lugs shig tu gyur to//dus rabs 17pa'i dus mgor/ dbyin ji'i gros tshogs nang bkas bkod sku drag gi 'thus tshab yod par ma zad/ 'byor ldan gral rim du gyur pa'i gsar dar sku drag dang grong khyer gyi bzo tshong las rigs kyi mnga' bdag gi 'thus tshab kyang yod/ gros mi mang po zhig ni rgyal chos khrod kyi gnam bdag chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen gtsang sel gtong rgyu'i lta ba rgyun srung byed mkhan gyi dwangs gtsang chos lugs pa (2011 tha1ba3 ༅maṣṭha)yin/ khi rom wel zhes pa ni dwangs gtsang chos lugs pa zhig yin zhing / 1628lo dang 1640lor snga phyir thengs gnyis la gros mir 'dems thon byung / gral rim mi 'dra ba'i khe phan mtshon pa'i mi rnams lhan cig 'tshogs pa na 'gal 'du dang 'thab rtsod 'byung ba ni shin tu rgyun ldan zhig yin/1625lor/ si thur thi (5 581 ༅ ༅྅sgo)rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po jem si dang po (13 03 1 ṣṭha7 —tsho)'das rjes/ bu thra li dang po (063 /031 za0—tsho)yis rgyal khri bzung / thra li dang po ni sger chod che zhing / rgyal po'i dbang thang 8 gnam gyis bskos pa ’ 'ud sgrog byed mkhan zhig yin pas/41

rgyal tshogs kyi dbang char snang chung byas la/ rgyal tshogs rgyab tu dor te rang nyid kyi blos thub gces blon 'ga' la brten nas rang mos ci dgar byas/1628lor/ rgyal tshogs kyis kho par 〈〈dbang cha'i re zhu'i yi ge 〉〉zhes pa zhig phul te/ lo rgyus thog gi 〈〈rtsa khrims chen mo 〉〉zhes pa'i don tshan drangs te rgyal po'i dbang char tshod 'dzin byed pa'i re ba bton/ 1640lo'i zla 4par/thra li dang pos hpha ran si dang si phen la g.yul 'gyed ched rgyal tshogs bsdus nas dmag gron bsdu thabs mi byed thabs med byung / rgyal tshogs kyis dang len ma byas pas/ rgyal po khros te/ btsugs nas zla ngo gcig kyang ma lon pa'i rgyal tshogs gtor ba de la lo rgyus thog 66yun thung rgyal tshogs zer/gros mi rnams kyis ngo nas bka' brtsi khul byas kyang sems nang khong khro chen po skyes/ rgyal po'i bya spyod des me la snum gyis btab pa ltar rim pa so so'i mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol byed pa je drag tu gyur la/ rgan 'dzin tshogs pa'i chos lugs pa rnams kyis drag chas spras mgo brtsams/ thra li dang po dngangs 'tshab skyes te rgyal tshogs slar ma bsdus thabs med byung zhing / rgyal tshogs khrod kyi khong khro 'bar ba'i gros mi rnams kyis phyir khyim du mi log pa'i rbad thag bcad pas/ rgyal tshogs thengs de 'tshogs yun shin tu ring ste/ lo ngo bcu'i yun la 'tshogs pas lo rgyus thog de la ‘ yun ring rgyal tshogs ’ zer/1641lor/ rgyal tshogs kyis rgyal po'i rngam zil je dma' ru gtong ched/ rgyal po'i gces blon zi thi ra hphu (160laḥ yo0ba/401 6’13 khya311 013 73110 6lo༈sgo7ma)hu'u jo la srog chad gcod rgyu'i re ba bton zhing /rgyal po 'thad pa mi 'byung thabs med byung bas/ zi thi ra hphu ske gcod stegs bur bkod do// zla 11par/ rgyal tshogs kyis 〈〈dgag yig chen mo 〉〉zhes pa zhig la gros 'cham byung zhing / de ru rgyal po'i nyes skyon re re bzhin bgrangs/42 —

rgyal pos phyir rgol byed bsam gyis/ sku dngos su rgyal tshogs khrod phyin nas ngo rgol pa'i 'go 'dzin lnga bo 'dzin bzung byed par brtsams na yang/ gros mi lnga bos snga mo nas tshor te 'byor ldan gral rim gyi stobs shugs che ba'i lon ton grong khul du byol sdod byas la/ gza' 'khor gcig gi rjes su kho tsho dmag gi rol mo'i ru khag gis srung skyel 'og rgyal tshogs su slar log de ni don gyis rgyal po la rngam zil bstan pa nyid do// thra li dang pos rgyal sa ru dngos gnas sdod thabs med par snyam nas/ phyi rol tu dmag dpung bsdu ru song ste rgyal tshogs dang dpung gtug pa'i gra sgrig byas/ 1642lo'i zla 8par/ rgyal pos no ten ham (khu0 1brtsa63 oṃ1yo)nas 'os langs byas te rgyal tshogs la g.yul bshams pas/ dbyin ji'i nang 'khrug gi mgo brtsams so//g.yul 'khrug gi thog ma'i skabs su/ phyogs gnyis kur pham rgyal res mos su byung zhing / rgyal po'i dmag dpung lon ton dang bcar ma nus la/rgyal tshogs kyi phyogs kyis kyang o khi si hphur ti (zog chu kha zhes pa'i don0 1016 ༅ṭha)len ma nus/ gsar brje dka' tshegs la 'phrad pa'i sgang der/ rgyal tshogs kyi dmag rur dmag dpon grags can zhig byung ste dpa' mdzangs mngon par gyur pa de ni khi rom wel zhes pa de red/khi rom wel gyis skya dmag ru khag cig bsdus te ming la ‘8lcags kyi skya dmag ’nyaces btags/ phyis su de'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgyal tshogs kyi dmag dpung bcos 'dzugs byas nas/ ru dpe gsar dmag nya zhes pa grub/1644lo'i zla 7par/ mā si 'on thang rgod (537bya 0 la0076loltosmo༅ṭha)kyi g.yul 'gyed du gnas babs ngan pa'i kha bsgyur zhing / 1645lo'i zla 6par nā si pe (satha3067 776khu)g.yul 'gyed du rgyal pham gyi thag chod par gyur/khi rom wel ni skye khongs zhing bdag yin zhing / mes po ni ten re brgyad pa'i 43

skabs kyi gces blonazhigayinal/ chos lugs bcos bsgyur skabs su 'byor ba chen po rgyas/ khiramakhrel rang nyid slob grwa chen mo nas mthar phyin rjes phyir khyim du log ste sa zhing dang / phyugs ra bdag gnyer byas pas/ sku drag gsar ba zhig yin la/ kho dwangs gtsang chos lugs pa zhig kyang yin te/skad cha bshad tshe gzhung dang lung la mi 'bral ba zhig yin/ kho da dung g.yul la bkod 'doms byed nus shing dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byed mkhas pa zhig kyang yin/ kho'i dpon dmag rnams mang shos gzhung drang ba'i zhing pa dang g.yog 'khor/ 'khor lo 'dren mkhan/ gru ba sogs yin/ khos rgyun du dmag mi rnams la chos lugs dad mos rnam dag yod pa dang / ci'i phyir du g.yul 'gyed pa shes dgos pa'i re ba 'don/ kho'i dmag mi rnams kyis dwangs gtsang chos lugs pa'i 8 thung ngur breg pa'i ’ skra 'jog pas mi rnams kyis 6 mgo ril tang ’’zhes kyang zer/ dma' rim gyi mi las grub pa'i dpe gsar dmag des sku drag mi chen dang dpung ba mnyam gshib sgos rgyal po'i dmag dpung gtor pham btang / thra li dang po'ang si kod lan ḍi (500 /3 6zocho༅)la bskrad/ si kod lan ḍi ni si thur thi rgyal rigs kyi pha yul yin mod/ 'on kyang skabs der des kyang kho'i srog skyob mi nus te/ rgya la tshogs kyis dbyin pung khri bzhi bcu yis kho pa phyir blus nas hi mu pi mkhar (ཿ7khri6༅)du btson 'jug byas/ gsar brje phyogs la dmag don steng rgyal kha thob pa'i rjes su nang khul gyi 'gal ba phyir mngon par gyur/ rgyal tshogs la dbang sgyur mkhan ni rgan 'dzin phyogs khag yin la/ dmag dpung gi dbang 'dzin mkhan ni khi rom wel gtso byas pa'i rang btsan pa yin/ rgan 'dzin pas sku drag chen po dang /'byor ldan gral rim chen po'i khe phan gyi tshab byas te rgyal po dang 'cham 'grig 44

yong rgyu'i lta ba bton/ 'on kyang rang btsan pa dang dpe gsar dmag gis rgyal po slar khri sar bkod pa na/ kho tsho'i ‘8gyen log dmag ’nyagu yangs su gtong mi srid pa ci la mi shes/ skabs der kho tshos khi rom khrel skul te rgyal po 'gebs srung byed mkhan gros mi bco brgyad gros tshogs las phyir 'bud btang / log spyod kyi gros mi phyir phud rjes/ dmag dpung nang khul gyi dmag dpon dang dmag mi'i nang slar yang 'gal ba byung / rgyal pos zing 'khrug g.yo slong byas la skabs glags de dang bstun nas bros byol byas/skabs der phyogs so so nas zing 'khrug langs shing / si kod lan ḍi'i dmag dpung dbyin ki lan ḍi (༅brtsa/3ba6 4pho༅)la bcar bas gnas babs yang bskyar dza drag tu gyur/ dgra chen la gdong gtad de/ rang btsan pa'i dmag dpon dang dmag mi phan tshun 'cham mthun byung zhing mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas gyen rgol la drag gnon byas pa dang / yang bskyar rgyal po bzung ste btson la sbyar bas/ mi dmangs rnams kyang sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas rtogs sad byung /de'i gzhug gi bya ba ni rgyal po la ji ltar bya rmyu de yin/rgyal po la ji ltar bya rgyu'i gnad don thad/ khi rom wel gyi rnam 'gyur ni sems thag chod po yin te/ khos thra li dang po ni gtum spyod dang ngo log pa/mi gsod mkhan/ mi dmangs kyi spyi dgra ru bltas te chad gcod byed dgos par 'dod pas/ khos 88nga tshos rgyal po dang kho'i cod pan lhan du gcod dgos ’ zhes bshad/ mnga' bdag cig la khrims bsher dang gsod khrims spyod pa'i sngar srol yo rob la gtan nas yod myong med pas/ srol rgyun gyi 'gog shugs ji 'dra che tshul ni rtogs sla'o// phyi'i rgyal khab kyi mnga' bdag gis ngo rgol dang 'jigs skul ji 'dra byas tshul skor 'dir ma brjod na'ang /rgyal nang gcig pu'i 'gog shugs kyang shin tu che ste/ gros tshogs khang stod 45

ma'i gros gtsos 8 rgyal po med na rgyal tshogs kyang med/ de bas/ rgyal po ni kho rang nyid kyi ngo log pa yin mi srid la/ rgyal khab la ngo log pa'i nyes pa 'byung mi srid ’ ces bshad pa dang / pa'o jo zhig gis ‘8yang snying rgyal pos dmag bsdus nas rgyal tshogs la rgol ba'i g.yul bkyes pa yin nam yang na rgyal tshogs kyis dmag bsdus nas rgyal por rgol ba'i g.yul bkyes pa yin/gnad don 'dir brtag dpyad bden thub bya dgos ’ zhes bshad/ sku drag gis dbang bzung ba'i gros tshogs khang stod mas gros tshogs khang smad mas rgyal po la khrims thag gcod rgyu'i gros gzhi de dgag slog byas/ skabs der gros tshogs khang smad ma blo thag chod po yod de/ des gros tshogs khang stod ma'i khra slog dbang cha med par btang zhing / rang nyid kyis ches mtho'i khrims khang rtsa 'dzugs sgos rang btsan kyi sgo nas thra li dang po'i nyes don la khrims bsher byed rgyu'i thag bcad do//thra li dang po la khrims bsher byed skabs dang thog rgyal po'i sgrob nyams shin tu che/ khos lag tu dbang dbyug thogs te khrims khang du yong bar ma zad/ des rtog dpyod pa'i phrag par rdeb rdeb byas te khengs nyams chen po bstan/ khos bshad rgyur ‘ ngas dbang chod gang zhig gis kho bo 'dir drangs yong ba shes 'dod/ ngas bshad pa ni khrims mthun gyi dbang chod yin/ de min da dung khrims 'gal gyi dbang chod mang po yod de/ dper na jag pa'i dbang chod lta bu red ’ ces bshad mod/ 'on kyang khrims bsher skor gsum pa mjug bsgril te/ kho 66rgyal po gtum po dang / ngo log pa/ mi gsod mkhan/ mi dmangs kyi spyi dgra yin pas mgo gcod dgos pa ’’dril bsgrags pa'i tshe/ kho pa skrag thag chod de sa la 'gyel zhing / mthar thug khrims dpon la ‘ sku zhabs lags/ khyed ngas zhus pa'i tshig la nyan 'dod yod dam ’ zhes 46

zhu ba byas par/ khrims dpon gyis ‘4sku zhabs lags/ khrims thag bcad tshar rjes khyod kyi skad chad nyan mi rung ngo ’ zhes lan btab/1648lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 29nyin/ khi rom wel sku dngos kyis gsod khrims lag tu bstar rgyu'i bka' yig bris shing / ches mtho'i khrims khang gi khrims dpon dang lhan 'brel gyis bka' yig der ming rtags bkod/bka' yig khrod 'di ltar bris yod de/ 6‘dbyin ji'i sngar gyi rgyal po thra li si thur thi la rgyal khab la ngo log pa sogs nyes skyon lci mo gzhan yod med brtag bsher byas/ 'dri rtog byas pa brgyud/ bden dpang khungs thub la brten nas/ nged khrims khang gis gza' 'khor sngon ma'i gza' drug par kho la srog khrims te/ mgo gcod pa'i khrims sbyar/ khyod tsho sang nyin snga dro'i dus tshod 10nas phyi dro'i dus tshod 5bar/ tshoms dkar thang chen du mgo gcod par lta rtog byed du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' ched du phab pa yin ’ zhes bkod yod/phyi nyin mgo gcod stegs bur 'god dgos pas/ thra li dang po mtshan gang bor gnyid ma khug rgyal khab kyi rgyal po yin bzhin du/ srog khrims sbyar ba'i nyes btson du lhung ste thung myur dbu gcod par 'gyur ba 'dir/ kho la yang snying bsam tshul ci zhig yod dam/ tshes 30nyin gyi snga mo'i chu tshod 2steng kho mal las langs/ lus po grang 'dar brgyab pas khos gon pa mang tsam gon rgyu'i re ba zhus la/ 8 nam zla 'di 'dra 'khyag pas/ ngas grang 'dar rgyag srid la/ ltad mo ba kha cig gis nga skrag par snyam srid/ ngas nyes 'gel de 'dra myong mi 'dod de/ nga gtan nas mi skrag ’ ces bshad/ nam langs rjes chos gtso yong nas kho la smon lam btab ste mchod gsol byas/ dus tshod 10yi steng dmag dpon hrang zha'o zhig yong ste kho gsod rar khrid/ rgyal pos chos gtso'i lag par 'jus te bshad rgyur/ 88'dir phebs/ khyod kyis kho bo 47

skyol cig ang ’ zhes bshad/ dus tshod 12steng thra li dang po la khrims sbyor kha'i mi zas tha ma za ru bcug rgyal pos bza' mi 'dod mod/ chos gtsos kho la mang tsam bza' rgyur skul/ mjug mthar khos rgun chang phor ba gang btung zhing / bag leb phyed ka zhig zos/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 1steng/ khrims sbyor hrang zha'o zhig gis kho mgo gcod stegs bur bskyal/ skabs der rgyal pos chos gtso dang hrang zha'o la tha ma'i kha chems kyi tshig 'ga' brjod pa'i skabs su/ su zhig sta re la reg byung bar/ rgyal po myur mor phyir 'khor te ‘ sta re la chag skyon 'byung du ma 'jug gal te chag skyon byung na bdag la gnod pa lhag par che ’ zhes brjod/ skabs der rgyal pos dngos gnas mtha' mi 'khyongs pas/ chos gtsos rgyal po 5la 8 rgyal po lags/ da ni gom pa gang gi rgyang dzi3rṣa thag las mi 'dug ste/ shin tu thung ba'i gom 7༷ cardotsu pa gang tsam las mi 'dug de nas des khyod za caX 5tsho ro shin tu rlabs che ba'i bgrod lam zhig la ca mi ‘'dren zhing / khyod mi yul nas lha yul du nyi dzo chi 'dren par 'gyur ro ’ zhes bshad/ rgyal po yang mar sgur te mgo bo gcod stegs su 'jog pa las thabs gzhan med par gyur/:rgyab rdzi bas bka' phab ma nyid du ngo gdong thra li dang pobatums pa'i khrims sbyor pas sta res gcig gzhus pa na/ thra li dang po'i mgo bo dang lus po de ma nyid du so sor phral/thra li dang po la gsod khrims sbyar ba des/ dbyin ji'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs kyi mjug rdzogs shing 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar 48 —
brje la rgyal kha thob pa mtshon la/ de nas bzang ma rtsa ring lags kyi dus ༄ ༄rabs gsar ba zhig la bslebs so//nga 49

drug pa/ mag pa rgyal po'i khri la 'khod/khi rom wel gyis 'go khrid de si thur thi rgyal rabs mgo rting slog rjes/khos rang nyid kyi sger gcod dbang sgyur 'dzugs pa'i grabs gshom byas shing /sa zhing slong mkhan gyi zhing pa dbul po'i 'thub tshab ‘4sa slog pa ’ la drag gnon byas pa dang / nus pa chen po 'don myong ba'i 8 yun ring rgyal tshogs ’ kyang gtor/ skabs de'i yun ring rgyal tshogs kyang dngos gnas 'dra chags po zhig med de/ kho tsho dbang cha lag tu thob pa na mu mthud mdun du bskyod re med par bkas bkod slar gso pa dang 'gab mthun byas/ 1653lo'i zla 4par/ khi rom wel gyis dpung chen khrid de gros tshogs su 'ongs te gros mi rnams bskrad cing / rgyal tshogs kyi sgo chen la sgo lcags brgyab/ zla 12par/khi rom wel rang ngos kyis bkod mngags byas pa ltar/ thengs 'di'i gsar brje las khe bzang thob pa'i mi dag gis kho 88rgyal srung bdag po ’’(7ṭhaca)gnang rgyur zhus/ de ltar spyi mthun gyi rnam pa spyad de/ khi rom wel dmag don sger chod kyi 66rgyal srung bdag po mi byas shing / phyis su 44rgyal srung bdag po ’ ni khi rom wel khyim rgyud kyis rgyud 'dzin byed chog pa khyab bsgrags byas/de ni rgyal rabs gsar ba zhig btsugs pa dang khyad par chen po med mod/yin na'ang khi rom wel srid dbang gi rmang gzhi ni 'byor ldan gral rim yin la/des 'byor ldan gral rim dang gsar byung sku drag gi khe phan la srang skyob byed 1skyirngordo ri si༅1658lor khi rom wel nad kyis shi la/ kho'i bu re khrar khi khi rom wel 50

(5105tha76 0 04yo05༅caḥ ༅྅tsholo)gyis 88rgyal srung bdag po ’ khur/khi rom wel chung ba skabs der rang lo so gnyis yin/ krung go'i kha dper/sum cu'i steng du rang tshugs thub zer ba yod kyang / khi rom khrel chung bas ‘4rang tshugs ’ thub dka' ste/ kho la ham sems med mod/ 'on kyang kho'i pha ltar gyi grags zil kyang med la/ nang sgos su kho'i pha ltar gyi chab srid dang rtsa 'dzugs byed pa'i 'jon thang med pas/ khos dmag dpung gi kha lo bsgyur mi nus shing / rgyal rabs rnying ba'i slar gso'i stobs shugs dang g.yon thal che ba'i spyi mthun tang mi la kha gtad gcog mi nus/ kho rgyal srung bdag po'i go gnas la bsdad nas lo ngo gcig kyang ma lon gong / rang nyid la nus pa med cing / rnyog 'dzing che ba'i chab srid gnas babs la kha gtad gcog mi nus pa rtogs te/ mkhas mdzangs kyi sgo nas go gnas nas babs/rgyal srung srid gzhung go gnas nas lhung ma thag tu/ slar gso'i stobs shugs kyi mgo bo 'degs mgo brtsams/ kho tshos phyi gyar du song ba'i thra li dang po'i bu che ba thra li sku rabs gnyis pa phyir gdan 'dren zhus te rgyal por mnga' gsol rgyur thag bcad/ thra li gnyis pa skabs der rang lo sum cu yin la/ rnam rig bkra zhing g.yo thabs ldan pa zhig yin/ khos bsgrags yig spel te kho rang slar rgyal srid du 'khod pa'i rjes su gsar brje'i skabs tshugs pa'i sa zhing dang rgyu nor gyi 'brel bar 'gan srung byed cing / dad mos rang dbang yin pa dang / rgyal rabs la ngo rgol byas pa'i nyes khag mi 'ded par khag theg byas/ 1660lor/ dbyin jis shog sbag rgyag pa dang cong rdung ba la brten nas thra li gnyis pa phyir log par dga' bsu byas/chos luni ṭwāṃ ༵ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃrdo ༵ ṭwāṃ~X pa~Xṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ~X/ kyaṭwāṃ /li/ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵༵ snatta byi ṭwāṃnā 51

gnam bdag chos lugs la dad mos byed/ kho'i srid dbang sra brtan du gyur rjes/ snga ma'i rtsis lan slog pa'i sbyor ba brtsams/ kho'i yab la khrims bsher byed par zhugs pa zhig yin phyin tshang mar ‘ rje bsad nyes pa ’ ltar thag bcad cing / khi rom khrel gyi rul sungs su gyur zin pa'i bem po'ang phyir phyung ste gsod khrims gsab gcod byas/thra li gnyis pa shi rjes/ kho'i nu bo jem si gnyis pas khri bzung / jem si gnyis pa'i sger gcod de kho'i phu bo las kyang mngon gsal dod po yod/khos gnam bdag chos lugs la dad mos mngon thog tu byas shing / kho'i rgyal po'i go 'phang ni 64gnam bskos ’ yin pa mngon bsgrags dngaka gnam bdag chos lugs la dad pa'i hpha ran si la mngon sum du phyogs par gyur to//de ltar/ kho dang rgyal tshogs/ 'byor ldan pa chen po/ sku drag gsar ba'i bar gyi 'gal ba nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur/ 'on kyang / dbyin ji'i mi rnams kyis skabs thog bzod sgom byed nges te/ rgyu mtshan ni jem si gnyis pa'i thad kur gyi rjes 'dzin pa ste kho'i sras mo ma re'u dang a ne gnyis chos lugs gsar bar dad pas/ mi rnams kyis kho'i rjes 'dzin pa'i dbang sgyur skabs gnas tshul legs phyogs su 'gyur ba'i re ltos byed pas so// 'on kyang 1688lor gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog byung/ jem si gnyis pa'i btsun mo chung bar bu zhig btsas/ skyed yum ni gnam bdag chos lugs pa yin la/ bu yang gnam bdag chos lugs la dad/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi rgyud 'dzin khrims srol ltar na/ thog mar rgyal khri rgyud 'dzin byed mkhan ni bu yin pa las bu mo ma yin/ de bas mi mang po zhig brel dngangs skyes te/ hur thag gis jem si gnyis pa bsgyel ba'i thabs la 'bad/dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan pa che gras dang sku drag gsar ba mang shos ni 52

bkas bkod bdag po las 'gyur thon byung ba yin pas/ kho tsho'i ngan gshis kyi rtsa ba ni gsar brje mthar phyin byed par 'jigs shing / 'gab mthun la mos pa de yin/ kho tshos ho lan ḍi la 'thus tshab mngags te jem si gnyis pa'i mag pa wi lim (yo151thal tsho )dang bu mo ma re'u la gros mol byas/ wi lim gyi khyim rgyud ni ho lan ḍi'i 'byor ldan gral rim du gyur pa'i sku drag chen po zhig yin la/ de'i mes po ni ne zi lan ḍi'i gsar brjer zhugs myong la/wi lim ni skabs de'i ho lan ḍi'i dbang sgyur pa yin/ gros mol byed pa'i cha rkyen ni wi lim dang ma re'u dbyin jir yong ste mnga' bdag byed rgyu dang /khrims 'dzugs dang nor srid/ dmag don sogs kyi dbang cha rgyal tshogs la dbang bar byed pa de'o// 1688lo'i zla 11par/ wi lim gyis dmag dpung 'bor chen khrid nas dbyin ji'i skam sar slebs pa na/ jem si gnyis pa'i mnga' zhabs pa bros byol lam yang na bdag po gsar bar mgo btags/ming la ngon chir chel (105ba 05570615 ༅smo yoolo)zer ba'i dmag ོdpon grags can de yang wi lim la btud/ kho ni phyis su 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs kyi dbyin ji'i skad grags che ba'i dbu blon wen si ton cher chel (yo1ba3 0sa 050705111 4shālo)gyi mes po yin/ jon chir chel ni dmag spyi yin la/ dmag dpung nang dbang zil ches che bas kho btud pa der shugs rkyen shin tu chen po yod/ dmag dpung med pa na/jem si gnyis pa la jus thabs zad de hpha ran sir bros byol mi byed ka med byung ngo //1689lor/ dbyin ji'i rgyal tshogs 〈〈dbang cha'i khrims gzhi 〉〉zer ba zhig la gros 'cham dngos su byung zhing / de ni don dngos thog rgyal po'i dbang char tshod 'dzin dang gros tshogs kyi dbang char 'gan len byed pa'i rtsa 53

7khrims shig yin/ de ltar/ jem si gnyis pa'i mag pa dang ho lan ḍi'i srid 'dzin pa wi lim gyis dbyin ji'i rgyal srid dngos su bzung la/ bu mo ma re'u rgyal mor byas te/ khyo shug gnyis ka khri la bkod do// yin na'ang kho tshor yab rgyal po jem si gnyis pa ltar gyi dbang cha chen po zhig med de/ kho tshos nges par du 〈〈dbang cha'i khrims gzhi 〉〉ru gtan 'bebs byas pa las mi 'da' ba'i sgo nas bya ba bsgrub dgos/ de nas bzung / dbyin ji bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi ‘ mis dbang sgyur ba ’ nas 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs kyi 66khrims kyis dbang sgyur ba ’ la bgrod mgo brtsams shing / mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs de da lta'i bar du rgyun 'khyongs byed bzhin mchis/ khrag ma bzhur ba'i srid 'gyur thengs 'di la dbyin ji ba rnams 88gzi brjid kyi gsar brje nya zhes 'bod rgyur mos la/ de ni don dngos thog dbyin ji'i zhing bdag dang ma rtsa can sogs khe gnyer pa rnams ho lan ḍi'i wi lim dang lhan du dbang sgyur gyi go gnas su bkod pa zhig go/4 54
