bdun pa/ dbyin ji'i mnga' 'bangs a ri bar gyur pa/a ri'i nye'u yog (sa04 701ji matram̐gi)'jug ngogs kyi rang dbang gling phran ⑦du mtho tshad dbyin khri sum brgya lhag yod pa'i rang dbang lha mo'i sku brnyan krong nger 'greng yod la/ kho mo'i g.yon lag tu 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉dang / g.yas lag tu dpal 'bar mthon por btegs yod/'dzeng rdo (2 8ba1 0 lolotsho)las grub pa'i khri gdan steng snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i snyan ngag cig brkos yod pa ni/bdag la gnang rogs/ khyod kyi de dag stethang chad la dbul phongs te'atshang kha shigs shigs kyis rang dbang gi 'byin rngub la re ba'i mi dmangs de dag dngakhyod kyi 'ur 'ur zing zing gi 'gram ngogs su dor ba'inyam thag pa'i mi tshogs de dag go'agro sa'i khyim gzhis med par char rlung la longs su spyod pa'i mi 'di dgasdeb gcig tu bdag la gnong dngabadag ni gser gyi sgo mo'i drung 'greng ginarang dbang gi sgron me mthon por btegs nas yodasnyan ngag 'di da lta'i a ri'i gnas babs la mtshon na zur za chen po ⑦ sngar ming la pis ti lo zi gling phran zer/55

zhig las ma 'das mod/ 'on kyang de ni lo rgyus kyi thon dngos dang / lo rgyus kyi dpang po zhig tu byas te phyogs gcig nas a me ri kha'i mi rigs dang a mi ri ka mnyam 'brel rgyal khab ( 60 0ba1 06 3 tha 0bya 01 40go0tharsālko1༅/ waṃ')grub tshul dang bltams tshul mtshon yod/ lha mo'i sku brnyan 'di ni hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis a ri rang btsan 'thab 'dzing la rgyal kha thob par rten 'brel zhu ched a ri'i mi dmangs la phul ba'i legs skyes red la/ snyan ngag 'di'i rtsom pa po ni yi'u the'i (3 0ོ136 7nga)bud med snyan ngag pa zhig yin/da lta'i a me ri kha ba kyi mes po mang shos ni gong gi snyan ngag der brjod pa ltar rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mtha' nas ‘8dor ba'i nyam thag pa'i mi tshogs ’ yin/ kho tsho dbyin ki lan ḍi dang / si kod lan ḍi/ er lan ḍi/ ne zi lan ḍi/ hpha ran si/ 'jar man/ si phen sogs nas yong ba yin la/ de'i khrod dbyin ji nas yong bas mang shos zin/ a ri'i yul gyi thog ma'i bdag po ni dbyin ti yan pa yin la/ mi ser spel mkhan gyis skor bcom byas pas phyis su mi grangs khri bcu tsam las med par gyur te a ri'i grangs nyung mi rigs shig tu gyur to// yo rob spos mi 'bor che ba me gling byang ma'i skam sar bslebs pa ni skabs de'i yo rob spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'brel ba dam po yod/ kho lum pu yis skam sa gsar ba ‘4rnyed ’ rjes su/ me gling byang ma de snga phyir si phan dang ho lan ḍi/ hpha ran si/ dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab kyis bzung / dbyin ji ni a ri byang ma'i mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod khrod zhugs pa cung 'phyi mod/ 'on kyang ma rtsa ring lugs 'phel rgyas mgyogs shing /rgyal stobs nyin bzhin rgyas pas/ 'dzam gling gi mnga' dbang 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing khrod snga gzhug tu ho lan ḍi dang / hpha ran si pham par brgyab ste de dag gi me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul tshur 'phrog nas/ me 56

gling byang ma'i mi ser spel ba'i mnga' dbang rgyal khab gtso bor gyur/dus rabs 16pa dang 17pa'i yo rob ni g.yo 'gyur chen po can zhig yin zhing / lo ngo mang por bstud mar byung ba'i mi ser spel ba'i 'thab 'dzing dang / rgyun chad med pa'i chos lugs gnod 'tshe/ ma rtsa ring lugs bzo tshong las rigs mgyogs myur dar ba/ ra bskor las 'gul nyin bzhin shugs drag tu phyin pa bcas kyis/ dka' ba myong ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs mi nyung ba zhig 'tsho thabs zad du bcug chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan 'dzin mkhan dang / dka' dub myong ba'i zhing pa dang lag shes bzo las pa skor skor byas te 'tsho thabs ched dang / yang na chab srid dam chos lugs kyi gnod 'tshe las thar ba'i ched du/ rgya mtsho chen po brgal te skam sa gsar ba der bslebs/ kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig ni 8 gan bzhag g.yog po ’ ste skabs thog rang bzhin gyi bran g.yog tu byas nas der bslebs pa yin/ de'i khrod kyi dbyin ji'i sdod dmangs mang che shos ni 6 gan bzhag g.yog po yin no// skabs der me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul du nam rgyun 'di lta bu'i bsgrags yig mthong bar 'gyur te/ ‘8lon ton (༅0 60ba khyamo)nas gzhon zhing lus sha rgyas pa'i bzo pa skor cig gsar du dbor 'dren byas yong la/de'i nang 'khel 'thag bzo pa dang / shing bzo/ lham bzo/ lcags mgar/ar las pa/ 'tshem drub pa sogs yod la/ gong sla mor btsong rgyu yin zhing / gro dang / 'bru rigs/ phye bcas la'ang brje chog ’ ces 'byung /mi rgyud dkar po'i gan bzhag bran g.yog las gzhan/ da dung dbyin ti an pa'i bran dmar dang / phyis su hphe gling nas mang du dbor 'dren byas pa'i bran nag kyang yod/ ring po ma lon par bran nag ni 'debs 'dzugs ra ba'i ngal rtsol stobs shugs gtso bor gyur/ 57

mi ser spel ba'i dus rabs kyi snga dus su/ me gling byang ma'i rgyal khab so so'i spos mi yis rang rang gi spyi tshogs shog khag btsugs la/ skad rigs mi 'dra ba brjode cing / yi ge mi gcig pa spyod pa/ chos lugs mi 'dra bar dad mos byas pa dang / dpal 'byor gyi thad nas kyang phan tshun 'gro 'ong shin tu nyung bas/ gcig gyur gyi mi rigs shig la re ltos med/ yin na'ang kho tshor mtshungs sa zhig yod pa ni/ phyis su kho tsho thun mong la dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur pa'i mnar gcod dang bshu gzhog myong ba de yin/don dngos su kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang che shos ni sngar dbyin ji'i rgyal po'i mnga' 'bangs yin/ lo zla'i 'khor 'gros dang bstun nas/ kho tsho'i phyi rabs pa rnams mes po'i rgyal khab la brtse dung phyi phyir chung bar gyur la/ mi ser spel yul nang khul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi 'brel 'dris phyi phyir dam zab tu gyur/ phan tshun 'gro 'ong khrod/ dbyin ji'i skad de rim bzhin spyi spyod kyi skad du gyur pa dang / kho tsho thun mong gi dka' sdug dang thun mong gi khe phan yang phyi phyir mngon gsal du gyur/ me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul de mi rigs btso sbyang byed sa'i zangs thab chen po zhig dang 'dra ste/mi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig rim bzhin du mi rigs gsar ba zhig ste/ a ri'i mi rigs (rsālko1༅/ ṭhalo)su grub bo// dus rabs 18pa'i stod du/ a ri'i mi rigs kyi 'byor ldan gral rim rim bzhin nar son te/ a ri'i mi dmangs la kho tsho'i ches che ba'i mi rigs kyi dka' sdug ni dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur de yin la/ kho tsho'i ches che ba'i mi rigs kyi re ltos ni rang btsan kyi rgyal khab cig 'dzugs pa de yin pa'i nges rtogs skyes/dbyin jis me gling byang mar lag tu bstar ba ni/ mi ser spel yul gyi khe phan khyur mid byas nas mnga' dbang rgyal khab kyi dbang sgyur gral rim phyug 58

por gso ba'i mi ser spel ba'i srid jus shig yin la/ de'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni mi ser spel yul de mnga' dbang rgyal khab kyi bzo las thon rdzas btsong sa'i tshong ra dang ma bcos rgyu cha 'byung khungs su bsgyur rgyu de yin/ dper na mtsho 'grul rtsa tshig nang / mi ser spel yul gyi thon rdzas phyir gtong nang 'dren gang yang nges par du dbyin ji'i gru gzings kyis skyel 'dren byed dgos la/ mi ser spel yul gyi thon rdzas gal chen rigs nges par du dbyin jis gnyer 'tshong byed dgos pa sogs thag bcad yod pa lta bu'o// de ni dbyin jis mi ser spel yul gyi nyo tshong phyogs yongs nas sger sdom byed pa dang / mi ser spel yul gyi dpal 'byor phyogs yongs nas kha lo bsgyur ba zhig red/ mi ser spel ba'i log spyod kyi dbang sgyur stobs shugs 'di rigs kyis sa gnas de'i mi ser la mi mos pa chen po slong nges yin/ 1676lor wer ke ne'u (517rtsa10180tshi༅yo)nas me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul gyi drag po'i 'os langs thengs dang po langs shing / 'os langs kyi 'go 'dzin la nā tan nel pe khon (sa3 53ba101 83000 7lo༅lo poyo)zer zhing / kho nidabyin ji'i mtshan nyid smra ba grags can hphu ran zhi si pe khon (tha thab0138300ba 7༅yo༅ potsho)gyi phyi rabs pa red/ pe khon gyis 'go khrid pa'i nub khul gyi spos mi'i 'os langs kyis wer ke ne'u khul gyi lte gzhi jem si mkhar bzung ste/ khul gyi gros tshogs gtor myong la/ phyis su mi ser spel ba'i dbang 'dzin pas drag gnon byas/ 1689lor nye'u yog tu tshong ba ya ku lis se li yis sne khrid pa'i 'os langs byung zhing / 'os langs pas skabs shig ring sa de'i srid dbang mgo rting slog ste bde 'jags u yon lhan tshogs btsugs/ phyis su lis se li 'dzin bzung byas te gyen log gi nyes pa ltar du gsod khrims bcad/ dbyin ji'i btsan gtum gyi mi ser spel ba'i srid jus 59

de kho pa'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur sra brtan du gtong bar ma phan par ma zirdo4 :pe :rdo 3) zudza shesgo :rdo /) jezad/ a 'a gas 'a ra ngas dang / a rgyal khab byung ba mgyogs su btang ngo // 60

brgyad pa/ a ri mnyam 'brel rgyal khab byungang/hphu ran khi lin (302)871sa tha78bakhu11ba sangawa tshi༅༅oṃ)ni a ri'i khyad du 'phags pa'i mkhas pa dang por bkur ba zhig yin/ kho'i legs bshad mang po zhig ste/ dper na 8 khyod tshe srog la gces sam/ des na dus tshod chud zos su gtong mi 'os te/ dus tshod ni khyod kyi tshe srog grub byed kyi ma rgyu yin pas so ’ zhes pa lta bu deng dus kyang mkhas pa'i ngag na rlung ltar grags/ mi rnams kyis ‘8 ’ rtags 88 — ’ rtags kyis pho glog dang mo glog mtshon pa ni kho'i glog gi rig par bzhag pa'i gsar gtod kyi lag rjes shig yin/ deng skabs khang brtsegs mtho gras rnams kyi klad du thog g.yol sgrig chas re yod pa de yang khos gsar gtod byas pa zhig yin/ hphu ran khi lin ni skad grags che ba'i glog rig pa zhig yin par ma zad/ da dung khyad du 'phags pa'i chab srid pa dang phyi 'brel pa zhig kyang yin zhing / a ri'i rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs pa mdzad rjes can zhig kyang yin/ wa hrin thon (yoḥ6 brtsa 0 ༅༅ sgro)la da dung ming grags med pa'i skabs nas hphu ran khi lin ni snyan grags shin tu che ba'i spyi tshogs las don pa zhig yin te/ khos dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur las thar ba'i chab srid kyi las don hur spel byas/ a ri rang btsan 'thab 'dzing ma langs pa'i gong rol gyi lo ngo bcu pa ste/ 1765lor khos dbyin ji'i gros tshogs khang smad ma ru dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur pa la/ ‘ khyod tshos gal te dmag dpung mngags te btsan khrims lag tu bstar grabs byed na/ gnas de na gsar brje med na yang 61

gsar brje 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen du 'gyur nges red ’ ces tha tshig bsgrags so//skabs der/ dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur pa rang che rang mthong thal drags pas/ hphu ran khi lin gyi tha tshig 'di rigs gtan nas rnar mi 'gro/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni hphu ran khi lin gyis tshig de bshad pa'i yar sngon gyi lo gnyis pa ste 1763lor/ dbyin ji hpha ran si las rgyal te/ ‘6lo ngo bdun gyi g.yul 'thab ’ mjug rdzogs yod pas so// dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i g.yul 'thab thengs de ni gtso bo me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed ched yin la/ 'thab yul yang me gling byang ma yin/ g.yul 'thab khrod dbyin jis me gling byang ma'i mi dmangs mang po zhig bkugs te 'thab tu bcug la/ wa hrin thon ni de'i khrod kyi gcig yin/ g.yul 'thab thengs der mi ser spel yul gyi mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi stobs shugs ngos zin par gyur la/ kho tshor 'thab 'dzing gi 'jon thang yang bslabs/ blun rmongs kyi dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur pa rnams rgyal kha la rlom sems skyes shing / mtsho steng gi btsan rgyal ho lan ḍi snga mo nas pham par gyur pa dang / deng dus kyi yo rob skam sa'i dgra chen hpha ran si yang cham la phab pas/ mi ser spel yul gyi 64gyen log pa ’ kha shas shig kho tsho'i mig nang du ci la 'jog lhag par du lo ngo du ma'i mi ser spel ba'i g.yul 'thab khrod 'gro gron shin tu che bas/ mi ser spel yul gyi mi dmangs las ham 'phrog byas te rang gi gyong gron gsab re 'chang sgang yin no// de bas hpha ran si dang g.yul 'thab mjug bsgril rjes/ dbyin jis bka' khrims rabs dang rim pa spel nas/ mi ser spel yul mi dmangs la bshu gzhog byed par shugs snon brgyab/ me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul dang dbyin ji'i 'brel ba de glo bur du dza drag chen por gyur ro//1763lor/ lo ngo bdun gyi 'thab mo'i mdel sgra 'jags ma thag tu/ 62

dbyin jis bka' khrims bsgrags te me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul gyi mi dmangs rnams a pa la chi'u ( 99ma3013sa ༅༅4 za༅)ri rgyud kyi nub phyogs su spo bar bkag 'gog byas/ de'i dmigs yul ni dbyin ji'i tshong ba rnams kyis dbyin ti an pa dang khe bzang shin tu che ba'i pags rigs nyo tshong byed pa la srung skyob byed ched yin/ 1764lor/ khral sdud rtsa tshig gsar ba bkrams shing / der 8 mngar khral 'ja' khrims ’ zer la/ khral sdud pa'i rnam grangs je mang du btang / lo der/ sgor bzo'i khrims kyang 'grem bsgrags byas te mi ser spel yul rang ngos nas dngul sgor par bzo byed pa bkag 1765lor/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis 88ris bkod khral khrims ’ zhes pa bkrams shing / tshong las kyi 'dzin byang dang /gan rgya/ dpang yig re re dang / deb chung re re/ tshags par re re/ tha na slob chung slob ma'i mthar phyin 'dzin yig re re dang / slob grwa chen mo'i 'dzin yig re re tshang ma'i steng khral ris 'god dgos par thag bcad/ de ni mi ser spel yul gyi mi dmangs kyis do gnyer byed pa'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi bya ba gang zhig yin kyang tshang mas mi ser spel mkhan srid gzhung la khral dngul nges can zhig 'jal dgos pa'i don no// ris bkod khral khrims khyab bsgrags byas ma thag tu/ 'ur zing chen po byung zhing / mi ser spel yul mi dmangs dang dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan srid gzhung bar gyi 'gal ba de ma nyid du rno ngar che bar gyur/ mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyis khral sdud pa bzung nas lus la rdo snum byugs shing bya sgro btsugs nas khrom ston byas/ la las khral sdud pa'i sdod shag gi sgo mdun du gsod stegs btsugs pa'i steng du khral sdud pa'i bzo lta'i 'dra gzugs shig dpyang ste khong khro mtshon/ mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyis da dung nye'u yog tu 66ris bkod khral khrims la rgol 63

ba'i tshogs chen nyanyabasdus te 〈〈khe dbang dang rang dbang 〉〉zhes pa'i bsgrags gtam spel/ de ltar mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyis rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas thun mong gi bgyi ba rtsom pa'i mgo brtsams la/ ‘4rang dbang gi bu rgod ’ dang 88rang dbang gi bu mo ’ zhes pa lta bu'i mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi gsar brje'i tshogs pa yang skabs der snga gzhug tu byung ngo //mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyi khong khro phyi phyir mched pa'i ngang tshul der dmigs nas/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan srid gzhung gis zhi drag nyis sbrags kyi byed thabs spyad/ phyogs gcig nas thabs zad de 1766lor ris bkod khral khrims med par byas pa khyab bsgrags byas la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas dbyin ji la mi ser spel yul nas khral sdud dbang yod pa rgyun 'khyongs byas shing / der mthud nas nor srid blon chen thang sin ti (058 10bya10ma 360ba6loḥṣṭha)yis khral don rtsa tshig gi ma phyi zhig bris la/ der lo rgyus steng smyo thong sen ti'i khral tshig ’ zer/ de'i mtshungs su/ dbyin jis slar yang sdod dmag rtsa tshig bkrams la/ me gling byang ma'i mkhar grong so sor sdod dmag btang ste/ drag shugs kyis mi ser spel ba'i khrims yig lag bstarakhyed grabs byas/ dbyin ji'i bya spyod 'dis hphu ran khi lin gyis tshod dpag byas pa ltar gyi gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub cig dngos gnas bslangs so//gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub de po si khron (303 0ba yo nyasmo)nas mgo bslangs/ 1770lo'i zla 3par/ po si khron gyi byis pa 'gas dbyin ji'i so srung dmag la gangs ril 'phangs shing / mgyogs myur ltad mo ba mang du 'dus/ mi tshogs khrod nas kyang mi mang po zhig gis dbyin ji'i dmag la gangs ril 'phangs te sems nang gi khro ba bstan/ dbyin dmag gi krung we (ltasgos)zhig gis mi tshogs khrod me mda' brgyab ste mi lnga bsad la/ de'i nang 64

gi gcig ni mi nag cig yin/ ‘8po si khron gyi dmar gsod don rkyen ’ des 'gal 'du lhag par dza drag tu btang / der mthud de/ 1773lor yang bskyar ‘ po si khron gyi ja byo don rkyen ’ byung / lo de'i zla 12pare/ a ri'i mis dbyin ti an pa'i chas spras te dbyin ji'i tshong gru zhig steng 'gos shing /pāng chig khri brgyad stong yod pa'i ja tshang ma rgya mtshor bshos/ dbyin ji'i dbang 'dzin pas de ma thag 'jug ngogs bkag sdom byed rgyu'i dril bsgrags/de la kha gtad gcog thabs gros mol byed ched/ me gling gi khul bcu gnyis ①kyi 'thus mi rnams 1774lo'i zla 9par hphe yu del hphu grong khyer (2611tha6019618 smone'i)du skam sa'i tshogs chen thengs dang po 'tshogs shing /dbyin ji la phyir tshong nang 'dren gyi nyo tshong dang 'dzad spyod kyi 'brel ba thams cad bcad pa khyab bsgrags byas/skabs der/ dbyin jis drag shugs spyad nas me gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul gyi gnad don thag gcod rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ 1775lo'i zla 4tshes 19nyin/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon ke kri (150yo0 0thartsa0 cho7)yis dmag mi chig stong bdun brgya khrid de le khi zhin ton (60zo1brtsa 0ba sto/1mdzarsā)dang khang khu ti (00ba00 6 lo༅2byu)gnyis kyi a ri'i rgyal gces mi sna 'du gnas la 'jab rgol byas/ a ri'i mis sngon la gnas tshul tshor te skung rgol gyi gra sgrig byas/ dmag lwa dmar po gon pa'i dbyin dmag 'phred bstar bsgrigs te rngam zil che ba'i sgo nas le khi zhin ton la rgol ba'i tshe/ a ri'i dmangs dmag gis dbyin ti an pa'i sa nas bslabs yong ba'i thor dmag 'thab rtsal spyad de dbyin dmag la rdung rdeg byas/ dmangs dmag rnams () tso kri ya khul gyi 'thus mi chad/ 65

kyis nags gseb dang khang rgyab nas me mda' brgyab pas/ dbyin dmag la gang sar rdung rdeg thebs shing gar 'thab mi shes par gyur te pham kha chen po myong zhing / mi re lnga bsad la/ mi brgya dang brgyad cu rmas te phyir logagayul 'thab thengs des a ri'i mi dmangs kyi dpa' sems dang spobs par skul lcag chen po thebs/ a ri'i rang btsan 'thab 'dzing ni de ltar du mgo brtsams so//1775lo'i zla 5par/ skam sa'i tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa 'tshogs te/cho kri wa hrin thon (yoḥ61 rtsa 0ba ༅ṭharsāsmo) a ri'i dmag spyi chen mor 'dems bsko byas/ a ri'i mi dmangs la rang nyid kyi dmag spyi yod pas rang btsan g.yul 'thab kyi gom stabs je mgyogs su song /wa hrin thon ni 'debs 'dzugs ra ba'i bdag po zhig gi khyim du skyes la/kho rang lo 20la bslebs tshe pha spun gnyis snga phyir tshe las 'das/ khos 8 wer nong (501 0balkololapo)ri gzhis ’ kyi zhing sa rgyud 'dzin byas shing / der sa zhing kung chin brgyad stong dang bran nag bco brgyad yod/ kho ni rta bzhon pa dang ri dwags rngon rgyur dga' la/ bdag gnyer gyi 'jon thang dang ldan pa zhig yin/ ma 'gyangs par kho dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dmag dpung du zhugs nas phyi rol nas lo ngo drug la g.yul 'thab byas pas/ g.yul 'thab kyi 'jon rtsal la byang bar gyur/ dbyin pho'i lo ngo bdun gyi g.yul 'khrug khrod khos bstud mar dpa' rtags bzhag pas hrang zha'o zhes pa'i go gnas thob/skam sa'i tshogs chen thengs dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs su/ kho ni wer ke ne'u yi 'thus mi yin zhing / lus la dmag lwa gon nas tshogs 'dur zhugs pas/ tshang mas snang 'jog chen po byas/ khos a ri'i dmag spyi chen po khur ba'i zla gnyis par/ ri bo pan khi'i g.yul 'gyed du nyin gcig la dbyin 66

dmag gi shugs drag po'i tshur rgol thengs gsum phyir bzlog 1776lo'i zla 3par/ wa hrin thon gyis dmag sne drangs nas po si khron la bskor rdung byas shing / dbyin dmag gi dmag spyis mkhar btang ste bros byol byas pas/ wa hrin thon gyi snyan grags lhag tu rgyas/1776lo'i zla )tshes 4nyin/ skam sa'i tshogs chen thengs gnyis pas 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉la gros mthun byung / de'i ma phyi 'bri mkhan ni thom zi je hpher son (160 ཿ10110 30 ༅bralo rke77)dang / hphu ran khi lin sogs yin/ smyug thogs pa gtso bo ni je hpher son yin la/ kho skabs der rang lo 35tsam yin zhing / bsam blo sngon thon dang spyang grung che ba zhig yin/ khos bab chags kyi skad cha dang / rngam brjid kyi tshig nyams la brten nas yo rob kyi bsam blo ba rnams kyis bton pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs dang gsar brje'i rtsa don gnad bsdus su brjod pa dang / zil shugs che ba'i sgo nas 44nga tshos bltas na gsham gyi bden don 'di ni khyad du 'phags shing khas mi len mi rung ba zhig yin te/ mi tshang ma skyes ma nyid nas 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / 'jig rten byed pos kho tsho tshang mar kha bsgyur du med pa'i dbang cha skor cig bstsal yod la/ de'i khrod du 'tsho gnas kyi dbang cha dang / rang dbang gi dbang cha/bde skyid snyeg pa'i dbang cha bcas yod/ srid lugs kyi rnam pa gang zhig gis dmigs 'ben 'di rigs la bar gegs byas pa na/ mi dmangs la de bcos bsgyur byedwa pa'am gtan med bzo ba'i dbang cha yod ’’ces dril bsgrags/ 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉ni a ri rang btsan yin par bsgrags pa'i lo rgyus yig tshang zhig yin par ma zad/ da dung 'byor ldan gral rim yar dar skabs kyi mi dmangs kyis dmangs gtso'i bdag dbang re 67

gnyer byed pa'i bsgrags gtam zhig kyang yin/ gong smros kyi legs bshad de dbyin ji'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mtshan nyid smra ba lo khe (106 ༅00khu0༈slo༅)yi lhan skyes dbang cha smra ba las byung ba zhig yin pa snyon med yin mod/'on kyang je hpher so/na ni lo khe las spyang po yod/ kho bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gtum por shin tu sdang ste/ kho'i thel tse zhig gi steng du/‘8mnga' bdag gtum por ngo rgol byed pa ni/ dkon mchog la 'dud pa'o mi zhes pa'i legs bshad cig brkos yod/ a ri ba'i sems su/ je hpher son ni wa hrin thon dang lin khon (61ba001 oṃzlo)bcas snyan grags mnyam pa'i rlabs chen mi sna gsum bgrang ba'i de'i gras su 'joga.a ri'i rang btsan g.yul 'thab de snga phyir lo ngo hril bo drug la brgyab pa dang / wa hrin thon gyis rgyal kha mi nyung ba zhig blangs la/ pham kha'ang mi nyung ba zhig myong / wa hrin thon gyis dmag dpung khrid nas g.yul ngor dpa' 'thab byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ hphu ran khi lin gtso byas pa'i phyi 'brel pa skor cig yo rob tu song ste/ skabs de'i gnas babs legs po bed spyad nas phyogs so so'i rgyab skyor thob thabs kyi4 dbyin ji kher rkyang du bzos/ skabs de'i rgyal spyi'i gnas babs de dngos gnas a ri la phan po zhig yod de/'dzam gling gi sger chod dbang cha 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i yun ring po'i 'thab rtsod khrod/ dbyin ji la dgra bo mi nyung ba zhig byung yod pas so// hpha ran si dang si phen/ ho lan ḍi sogs kyis skabs glags de dang bstun nas dbyin jir 'thab brda sbran zhing / u ru si yis drag chas kyis bar gnas bgyid rgyu khyab bsgrags byas so// dbyin jis 'thab g.yul mang po nas dus mtshungs su ma 'thab dbang med byung bas gnas babs nyen kha shin tu chen por gyur/ phyi 'brel gyi pham gyong las dmag don thad nas kyang mgyogs por pham par gyur/ 68

1781lo'i yo khi grong brdal (50 khu 04ba sbyogi༅ma)gyi g.yul 'gyed nang /dbyin ji'i dmag spyi chen mo khang wa li (058 103 007b.lom13 lo༅sa/)pham par gyur te/ dmag dpung mi grangs bdun stong dang lhan wa hrin thon la mgo btags/ rngam zil do zla med pa'i dbyin ji'i rgyal tshang dmag mi rnams kyis ‘ gnam sa mgo rting log cing / 'jig rten phyir 'khor brgyab pa'i ’ gzhas chung gtong bzhin/ gyon chas ngan ngon can gyi a ri'i dmag dpung gi mdun du drag chas sa la bzhag 1783lo'i zla 9par/ dbyin ji dang a ris 〈〈pha ri si'i (23ba3 ༅ཿ)gros chings 〉〉bzhag ste/ dbyin jir thabs zad nas a ri rang btsan yin par khas blangs so//gsar brjer rgyal kha thob/ wa hrin thon dmag spyi chen mo dang / rgyal 'dzugs pa zhig tu byas te/ mdzad rjes rmad du byung ba bzhag wa hrin thon gyi lag 'og gi dmag dpon skor cig gis kho la thengs du mar zhu yig phul te/a ri mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs kyi rgyal khab tu 'dzugs pa dang /khong rang rgyal por bkur rgyur zhus/ le'u ye zi ne'u khi la (smo17lo ༅yorto'i)zer ba'i hrang zha'o zhig gis wa hrin thon la thad kur yi ge bris te/dmag dpung gi rgyab skyor la brten nas rang nyid rgyal por bsko ba'am sger gcod par byas te/ dbang cha gcig sdud can gyi srid gzhung stobs ldan zhig 'dzugs rgyur zhus/ wa hrin thon gyis 'phrin yig bklags rjes ya mtshan dang khong khro shin tu skyes te kho la 'phrin lan 'di ltar bris/88bdag gis blo rtse sgrim nas khyod kyis bdag la springs pa'i bsam 'char yī ge der bltas pas/ nga rang ya mtshan chen po skye ru bcug ‘rgyal po midang ‘sger gcod pa )sogs yi ge 'di dag ni bdag la mtshon na ngo tsha ya med cig yin/ 69

‘‘ 64gal te khyod kyis khyod rang gi mes rgyal la gong bkur dang / khyod rang nyid dang khyod kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud la brtsi 'jog bdag la'ang gus bkur byed pa'i dbang du btang na/ bdag gis khyod la bsam blo 'di rigs khyod kyi sems nas gtsang sel byed rgyu'i re ba bton pa yin la/ khyod dang gzhan su zhig gis kyang da nas bzung lta ba 'di rigs sgrog spel byed mi chog par brjod pa yin no//’’wa hrin thon gyis rnam 'gyur gsal po'i sgo nas rgyal po byed pa dang du ma blangs pa'i rjes su'ang / khos don 'dir sems bde mo yong mi thub cing / nam rgyun bsam gzhigs yang dang yang du byas/ khos yang snying gsar byung gi rgyal khab 'di phyogs gang zhig la 'khrid 'os sam/ khong la rang gi phrag par babs pa'i 'gan khur de yang mo zhig ma yin par nges shes skyes/ khos bsam gzhigs yang wa hrin thon/yang byas pa'i mthar spyi khyab dmag dpon gyi 'gan khur bskyur te phyir khyim du log nas zhing las gnyer rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i gtso 'dzin lag na yod pa de dor nas khyim du log ste zhing las gnyer rgyu ni sems khong yangs shing rang ham med pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi snas da gzod bgyi nus pa zhig red/ wa hrin thon ni de lta bu'i rlabs chen gyi mi zhig red/ 70

1783lo'i zla 12par/ khos spyi khyab dmag dpon gyi 'gan phab re ba dngos su zhus te lo ngo drug la gyes pa'i pha yul du slar log nas zhing las gnyer/1787lor a ris rtsa khrims gtam la phab/ 1789lor wa hrin thon a ri'i tsung thung thog mar 'dems bsko byas pas kho yang bskyar zhing gzhis dang gyes dgos pa byung / khos tsung thung skabs thog gnyis la khur zhing der khyon bsdoms lo ngo brgyad 'gor ba dang / tsung thung skabs gsum pa bstud mar 'khur rgyu dang tshe gang tsung thung 'khur rgyu'i thad blo thag rbad chod kyis ngo rgol byas/ 1796lor khos skad grags che ba'i 〈〈gyes bral gtam bshad 〉〉du grags pa spel nas slar yang zhing gzhis la log 1799lo'i zla 12par/ kho mid pa'i tsha nad kyis tshe las 'das/ tshe las 'da' khar khos kha chems bzhag ste rang gi bem po wer nong ri gzhis su dur 'jug byed par gdams/ wa hrin thon gyis tsung thung skabs gsum pa bstud 'khur ma byas pa'i spyod pa de/phyis su a ri'i tsung thung bstud 'khur skabs gnyis yan mi bgyi ba'i mig dpe ru gyur/ a ri'i mi dmangs kyis kho ni ‘8g.yul 'khrug dus skabs kyi mi dang po dang / zhi bde'i dus skabs kyi mi dang po yin la/ a ri'i mi dmangs kyi sems khong gi mi dang po yang yin ’ zhes bsngags brjod byed do//

dgu pa/ mi rnamasaya blongaskyed sbyin pa'i mi/dus rabs 18pa'i dus stod du/ hpha ran si ni mi sna rlabs chen mkho gal che zhing rlabs chen mi sna 'byung yang nus pa'i dus rabs shig tu gnas yod/ 'byor ldan gral rim de ches 'byor phyug ldan pa'i gral rim zhig tu gyur zin zhing / dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi chab srid lam lugs te dper na mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs lta bu dang / dbyin ji'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rigs pa ste dper na lo khe'i lhan skyes kyi dbang cha smra ba lta bu/dbyin ji'i sngon thon gyi rang byung tshan rig ste dper na nye'u thon (1347khu0spo 0ba༅rsāsmo)gyi dngos khams rig pa lta bu tshang mas hpha ran si la shugs rkyen gting zab mo thebs/ skabs de'i hpha ran si'i chab srid lam lugs la mtshon na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod kyi lam lugs mtshan nyid pa zhig yin te/ rigs kyi rim gras gzab nan zhig yod la/ rgyal po'i dbang thang ya na med pa zhig yin zhing / chos lugs kyi rmongs blo ring lugs kyis mi rnams kyi bsam blo kun nas bcings pa zhig yin/ lu'e zi sku rabs bcu bzhi pa (༅0513 1sa 7skya/a)yis ‘ rgyal dbang gnam gyis bskos pa ’ dang ‘ rgyal po ni rgyal khab yin ’ pa'i lta ba mngon bsgrags byed/ rgyal po'i go thob dang jo thob/ (tsho1mo) dpon thob la rgyud 'dzin dang tshe gang lam lugs lag tu bstar bzhin mchis/ lu'e zi bcu bzhi pa khrir 'khod pa nas 'das reg (1643 — 1715)tu/ khri gnas su lo ngo bdun cu don gnyis la bsdad pas/ha lam 'dzam gling steng rgyal po byas pa'i dus yun ches ring ba zhig yin srid/72

'byor phyug ches che ba'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa dag dbang cha med pa'i go gnas su mchis pas/ gnas babs la shin tu mi mos pa ni smos ma dgos so//kho tshos skabs glags btsal nas 'ur chen po brgyab ste kho tsho'i bsam tshul dang re ba zhu 'don byed/ de ltar/ dus rabs 18pa'i dkyil du bslebs pa na/hpha ran si la khyad du 'phags pa'i mi sna skor cig byung nas/ shugs rkyen gting zab cing yun ring bo dang ldan pa'i bsam blo bcing 'grol gyi las 'gul zhig langs/ de ni mi rnams kyis rgyun du bshad pa'i 88blo bskyed las 'gul ’ zhes pa de red/ las 'gul thengs des ya nga med pa'i sgo nas bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs dang chos lugs rmongs blo ring lugs la sun 'byin dang rdung rdeg byas shing / lha dbang dang rgyal po'i dbang thang /bkas bkod khyad dbang bcas la rdung rdeg dang / spro bag 'phel ba'i sgo nas 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 64rang dbang dang / 'dra mnyam/ byams brtse chen po ’ dang / 64tshan rig dang dmangs gtso ’ bcas dril bsgrags byas/ las 'gul thengs 'di'i sngon gral du 'greng mkhan gyi skad grags che ba'i 'thus tshab pa ni wol ther (701 tha1 0yo lodngha)dang/ mon the si khe'u(50ba na'5105chotsho༅ཿ)/ ro'u si'u(108sa— /309503 50533035 ṇa7)/ ti te rod (00 13 ba160 0 7mtsho)bcas yin/ kho tsho ni 'jon thang sna mang po can yin zhing / dpe gzhung brtsams te brtan brling sgos 'thab 'dzing byed phod pa zhig yin/ kho tsho'i rno dbal ldan pa'i bsam blo yis glog dmar bzhin mi rnams rmongs gnyid las sad du bcug ste/ bsleb la nye ba'i hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje chen po la rnga rdung lam 'byed byas shing /bsam blo'i thad dang gzhung lugs kyi thad nas gsar brje thengs der gra sgrig tshags su chud pa byas/ de dag gi lo rgyus kyi mdzad rjes ni dus rabs dang sa 73

khul gyi khyab khongs las brgal yod de/ kho tsho'i bsam blo mi nyung ba zhig da lta'ang gzi 'od 'bar gyin 'dug yin na'ang skabs der kho tshos 'tsho ba dang 'thab 'dzing thad dka' ba ha cang mang po zhig myangs/ gsham du gong nas bshad pa'i blo bskyed bsam blo ba bzhi mtshams sbyor rags tsam bya'o//wol ther gyi gdod ma'i ming la hphu ran zo ye ma re a no yed (kha 3ba0013—5tha 10 ba050 770lo bralko/ adngha༅)zer zhing / pha ri si'i khyim tshang phyug po zhig tu skyes la/ chung dus nas slob gso legs po thob/ kho lu'e zi bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/ bcu drug bcas bkas bkod mnga' bdag gi dbang sgyur dus skabs brgyud de/ hpha ran si'i sger gcod ring lugs dar ba nas rgud par gyur tshul dngos su mthong / khos gsar brje bsleb nges pa snga nas rtogs te/ rang gi grogs po la bshad rgyur/ 88bdag gi mtha' 'khor du byung ba yod tshad kyis gsar brje'i sa bon 'debs kyin yod/ nga rang nyid kyis gsar brje dngos su mthong bar 'gyur ba'i nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang de nges par du bsleb 'gyur ro ’ zhes brjod/wol ther gyi brtsams chos ni rno dbal che ba'i skad cha dang zur za'i tshig nyams kyi cha nas skad du grags yod/ khos tsha rnon gyi sgo nas sger gcod ring lugs la zur za byas pas thengs gnyis la pa si thil btson khang ( ta0 3ཿ 1khu0phya༅ṭha7)du bcug la/ kho'i dpe cha bkag sdom byas nas bsregs shing /thengs mang por rgyal khongs las phyir sgyugs/ kho'i gsung rtsom gtso gras ni 〈〈mi rigs so so'i yul goms dang snying stobs 〉〉dang 〈〈mtshan nyid rig pa'i tshig mdzod 〉〉sogs yin la/ ches shugs rkyen che ba ni 〈〈mtshan nyid rig pa'i cha 'phrin 〉〉zhes pa de yin zhing / de la mi rnams kyis ‘8lam lugs rnying par 'phangs pa'i 'gas mdel dang po ’ zhes zer ro//74

skabs la lar kho yang lam 'gro shin tu rgyug po byung ste pha ri si'i sku brnyan du bkur te/ kho la 8 hpha ran si'i ches phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa ’ zhes brjod pa dang / skabs shig ring lu'e zi bco lnga pa'i pho brang gi dpon rigs kyang 'khur myong / kho la phu ro zi'i (943318 stsospro )rgyal po hphu re te ri khi sku rabs gnyis pa'i (tha 060110khu khya lko༅ཿ༅tshongakhri)mos pa thob myong zhing / u ru si'i rgyal mo ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pas (༅5'il09552 khya khu/༈༈sgo ཿngatsho7༅)kyang mjal 'phrad gnang myong / yin na'ang / mjug 'bras tshang ma ni gyen rgol gyi bsam blo dang rno ngar gyi skad cha las phyir 'bud btang ba kho na'o//wol ther gyis sger gcod ring lugs dang chos lugs kyi mun nag dbang sgyur la sun 'byin byed pa ni dngos gnas tsha rnon che zhing ya nga med pa zhig yin/ khos chos rgyal la 64rkang gnyis gcan gzan ’ dang / chos pa la ‘ rig pa'i 'chal po ’/ gnam bdag chos lugs la ‘4g.yo sgyu can gyi mi skor zhig gis bkod pa'i ches ngo tsha bral ba'i g.yo sgyu'i dra ba ’’zhes 'bod/ khos ‘4mi re re tshang mas rang nyid kyi thabs kyis 'jigs su rung ba'i chos lugs kyi smyo spyod la 'thab 'dzing byed dgos te/ mi la las de'i am cog la so 'debs pa dang / kha cig gis de'i pho bar rdog brdzis byed pa/ da dung skor zhig gis thag ring po nas dmod mo byed dgos ’nyazhes 'bod skul btang /yin na'ang wole ther ni lha med smra ba zhig min/ khos mi dmangs la dbang sgyur byed kyi chos lugs ni med du mi rung ste/ ‘ 'jig rten skyabs mgon zhes pa zhig med pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / de gsar bzo byed dgos ’ zhes zer/wol ther ni rang byung dbang thang smra bar dad mkhan zhig yin la/ ‘ mi 75

rnams ngo bo'i steng nas 'dra mnyam yin par 'dod cing / mi re re bzhin ‘ rang byung gi dbang thang ’ ldan par re 'bod byed/ khos mi re re bzhin khrims kyi mdun du 'dra mnyam yin mod/ 'on kyang rgyu nor gyi dbang cha'i 'dra mnyam ma yin pa ni g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin par 'dod/ wol ther gyis da dung ngal rtsol mi dmangs la mthong chung byed de/ kho tshos las ka rtsing po dag byed pa las bsam gzhigs gtong mi nus par 'dod/ khos 6 mi ser rnams kyang bsam gzhigs gtong ba'i skabs su yod tshad tshar song ba yin mi’zer/mtshan nyid rigs pa'i gsung rtsom las gzhan wol ther gyis da dung snyan ngag dang rigs rtogs brtsams sgrung / lo rgyus 'khrab gzhung mi nyung ba zhig kyang brtsams yod/mon the si khe'u ni skye khungs khyim rgyud mtho ste/ kho'i mes po ni por to khrims khang gi 'go 'dzin yin la/ de ni rgyud 'dzin rung ba'i 'gan gnas shig yin pas/ phyis su kho'i a khus rgyud 'dzin byas/ khos rang lo 27steng a khu las 'gan gnas de rgyud 'dzin byas shing / mon the si khe'u nan jo zhes pa'i 'ja' sa'ang thob/ kho'i thog ma'i ming la khrar le lu'e zi nyi si khon tad (06tha 103 0513 60 3ཿ0ba62 za loskya ཿ zarto6ca)zer la/ mon the si khe'u zhes pa'i ming 'di grags che bas thog ma'i ming de shes mkhan shin tu dkon/ mon the si khe'u yis khrims khang gi 'go 'dzin gyi las gnas su bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs kyi gtum drag dang rul sungs dngos su mthong bas sems khong nas khro ba chen po skyes/ kho dpon rigs kyi 'tsho bar rim bzhin zhen pa log par gyur pas khrims khang gi 'go 'dzin gyi khyim rgyud go 76

gnas de rin gong mthon po'i ngang phyir btsong ste/ rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi las la blo sems rtse gcig gis zhugs/ kho yo rob kyi rgyal khab so sor 'grul skyod byas shing / yul dngos su song ste rgyal khab so so'i chab srid lam lugs la rtog dpyod byas la/ nang sgos su dbyin ji'i mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs la rtog dpyod zhib tshags byas/ kho'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos ni 〈〈par zig gi mi'i springs yig〉〉(703 60 013 9048baḥ ༅༅ma/rbha༈6)dang 〈〈rom gyi dar rgud rgyu rkyen gleng ba〉〉 〈〈khrims kyi dgongs pa gleng ba 〉〉zhes pa bcas yin/ 〈〈khrims kyi dgongs pa gleng ba 〉〉zhes pa ni khos lo ngo nyi shu'i ring zhib 'jug gzab nan bgyis pa'i grub 'bras yin la/ par du bskrun rjes skad grags chen po byung zhing / lo ngo gnyis ring par thengs nyer gnyis btab/ mon the si khe'u yi ches khyad du thon pa'i bsam blo ni ‘ dbang gsum so sor 'dzugs pa ’ yin/ kho 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam blo ba zhig tu byas te/ bkas bkod sger gcod lam lugs la shin tu sdang bo yod/ khos sna gal te mnga' bdag gis rang gi mnga' 'bangs la bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bskrun par mi nus par ma zad/ de las ldog ste kho tshor gnya' gnon dang mnar gcod byas tshe/ kho rang la brtsi bkur byed dgos don med/ skabs der/ kho tshos rang nyid kyi lhan skyes rang dbang slar gso byed chog ’ ces brjod la /khos da dung ‘6khrims 'dzugs dbang dang srid 'dzin dbang de mi gcig gam yang na las khungs gcig gi lag tu shor tshe/ rang dbang yod mi srid do 7zhes kyang brjod yod/ khos dbang cha bgo dgos pa'i re ba bton te/ khrims 'dzugs dang khrims 'dzin/ srid 'dzin gyi dbang so sor phye dgos pa'i lta ba bton/ gros tshogs kyis khrims 'dzugs dbang 'dzin zhing / khrims khang 77

gis khrims 'dzin dbang 'dzin pa dang / rgyal pos srid 'dzin gyi dbang cha bzung ste/ de gsum phan tshun tshod 'dzin dang / phan tshun do snyoms yong ba byas nas dab nga cha gang 'dod du spyod pa 'gog dgos par brjod/ mon the si khe'u yi dbang gsum so sor 'dzugs par smra ba de gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tshab byas te bkas bkod dbang sgyur par dbang cha mnyam spyod kyi re ba bton pa zhig yin pa ni mngon gsal red mod/ 'on kyang khos gsar brje la bsngags bstod mi byed de/ kho'i phugs bsam gyi dpe gzhi'i rgyal khab ni dbyin ji'i rnam pa'i mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lam lugs yin/ mon the sekhi'u yi ‘ dbang gsum so sor 'dzugs par ’ smra ba de a ri'i gsar brje dang hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i khrod mngon bstar byung yod/ro'u si'u yi ming kha tshang la jon je khus ro'u si'u (/0thab—/30550350033085 11 ཿ༅ ṇaṣṭha)zer/ kho ni wol ther dang mon the si khe'u gnyis dang mi 'dra ste/ skyes khungs shin tu dbul zhing chung dus nas bzo phrug byas te slob gso rnal ma zhig myong ma thub pas/ kho'i shes yon ni rang sbyong la brten nas thob pa yin/ 'tsho thabs kyi ched du khos gla g.yog dang drung yigakhyim zhus dge rgan/ dbyangs tshig bshu 'bri ba sogs byed myong zhing / mi yul gyi skyo sdug mang du myangs/ kho la 'jon thang shin tu che zhing / stes dbang gi go skabs shig las kho ming du grags par gyur/ skabs de ni 1749lo yin/nyin zhig kho btson bkag byas pa'i ti te rod la lta ru phebs lam du dus deb cig steng ti rung tshan rig gling gi 〈〈tshan rig dang sgyu rtsal bskyar dar gyis yul goms drang bsgyur byed par phan min 〉〉skor gyi rtsom bsdu'i yi ge zhig bkod yod pa mthong bas/ de dang len sgos rtsom 'bri rgyu'i sems thag bcad cing /lo ngo mang por sems na gsog pa'i dungs pa dang bsam gzhigs byas pa'i lta 78

ba lhug par bton/ mjug 'bras ni kho'i dpyad rtsom la bya dga' ang dang po thob/ yin na'ang ro'u si'u spyi tshogs gong ma'i gras su 'tshang 'dod med pas mu mthud du dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba rol zhing / blo sems rtse gcig gis dpe gzhung 'bri rtsom byas/ 1755lor 〈〈mi'i rigs kyi 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i 'byung khungs dang rmang gzhi 〉〉zhes pa 'grem spel byas shing / 1762lor kho'i mi tshe gang bo'i nang gi ches gting zab pa'i gsung rtsom 〈〈spyi tshogs chings gan smra ba 〉〉zhes pa 'grem spel byas/ khos da dung rtsom rig phyogs kyi brtsams chos kyang mang po 'bri myong / kho'i shugs rkyen cung che ba'i slob gso'i brtsams sgrung ni 〈〈cha mel〉〉(༅ ༅4110tsho.oṃlo)dang phyir dran zin tho'i rang bzhin can gyi 〈〈'gyod bshags zin tho〉〉(20300ba103310236lorṣa)yin/ro'u si'u ni 'byor ldan chung ba'i gral rim gyi drag skyod dmangs gtso ring lugs pa zhig yin la/ kho blo bskyed bsam blo ba gzhan dag las khyad du 'phags yod/ kho yang 8 lhan skyes mi dbang ’ smra ba zhig yin te mi re re bzhin skyes pa nas 'dra mnyam yin pa ni skyes thob kyi dbang cha yin par 'dod mod/ 'on kyang khos 'dra mnyam mayin pa'i 'byung khungs ni sger dbang gi rgyu nor bdag tu bzung ba yin par 'dod do// ro'u si'u yis chab srid spyi tshogs kyi khrims mthun gzhi rkang ni spyi tshogs chings gan la brten pa yin par 'dod de/ mi rnams kyis spyi tshogs chings gan gzhir bzung nas rang nyid kyi khe dbang dang dbang shugs spyi tshogs la bcol zhing / mi sger gyi 'dod mos de spyi mos su gcig gyur yong dgos la/ bdag dbang gi ngo bo ni spyi mos kyi ngos na yod la/ thun mong la dbang ba yin pas/ mi nyung shos kyis sger 'dzin byed mi rung bar 'dod/ ro'u si'u bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs la sems gting nas sdang po yod/ khos mnga' bdag gtum pos 79

btsan shugs la brten nas mnga' 'bangs kyi tshe srog dang rgyu nor la gang byung byas pa na/ mnga' 'bangs kyis kyang btsan drag la brten nas kho pa mgo rting slog 'os zer/ nā pho lun (mtha༅/002 80ba39tha 0 4waṃ)gyis kyang gal te ro'u si'u med na hpha ran si'i gsar brje yang yod mi srid ces brjod do//ro'u si'u yis mi'i rigs la rig pa'i shul nom phun sum tshogs po zhig bzhag yod mod/ 'on kyang skabs der kho rang nyid la thob pa ni mtshan snyan ma yin par gnod 'tshe yin/ kho'i brtsams chos mer bsregs par ma zad/kho 'dzin rgyu'i bka' rgya'ang bkram pas/ thabs zad de rgyal khab gzhan du yib sdod byed dgos pa byung / kho rang lo 58la son tshe da gzod mes rgyal la log chog pa byung zhing / lo drug cur slebs ma thag 'khor gegs byung nas/gza' 'khor drug gi rjes te/ 1778lo'i zla 1tshes 2nyin hpha ran si'i rtsom rig gar stegs kyi skar ma 'od po che de 'grib par gyur la/ kho 'das khar gam du nye 'brel gcig kyang med/ kho rang lo 32skabs mgron khang gi g.yog mo zhig dang mnyam sdod byas te byis pa lnga yod myong mod/ 'on kyang khos tshang ma dwa phrug khang du bskyal/ mi kha cig gis don de las kho la snyad 'dogs byed de/ kho ni bag med snying rje bral ba zhig yin par brjod/ nga tshos gnas skabs su kho'i sger ngos kyi 'tsho ba gleng brjod mi byed la/ don dngos thogarlabs chen gyi mi zhig la'ang yon tan las skyon med pa zhig gang na yod/blobaskyed bsam blo'i khrod da dung ti te rod ces pa'i mi sna grags can zhig yod/ kho'i ming ni 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉dang gzhi gcig tu 'brel yod de/ kho gtso byas pa'i bsam blo ba skor cig la shes bya kun 'dzoms pa zhes 'bod/ ming de thogs khungs skor ni khos rtsa 'dzugs sgos rtsom 'bri byas pa'i 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉dang 'brel nas bshad dgos/ 80

1728lor dbyin ji'i chan po zi dpe skrun khang gis shes bya kun 'dzoms deb tshogs shig par du bskrun la tshong kha shin tu rgyug po byung /1747lor hpha ran si'i dpe skrun pa gnyis kyis de hpha ran si'i skad du bsgyur nas dpe skrun byad 1 dod de ti te rod btsal bas khos de ma nyid du khur du blangs/ skabs der kho rang lo so bzhi yin te/ lo na gzhon zhing nus stobs rgyas pa/ spyang grung ldan pa/'i sgang yin/ yin na'ang lo tsā'i khrod khos dbyin ji'i shes bya kun 'dzoms dpe tshogs de nang don tha thor yin zhing lta ba rnying la/ mi yi dbugs sgo gcod pa'i bkas bkod lha dbang dang chos lugs rmongs dad kyi bsam blo yang mang du yod pa rtogs par gyur pas/ khos rang nyid kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas te shes bya 'thus sgo tshang zhing yid rton rung ba/ nang don tshan rig ldan pa/ sgrig stangs gsar mtshar che ba'i shes bya kun 'dzoms dpe tshogs shig bsgrig rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ ti te rod kyi 'char gzhi der wol ther dang / ro'u si'u/ hol pa hi(sngatha01 50ba 1 010/ 106 63 026’5016805 ṇḍi1mdophyarkilko)/ elawe zhu (0/3060 6710sa 5 1ma60 12321lotram̐khri/ṣṭha)sogs mkhas pa grags can nyi shu lhag gi rgyab skyor thob/ti te rod kyis sgrub pa de ni las don gsar ba zhig yin pas mdun skyod kyi gom pa re re bzhin gegs 'tshe dang 'phrad/ 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉mngags nyo'i skabs su kho ci yin 'di yin med par btson du bcug ste zla ngo du ma 'gor/ dum pa dang po dang gnyis pa par du bskrun rjes chos tshogs kyis chos pa mngags nas don tshan re re bzhin zhib bsher byas shing / 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉kyis 8 lha dbang khyad du bsad yod ’ pas ru log lta can ’ yin pa'i skyon 'dogs byas/ pha ri si'i mtho rim khrims khang gis de'i rtsom pa po zhig khrims gtug byas te kho phyir bros mi byed thabs med du btang / yin 81

na yang skabs de'i 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉ni gegs thogs med pa'i sgo nas spyi tshogs steng mgyogs myur du dar khyab byung ste/ mi rnams kyis 'gran pa bzhin lta klog dang bsngags brjod chen po byas la/ tha na dus skabs shig ring pha ri si'i lcam chen dag gi mchor sgrom steng du'ang 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉re gnyis 'jog pa'i tshad du bslebs/ 1752lor nye blon 'gas rgyal po lu'e zi bco lnga pa la/ gal te lcam mo dang sras mo re re'i mchor sgrom tshang ma'i steng du 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉'ga' re bzhag pa na rgyal gzhis la 'jigs nyen 'byung bar gdon mi za zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos mu mthud du par bskrun byed mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ 'on kyang mchor sgrom gyi zing cha des 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉mu mthud par bskrun byed pa 'gog par ma nus/ mi dmangs kyi spro shugs che ba'i rgyab skyor 'og mngags nyo'i yi ge phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas sngar mus bzhin btang yong bas/ dbang 'dzin par yang thabs zad de mu mthud par bskrun byed du bcug〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉kyis dngos gtso ring lugs dang rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya dril bsgrags byas te/ bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs dang chos lugs kyi rmongs 'thoms ring lugs la dgag pa brgyab/ shes bya kun 'dzoms pa'i khrod kyi mi mi nyung ba zhig ni dngos gtso ring lugs pa dang lha med smra ba yin mod/ 'on kyang kho tsho ni dngos gtso ring lugs rengs po'i dus rim du gnas pa ni smras ma dgos so// kho tshos dngos po ni rtag brtan dang / yod pa gcig pu yin la/ gsar gtod dang rtsa med gtong mi nus par 'dod cing / dngos po'i rang byung khams las gzhan gyi rang byung las 'das pa'i byed po zhig gtan nas med par 'dod/ ti te rod kyis 6‘mi rnams kyis chos lugs la rgyab skyor byed spyad du spyod pa'i don de dag ni rnying 82

rul dang ya mtshan che la/ de ni dogs tshom ya na med pa'i don dag la brten nas ches yid rton mi rung ba de la bden dpang byed pa zhig yin ’ zhes brjod pa dang / hol pa hi yis 88mnga' bdag ni mi yin pa las lha ma yin ’ zhes brjod/ khos mnga' bdag lha ru smras pa ni/ lha yi ming spyad nas tshul min lugs 'gal gyi gnod 'tshe'i bya ba spyod bde kho na'i ched yin par 'dod/shes bya kun 'dzoms pa yis dril bsgrags byas pa'i bden don de dgalha yi ming g.yar nas rdzob spyod bgyi mkhan gyi dbang sgyur pa'i na gnad du phog pas/ kho pa tshos smyo ham che ba'i sgo nas de dag la gnod pa'i sbyor ba brtsams/pha ri si'i zhib dpyod spyi dpon gyis 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉ni 88dngos gtso ring lugs dril sgrog pa nying don du byas te/ chos lugs rtsa med gtong ba dang / rang btsan gyi snying stobs skul spel byed pa/ kun spyod tha mal du bsgyur ba zhig yin ’ zhes smad brjod byas pa dang / chos gtsos mer bsreg dgos pa'i bka' phab la/ khrims dpon chen po zhig gis kyang mtho rim khrims khang du ‘4mtshan nyid smra ba'i dpe cha bsregs nas 'dang song / da ni mtshan nyid smra ba rang nyid bsregs pa'i dus la ran song ’’zhes kyang skad cor brgyab bo//de lta bu'i gnas babs ya nga ba zhig tu/ ti te rod yi thang ma chad la zhum pa med pa'i sgo nas/ wol the la 'phrin yig springs te ‘ ji ltar byung na yang / kho bo la dmu rgod rnams kyi khrod nas bya ba sgrub skabs/ dngangs skrag skye zhing sdar ma'i ngang tshul 'byung srid do snyam pa'i bsam tshul ma skye zhig nga rang tsho'i 'bod tshig ni rmongs dad can dang smyo dad can/ blun po/ smyon pa/gte bo/ gtum rgyal rnams gtan nas gu yangs mi gtong ba ’ de yin zhes smras/ de ltar/ ti te rod kyis ngo mtshar skyed pa'i hur sems dang spobs 83

pas lo ngo nyi shu la rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ mthar 1766lor gtos su che ba'i 〈〈shes bya kun 'dzoms 〉〉kyi gtso bsgrigs legs grub byung / khos mtha' ma'i shog lte 'gar zhus zhib gnang rjes spro bag shin tu chen pos 8 da nyin bcu lhag gi rjes su/ bdag gi mi lo nyi shu'i dus tshod bzung ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'dis bdag la 'byor phyug chen po ma rgyas mod/ 'on kyang bdag nyen kha chen por gtugs te cung min na mes rgyal dang bral te rang dbang yang shor dgos byung song ’ zhes smras/ en ke sis ‘4gal te/ mi su zhig gis ‘bden don dang drang tshugs kyi lhag bsam ’ (tshig 'di'i drang phyogs kyi don brjod na )ched tshe srog phul yod na/ de ni ti te rod lta bu'i mi zhig yin par nges ’ zhes gsungs so//1784lo'i zla 1tshes 30nyin/ dgong ja 'thung rjes ti te rod bsnyes stegs su mi yul dang gyes la skabs der dgung lo 71yin/ kho'i tha ma'i skad cha ste ‘ the tshom ni mtshan nyid rigs pa'i phyogs su bgrod pa'i gom pa dngang po yin ’ zhes par gsan mkhan ni kho'i bu mo yin/ ti te rod ni phul du byung ba'i blo skyed bsam blo ba zhig yin par ma zad/ da dung khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsom rig pa dang mdzes dpyod rig pa'i gzhung lugs pa zhig kyang yin te/kho'i brtsams chos gtso bo la 〈〈dge sgrub ma〉〉(༅3 506rtsa10530 ṣṭha7)dang/〈〈rā mo'i tsha bo〉〉(60 sa0 0ba 60 53la03ba 4sgoyotshe'i16)/ 〈〈las dbang smra ba rja khu dang kho'i bdag po〉〉(/mi0zhwa503 10 thatha ma13 0 0 30 mam 10 khu1lo'ite〉tshunatshokhrirte1lko0lo'isgokyisgruX14)sogs yin/ ti te nod dang blo skyed bsam blo ba gzhan dag gi dgongs pas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod ring lugs dang chos tshogs kyi log spyod stobs shugs la rdung rdeg tsha nan btang zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi kun spyod 84

bcu pa/ yo'adi na pa si thilangatson khang dur dungacugayod7/de/hpha ran si'i gsar brje chen po mgo brtsams pa/lo rgyus la rgyun par 'dra mtshungs kyi snang tshul ha las pa 'byung gi yod/nga tsho'i dran ngos su/ 1640lor dbyin ji'i rgyal po thra li sku rabs dang pos dngul lor gyi dgos mkho byung ste yun ring por snang med du bzhag pa'i rgyal tshogs bsdus la/ mjug 'bras su gsar brje chen po zhig langs te mthar rang nyid dbu gcod stegs bur bkod/ 1789lor hpha ran si'i rgyal po lu'e zi sku rabs bcu drug pas slar yang 'khrab tshan de bskyar ston byas mod/ 'on kyang de yis bslangs pa'i hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje de dbyin ji'i gsar brje las kyang lhag par mthar thug dang gting zab pa yin/lu'e zi bcu drug pa ni 1774lo8 rgyal khrir 'khod pa yin la/ kho srid khrir 'god skabs rgyal nang du 'gal ba shin tu dza drag po mchis/ zhing ba dang bzo pa/ 'byor ldan gral rim/ 'og rim sku drag bcas mi mos la/chos pa'ang mi mos pa'i khar/ kho rang nyid la'ang 'jon thang ci yang med/der ma zad bud med ngan pa zhig ste/ o si khri ri ya'i ( 73 713zalolko/)rgyal po'i sring mo mā re an tung ne thi zhes pa btsun mo byas pas/ kho'i bya ba lhag par lam du ma song / bshad tshul ltar na btsun mo der byad mdangs cung bzang la pho brang gi 'brel 'dris khrod ngor 'bud rgyur dga' zhing 'tsho ba rgyas spros che ba dang / khog rgya chung bar ma zad/ da dung shin tu khengs dregs 86

che ba zhig yin/ de lta bu'i mi zhig gis gal srid srid don la the gtogs byas pa na gnod tshabs mi skyel ba ga la srid/ 1781lor nor srid spyi 'doms ne khi (1tha0zhwa503 sa00(0 la༅)zhes pas 'gro gron nyung sri byas te nor srid kyi dka' khag sel dgos pa'i gros gzhi bton la/ snyan zhu'i nang pho brang gi chud zos skor brjod yod pas btsun mo dang 'gal te dpon gnas nas phab/ mi rnams don de la gting nas khro yang ngag nas smra mi phod/ lu'e zi bcu drug pas srid lo bco lngar bskyangs ring rgyal khab kyi bu lon ldab gsum 'phar/de'i khar rang byung gis kyang gnod 'tshe btang nas lo bstud mar ston thog dkon por gyur te/ rang byung gnod 'tshe dang mis bzos gyong gud kyis rgyal mdzod stongs shing / mi dmangs dka' sdug chen por gtad/ pho brang gi rul sungs kyis gsar brje bsleb pa je mgyogs su btang ngo //1789lor/ lu'e zi bcu drug pa nor srid thad ci bya gtol bral du gyur te/ dngul lor bsdu ched pho brang wer se le (50 331503 ༅lomo)ru lo ngo brgya dang don lngar bsdu ma myong ba'i rim pa gsum gyi gros tshogs bsdus la/dpon gnas nas smyugs pa'i ne khi yang slar bkug yin na'ang skabs der gsar brje'i glog dmar 'ur 'ur 'khyug mgo brtsams zin/rim pa gsum zer ba ni/ bkas bkod kyi spyi tshogs go gnas ltar mi rnams rim gras gsum du phyes pa ste/ rim pa dang po ni tshangs spyod de 8 gsol 'debs la brten nas rgyal por zhabs zhu sgrub mkhan ’ dang / rim pa gnyis pa ni sku drag ste 8 ral gri la brten nas rgyal por zhabs 'degs sgrub mkhan’ / rim pa gsum pa ni zhing pa dang bzo pa/ grong khyer gyi mi ser dang 'byor ldan gral rim ste ‘ rgyu nor la brten nas rgyal por zhabs 'degs sgrub mkhan ’ yin/ skabs der hpha ran si'i mi 'bor ha lam khri phrag nyis stong lhag 87

yod la/ rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i mi grangs spyi 'bor khri sum cu la'ang long med/ kho tshor bkas bkod kyi khyad dbang sna tshogs yod la/ 'os 'gan mi 'khur ba'am yang na nyung tsam las 'khur gyin med/ mi 'bor spyi'i brgya cha'igo dgu zin pa'i rim pa gsum pa'i mi yis bkas bkod kyi 'os 'gan 'khur dgos pa ma gtogs dbang cha gzhan ci yang med/ ‘ dbang shugs lhas gnang ba'i ’’rgyal po ni bkas bkod kyi mchod rten 'di'i yang steng du bzhugs te dbang shugs tshad med pa longs su spyod do//srol rnying ltar na/ rim pa gsum gyi gros tshogs ni so sor phyes te 'tshogs la/ gros chod skabs rim pa re rer gros shog re yod/ rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa mnyam du sbrel nas nam rgyun gnyis dang gcig gi bsdur tshad kyis rim pa gsum pa'i mgo gnon par byed/ gal te gros tshogs su zhugs pa'i mi grangs ltar brtsis na rim pa gsum par dge kha thob par 'gyur/skabs der rim pa dang por 'thus mi sum brgya dang brgyad yod pa dang /rim pa gnyis par nyis brgya dang gya lnga/ rim pa gsum par drug brgya dang nyer gcig yod pas/ rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mi'i grangs ka de rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i 'thus mi'i spyi grangs las brgal yod/ yang skabs der rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mi'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig la 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i bsam blo yod de/ dper na ro pe si pher lta bu yin/ kho tshos gros thag gcod skabs mi grangs ltar brtsi dgos pa'i re ba bton la/ de dbang sgyur pa'i na gnad du phog rgyal pos rim pa gsum pas skar li gang yang mi phud pa ma zad/ da dung kho la glags btsal bas shin tu khros te tshogs ra sgo brgyab par khyab bsgrags byas nas rim pa gsum pa phyir bskrad/ rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mi zhum pa med pa'i sgo nas tshogs khang du 'gro ma thub yang 88

dra 'then spo lo rtsed rar byed pa'i khang pa zhig tu 'du tshogs bsdus shing / dbyin ji'i gros mi la dpe ltos kyis dam bca' bzhag ste/ kho tsho rang nyid ni rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi 'thus tshab yin pa dang / kho tshos 'tshogs pa ni 8 rgyal dmangs gros tshogs ’ yin pa/ rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs ma byas sngon du kho tsho gtan nas gyes 'thor mi byed pa bcas khyab bsgrags byas/ de ni bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs pa la dpa' gdeng yod pa'i sgo nas 'gran bzung ba zhig yin/lu'e zi bcu drug pa la rgyal skyong 'jon thang dman rung / lkog g.yo ngan jus la mkhas te/ ‘4gyen rgol nya byed mkhan rim pa gsum par gdong gtad nas khos lhing 'jags kyi rnam 'gyur bstan te bzod yangs kyi tshul du rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mi dang lhan tshogs byed rgyur 'thad pa byung bar ma zad/ da dung mi grangs ltar gros thag gcad chog par 'thad pa byung / lkog tu khos dmag dpung bsdu 'gug gis drag chas la brten nas lag na khab 'bigs tsam yang med pa'i mi dmangs la drag gnon byed grabs byas/gtum drag can gyi rgyal pos rim pa gsum pa'i mi dmangs la ral gri 'debs nye ba der dmigs kyin bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i pha ri si'i mi dmangs rnams bzod bsran byed thabs bral bar gyur/ kho tshor rgyal dmangs gros tshogs kyi khe phan ni rang nyid kyi khe phan dang gcig gyur yin pa'i ngos zin skyes la/ rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mir rgyab skyor gyis rgyal po la ngo rgol byas/ zla 1tshes 13nyin 'os langs byas te grong khyer bzung la/ tshes 14nyin pa si thil btson khang la rgol rdung byas/pa si thil btson khang ni dus rabs 14par btsugs shing / phyogs bzhir sra zhing mthug pa'i mkhar gyang dang skyogs rdzong bzos yod la/ zheng 89

tshad la spyi khru nyer lnga yod pa'i mkhar srung chu bo bzos yod pa dang / 'gro 'ong byed skabs dpyang zam zhig brgyud dgos pas shin tu skyi g.ya' bo yod/ de ni rgyal rabs rim byung gis chab srid nyes can btson 'jug gnod skyel byed sa yin/ skad grags che ba'i blo skyed bsam blo ba wol ther yang de nas btson 'jug byed myong la khos ya mtshan che ba'i btson ma zhig kyang dngos su mthong myong ste/ btson ma der lcags las bzos pa'i gdong 'bag gis ngo gdong bkab yod cing / mi su dang yang skad cha bshad du mi 'jug 4 kho ni lu'e zi bcu bzhi pas bzung ba zhig yin/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyi blo ngor pa si thil btson khang ni bkas bkod sger gcod ring lugs kyi mtshon byed du grub yod do//pha ri si'i 'os langs pas dang thog gros mol la brten nas pa si thil btson khang 'dzin 'dod mod/ 'on kyang srung dmag gis me mda' dang skyogs chen la brten nas drag gnon byas pas/ khong khro 'bar ba'i mi dmangs kyis drag rgol byas shing / skyogs mdel zhig gis dpyang zam gyi lcags thag la phog ste dpyang zam mar phab pas/ mi tshogs drag rlabs bzhin nang du shor zhing pa si thil btson khang bzung / lu'e zi bcu drug pas tshul de thos nas dngangs 'tshab langs te g.yas g.yon gyi mi la ‘6'di ni gyen log cig yin nam ’’zhes dris tshe/ kung jo zhig gis sems chung ngang 88ma red/sku ngo / 'di ni gsar brje zhig red ’’ces lan btab/ pa si thil btson khang de pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis shul med bzos shing / byang bu zhig btsugs pa'i steng 88'di na pa si thil btson khang dur du bcug yod ’ ces bris yod/ mi dmangs kyi lag tu grong khyer pha ri si thob pas rgyal pos ngo thog nas 90

/brnga5 /che/cad zug dranazug po/ khye)dzod dranapang 95/ 〉 tsho sdu:ji rtso rno 5 ra mi mom tsu4 ༷ rṣa~Xtshi ra snangarghaṃ tshon mdangs gsum can gyi rgyal ṭwā tsha ༷ shā 4 ra rtaro 〉 tsho ༷sgroX dar gsar ba dang zhwa rtags thogs te pha ri si'i grong khul la bskor ba zhig kyang byas pas/ gzhung drang ba'i mi ser skor zhig la dga' spro spradathabangaka byaspusprad /sde/thag/ (pe/6re ༷ze thabaXspyi ༷— /spyo ༈ drug pa:re murakhrab shesten de:re sheskog nas gsang ba'i sgo nas mu mthud du dmag dpung bsdu 'gug byas la/ zla 10tshes 1nyin dpon dmag la gsol ston btegs/ rgyal rgyud kyi pa si thil btson khang blangs pa/dpon dmag de dag chang phor 'ga' lto bar song ba'i rjes su rgyal tshang la sri zhu bsgrub rgyu'i sems thag bcad/kho tshos rgyal po srung skyob kyi glu dbyangs gsang mthor len gyin tshon mdangs gsum can gyi rgyal dar gsar ba dang zhwa rtags la rdog brdzi btang / bag leb med par sems 'tshig pa'i pha ri si'i bud med rnams ni pho brang du da dung gsol ston spro skyid gtong tshul de mthong bas shin tu khros par gyur/ zla 10tshes 6nyin/ kho mo tshos lag tu dbyug pa thogs te ngag nas 64bag leb/bag leb/ bag leb ’rtaces gsang mthor sgrog gin pho brang wer se le'i phyogs su bskyod cing / pho brang du rgol 'dzul byas/ rgyal po 'khor lor bsdad nas 'bro 'dod kyang phyir ma thar/ mthar rgyal po dang btsun mo thabs zad de mi tshogs kyi rjes 'brang ste pha ri si la phyin nas mu mthud du skabs glakā~X ngang

sgug byas/de dang dus mtshungs su/ hpha ran si'i rgyal khab hril bos pha ri si la dpe ltos byas pas/ bkas bkod srid dbang dang sgrig srol rnying ba de ma nyid thor zhig tu song / rim pa gsum pa'i gros tshogs kyis kyang ‘8rgyal dmangs gros tshogs mi dngos su btsugs la/ de nas rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs la gzhol bas khrims bzo'i gros tshogs zhes kyang zer/ khrims bzo'i gros tshogs kyi thog ma'i grub 'bras ches che ba ni 1789lo'i zla 8tshes 26nyin 〈〈'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉la gros 'cham byung ba de yin/ de ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyis bkas bkod la rgol ba'i rtsa 'dzin rang bzhin gyi yig cha zhig yin/ de'i nang du/ dbang cha'i phyogs nas/ mi rnams skyes ma nyid nas ma zad dus gtan du rang dbang 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / bca' khrims ni spyi mos kyi mngon byed yin la bca' khrims kyi mdun du mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa/ spyi dmangs la smra brjod dang par bskrun gyi rang dbang yod mod/ 'on kyang nges par bca' khrims kyi tshod 'dzin thebs dgos pa sogs dril bsgrags byas yod pa dang / bsgrags gtam du da dung sger dbang rgyu nor ni 8 mchog gyur ston med ’ yin par thag gcod gsal po byas yod/hpha ran si'i blo skyed mkhas pa dag gi bsam blo dang / nang sgos su ro'u si'u yi bsam blo de bsgrags gtam nang 'bur thon du mngon yod do//〈〈'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉ni la hphi te (1309003༅tha111 07༅ཿ)sogs kyis ma phyi bris pa zhig yin/ la hphi te yis blo skyed bsam blo ba'i gsung rtsom dpyod klog byed myong zhing / a ri rang btsan g.yul 'khrug tu'ang zhugs myong bas/ gsar brje'i dus mgor skad grags shin tu che la/ khrims bzo'i gros tshogs dang rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gi dbang 92

yod par gyur/ khos da dung 〈〈'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉gyi ma phyi thogs te a ri'i 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉gyi ma phyi 'bri mkhan je hpher therdos /lce/ ༷༷//sbyo1 cojethere thes/ /lce/ :she :re/rtsaran bsam 'char 'a nga / phar na sa skabs ra a 'a hpha ran sir sdod pa'i gzhung tshab khur yod/ la ji te la lo rgyus kyi mdzad rjes yod pa bsnyon med yin mod/ 'on kyang kho gsar brje ba mthar thug cig ma yin/kho dang me ra po (5 6 ཿོ yo)sogs kyis rgyal rabs mgo rting slog 113 035 7par mos pa mi 'dzin par mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs kyi lta ba 'dzin/gsar brje gting zab tu 'phel ba dang bstun nas kho tsho thung myur ngang gsar brje'i rba klung gis bsnubs par gyur ro// 93

bcu gcig pa/ 66rgyal po'i mgo' kho pa tshor 'phangs pa hpha ran si'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sgrig srol rnying ba de rtsa ba nas gtor zhing / rgyal po dang btsun mo ni rang nyid kyi blon 'bangs kyis kha lo bsgyur ba des/ yo rob kyi mnga' bdag che chung rnams la rang nyid kyi cod pan yang nam zhig mi brtan par 'gyur snyam gyi dngangs 'tshab chen po skye ru bcug kho tshos phan tshun 'brel gtug dang mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas hpha ran si'i gsar brjer dreg gnon byas te sgrig srol rnying ba slar gso byed re bcangs/ de'i khrod hpha ran si'i rgyal po'i btsun mo'i phu bo ste o si khri ri ya'i rgyal po le'o pho ti gnyis pa (༅009016 khya kro/1tsho ṣṭha rha tsho)ni hur shugs ches che ba zhig yin/ bros byol du phyin pa'i hpha ran si'i sku drag skor zhig gis kho tsho'i 'das dus kyi rngam zil dang rgyu nor slar gso 'byung re rtse gcig tu 'chang gin gang sar 'brel gtug byas te rgyal khab so so'i mnga' bdag la mgyogs myur ngang hpha ran si'i rgyal por rogs skyor byed pa'i 'bod skul gang thub bgyis/lu'e zi bcu drug pa ni gsar brje'i mi dmangs kyi lta rtog 'og ci bya gtol bral du gyur te mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs la mos mthun yin pa'i phyi tshul mi ston ka med byung yang / sems nas rgyal khab so so'i mnga' bdag gis dmag btang nas the gtogs byed par re sems bcangs/ khos kho tshor lkog 'phrin btang ste/ kho rang 66gtum dmangs ’ kyi lag nas bcings 94

'grol gtong ba'i re ba zhus shing / sa cha bcad nas drin gzo byed rgyu'i bsam pa bstan/ de'i mtshungs su kho dang btsun mo gnyis kyis lkog jus zhib tshags bgyis nas chas bsgyur bros byol byed pa'i dgod bro'i bgyi ba brtsams/1791lo'i zla 6tshes 20nyin gyi dgong mor/ lu'e zi bcu drug pa dang btsun mo gnyis rang rang gi mal du log pa na/ lta rtog byed mkhan dmag mi rnams rgyun srol ltar pho brang nang ma nas phyir bud/ nam gung du/ rgyal pos g.yog chas spras te 'jab 'jab ngang btsun mo'i gzim shag tu song / skabs der btsun mos kyang khyim zhus dge rgan zhig gi chas spras yod la/ kho gnyis lag gdang sbrel gyin pho brang gi nang khang rnams brgyud de phyir thon song /srung dmag rnams kyis mdza' 'brel can gyi g.yog po gnyis yin par snyam nas 'dri rtog ma byas/ rgyal po dang btsun mo pho brang sgor thon te sin mā ten sgo chen (531 1 zo bra1/ ka)du phyin/ de na shing rta gnyis kyis snga mo nas sgug yod/ kho gnyis shing rtar bsdad rjes mgyogs myur ngang shar phyogs su bskyod song / rgyas spros can gyi shing rta zhig nang gzab mchor can gyi sku lcam zhig bsdad yod la/ kho mo'i lam yig steng u ru si'i khu ar hphu nan jo'i sku lcam zhes bris yod/ nan jo'i sku lcam de don dngos thog btsun mo'i bran mo zhig yin la/ mos so dmag brje ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas rgyal sras dang sras mo khrid de sngon la phyir thon pa yin/ skabs der rgyal po ni nan jo'i sku lcam gyi spyi gnyer du spras yod cing / lo drug can gyi rgyal sras la mo chas spras te lo 13can gyi sras mo dang lhan sku lcam gyi bu mor brdzus yod la/ btsun mo ni byis pa gnyis kyi khyim zhus dge rgan du brdzus yod/ dgod bro'i bgyi ba de jus 'god khrid ston byed mkhan ni su'e ten (bya4060ba lkorsā)gyi mi zhig ste de'i ming la hphe ar se na zer/ mtshan mo der kho pa pho brang du 'gro 'ong thengs 95

gsum byas shing / rgyal po dang btsun mo pho brang nas phyir thon par bkod sgrig bsu len byed pa las gzhan/ khos da dung rgyal po'i sring mo dang rgyal sras/ sras mo/ bran mo 'ga' bcas pho brang phyir bskyal te sus kyang mi tshor ba byas pas/ pho brang phyi nang gi nyen srung ba dang bran g.yog dpon blon rnams rmongs par yang byas so// rgyal po dang btsun mo bskyal rjes su/ khos da dung skad mthon pos ‘6khi ar hphu lha lcam/ bde mo gyis ’ zhes brjod la de nas pha ri sir dal 'jags ngang log lam skabs kyi sku srung 'gan 'khur ba ni shar phyogs dmag khul gyi dmag spyi dang lo ren (20 gra ba0 tsho.oṃ)zhing chen gyi gtso 'dzin gcig lcogs pa de yin/lu'e zi bcu drug pas rta pho lcag gis skul te myur mor bskyod pas phyi dro'i dus tshod bdun gyi steng sin mo ne wor (ca 7lo'ulo)grong tshor slebs/de ni shar phyogs dmag khul gyi dmag spyi'i bdag dam sa khul yin/ kho tshos sems lhod pos dbugs gtong gan lam skabs bde blag byung bar spro sems skye skabs der/ grong sde'i mi rnams ya mtshan ngang ltad mor rub yong / de lta bu'i rgyas spros can gyi shing rta dang / rin po ches rgyan mchor spras pa'i sku lcam zhig sa khul chung chung de ru mthong shin tu dkon no// glo bur du/ mi tshogs khrod kyi mi zhig gis 6 mig shel gyon pa'i rgyags po de ni rgyal po red ’ ces 'ur brgyab pas/ mi tshogs 'du 'du zing zing du gyur/ lu'e zi bcu drug pas rang nyid ngos zin pa thos pas kha lo bar rta pho lcag gis skul du bcug ste wa lon gyi phyogs su bros/rgyal po ngos zin mkhan de ni grong tsho de'i tshigs mal dpon po ti lo e zhes pa yin la/ kho ni gsar brje'i dpung sde'i mi yin/ khos rgyal po bros pa mthong rjes/ rta mgyogs po zhig bcibs te nye lam brgyud nas rgyal po'i sngon 96

la wa lon du thon zhing / de ga'i mang tshogs skul slong gis lam 'gog tu bcug rgyal po 'khor bcas bslebs pa na phyogs bzhi'i mang tshogs kyis kho tsho kun nas bskor/ rgyal pos da dung g.yo 'phrul gyis thar thabs byas kyang /ti lo e yis dkrum mda' lag tu thogs te ‘8da gom gang song na kho bos me mda' rgyag gi yin ’ zhes skad brgyab pas/ rgyal po thabs zad cing phyir pha ri sir brdzangs skyel byed du mi 'jug ka med byung / rgyab 'ded kyi mang tshogs stong phrag bzhi lhag yod/ kho tshos lag tu me mda' dang dbyug pa thogs shing lam skabs hril bor ‘ phag rtul mi dang / ‘4g.yo can nya zhes sdigs te/ nam rgyun gzi brjid ya na med pa'i rgyal po'i zil shugs rtsa med btang ngo //rgyal po bros byol byas pa'i don des mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi khro ba che ru bskyed pas/ tshang mas mnga' bdag med pa bzo zhing rgyal por khrims gcod byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ khrims bzo'i gros tshogs khrod kyi dbang chen 'dzin mkhan 'byor ldan gral rim gyi khrims 'dzugs smra ba rnams kyis gang thub sgos rgyal po srung thabs byas te/ kho ni 88bslu khrid nya byas pa yin zer la/mu mthud du kho la dbang cha chen po sprad de/ 1791lor kho la rtsa khrims steng ming rtags 'god du bcug rtsa khrims de ni phyogs mang po zhig nas phyi nur byas yod de/ der mnga' bdag lam lugs sor 'jog byas yod pa dang /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi rim gras lam lugs med par btang yang rnam pa gsar ba zhig tu brjes te spyi dmangs rnams ‘6spyi dmangs grim po ’ dang 8 spyi dmangs nyob to ’’ gnyis su phyes yod/ spyi dmangs nyob to zhes pa ni don dngos thog rgyu nor med pa dag ste sngon gyi rgyal po'i 64'bangs tha ’ dag yin/skabs der gsar brje'i dpung khag nang khul du rgyal po dang rtsa khrims skor gyi lta phyogs tha dad pa'i dbang gis 'gal gyes byung yod/ 97

mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs smra ba rnams gsar brje'i dus mgor btsugs pa'i ya ku pen (/30061ba3 ཿ6za)mnyam spro khang ①dang gyes te/hphe lang (tha00158sa ༅7)pa ④zhes pa btsugs/ khrims 'dzugs gros tshogs khrod hphe lang pa ni g.yas lhung ba dang / ya ku pen pa ni g.yon lhung ba yin/phyis su ya ku pen pa'i nang khul du'ang zhi mthun gyi je ron ti (01 0ba60 rshakhya༈sgo)pa ①dang drag skyod kyi ri sgang pa ⑦gnyis su gyes/ ri sgang pa'i gtso 'dzin ni ro pe si pher yin/ kho tshor dang thog gros tshogs khrod mi grangs de 'dra mang po med mod/ 'on kyang mang tshogs kyis rgyab skyor chen po byed/gsar brje'i dpung khag nang khul gyes bral dang gsar sdeb byed pa'i skabs der/ phyi nang gi slar gso'i stobs shugs kyis ngan 'brel shugs chen bgyi bzhin 'dug phu o'i dmag chen hpha ran si'i mtha' mtshams su bkod de drag chas kyis pha ri ser rgol rdung byed pa'i 'ur brgyab/ je ron ti pa rnams g.yul 'thab la brten nas srid dbang len bsam bcangs shing /lu'e ze bcu drug pas gzhan lag g.yar te nang dgra rtsa med gtong bsam gyis nang blon skul te o rgyal la g.yul brda sbon par gdams shing / btsun mos lkog tu hpha ran si'i g.yul 'gyed 'char bkod o dmag la gsang skyel byas/hpha ran si'i sku drag dmag dpon rnams kyis yang na dmag dpung mi 'gul ba dang / yang na phyi tshul du 'thab khul byas pas hpha dmag la pham kha reg gin dgra bo pha ri ser bcar/ la hphi te yis dmag dpung bskyur te khor rkyang du ① rgyun du sin ya ku pen chos khang du 'du 'dzoms byed paṃs de ltar btags/() hphe lang chos khang du 'du tshogs byas pas so/④ 'thus mi mang shos je ron ti rdzong khul nas thon pas de ltar thogs/⑦ gros tshogs khrod go gnas cung mtho bas de ltar thogs/ 98

rgyal sar phyir bros brgyab ste/ gsar brje'i mnyam spro khang gtor rgyu'i re ba bton/ gsar brje nyen 'gag tu gnas pa'i skabs der/ ro pe si pher dang tan ton/ ma la sogs dmangs gtso drag skyod pa'i gtso 'a dzin gyis mi dmangs la mes rgyal skyob rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / tan ton gyi skad char skul slong gi rang bzhin chen po dang ldan te/ 8 nges par du rtul phod dgos/rtul phod dgos/ da dung rtul phod dgos/ de ltar yong na da gzod hpha ran si skyob par nus ’ zhes brjod pas/ mi dmangs rnams yar la langs te/ 〈〈ma ze'i gzhas〉〉(༅3 53 3015tha130paṃchoyo)gtong bzhin pha ri si'i phyogs dang g.yul gyi gdong len du bskyod do//〈〈ma ze'i gzhas 〉〉zhes pa ni ma ze'i dang blangs dmag gis thog mar glu gzhas 'di len gyin dpa' spobs kyis khengs te pha ri sir dpung 'jug byas pas de ltar thogs pa yin/ glu gzhas 'di la sngon 〈〈re in (5501ba lko.oṃ)khul gyi dmag gzhas 〉〉zer zhing / ming la ro ri ti rlal li (01tha060/0309620560/ 60 sbyi’/310dngha' ཿ tsholo)zhes pa'i bzo dmag dmag dpon zhig gis dgra dmag gis rub rgol byed bzhin pa'i mtshan mo zhig la bris pa yin la/nyin gnyis par khos glu gzhas de khyer nas grong khyer dpon po'i sar song nas blangs pa dang / 66mdun du skyod/ mes rgyal gyi bu dang bu mo/ gzi brjid kyi dus de slebs song / gtum spyod pas khrag sbags kyi dar cha sgreng gin/ nga rang tsho'i sar bsres byung ngo ’ zhes pa'i glu gzhas 'dis mi dmangs kyi khrag dron 'khol du bcug ste/ thags thogs med par rgyal yongs kun la khyab/〈〈ma ze'i gzhas 〉〉de phyis su hpha ran si'i rgyal glu ru gtan 'bebs byas so//gsar brje'i spro gdeng dang ldan pa'i hpha ran si'i mi dmangs la gdong gtad de/ phu o mnyam 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab chen mos/ gal te lu'e zi 99

bcu drug par gnod 'tshe nyag tsam byas pa na/ kho pas pha ri si shul stong du gtong nges yin tshul gyi 'jigs gtam smras/ pha ri si'i mi dmangs yang bskyar 'os langs byas te de la ya lan sprad/ 1792lo'i zla 8tshes 10nyin/'os langs mi dmangs rnams kyis khrims 'dzugs pa'i srid dbang mgo rting slog ste rgyal po gnas phab btang ba dang btson 'jug byas pa khyab bsgrags byas la/ zla 9tshes 22nyin hpha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs/ de ni hpha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab dang po zhes pa de yin/skabs der/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyi mdun du las don chen po gnyis yod de/ gcig ni dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs kyis phu o'i btsan 'dzul pa phyir bskrod pa dang / gzhan zhig ni rgyal por chad gcod byed pa yin/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs dpa' ngar ngang g.yul gyi mdun gral du song ste lo mjug sngon btsan 'dzul pa rgyal khongs nas bskrad pa dang / 1793lo'i zla dang por/rgyal dmangs spyi'i tshogs pa nas rgyal por thag gcod ji ltar byed rgyu'i gnad don la gros byed mgo brtsams/ skabs der srid gzhung gi dbang cha don dngos thog je ron ti pa'i lag tu thob yod la/ zhi mthun gyi je ron ti pa rnams g.yas lhung par gyur yod pas/ rgyal dmangs spyi'i tshogs pa'i khrod sngar gyi hphe lang pa'i spyod tshul bzung ste ci lcogs sgos rgyal por srung skyob byed/ri sgang pas rgyal por gsod khrims sbyor dgos pa'i lta ba 'dzin/ ro pe si pher smra stegs su bud de/ ‘8kho bo ni btsan gnon pa la ngo so ci yang med pa zhig yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni kho bo btsan gnon myong mkhan la snying rje tshad med yod pas yin/ kho bos mi dmangs dmar gsod dang gtum rgyal la gu yangs gtong ba'i mi chos shig khas mi len/ kho bos kho par srog khrims gcod par mos mthun byed ’ ces brjod/ gsar brje'i stobs shugs kyi mtho rlabs 100

'phyur 'og rgyal dmangs spyi'i tshogs pas ming mi 'god par gros shog 'phen pa'i thabs spyad pa na mang shos rgyal por srog khrims gcod rgyur mos mthun byung / 1793lo'i zla dang po'i tshes 21nyin/ rgyal po lu'e zi bcu drug pas dbyin ji'i rgyal po'i shul rjes ded de mgo gcod stegs bur 'dzegs so//lu'e zi bcu drug pa'i mgo bo bcad pa des yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i mnga' bdag la 'jigs skul thebs pas/ smyo ham chen pos the gtogs dang drag gnon byed pa'i grabs gshom byas/ tan ton gyis lhing 'jags ngang ‘8yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i rgyal pos nga tsho dang g.yul sprod nges red/ nga tshos rgyal po'i mgo bo kho tshor 'phangs chog ’ ces bshad/ lu'e zi bcu drug par gsod khrims sbyar rjes kyi zla gnyis pa ste/ 1793lo'i zla 2par phu o si dbyin bcas rgyal khab rnams kyis hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mna' 'brel btsugs te phyogs bzhi nas hpha ran ser rgol rdung byas/ hpha ran si'i rgyal nang du rgyal rgyud tshogs khag gis ram 'degs byas nas zing cha bslangs la/ je ron ti pa rnams mngon sum 'dzem med ngang dgra bor mgo btags pas/gsar brje yang bskyar nyen 'gag tu bslebs pa'i skabs su/ mi dmangs rnams je ron ti pa dag la bzod sgom bya thabs bral bar gyur pas/1793lo'i zla 5tshes 31nyin nas zla 6tshes 2nyin bar pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis yang bskyar 'os langs byas te je ron ti pa'i dbang sgyur mgo rting slog pa dang / ya ku pen pas srid dbang bzung zhing / ro pe si pher 'go 'dzin pa gtso bor gyur te/ hpha ran si'i gsar brje la yang bskyar mtho rlabs gsar ba 'phyur/ ro pe si pher ni dag sel ba'i khyim du skyes/ ming sring bzhi yod/ rang lo 6la son skabs a ma tshe las 'das shing rang lo 9la son tshe pha phyi ru song 101

bas/ chung dus nas mes pos snyor skyong la brten te nar son pa yin la/ pha ri si'i slob grwa chen mo'i bca' khrims tshan khag tu slob gnyer byas te mthar phyin rjes phyir pha yul du log ste dag sel pa byas/ ro pe si pher lo na gzhon dus blo skyed bsam blo ba'i gsung rtsom bklags myong la/ nang sgos su ro'u si'u la dang rtsis chen po byed pas/ slob ma'i skabs su khong gi khyim du song nas mjal zhu byed myong zhing / ro'u si'u gshegs rjes dur 'gram du song ste mya ngan yang byed myong / 1789lor kho pha yul nas rim pa gsum pa'i 'thus mir 'dems te wer se le pho brang du rim pa gsum pa'i gros tshogs la zhugs/skabs der/ khos hur thag gis gsar brje'i las don gnyer/ ro pe si pher gyi lta rgya yang thon skyed pa chung ba'i sems khams las 'da' thub med la/thon skyed pa chung ngu'i phugs bsam gyi spyi tshogs shig ste/ 66so sor sa zhing dang / tshong khang chung chung ngam khrom tshong byed sa chung chung re yod la/ khyim gyi 'tsho thabs 'dang bas gla phogs la re ltos byed mi dgos pa/ mi re re bzhin rang nyid kyi ngal rtsol la brten nas 'tsho zhing bu lon gtong len mi dgos pa nya zhig 'dzugs bsam 'chang / phugs bsam gyi spyi tshogs de lta bu zhig ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang mngon gsal du 'gal ba ltag sprod yin pas mngon 'gyur yong mi srid do//ya ku pen pas srid bzung rjes/ ro pe si pher gyis blo spobs chen pos thabs jus rabs dang rim pa bkod/ khos 'go khrid nas yar thon rang bzhin shin tu che ba'i 1793lo'i rtsa khrims gtan 'khel byas pa dang / sa zhing khrims srol rabs dang rim pa bsgrags te/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi sa zhing dbang ba'i lam lugs med par bzos nas zhing pa la phan khe re 'ga' thob tu bcug pa dang / rgyal srung stobs shugs la shugs snon dang gsar brje 102

ngo rgol par blo rtse gcig gis rdung rdeg byas la/ rgyal po'i btsun mo mgo gcod stegs bur bkod/ 'tsho ba'i thad/ ro pe si pher gzhung dkar rnam dag yin zhing dngul lor la 'gram chu mi ldang ba zhig yin/ dpon sar bsdad rjes kho mu mthud du shing bzo zhig gi khang khyim rnying ba zhig tu bsdad/ skabs der khos mdza' grogs bsgrigs skabs yin kyang / brel myur gyi gsar brje'i bya bas kho la rang sger gyi gnyen don sgrub khom ma byung bas 'chi reg tu gnyen sgrig byas med/ro pe si pher gyis gtso byas pa'i ya ku pen pas rbad chod kyi thabs jus lag tu bstar bas/ nang 'khrug ring po ma thogs par zhi 'jags btang la/hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag kyang 1794lo'i dbyar khar rgyal khongs nas bskrad/ 'on kyang skabs der g.yo jus chen po sta gon byed kyin 'dugam gzhir/ ya ku pen pas dngos 'bebs byas pa'i srid dbang sger 'dzin gyis 'byor ldan gral rim la'ang tshod 'dzin ci rigs shig thebs yod la/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs kyi slar gso'i stobs shugs kyi 'jigs zil 'og kho tshos bzod bsrad byed nus kyang / 'jigs zil de med par bzos rjes kho tshos ro pe si pher srid dbang la mi mos pa'i sems khams de lag len du dngos su bstar/ de dang dus mtshungs su/ ro pe si pher sogs kyi gtum drag dang 'jigs skul yang thal drags par ma zad/ tha na gtum drag dang mgo gcod stegs bu de gsar brje'i lag thabs gcig pu ru bltas/ dgra bo la drag gnon kho na byed pa las gyes 'gug kha bral du gtong thabs mi byed par ma zad/ tha na chab srid kyi lta stangs mi mthun pa 'dzin mkhan rnams kyang dgra ru bltas te gu yangs gtan nas mi byed/ smra brjod 103

mang po zhig kyang thal che ba'am ham shed drags che bas spyi dmangs kyi bzod bsran nus tshad las brgal/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ ro pe si pher gyis ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi re sems mthon po la ngo rgol byed cing / mi ser khe phan gyi tshab byed khro 'dzin pa la drag gnon byas/ de ltar/ ro pe si pher gtso byas pa'i ya ku pen pa'i srid dbang gi spyi tshogs rmang gzhi la'ang nyams rgud chen po byung /ro pe si pher gyis zing cha myur du 'byung nges pa tshor la/ 1794lo'i zla 1tshes 26nyin/ khos rgyal dmangs spyi'i tshogs pa'i smra stegs su mi 'ga' res g.yo jus gshom tshul sun 'byin byas/ tshes 27nyin mu mthud du tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ skabs der/ dgra bos lag snga brtsad de glo bur du rgol zhing /8 gtum po rtsa med bzo ba'i ’ 'bod sgra'i khrod gros thag bcad de/ ro pe si pher sogs bzung zhing / snying khar gri btsugs te kho tshor dag sel byed du ma bcug nyin gnyis par 'dri rtog kyang ma byas par ro pe si pher sogs ya ku pen pa'i 'go khrid pa nyer gnyis mgo gcod stegs bur bkod/ 'di ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje ba'i skyo gar chen po zhig yin/ 'chi skabs su/ ro pe si pher rang lo so drug tsam yin/srid 'gyur de la lo rgyus thog tsha zla'i srid 'gyur ’nyazer/ ‘ tsha zla ’ zer don ni/ 1792lo'i zla 9tshes 22nyin hpha ran si'i spyi mthun rgyal khab dang po btsugs rjes/ hpha ran sis lo rtsis gsar ba spyad la/ lo rtsis gsar ba'i zla ngo ni nam zla'i dus tshigs ltar ming btags pa yin te/ dper na smug zla dang / bad zla/ tsha zla sogs lta bu yin/ spyi zla 7pa'i tshes 19nas zla 8pa'i tshes 17bar ni 88tsha zla ’ yin/ srid 'gyur byung dus kyi zla 7pa'i tshes 27nyin ni tsha zla'i tshes 9nyin yin pas/ 88tsha zla'i srid 'gyur ’ zer ba yin/ lo rgyus 104
smra ba rnams kyis spyir btang ‘8tsha zla'i srid 'gyur mi de hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje mjug sgril ba'i mtshon byed du 'jog go/ 105

bcu gnyis pa/ lhan skyes kyi 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi ya mtshan can zhig dang / ham sems can zhig chab srid pa zhigadamag don mkhas mchog pa zhig 'khrungs pa/dus rabs 18pa'i dus mjug dang dus rabs 19pa'i dus mgor/ yo rob kyi lo rgyus gar stegs su shin tu mthong dkon pa'i jus spobs 'dzoms shing / skad grags can gyi mi sna zhig byung zhing / de ni nā pho lun po na phad (khra3901000 80sa398 /0rjor74po〉 74rjozlophya)yinano//nā pho lun gyis lo ngo bcu lhag ring hro we nas hro zho dang / dmag dpon chen po nas dmag spyi chen po/ skabs thog srid 'dzin pa dang tshe gang srid 'dzin pa nas rgyal po/ hpha ran si'i gong ma nas i ṭa li'i rgyal po zhor 'khur pa ste/ kho la dngos su thob pa'i mtshan btags ni bcu phrag tu long pa zhig yod la/ phyi rabs pas kho la gdeng 'jog byed skabs kyi cod pan kyang bcu phrag bcu phrag tu brtsegs yod/ la las kho la 8 khir zhi ga'i (0073103 rnya4yozlo)byad 'dre mi’ zer zhing / la las kho la 8 smyo ham nas smyo ham du skyod mkhan ’ dang / 88'jigs su rung ba'i gtan tshigs smra ba ’ zhes zer ba dang /kha cig gis kho la ‘ ham sems can ’ zer zhing / kha cig gis kho ni 88zhi bde skrun mkhan ri’yin par ma zad/ 88g.yul 'thab slong mkhan ’nyakyang yin par brjod pa dang / 'ga' res kho ni 88rta rgyab kyi ro pe si pher ’ dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la rgol ba'i dpa' rgod/ rlabs che ba'i chab srid pa zhes 106

sogs zer la/ la las kho la 88shing gzugs zlos gar ba mi’zhes brjod pa dang / mi mang po zhig gis kho ni ‘8e leg zan ter ( 10za3sa60 ༅lo'7)dang khe zar (0tha033 mmu7)lta bu'i spyang grung can ’ zer ba sogs lta bu'o//dngos gnas mi re'i ngag na brjod lugs re yod do//des na nā pho lun la gdeng 'jog byed pa ni shin tu dka' bar snang /kho la gdeng 'jog don mthun zhig ji ltar byed dgos sam zhe na/ lo rgyus smra ba rnams la gom gang mdun spos kyis dpyad zhib byed du 'jug pa las thabs gzhan med de/ nga tshos 'dir gdeng 'jog dang 'bod stangs 'ga' bkod pa ni lo rgyus mi sna 'di'i shugs rkyen la gsal bshad phyogs tsam byed ched yin/kho ni dus rabs shig ring skad grags chod cing / mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi mi sna zhig yin pa la dngos gnas bsnyon du med do//1769lo'i zla 8tshes 15nyin/ nā pho lun sa dbus rgya mtsho'i sa khul gyi khir zhi ka gling phran du skyes/ sngar gling phran de i ṭa lir gtogs kyang nā pho lun skyes nas zla 'ga'i rjes su hpha ran ser dbang bar gyur/ nā pho lun ni bu gnyis pa yin la kho'i pha ni dag sel pa zhig yin/ kho'i ma yum gyi skye 'bras mdzes par ma zad sbyang yon kyang 'dzoms po yod cing / bu yi slob gso'i thad shin tu nan mo yin/ nā pho lun gyis phyis su 88kho bos las don 'di 'dra rlabs po che zhig sgrub nus pa ni/ a ma'i slob gso la yongs su brten pa yin mi zhes brjod myong /nā pho lun lo 10la son skabs pu re en (8110bab0 oṃ༅༅)dmag gi slob grwar zhugs la/ lo 15la son tshe sbyang 'bras phul du byung bas pha ri si'i dmag gi slob grwar bskyal/ 1785lor pha tshe las 'das shing dpal 'byor gyi 107
