dka' tshegs rkyen slob mtshams bzhag ste dmag nang zhugs nas sgyogs mdel dmag dpung du hro we zhig byas la/ skabs der kho rang lo 16dang nyin bco lnga tsam yin/ kho la krung go'i gna' dus kyi shes ldan dmag dpon gyi gshis khyad ldan zhing / nam rgyun rig gnas pa dang 'grogs te dpe klog hur thag byed/dmag don dang lo rgyus thad kyi dpe cha las gzhan/ da dung wol ther dang mon the si khe'u/ ro'u si'u bcas kyi dpe cha'ang klog pas/ blo skyed bsam blo ba dag gi shugs rkyen gting zab thebs/ hpha ran si'i gsar brje chen po'i snga rol du/ khos 〈〈rgyal po gleng ba 〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig tu 64gnas phab gtong mi 'os pa'i rgyal po ni shin tu dkon ’ zhes brjod yod/1789lo'i hpha ran si'i gsar brje byung skabs/ khos gsar brjer rgyab skyor byas te mu mthud du dmag dpung du bsdad/ 1793lo'i lo mjug tu/ kho bka' bzhin thu lon (10010sa khya)du dbyin dmag gis rgyab skyor byas pa'i rgyal rgyud pa'i zing cha zhi 'jags gtong su phyin/ khos skyogs chen gyis rgol rdung byas pa dang / g.yul ngor ngos phebs kyis bkod 'doms byas shing /mdel char 'tshub pa'i drag 'thab khrod g.yul gyi mdun du 'gying nger langs pas/ dmag mi rnams kho'i bkod 'doms kyi 'jon thang dang dpa' snying la yi rang shor ba dang / hur sems kyis g.yul 'thab byas pas thu lon rgol thengs gcig gis blangs/ skabs de nas bzung nā pho lun gyi 'jon thang mngon par gyur/ 88tsha zla'i srid 'gyur ’ rjes su/ mi la las kho ni ro pe si pher gyi phyogs gtogs yin par the tshom zos te cung min na mgo gcod stegs bur bkod/stabs legs pa zhig la zing cha myur mor zhi yang / kho la mthong chen ma byas/pha ri sir khom sdod byed ring / khos blo sems rtse gcig gis dpe cha klog pa'i 108

dus mtshungs su/ don gyi 'pho 'gyur la snang 'jog gis go skabs la ngang sgug byas/ 1795lor rgyal rgyud pas yang bskyar pha ri sir zing cha bslangs/skabs der ti srid gzhung ④ga 'go 'dzin pā ra si (28 ཿ ༅4lo)yis thu lon g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi nā pho lun dran par gyur nas kho la zing cha zhi 'jags gtong rgyu'i 'gan bskos/ nā pho lun gyis rbad chod ngang skyogs chen gyis rgol rdung byas te mgyogs myur ngang zing cha mnan pas/ de nas kho'i skad grags shin tu rgyas/ 1796lor/ khos gnyen sgrig pa'i nyin gnyis par/ kho i ṭa li la rgyang skyod dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag dpung gi spyi khyab chen mor bskos la/skabs der kho rang lo 27tsam yin/ i ṭa lir dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni o si khri ri ya pham par rgyag ched yin/ skabs der o si khri ri ya dang phe meng thi'i (910laXs 0 ༅mmurṣa)mnyam 'brel dmag dpung la ha lam dmag mi khri bdun lhag yod la/ nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung la mi khri gsum bzhi tsam las med/ dmag thabs la mgyogs myur shin tu gal che bas/o dmag dang phe dmag gi phyi lam gcod ched/ khos pha rol po'i blo yul las 'das pa'i sgo nas gza' 'khor gnyis nang lo yi 'khor mor gangs kyis bzung ba'i yal phi si ( 193 alasgolo)ri bo brgal/ khos dmag mi la 8 khyod tshor za ma bzang po med la/ gon pa ha lam med tshod du 'dug ti srid gzhung la khyod tshos rgyab skyor byas kyang khyod tshor ci yang byin med/ da ni ngas khyod tsho khrigade sa'i sgo lar steng ches 'byor phyug ldan pa'i sa char ① ti srid gzhung nib1 ཿ 01 0joyolozhes pa ste/ hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i srid gzhung gi mi lnga'i rgyal srid las khungs la zer ba yin/ 109

'gro ba yin/ de ga'i dar rgyas che ba'i grong khrom dang / khod yangs pa'i sa gzhi ni khyod tshos byas rjes 'jog yul yin/ de na gzi brjid dang 'byor phyug gis khyod tshor sgug yod/ i ṭa li la rgyang skyod byed mkhan dmag mi tsho/ gal te khyod tshor dpa' snying zhan pa yin nam ’ zhes skul slong byas/nā pho lun gyis i ṭa lir shar dkrog nub rdung dang / dmag stobs hrag bsdu/ mgyogs myur spo 'gul sogs kyi 'thab rtsal 'thab jus spyad pas bstud mar rgyal kha thob/ de'i khrod a ta (la ca)gtsang bo btsan brgal byed pa'i g.yul 'gyed la thog mtha' bar gsum du dmag don smra ba rnams kyis bsngags bstod byed/ nā pho lun gyis me lan (5118sa0 ཿ༅)du thad kur skyod pa dang / lom pa ti (60 6tha 67 ྅༅7)'phred gcod byed ched/thog mar lo ti (stsa ༅)len rtsis byas kyang / mdun du zheng tshad smi brgya lhag can gyi a ta gtsang bos bcad yod/ gtsang bo'i steng du shing zam zhig yod la/ pha rol du o si khri ri ya'i dmag gis rkang dmag nyis khri lhag dang rta dmag nyis stong lhag bkod sgrig byas yod par ma zad/ sgyogs chen nyi shu lhag bkod yod pa dang / dgos pa byung tshe de ma thag tu shing zam gtor chogadapung gnyis gtug pa na/ dpa' rgod rgyal bar 'gyur/ nā pho lun gyis gtsang bo btsan brgal byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ khos me sbyogs brgyab ste dgra bo'i me shugs gnon dgos pa'i bka' phab la/ phyogs gcig nas rta dmag nyung shas shig chur brgal nas dgra bo'i mig sgo bskor zhing / de'i mtshungs su 'gas mdel dmag dpung la bka' phab ste zam pa'i steng gdong mchong byed du bcug yo dmag gi me shugs kyang shin tu drag pas gdong mchong dmag gis mtha' 'khyol ma nus par phyir bshol mgo brtsams/ nā pho lun gyis gnas tshul dza drag che ba mthong ste/ dmag dpon lan si zhes pa 110

dang lhan du mdel char bsus te dpung ru'i sngon du bsres/ ches sngon mar pha rol du thon mkhan ni lan si yin la/ gnyis par thon mkhan ni nā pho lun yin/ skar ma 'ga' tsam las ma 'gor bar hpha dmag gis o dmag cham la phab/ de ni 1796lo'i zla 5tshes 11nyin red/nā pho lun gyis i ṭa li nas thob pa'i rgyu nor dang sgyu rtsal dngos rdzas 'bor chen pha ri sir bskyal bas dbang sgyur pa shin tu spro bo byung / yin na'ang nā pho lun gyi dbang stobs nyin re bzhin rgyas pa na dbang 'dzin pa la kho nyams rgud du gtong bsam skyes/ kho tshos nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung khag gnyis su phyes shing / dmag spyi chen po khi li man (ma74)mngags nas de'i khag gcig la bkod 'doms byed du bcug nā pho lun shin tu ma dga' la/dmag dpung gcig la dmag spyi gnyis yod na g.yul legs po sprod mi nus snyam pa byung / khos 88kho bor rgyal kha mang po lon pa ni kho bo'i bya spyod dang kho bo'i bsam blo gcig mthun mgyogs myur yin pa'i rkyen kho nas yin/ bsam pa na de ma nyid du lag tu bstar g.yul sprod pa la mi so sor thabs jus mi 'dra ba yod/ dmag spyi khi li man la kho bo las myong thob mtho zhing / byas rjes kyang kho bo'i gong na yod/ gal te nged gnyis kyis bya ba lhan sgrub byas tshe/don legs lam du mi 'gro nges can red/ dmag spyi phal ba zhig kyang 'jon thang can gyi dmag spyi gnyis las rgyal thub ’ ces zhu yig phul/ ti srid gzhung gis nā pho lun gyi rnam 'gyur de 'dra rbad chod yin pa rtogs pas thabs zad nas sngar ltar bzhag 1797lo'i zla 12par/ nā pho lun pha ri sir phyir log tshe mi rnams kyis lhag bsam zol med ngang gong bkur bla na med pa byas/ skabs der kho dmag mi'i sprul ba dang / rgyal kha'i mtshon byed du gyur te/ kho sdod sa'i srang de'i 4111

ming yang ‘4rgyal kha'i lam 7zhes par bsgyur/ dga' 'bod de'i khrod du khos khengs dregs kyi nyams 'gyur ma bstan par ma zad/ bab brling ngang gnas bab la gzhigs kyin go skabs lhag par bzang po zhig la ngang sgug byas/ khos rang nyid kyi go thang da dung dma' la/ lo na yang ti srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin 'khuraba'i khrims bkod lo tshod du da dung slebs med pa rtogs par ma zad/yun ring bor pha ri sir khom sdod byas na rang nyid gab sbas su gtong ba'ang rtogs pas/ khos dbang 'dzin par zhu yig phul te/ skabs der tur ki (15 khu05 pho༅)yis dbang du sgyur ba'i e cib la dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i re ba zhus/ hpha ran sis o si khri ri ya pham rjes/ dbyin ji 'gran ya gtso bor gyur yod/ i jib la dpung 'jug byas te sa dbus rgya mtsho sger sdom byas na/dbyin jis bzung ba'i shar phyogs kyi rgya gar la 'jigs skul nus par ma zad/dbyin jir gzhogs rdung yang byed nus pas/ nā pho lun gyi bsam 'char de ti srid gzhung gi bsam tshul dang gcig mthun byung /1798lo'i zla 5par/ nā pho lun gyis dmag dpung khrid nas/ gru gzings sum brgya lhag la bsdad de zla ngo gcig dang phyed kyi rgyang bzhud byas la/dbyin ji'i gru gzings kyi snyeg rgol g.yol nas/ zla 7pa'i mgor e leg zan ter ( 10 thab607 ༅lomam)'jug ngogs nas skam sar bud/ gtor dbyibs mchod rten gyi g.yul 'gyed du tur ki'i rta dmag pham par brgyab ste khe ro (0410 zo7)blangs/ nā pho lun gyis i jib tu 'jigs skul dbang sgyur lag tu bstar/ khos sna tur ki'i mi bcos bsgyur byed pa la chad 'gel lci mo spyod dgos/ kho bos nyin re bzhin khe ro'i srang du mi lnga drug re bsad nas/sdod dmangs rnams la gong bkur byed du 'jug ste/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho'i lta ba la gong bkur ni dngangs skrag yin pas so ’ zhes bshad/ 'on kyang 112

bkas bkod kyi sa bogs med par bzos pa dang / mi dmangs kyi chos lugs dad mos dang yul srol goms gshis la brtsi bkur byas par ma zad/ da dung so'i zi (500༅ lokhya )mi bzos gtsang bo bzo ba dang / sa dbus rgya mtsho dang rgya mtsho dmar po sbrel te mtsho lam btod rtsis byas/ yin na'ang dmag dpung dang lhan du 'ong ba'i tshan rig lag rtsal mi snas sa dbus rgya mtsho dang rgya mtsho dmar po'i chu mtshams mtho dma' mi 'dra bar 'dod pas 'char gzhi der 'gal rkyen 'phrad/nā pho lun gyis i jib bdag gnyer bgyi skabs der/ kho la rdung rdeg tsha nan zhig thebs/ de ni dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi dmag spyi grags can nāl zhun (༅0 3 10 sa0130bayolo༅)gyis sne drangs pa'i dbyin ji'i gru dpung gis thog mtha' bar gsum du kho la rjes 'ded byed bzhin yod la/ zla 8tshes 1nyin nāl zhun gyis hpha ran si'i gru dpung sbrul dbyibs ltar ne le gtsang bo (sa110 lo༅kho)yi 'gram rgyud du bsdad yod pa tshor bas/ blo yul las 'das pa'i sgo nas mtshan mor tshur rgol byas la/ gru gzings skor cig hpha ran si'i gru dpung nang rol tu bskyod bcug nas phyi nang mnyam 'brel gyis rgol bas hpha ran si'i gru dpung la ya lan slog thabs bral ba bzos/ hpha ran si'i gru dpung gi dmag spyi bsad la/ gru gzings gnyis bros shor byung ba las gzhan tshang ma med par bzos/ g.yul 'gyed thengs der nā pho lun gyi phyi lam bcad la/ rgyal nang dang 'brel ba yang chad du bcug khos khe ror bkag sdod byas na dmag sems 'tshub par 'gyur bsam nas/ si ri ya (57 13malko1༅)la phar rgol byas te nyen babs las thar 'dod skyes/ 'on kyang lam du rims nad la 'phrad de phyir khe ro la mi log ka med byung /nā pho lun la thabs zad pa'i skabs der/ nyin zhig khos dbyin dmag 113

gi lag nas yo rob nas khyer yong ba'i tshags par 'ga' mthong la/ de las/yo rob kyi gnas bab la 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod de/ u ru si dang o si khri ri ya sogs rgyal khab yang bskyar mnyam 'brel byas te hpha ran si la dpung 'jug byed cing / tshur blangs pa'i i ṭa li slar shor te/ g.yul gyi gnas bab de hpha ran si la phyi phyir mi phan par gyur yod pa dang / hpha ran si'i rgyal nang du chab srid la g.yo 'gul byung bas/ mi rnams kyis 'jon stobs ldan pa'i mi zhig gis rnyog zing gi gnas bab de bcos par re ltos byed kyin mchis la/ ti srid gzhung khrod kyi zhis e zi (310763 yotho7)yis thabs lam 'tshol bzhin pa bcas rtogs par gyur/ khos skabs de'i hpha ran si la 88dngos po gnyis mkho che ste/ klad pa zhig dang ral gri zhig ’ mkho bar 'dod/nā pho lun gyis lo rgyus kyis rang nyid kyi 'jon thang rtsal du 'don pa'i go skabs legs po zhig bstsal ba ngos zin zhing / go skabs 'chor mi 'os shing gal srid shor tshe slar mi 'ong ba'ang shes pas/ khos rbad chod kyis dmag dpung bzhag ste rang gis drung 'khor nyung tsam khrid nas gru chung zhig la bsdad de nyen tshabs chen po gdong gis bsus te dbyin dmag gi bkag sdom g.yol zhing / brel myur ngang hpha ran sir log114

bcu gsum pa/ nā po lun rgyal por bzhugs pa/ nā pho lun ni dmag spyi 'jon thang can zhig yin par ma zad/ chab srid thad kyang spyang grung chen po ldan pa zhig yin/ kho 1799lo'i zla 10par i jib nas pha ri sir log la/ zla gcig kyu nga ma long pa'i dus yun thung thung nang 'dzam gling la skad du grags pa'i 8 smug zla'i srid 'gyur ’ bslangs/kho hpha ran si nas skam sar bud ma thag ‘ nā pho lun phyir phebs byung ’ zhes pa'i gnas tshul de rgyal yongs la rlung ltar khyab par gyur/ skabs der nā pho lun gyi 'jon thang ldan pa'i spun mched gsum ste/ yo ze phe po na phad (103096 30ba393 0 tram̐shiza〉 yonghru༅) dang / lu zen po na phad(65010sa20ba393 0 tshoyoza ṣṭhaphuraphya)/ lu'e zi po na phad (༅0513 802393 0 tshonaskya ṣṭhanghru༅)gsum gros chad byas te kho bsu ru phyin/ le zen rang lo nyer bzhi tsam las med kyang lnga brgya'i gling ④gi gros gtso'i 'gan khur yod pas/rgyal nang gi chab srid gnas bab la gsal cha shin tu che/ khos nā pho lun la/khyod don dngos thog rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin du gyur yod pas/ nga tsho'i mdun du lhag yod pa ni bca' khrims kyi 'gros rim yin tshul bshad cing / kho tshos gsang stabs kyis gros mol byas nas gling gnyis kur btsan thabs kyi sgo nas bca' khrims la bzo bcos byed du 'jug rgyu byas/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni nā pho (nye lnga brgya'i gling zhes pa ni hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i skabs kyi mang gros gling ste/ rgya yig tustuthomatshodang yang na' lngatshozhes pa'o/ 115

lun da dung rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin byed pa'i khrims bkod kyi lo tshod la ran med pas so//nā pho lun gyi khyim mi tshang mas phyogs so sor 'brel gtug 'gro 'ong byas shing / kho tshos ti srid gzhung khrod kyi zhis e zi dang tis khi (50rtsa0 — 05003 7༈4)gnyis tshur bkug ste/ kho gnyis la thog mar las khur dgongs zhu byed du bcug pa dang / de nas zla 11tshes 9nyin ④ti srid gzhung gi khongs mi gzhan dag la'ang btsan thabs kyis las khur dgongs zhu byed du bcug de nas rgan gtso gling la mi la las ngan jus gshom gyin yod tshul zhus te gling gnyis brel myur ngang sin khi lu pho brang (cha༅zlotshi)du spor/ de ltar du ti srid gzhung la ming tsam las dbang cha med par btang / nyin gnyis par gling gnyis gas so sor sin khi lu pho brang nas tshogs 'du bsdus shing / nā pho lun gyis drag chas spras te srung dmag gi srung skyob 'og rgan gtso gling(zatsoṭha)du song ste gtam bshad byas shing / bca' khrims la bzo bcos byed rgyu'i re ba bton/ gros mi la las nā pho lun drag chas spras te bla na mtho ba'i gros tshogs tshoms chen du yong ba la bsam pa bzang po med pa shes te/ ‘ sger gcod pa rtsa med du gtong ’’/ 64gtum po cham phab gtong ’ zhes 'bod kyin nā pho lun gyi sngon du mchong ste phan tshun 'phud 'then byas la/ la las kho'i gong ba nas bzung zhing rkang lag gnyis gas brdungs/ g.yul ngor dpa' zil che ba'i nā pho lun yang skabs der mgo 'thoms shing ha lam dran pa nyams pa'i tshod du bslebs/ srung dmag gi srung skyob 'og da gzod dka' ba mang du myong bzhin phyi rol gyi khang pa zhig nang g.yol thub pa byung / kho'i nu bo lu zen () spyi mthun lugs kyi smug zla'i tshes 18nyin/116

la lhing 'jags dang spyang grung ldan rung skabs der lnga brgya'i gling gi mgo gnon ma nus la/ phyi pa ring po de phud cing gros gtso'i rtags mtshan tshang ma dor te/ brel 'tshub ngang phu bo'i gam du song / nā pho lun gyis rang gi 'char gzhi stong bar 'gyur bzhin pa'i tshul de mthong nas drag chas spyod rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ kho tsho dmag mi'i mdun du song ste/ lu zen gyis 88kho bo ste/ lnga brgya'i gling gi gros gtsos khyod rnams la bsgrags rgyu ni/ rang re'i gros mi mang shos skabs 'dir gros mi kha cig gi 'jigs skul 'og lhung yod/ kho bos gros mi mang shos skyob pa'i 'gan de khyod tshor bcol rgyu yin ’ zhes smras ma thag nā pho lun gyi glo nas ral gri phyung ste nā pho lun gyi snying khar btsugs nas/64gal te 'di'i nang na sger chod pa'i snying zhig yod tshe/ kho bos gu yangs gtan nas med par ral gri rgyag gi yin minyazhes bshad pas/ dmag mi rnams kyi sems kha bsgyur te/ lhan cig tu gros tshogs tshoms chen nang mchong song zhing / khong khro 'bar gyin pa'i gros mi rnams phyir bskrad/ dgong mo der lu zen gyis gros mi sum cu lhag khrid 'ong ste gnas skabs lag bstar srid gzhung 'dzugs rgyur chog mchan bkod la/ nā pho lun gnas skabs srid 'dzin pa dang por bskos shing / zhis e zi dang tis khi srid 'dzin par bskos/ don de dag tshang ma grub rjes phyi nyin gyi zhogs par bslebs yod/ nā pho lun gyis dbugs ring zhig gtong gan g.yas g.yon gyi mi rnams la 'di ltar dris/‘8ngas skad cha rdzob po mang du smras song ngam’ /8 mi nyung lags/ dmag spyi /88kho bo dmag tshidang gleng mol byed rgyur dga' mod/ 'on kyang dag sel pa 'di dag dang kha lce 'khrug mi 'dod/ gte bo 'di dag gis kho bo dngangs su bcug byung ’ /117

nā pho lun gyis gnas skabs srid 'dzin pa dang po'i 'gan bzung ba'i rjes su/ 1802lor tshe gang srid 'dzin par bsdad la/ 1804lor rang nyid rgyal por bsdad de dbang cha'i yang rtser 'gos so/ /nā pho lun ni 'byor ldan gral rim pa'i rgyal po yin/ khos krung dbyang gi dbang cha gcig sdud la shugs snon gyis mu mthud du 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i grub 'bras sra brtan dang 'phel rgyas su btang la/ gu yangs med pa'i sgo nas por pon (200 60ba ṣṭhazo)rgyal rabs slar gso'i stobs shugs la rdung rdeg byas/ lu'e zi bcu drug pa'i nu bos rang gis rang nyid la lu'e zi bco brgyad par btags shing / kho pas slar gso'i re ba nā pho lun gyi steng du bcol nas/ kho la 'phrin yig btang ste/ phyir rgyal nang du log nas por pon rgyal rabs slar gso byed rgyu'i re ba zhus/ nā pho lun gyi 'phrin lan ni shin tu rbad thag chod po yod de/ 8 khyod kyis rgyal nang du log rgyu'i re ba ma byed/ gal te khyod phyir log na/ nges par du bem po khri phrag bcu'i ma rtsa 'jog dgos ’nyazhes bris yod/nā pho lun gyis srid bzung rjes bzo tshong pa rnams la bya dga' byin pa dang / zhing las lag rtsal gsar brje byed par skul lcag byas shing / hpha ran si'i dngul khang gsar 'dzugs dang / gzhung lam bskrun pa/ gnam bdag chos lugs rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur 'og 'jug pa bcas byas mod/ yin na'ang de'i mtshungs su khos dmangs gtso'i stobs shugs la drag gnon byas te/ 8 bzo pa'i lag deb ’ lam lugs gtan 'khel byas/ kho ni shin tu mi bed spyod byed mkhas po yod pas/ lag 'og gi mi'i nang na 'jon thang ldan pa mi nyung ba yod la/ khos rang nyid la 88kho bo'i bsrung bya'i gdams ngag ni ‘'jon po 'ba' zhig bsko ba riyin zhing / khyim rgyud mtho dma' dang rgyu nor 118

mang nyung la mi lta ba nya yin par brjod/ yin na'ang kho bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi khyim rgyud 'brel ba'i thad kyang shin tu tshabs chen po yod de/ kho'i phu bo yo ze phe po na phad ni na phi le si (sa 9103smokhyarayo7)yi rgyal po dang /nu bo lu zen po na phad ni lnga brgya'i gling gi gros gtso/ lu'e zi po na phad ni ho lan ḍi'i rgyal po/ nu bo chung ba lo pu po na phad ni we si thi hpha lon (malo/rnyatsholo〉)gyi rgyal por bskos/ nā pho lun gyi bud med la lta stangs thad kyang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi rang mdangs mngon gsal dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ khos 88kho mo tshos gtan du bkur bstun byed dgos ’ zer la/〈〈dmangs khrims 〉〉su ‘ chung mas nges par du khyo gar brtsi bstun bya dgos ’ zhes gsal por bkod yod/nā pho lun gyi ches che ba'i byas rjes ni khos 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'igrub 'bras de bca' khrims kyi rnam pas sra brtan du btang ba de yin/khos snga phyir 〈〈dmangs khrims 〉〉dang / 〈〈tshong khrims〉〉/ 〈〈nyes khrims 〉〉sogs khyab bsgrags byas/ 〈〈dmangs khrims 〉〉la khyon don tshan nyis stong nyis brgya gya gcig yod la/ don tshan so so'i nang don zhib tshags yin pas/bkol spyod skabs gsal bshad mang po mi dgos par nges sla ba zhig yin/ nā pho lun rang nyid dngos su ma phyi 'bri bar zhugs la/ bshad tshul ltar na kho'i lag ma brgyud pa'i don tshan gcig kyang med/ 〈〈dmangs khrims 〉tol phyis su 〈〈nā pho lun khrims yig 〉〉tu btags/ nā pho lun gyis 88kho bo'i don dam pa'i gzi brjid ni rgyal kha'i g.yul 'thab thengs bzhi bcu brgyab pa de ni ma yin te/wa ther lo (yo3 07100 tshoṣṭhaṇa)yi 'khrug thengs des dran pa de dag thams cad bslabs song / 'on kyang don gcig ni mi rnams kyis brjed7 mi srid de/de la gtan du nyams pa med/ de ni kho bo'i dmangs khrims yin mi’zhes dngos 119

su bshad myong /nā pho lun zhes pa'i rgyal po 'di'i thad la/ kho rang nyid kyis gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig brjod myong ste/ 88kho bo il pa (khya/63 khong/ ༅yi)gling phran nas phyir log skabs/ rgan mo zhig 'khar bar brten nas gya ma gyol du 'gro bzhin pa mthong / kho mos nga ngo ma shes/ ‘we/ a ma rgan mo/ khyod gang la phebs rgyu’zhes dris pa na/ rgan mo des ‘ngo ma/ mi rnams kyis nga la rgyal po 'di na bzhugs zer bas/ ngas rang nyid ma shi ba'i sngon la khor gcig lta dgos zhes lan btab/ ‘khyod kyis kho la lta don ci yin nam/ khyod la kho'i sa nas ci zhig thob myong / kho ni gtum po zhig yin te/ gtum po gzhan dag dang 'dra ’zhes bshad par/ ‘legs so/ sku zhabs/ de ltar yin srid mod/ gang ltar khong ni mi dmangs kyi mnga' bdag yin/ por pon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po de dag ni sku drag gi rgyal po red ’ces lan btab ’’byung zer/nā pho lun gyi tshig der rang nyid 'ud bstod byed pa'i cha yod srid pas yongs su rlom mi rung mod/ 'on kyang en ke sis 'di ltar bshad myong ste/ nā pho lun de zhing pa'i mig lam du skyes bu zhig ma yin par kho tsho'i khe phan gyi tshab byed pa'i rtsa don zhig yin zhes gsungs myong ngo //nā pho lun gyi mi tshe gcig po phyi phyogs g.yul 'thab dang dam du 'brel yod/ kho thengs bdun la hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel g.yul 'gyed dang 'phrad cing / lho bskyod byang rdung sgos rgyal kha'i g.yul 'gyed bcu phrag 4'ga' brgyab pa dang / we en na (510sas8 ཿ71ma)dang rom(5040 ༅6)/ per lin (80 11ba/khrirnyekhri)/ hwa hwa (yotha434 shtsa༅)/ sogs yo rab kyi grong khyer grags can mang po bzung myong / de dag las skad grags che ba'i g.yul 'gyed ni/ 180)lo'i ma ren ku'i (53 0sartsa0 6khyamo)g.yul 120

'gyed dang / 1805lo'i o si thi li tshi'i (me bya 0 11 2 tsholo༈rnyalko1cho)g.yul g.yul 'gyed/ 1806lo'i ye na'i (10sa3 sgokhyarsā)g.yul 'gyed/ 1809lo'i wa ki la mu'i (7tsho4khri))g.yul 'gyed sogs yod la/ khos dbyin ji dang o si khri ri ya la btsan thabs kyis chings yig 'jog tu bcug 1807lor hpha ran si'i dmag gis u ru si'i dmag ches cher pham ste/ zar rgyal (02tha 7/༅)e leg zan ter dang po la thel zhi thi'i (11 131/lo1lo.o31)nye 'dabs kyi ne man gtsang bo'i steng gi shing gru zhig steng nā pho lun la mjal 'phrad byed du bcug e leg zan ter gyis nā pho lun la 8 ci zhig la yo rob gling zer ’ zhes dris par/ nā pho lun gyis 88nga tsho ni yo rob yin ’ zhes lan btab/ kho tshos 88nga tsho ni yo rob yin ’ zhes pa'i snying stobs gzhir bzung nas stobs shugs kyi khyab khongs phyes shing / 〈〈thel zhi thi'i zhi chings 〉〉zhes pa bkod de/nā pho lun btsan rgyal gyi stobs shugs dar rgyas kyi yange rtser bslebs/ dmag dar mdun nas mdun du bskyod pa dang bstun nas/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bca' khrims dang lam lugs dag kyang mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i sa khul du khyer bas/ sa de ga'i bkas bkod kyi lam lugs dang sgrig srol la brdab gsig dang gtor bshig btang / mi la las nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung gi ral gri'i so khar de ltar rno dbal ldan pa ni ral gri'i so kha na bsam blo yod pas yin zhes brjod la/ brjod stangs der yang gnas lugs shig yod do//yin na'ang kho'i g.yul 'thab la'ang bran bkol rang bzhin gyi phyogs yod de/dper na si phen dang he khri la btsan 'dzul byas pa lta bu yin/nā pho lun gyi dbang stobs phyi phyir je cher song la/ kho'i ham sems kyang nyin re bzhin che ru bskyed/ mthar kho'i ham sems de lo rgyus kyi tshad khongs las brgal bas kho rang go gnas nas lhung bar gyur/ khos mngon sum 'dzem 121

med sgos 88kho bo 'dzam gling gi bdag por 'gyur dgos mi’zhes smras la/ chab srid steng khos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dngos rgyud ring lugs pa dang 'gab mthun byas te/ ci thub kyis yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyal rgyud la bsnyes brten byas/ ches 'bur du thon pa'i mngon tshul zhig ni khos o si khri ri ya'i rgyal po'isras mo btsun mor bsus pa de yin zhing / ya mtshan pa'i chab srid kyi gnyen don de'i khrod/ phyogs gnyis so sos ngan g.yo khog bcug byas yod la/gnyis ka shin tu hur por snang / nā pho lun gyis dang thog u ru si'i sras mo an na btsun mor len 'dod kyang / u ru si'i rgyal pos dang len ma byas pas/ o rgyal gyi sras mo ma re'u 'u'e zi (53710—600130༅o loskyatsho)la bsam pa 'khor/ skabs der o rgyal du spyang grung can gyi me thi nye (nga10la0sa3sku'i00201khu090la5khu 60 5tha19 khya573/ma0ba 50 0 ba106skesgro༈rnyaskya'i)yis phyi 'brel blon po khu3sna yod la/ kho ni 88rgyal chen stobs mnyam ’’srid jus dar spel gtong mkhan byang cha can zhig yin pa dang / khos gnas bab dang stobs shugs ngo mar dpyad bsdur byas rjes/ mthun gnyen gyis dmag 'khrug gi tshab byas te/ gnas skabs nā pho lun 'jags su 'jug pa dang / phyis su skabs glags btsal nas kho pa 'dul rgyu'i 'dod pa bstan/1809lo'i lo mjug tu/ nā pho lun btsun mo snga ma yo se hphin (1036961ba60803063 sa313tram̐gizazo ཿ khu7lokhya)dang 'thor zhing / 1810lo'i zla 3par o rgyal gyi sras mo dang gnyen bsgrigs te/ phyi lor sras shig skyes pa rom gyi rgyal por bskos so//skabs der/ nā pho lun gyi klad pa phyi phyir 'khrugs par gyur zhing / kho rang 'dzam gling gi bdag por 'gyur ba'i gegs rkyen gtso bo sel ched/ khos sku dngos kyis khri phrag drug cur long pa'i dmag chen khrid de mo si kho (50bya00lo122

zalo༈ 4)la dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i thag bcad cing / 1812lo'i zla 6par/hpha ran si'i gtos su che ba'i rgyang 'jug dmag dpung u ru sir drangs/ khos khrid pa'i dmag chen ne man gtsang bo brgal te u ru si'i khongs su bgrod grabs byed skabs/ kho'i chibs rta de ri bong la 'drogs te 'gyel zhing / kho rang rta thog nas lhung / de bkra mi shis pa zhig tu bgrang dka' mod/ 'on kyang u ru si la dpung 'jug byas pa ni kho lhung ba'i mgo rtsom byed yin te/ e leg zan ter jus thabs la brten nas kho las rgyal bar gyur/ u ru si'i dmag gis hpha ran si'i dmag gi rno dbal g.yol te gzhogs nas 'jab rgol byas shing / nā pho lun mo si kho'i mkhar stong la brid 'khrid byas/ hpha ran si'i dmag gis lam thag ring bo nas dmag brgyab pas ngal zhing dub la/ mo si khor bslebs rjes bkres ltogs kyis mnar zhing / u ru si'i nam zla 'khyag po de yang thung myur du bsleb nye bas/ dpa' bo yang tha ma'i lam sner thug nā pho lun gyis thengs gsum la e leg zan ter dang zhi gros byed rgyur skul yang /zar rgyal gyis khengs pa'i sgo nas kha ya ma byas/ zla 10par/ grang ngar chen po'i mdun du/ nā pho lun phyir 'then mgo brtsams/ bkres ltogs dang grang ngar/ rdung rdeg bcas myong bzhin phyir hpha ran sir bslebs tshe khri phrag drug cu'i dpung chen der khri phrag gsum tsam las lhag med/ 1813lo'i zla 10par/nā pho lun u ru si dang phu ro zi/ o si khri ri ya/ dbyin ji bcas kyis pham zhing / 1814lo'i zla 3par mnyam 'brel dmag gis pha ri si bzung la/ zla 4par nā pho lun go gnas nas ma babs ka med byung /chings yig ltar du/ nā pho lun sa dbus rgya mtsho'i il pa gling phran du rgyang phud btang / sdod dmangs chig khri lhag rmis med pa'i gling phran chung chung de'i steng kho mu mthud du rgyal po byas chog la/ mi grangs stong phrag gcig lhag 123

gi dmag dpung zhig kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang dbyin dmag gi lta rtog 'og gling phran de dang 'bral mi chog nā pho lun gling phran de'i mtho sa zhig tu 'dzegs te gling phran hril bor lta bzhin du/ ‘4rgyal khongs 'di shin tu chung drags pa ma yin nam mi zhes smras/nā pho lun go gnas nas phab rjes lu'e zi bco brgyad pa la hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis rogs skyor byas 'og por pon rgyal rabs slar gso byas/ kho'i bya spyod ji 'dra zhig yin pa de mi rnams kyis sngon dpag byed dka' ba zhig ma yin/ zla 8tshes 15nyin/ hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis nā pho lun gyi skyes skar la rten 'brel zhu ba'i rnam pa spyad de slar gso byas pa'i rgyal rabs la khro ba bstan no//nā pho lun gyis mi dmangs kyi chab srid kyi sems khams shin tu gsal por shes/ 1815lo'i zla 3tshes 1nyin/ khos mi stong phrag gcig lhag khrid de hpha ran si'i lho khul nas skam sar bud pa na/ zhing pa rnams kyis 88rgyal po khri lor shog ’ ces dga' 'bod gsang mthor bsgrags la/ kho'i lag 'og rgan gras rnams kyis spro sems ngang rgyab skyor byas te snga gzhug tu bsten par 'ong /nā pho lun mi rnams kyi gong bkur 'og pha ri sir bskyod de slar yang rgyal khrid 'khod pa mi rnams ngo mtshar chen po bskyed/ nā pho lun rang nyid kyis pha ri sir bskyod pa'i gnas tshul 'di ltar bshad de/ sger sems ci yang med pa'i mi rnams 8 kho bo'i rjes su 'brangs te grong khyer gcig nas gcig brgyud la/kho tsho mu mthud mdun du bskyod mi nus skabs/ mi gzhan gyis kho tsho'i tshab byas te kho bo srung skyel byas/ de ltar du kho bo pha ri si la bskyal byung nya zhes bshad do// lu'e zi bco brgyad pa nā pho lun pha ri ser bslebs pa'i snga dgong brel dngangs kyis bros song /124

u o phu sogs rgyal khab kyi rgyal po rnams we en na ru tshogs 'du 'tshogs sgang du/ nā pho lun bskyar dar byung ba thos te mgyogs myur ngang thengs bdun par hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ zla 6tshes 18nyin wa ther lo'i g.yul 'thab der nā pho lun la mtha' 'jug gi pham kha myangs/ thengs der nā pho lun gyi srid dbang ha lam nyin brgya la rgyun 'khyongs byung yod pas/ lo rgyus steng de la 88nyin brgya'i rgyal rabs ’ zer/ nā pho lun ma gzhir gru gzings la bsdad de a rir 'gro rtsis byas kyang dbyin grus bkag pas/ kho bya thabs zad de dbyin gru la bud de dbyin ji'i gru dpon la ‘6kho bo khyod kyi gru steng du bud pa ni/rang nyid dbyin ji'i bca' khrims kyi srung skyob 'og bcug pa yin ’ zhes bshad/ 'on kyang dbyin ji bas 'gro lam zad pa'i rgyal po de btson mar byas te/ sin he na pho lar/ len gling phran (bya31sa — 'a ༄ / 010ba0caḥ.oṃḥyam̐)du rgyang 'bud btang ngo //sin he len gling phran ni nub mtsho chen mo'i lho khul duyod cing / yo 125

rob la spyi le sum stong nyis brgya'i bar thag yod/ de dang thog ming grags med pa'i gling phran zhig yin mod/ nā pho lun rgyang phud du btang ba las 'dzam gling du skad grags che ba'i sa khul zhig tu gyur/ gling phran steng gi dbyin ji'i spyi khyab kyis dbyin le bcu gnyis kyi sa khongs shig nā pho lun 'gro 'dug byed sar byas te/ dmag mi nyis brgya la nan mor srung du bcug pa dang / kho la 'khor g.yog bzhi bcu 'jog chog par byas/ sa chad de'i khongs su me tog dang sngo rtswa 'debs chog la/ 'chag 'chag gtong ba dang rta bcib kyang chog pa dang / tshags par dang dpe deb klog pa'am phyir dran zin tho bris kyang chog nā pho lun gyis 'khor 'brang rnams la rang nyid kyi tshe gang bo'i myong brgyud ngag thog nas bshad la/ phyis su 〈〈nā pho lun gyi phyir dran zin tho 〉〉zhes su bsdu bsgrigs byas/ khos sin he len gling phran nas an ti sin gyis bris pa'i 〈〈ma kur ne (600 rtsa0 530tha ba07 bra7lo༅)ru mtsho bskyod byas tshul las krung go'i skor bris pa 〉〉zhes pa bklags rjes/ nges shes 'drongs pa'i sgo nas 8 krung go nam zhig sad par gyur pa'i tshe/ 'dzam gling la g.yo 'gul gtong bar 'gyur ’ zhes bshad myong /1821lo'i zla 5tshes 5nyin/ tshe gang g.yul la zhugs shing / grags chod gling bzhir khyab pa'i mi sna de tshe las 'das la/ skabs der rang lo 52tsam yin/nā pho lun 'das tshul skor de da lta shin tu lkog gyur zhig tu gyur yod/dus rabs gcig dang phyed kyi ring la tshang mas kho ni pho skran gyis 'das zer mod/ 1955lor rgyal po'i nye 'khor lu'e zi mal hrang (po7 bralolo)gis bris pa'i phyir dran zin tho par du bskrun la/ dpe cha der kho'i bdag po 'chi kha'i 'phag 'tshag gi gnas tshul bkod yod/ su'e ten gyi so dpyad sman pa 126

dang nad dug rig pa ba si than spro hru hphu wu ti (lo༅ choyoza7mmu)zhes pas dpe deb de bklags rjes/ nā pho lun gyi skra la rdzas 'gyur brtag zhib byas pa na/ rgyal po de ni dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi ar se ni khi (3 30ba10 7)zhes pa'i dug phog ste shi ba yin pas jus gsod byas pa yin par kha tshon bcad/ bshad tshul ltar na 1840lor nā pho lun gyi bem po sin he len gling phran nas pha ri si'i gzi brjid dmag gling du spo skabs/ dur sgam kha phyes tshe bem po sngar mus su legs por yod/ su'e ten gyi so dpyad sman pa des zhib 'jugacos pa ltar na/ de yang ar se ni khe yi nus pa las byung ba yin no//don dam ji ltar yin pa ni/ rgyal khab so so'i mkhas pa rnams la mu mthud dpyad zhib gnang du 'jug pa las thabs gzhan med do//ṇa

bcu bzhi pa/ 66'das don de kho pa'i bzhugs khri ru g.yug gog pa /de/me thi nye dang we en na'i gros tshogs/la las bshad na/ nā pho lun dang ‘ hpha rgol mna' 'brel ’ bar gyi g.yul 'khrug ni hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i gces phrug dang sgrig srol rnying ba'i bar gyi g.yul 'khrug yin zer/ brjod lugs de yang gnas lugs med pa zhig ma yin/ nā pho lun lo rgyus kyi stegs bu nas phud rjes/ yo rob kyi rgyal po tshos 8 'das don de khopa'i bzhugs khri ru g.yug ’ par brel ba ste/ gang thub sgos hpha ran si'i gsar brje dang nā pho lun g.yul 'khrug gi shugs rkyen sel thabs byas/ rgyal kha thob pa'i rgyal khab kyis nā pho lun il pa gling phran du bkag 'jug byas rjes/ 1814lo'i zla 10tshes 1nyin we en na ru tshogs 'du 'tshogs te/ thob nor bgo ba dang gsar brje 'gog thabs la gros bsdur byas/ tshogs 'du de 'tshogs yun shin tu ring ste/ lo rjes ma'i zla 6pa'i tshes 9nyin da gzod mjug bsdus/ tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan khrod zar rgyal e leg zan ter sku rabs dang po dang / o si khri ri ya'i rgyal po hphu ran sis zi dang po (kha1thab01 3 1 lkoṣṭhakhyayo7—tsho)/ phu ro zi'i rgyal po hphu re te ri khi wi lim gsum pa ( 27060 10khu yo151thal khya lko༅ཿ༅lko ma zatsho)bcas dang / rgyal khab skor cig gi blon chen dang phyi 'brel blon chen sogs yod la/tshogs zhugs 'thus mi khyon bsdoms nyis brgya lhag yod/ de lta bu'i gzab rgyas snga na med pa'i rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs shig gi 'go 'dzin de skabs der ming 128

grags che ba'i zar rgyal dang yang na o dang phu'i rgyal po ma yin par/ o si khri ri ya'i phyi 'brel blon chen me thi nye yin/ go gnas thad nas bshad na me thi nye ni mnga' bdag gi blon 'khor yin mod/ 'on kyang spyang grung thad nas bshad na skabs de'i yo rob dbang sgyur tshogs khag nang kho ni don dngos 'jon thang can zhig tu bgrang chog we en na'i gros tshogs kyi 'gan khur gtso bo ni yo rob kyi sa bkra bskyar 'bri dang / nā pho lun gyis —gtor bshig btang ba'i sgrig srol rnying ba slar gso byed rgyu de yin la/ me thi nye ni tag tag nā pho lun pham mkhan gyi dgra zla yin te/ nā pho lun la 'thab 'dzing byed pa'i khrod dar yong ba'i sgrig srol rnying ba'i mtshon byed cig yin/1806lor/ o rgyal gyis nā pho lun gyi ral gri rnon po'i so ngogs su 88khyad du 'phags pa'i rom gyi rgyal po ’ zhes pa'i mtshan de mi 'dor ka med byung / o si khri ri ya de lta bu'i gnas bab sdug po zhig gi skabs su/ me thi nye yis pha ri sir sdod pa'i gzhung tshab khur/ pha ri si nas kho dpon gras kyi 'brel khongs su 'gro 'ong gis lhing 'jags ngang nā pho lun la lta rtog dang / skad cha bshad pa'i tshe shin tu gzab po byas/ nā pho me thi nyelun gyis kho'i ngor bltas nas bshad rgyur ‘ khyod 'di gar bya rba 4shin tu lam 'gro rgyug rgyu mtshan ni khyod skad cha nyung bas/ gzhan gyis khyod la glags mi rnyed ’ ces bshad/ 1809lor o si khri ri ya thengs lnga pa'i hpha rgol mna' 'brel du zhugs la/ wa ki la mu g.yul 'gyed 129

khrod slar yang hpha dmag gis pham ste/ we en na yang blangs/ nā pho lun gyis me thi nye la sdigs mo drag po byas te kho'i phyi 'brel gyi khyad dbang med par byas shing / kho we en nar brdzangs skyel byas/ rgyal po hphu ran sis zi yis kho'i spyang grung la shin tu rtsis mthong byed pas rang gi gam du bzhag la/ ring po ma 'gyangs par phyi 'brel blon chen la spar/me thi nye yis phyi 'brel blon chen khur rjes kyi las don chen po dang po ni nā pho lun gyis brnyas smod byas pa'i na zug bzod bsran sgos/ rang nyid kyis nā pho lun dang sras mo ma rezhu lu'e zi'i bar gnyen 'brel btsugs shing / zhi gnyen gyis g.yul 'khrug gi tshab byas nas/ dbugs ngal gso ba'i dus tshod brtson len byas pa dang / nyams la khad kyi ha pi si pur rgyal rabs (5cha365 6 40ba3 067ṣā.oṃlo༅cha7)bskyabs/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni thengs lnga pa'i hpha rgol mna' 'brel pham rjes/ nā pho lun gyi ral gri'i so kha nam rgyun o si khri ri ya'i mgor btsugs yod pas so// stobs shed rgyas shing gang 'dod spyod pa'i nā pho lun la dmigs nas/ me thi nye yis mig sngar 88nga tsho'i kha gtad gcog thabs ni nges par du rlung gi rgyu phyogs la blta dgos shing /rang nyid chums dgos la/ rgyal kha thob mkhan gyi ngo la lta dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod nga tsho mu mthud du gnas nas/ yongs su thar ba'i nyin mo la bsgug thub ’ces bshad/ nā pho lun gyi mos pa thob slad/ me thi nye yis rang dngos kyis gnyen sbrel byas pa ma zad/ rang dngos kyis rgyal po'i sras mo pha ri ser bskyal zhing / ma 'ongs pa'i 8 rom gyi rgyal po ri la chang phor btegs te rten 'brel yang zhus/ nā pho lun gyis dam bca' 'di ltar bzhag yod de/kho dang sras mo la gal te bu zhig skyes na ‘ rom gyi rgyal por ’ bsko rgyu byas/ me thi nye yis ‘ smyan ma ’ yi tshul bzung ba'i dus mtshungs su/ nang sems nas 130

gom gang mdun spos sgos nā pho lun 'dul ba'i jus thabs la mno bsam btang / kho'i 'dod tshul ni sras mo'i gnyen don gyis rang nyid kyi rgyal khab nyams rgud las bskyabs mod/ 'on kyang o si khri ri yas da dung nges par du drag chas spras te/ g.yul sprod rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos par snyam mo//nā pho lun gyis me thi nye yi jus 'phrul la ngos zin cung tsam yang med ces brjod mi nus te/ me thi nye yi skor la nā pho lun gyis tshig 'di 'dra zhig brjod myong ste/ 8(spyir mtshams la lar mi tshang mas rdzun gtam bshad kyin 'dug mod/ 'on kyang kho'i rdzun gtam lhag par du mang ’’zhes so// yin na'ang gnyen don 'di'i thad/ tshe gang g.yul la zhugs pa'i mi sna 'di me thi nye yi jus 'og tu tshud par gyur/ de yang gtso bo nā pho lun rang nyid kyi bsam blo la rag yod de/ en ke sis bstan pa ltar/ ‘ nā pho lun gyi ches che ba'i nor 'khrul ni/ khos o rgyal gyi sras mo chung mar bsus te/ sgrig srol rnying ba'i gsar brje ngo rgol gyi rgyal rabs dang mna' 'brel btsugs pa dang / yo rob kyi shul rjes rnying ba thams cad rtsa med ma btang bar de las ldog ste de dang 'gab mthun byas pa de yin nyanyazhes pa ltar ro//1812lor nā pho lun gyis u ru sir dpung 'jug byas la/ o rgyal gyis hpha ran sir rgyab skyor byed khul brjod cing / dmag 'bor khri gsum u ru sir drangs pa'i phyi tshul bstan mod/ 'on kyang lkog tu u ru si la brda sbran te/o dmag ni shugs bskyed de g.yul la mi zhugs par smras shing / nang sems nas nā pho lun pham par re ltos byas/ nā pho lun la dngos gnas pham kha chen po reg byung bas/ me thi nye yi rin thang dang skad cha'i nus tshad ches cher je mthor song / 1813lor/ me thi nye yis drag chas kyi sgo nas bar 'dum byas/zla 6tshes 26nyin/ kho dang nā pho lun gyis ti re zi ton (ba 0360 ཿzalo1smo)131

nas dus tshod dgu yi yun la ‘ phyi 'brel thad kyi wa ther lo g.yul 'gyed ’ ces pa bgyis/nyin der/ nā pho lun gyis ral gri glo la btags shing / lag tu gzab zhwa bzung yod/ me thi nye yis skad cha tshig gcig mi bshad par/ mi tshogs brtol te mgron mjal khang du shar mar song / nā pho lun gyis rgyun srol ltar rang gi sgyug po bde min sogs skor dris la/ de nas lce 'thab kyi mgo brtsams/ nā pho lun gyis ‘ we/ khyod kyis g.yul sprod dam/ mi 'gyangs par khyod kyi mgor bsleb yong mi zhes bshad/ thengs 'dir me thi nye yang ‘ smyan ma ’ byed du 'ong ba min pas/ khos 66de ring khyod kyis gros kha mthun po byas na da dung 'phyis med/ 'on kyang sang nyin 'phyis srid/ bdag gi rgyal pos lhag bsam kho nas bya ba sgrub pa yin pas/ khyod kyis kyang da ni rang nyid kyi lhag bsam la dri ba zhig byed ran 'dug ’ ces smras pa na/ nā pho lun gyis ‘ khyod tsho'i mnga' bdag gi rgyal khri ni rgyud 'dzin byed pa yin pas kho tsho thengs nyi shur phyir bskrad kyang mjug mthar slar yang khri khar log thub/ las skal gyi gces phrug kho bo ni de 'dra ma yin/ ’ zhes bshad nas cung bsdad de/slar ‘8kho bos na ning gi gyong gud slar gso byas yod/ nye lam kho bo'i rgyal kha'i 'thab mo thengs du mar bgyis pa'i dmag dpung la bltas pa tsam gyis de rtogs par 'gyur/ kho bos dmag gzigs mdzad sgo zhig spel te khyod la ston dgos 'dug ’ ces kha gsab byas/ me thi nye yi sems su skabs der hpha ran si'i mi dmangs dang / nā pho lun gyi dmag dpon mtho rim skor cig kyang zhi bde la re smon byed kyin pa gsal bor shes/ kho tsho g.yul 'khrug gis shin tu thang chad yod/ yin na'ang khos der dag bcos ma byas par yo rob kyi ngag tshab pa yin pa'i khengs nyams dang bcas 66sku zhabs kyis da lta kho bor brjod 132

pa dag las/ kho bor bden dpang gsar ba zhig thob la/ des yo rob dang sku ngo gnyis phan tshun bzod mthun yong thabs bral/ khyod dang yo rob kyi 'thab mo'i dus skabs ni slebs zin yod/ khyod phyir song ste g.yul lan byos la/ yo rob kyis kyang de ltar du byed par nges/ ma 'ongs par pham kha myong mkhan ni yo rob yin mi srid ’ ces brjod/ nā pho lun gyis me thi nye khengs dregs de ltar che ba mthong bas rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa nyams par gyur zhing / tha na ngag nas tshig rdzob po'ang thon/ khos rkang pa sa la rdeb kyin phyogs gcig nas 8 khyod dmag mi ma yin pas/ khyod kyis dmag mi zhig gi dran tshul shes mi thub/ kho bo ni g.yul 'thab las dar ba zhig yin la/ kho bo lta bu'i mi zhig gis mi khri tsho brgya phrag gi tshe srog sems nang gtan nas mi 'jog go ’ zhes smras la/ phyogs gcig nas lag gi leb mo sa la brdabs/de ltar byas kyang me thi nye yi rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ldog ci yang med/nā pho lun gyis skabs de'i me thi nye dang lo der smyan ma byed mkhan gyi me thi nye gnyis ni mi mi 'dra ba gnyis dang mtshungs pa de la lta bzhin/ sems nas rang nyid kho pa'i bslu brid 'og lhung ba ngos zin par gyur pas/ khos 'gyod sems kyis 88kho bos o si khri ri ya'i sras mo dang gnyen bsgrigs pa'i don 'di'i steng nas/ blun spyod ya na med pa zhig bgyis 'dug ’ ces smras pa na/ me thi nye yis bsam bzhin du rma thog la gtsags bu gsar ba btsugs te ‘ sku ngos kho bo'i bsam 'char la rgyus lon byed 'dod na/ kho bos brjod chog ste/ de ni dbang du sgyur mkhan nā pho lun gyi nor 'khrul yin no ’ zhes bshad/nā pho lun phangs pa'i ngang ‘ khyod kyis bshad pa la kho bo ya mtshan ci yang mi skye/don de dag thams cad kyis kho bos gu yangs gtong mi rung ba'i nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo zhig bcangs par bden dpang byas song / kho bo sras mo dang gnyen 133

sgrig pa'i skabs su/ kho bos gsar ba dang rnying ba gcig tu bsre 'dod/ kho bos rang nyid mgo bskor song / de ring da gzod kho bos rang nyid kyi nor 'khrul de'i tshabs che tshad rtogs song / kho bos de las rang nyid kyi rgyal khri 'chorasrid mod/ 'on kyang kho bos 'dzam gling 'di shul stong du gtong nges yin ’ zhes bshad/skad cha bshad mtshams 'jog skabs mun pa rub 'dug pas/ me thi nye yar langs nas 'gro grabs byas/ nā pho lun gyis kho'i phrag par rdeb kyin ‘ we/khyod kyis ci zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ba shes sam/ khyod kyis kho bor g.yul sprod ci la srid ’’ces smras pa na/ me thi nye yis 6 sku ngo/ khyod pham song/ da kho bo 'gro rgyu yin/ kho bos bltas na khyod pham nges red ’ ces bshad/ma 'gyangs par/ nā pho lun dngos gnas pham song / nā pho lun gyis rnyog dkrugs btang ba'i yo rob kyi las don gtsang bcos byed pa'i skabs su/me thi nye yis yang bskyar 'jon thang ngoms byung / khos phyi 'brel gyi lte gzhi de pha ri si dang lon ton nas we en na la bde blag sgos spos te/ o si khri ri ya'i rgyal spyi'i go gnas je mthor btegs shing / kho rang dkyil du bsdad de kha lo bsgyur bde bzos/ we en na'i gros tshogs steng / khos mngon lkog ci rigs kyi sgo nas dbye sbyor gyi lag thabs mang du spyad/ kho 'brel 'dris la shin tu 'jon zhing / kho tsho'i spyi tshogs gong ma'i mos phyogs kyang gsal bor shes/ kho rgyas spros la phangs pa med cing / dngul lor chu bzhin du gtong /gzab rgyas che ba'i dmag gzigs mdzad sgo dang / rten 'brel gyi 'du tshogs gzab rgyas 'tshogs pa dang / rgyas spros che ba'i gsol ston dang gar rtsed 'du tshogs bsdu ba dang / rgyal rabs rnying ba'i skabs kyi pho brang gi spro rtsed sna tshogs spel/ khos we en nar tshogs 'du ra phebs pa'i rgyal khab so so'i rgyal 134

blon dang sku lcam rnams nyin re bzhin mgo rmongs par byed pa'i 'brel 'dris kyi byed sgo'i khrod chags su bcug la/ kho rang nyid phye leb bzhin 'phur lding gar du rtsen pas/ mi rnams kyis ‘ phye leb blon chen ’ du btags/ me thi nye yis de ltar byed pa la rang nyid kyi bsam tshul zhig los kyang yod de/ hpha ran si'i phyi 'brel blon chen gyis 6‘kho'i 'jon thang chen po ni nga tshor dus tshod 'chor du 'jug pa yin te/ khos de ltar byas na khe bzang lon par bsam yod do ’ zhes smras pa ltar ro//nā pho lun pham par brgyab rjes kyi yo rob gnas bab de/ me thi nye la mtshon nas bshad na ha cang bag yangs pa zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ u ru sis po lan (201thas6 7༅)sger bzung byed brtsis dang / phu ro zis ci thub sgos sa khi so ne (3tha 0ba7rṣa༅ཿ)bdag thob byed brtsis 'chang ba dang / u phu phan tshun bsdongs te o si khri ri ya'i khe phan la 'jigs snang ster bzhin yod/ stobs shugs kyi cha nas bshad na/ o si khri ri ya u ru si dang dbyin ji'i do zla mi yong / de bas/ me thi nye yis kho'i phyi 'brel gyi 'jon thang la brten nas 'gal 'du bed spyad de/ dbyin ji tshur 'gug pa dang / hpha ran si nyams rgud du chen por mi gtong ba'i sgo nas 8 stobs mnyam ’’srid jus lag tu bstar te/ rgyal chen stobs mnyam spel lo// dngos rgyud ring lugs kyi rtsa don ltar na/ we en na'i gros tshogs kyis yo rob kyi sa khongs bskyar bgos byas shing / rgyal rabs rnying ba'i sgrig srol rnying ba slar gso byas/ snga dus kyi mnga' bdag re re bzhin slar yang gzab chas spras te khri khar 'khod/hpha ran si'i lu'e zi bcu drug pa'i nu bo rgyal por bsdad de lu'e zi bco brgyad par bos pa dang / hpher ti nan bdun pas (kha0761sathas6 5 ༅7lo tsho)kyang si phen gyi rgyal po'i go 'phang slar gso byas la/ por pon rgyal rgyud 135

rnams kyang nāb le si (ma89/03 4lo7༅)dang si ze le (510117 loyotsho)yi rgyal po'i khri la 'khod pa dang / chos rgyal gyis kyang yang bskyar i ṭa li'i dbus khul gyi rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur ba dang / 'jar man gyi mna' 'brel rgyal phran gyi rje bo rnams kyang sngon chad kyi gzi zil slar gso byas/'jar man gyis mna' 'brel rgyal phran bco brgyad btsugs te/ 'jar man mna' 'brel rgyal khab btsugs/ phu ro zi'i ho hen tso len (50kho02201101baṣṭhastorsākhya)rgyal rabs kyis mnga' khongs rgya cher bskyed mod/ 'on kyang o si khri ri ya yis phu ro zi de 'jar man mna' 'brel rgyab khab khrod mgo cher 'bur du mi 'jug u ru si ni po lan ḍi'i mnga' khongs che shos bzung zhing /phu ro zi la sa khi so ne yi lnga cha'i gnyis thob/ o si khri ri ya yis po lan ḍi'i mnga' khongs kyi ka li zhi ya (071013 ’khyatsho.o༅)sor 'dzin dang / i ṭa li'i byang khul gyi lom pa ti(/0468nga67 khya༅ṭha )/ dang we ni se (50 100 tsho༅lo)sogs sa khul thob/ hpha ran si 1792lo'i sngon gyi mnga' khongs kyi tshad du slar gso byas pa sogs lta bu'o// u ru si la dge kha thob mod/ 'on kyang stobs shugs je drag tu chen por ma song ba dang / g.yul pham pa'i hpha ran si la chad gcod byas mod/ 'on kyang de'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su chen po ma btang la/ 'jar man mna' 'brel rgyal khab tu gyur mod/ 'on kyang de la stobs ldan gyi krung dbyang srid dbang ldan du mi 'jug la/ phu ro zi yang de'i khrod kyi mna' 'brel rgyal khab cig tsam yin pa dang / i ṭa li sngar mus bzhin kha thor yin pas/ o si khri ri yas don dngos thog i ṭa li'i sa khul mang che shos dbang du sgyur bzhin yod/ yo rob kyi mnga' bdag che chung tshor rang rang la 'thob bya thob pas/ dga' spro ches cher rgyas zhes ma brjod kyang /nyung mthar yang mang che shos yid tshim pa byung ngo // 136

we en na'i gros tshogs kyis btsugs pa'i sgrig srol de dag srung skyob byed ched/ 1815lozla 9tshes 26nyin/ zar rgyal e leg zan ter gyis gros mgo bslangs te 66bla med mna' mthun ’ zhes pa btsugs/ u ru si dang /phu ro zi/ o si khri ri ya de'i khrod zhugs la/ phyis su yo rob kyi mnga' bdag rgyal khab mang shos zhugs par gyur/ e leg zan ter gyis ye shu'i chos lugs kyi gdams pa dar spel btang ste/ 64bla na med pa'i ’ mnga' bdag rnams phan tshun rogs skyor gyis thun mong gi sgo nas ‘6bla na med pa'i ’ bkas bkod sgrig gzhi srung skyob byed rgyu'i re ba bton/ ‘4bla med mna' mthun ’ de yang bla na med pa zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ chos rgyal der ma zhugs la/ dbyin jis snang chung byed cing / me thi nye yis mthong chung byas te/ de ni 88nang don ci yang med pa'i 'bod pa skad gsang mthon po tsam zhig las ma 'das ’ par 'dod/ me thi nye yis mthong chen byed pa ni lo de'i zla 11par btsugs pa'i u ru si dang / dbyin ji/ phu ro zi/ o si khri ri ya bcas kyi 8 rgyal khab bzhi'i mna' 'brel ’ yin/ mna' 'brel chings yig tu/ rgyal khab bzhi bos sems thag rbad chod kyis drag dpung la brten nas we en na'i gros tshogs kyi chod don rabs dang rim pa srung skyong byed rgyu'i thag bcad yod/ 8 rgyal khab bzhi'i mna' 'brel ’ de don dngos thog ‘ bla na med pa'i mna' mthun ’ gyi kha gsab tu gyur yod/ de nas bzung / me thi nye ni gong smras rtsa 'dzugs kyi bla srog tu gyur zhing / ‘8gsar brje'i me lce gsod pa'i me skyon 'gog srung ru dpon ’ du gyur ro// me thi nye yis lo rgyus kyi dus tshod phyir bskor rgyu'i stong bsam bcang nas/rags chen po re re bskrun te dus rabs kyi rlabs rgyun mdun du 'phyo ba 'gog ci thub byas/ 'on kyang 'jar man mi rigs dang / i ṭa li'i mi dmangs/137

si la hphu (31373 ༅4rsā)yi mi rigs so sos gcig gyur gyi re ba bton zhing /rgyal khab so sos rang btsan byed rgyu'i re ba 'don pa dang / rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi dmangs gtsor re ba'i gsar brje'i drag rlabs ni 'gog gnon byed du med pa zhig yin/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo las rgyun chad med par dar 'phel byung ba dang bstun nas gsar brje'i drag rlabs de phyi phyir shugs drag tu gyur/ 1830lo'i hpha ran si'i gsar brje dang / 1831lo'i po lan ḍi'i 'os langs tshang mas ru bla med mna' mthun ’ 'thor zhig tu gtong gin yod/ mjug mthar 1848lo'i yo rob gsar brje yis we en na'i gros tshogs kyis btsugs pa'i sgrig srol rnying ba yongs su gtor ro//

bco lnga pa/ zar rgyal gnyis/zar rgyal zhes pa ni u ru si'i rgyal po la 'bod pa'i ming zhig yin/ u ru si'i skad kyi 88zar rgyal’ (0731 ༅/ ༅)zhes pa de gna' bo'i rom gyi rgyal po'i go ming ‘ khe zar’ (93033smotsho7)zhes pa las sgra 'gyur byung ba zhig yin te/ rgyal po'i don yin/ zar rgyal dang po ni dus rabs bcu drug pa'i skabs kyi e wan bzhi pa/ (173ba sa kyil〉kyi.ashu/)yin la/ kho'i sngar gyi go ming ni mo si kho gung rim pa'i rgyal khab kyi gung chen (mengatus)yin/ u ru si rgyal khab ni mo si kho gung rgyal gyi rmang gzhi'i steng dar 'phel byung ba zhig yin/nye rabs lo rgyus thog u ru si la phyi rgya bskyed pa'i ham sems shin tu che ba'i zar rgyal gnyis byung yod de/ gcig ni phe ther dang po (20 0 1 ṣṭha2ñtsa—tshozhes pa'am20 07’ 60 0108 lo42snyo14lo1zhes pa'o//)yin la/ gzhan zhig ni ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa yin/ phe ther dang pos srid 'dzin skabs/ phal cher krung go'i ching rgyal rabs kyi khang zhi'i (blangakhraX)skabs yin la/ ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pas srid 'dzin skabs/ krung go'i chan lung (sgo'itshokhyi)gi skabs yin/phe ther dang po dang ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa gnyis dzir u ru si'i sku drag gis rgyal chen zhes 'bod cing / kho tshos bya spyod kyis u ru si la shugs rkyen gting zab mo thebs yod/ phe ther dang po ni 1672lor skyes shing / 1682lo kho dang pha gcig la ma mi gcig pa'i phu bo e wan lnga pa dus mtshungs su zar rgyal yin par bsgrags/ phe ther skabs der rang lo 10tsam yin la/ e wan yang nar son 139

med/ rgyal po gnyis chabs cig tu bzhugs khri gnyis can gyi rgyal khrir 'khod de zhi drag blon chen rnams kyis mjal zhu byed pa ni shin tu dgod bro ba zhig yin/ de ni rgyal po'i nye 'brel gyi chab srid tshogs khag mi 'dra bas 'gal rtsod byas pa'i mjug 'bras shig red/ rgyal po chung chung gnyis ni phyi tshul tsam yin la/ don dngos kyi dbang cha ni kho tsho'i a ce sras mo zo hphe ya (077thalam0ma0༅7 'ilkolko༅ asto/1ma7lorke7)yi lag tu bzung yod/ e wan gyi mig dbang rgyang sgrib tshabs chen po yod la/ col chung klad med kyi nyams shar ba zhig yin la/ phe ther ni skye gzugs legs la gson nyams ldan pa zhig yin/1689lor/ phe ther rang lo 17la son pa na/ a mas kho la btsun mo zhig bsus te/ na tshod dar la babs pa mtshon/ skabs der/ khos mu mthud gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i gnas babs de 'dra bzod thabs bral nas/rgyal spun e wan la 'phrin yig btang ste/ ‘6rgyal po/ nga tsho dar la babs skabs kyang / ngo tsha med pa des rgyal srid bdag tu bzung ste nga tsho logs su 'god pa 'di ni nongs pa ya med cig red ’ ces bshad/ sras mo zo hphe ya yis kyang phe ther gyi bya spyod la blo shin tu ma bde bas/ srid 'gyur bslang ste kho med pa bzo rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ phe ther gyis kho'i byis dus kyi dmag don rtsed mtshar las dar 'phel byung ba'i ‘6rtsed dmag ’ ste/ dngos skyong dmag dpung der brten nas sras mo'i lkog g.yo rdul du brlags la/ kho mo dge sgrub khang zhig tu btson 'jug byas/ de nas bzung phe ther gyis dbang cha dngos su bzung zhing / shes rab dman pa'i rgyal spun des mu mthud du phyi tshul tsam bstan/ lo ngo mang po ma 'gyangaca/ par e wan tshe las 'das/phe ther dang po ni u ru si'i lo rgyus steng gsar phyogs kyi bcos sgyur pa 140

zhig yin/ dus rabs 17pa'i mjug dang dus rabs 18pa'i mgor/ u ru si ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi rgyal khab cig yin zhing /bzo zhing thon skyed dang / tshan rig lag rtsal/ rig gnas slob gso gang thad nas kyang nub gling gi rgyal khab gzhan dag las rjes lus shig yin/ rjes lus kyi rnam pa de las thar ched/ khos bcos bsgyur byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ bcos bsgyur bya dgos na sngon thon la slob sbyong byed dgos/ de bas/khos 'bor che ba'i mtho rim pho nya rgyal phyir 'tshams 'drir mngags te/ nub gling ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab kyi tshan rig lag rtsal dang rig gnas slob gso/chab srid lam lugs sngon thon can sogs la yul dngos mar phebs nas rtog dpyod byed du bcug pho nya'i tshogs par nyen srung dang / 'khor g.yog sogs khyon mi grangs nyis brgya dang lnga bcu yod/ pho nya'i tshogs pa de'i ming thog gi mgo 'dzin pa gtso bo ni ming la hphe le chub thi (0 5 lo'adze༅lko kro//rsālo sgo)zhes pa'i si we tser lan mi zhig yin la/ de ni phe ther chung dus dmag rtsed byed grogs shig yin/ mgo 'dzin gnyis pa ni u ru si'i tshab byas te krung go dang gros mol byas la 〈〈ne pu khri chings yig 〉〉'god mkhan ko lo pun (0༄'a09 sam0nga0ཿ755 ༅0ma0tha5 lothang)zhes pa de yin/ kho ni phe ther gyi phyi 'brel pa yin la/ phe ther gyi bka' bkod lag tu bstar mkhan gyi mgo 'dzin dngos ma yin/ phe ther rang nyid ming la me he nye lo hphu (ba019yopo5'ipoya02ཿloṣālkoza)zhes btags te tshogs mi phal ba zhig tu byas nas lhan du song / pho nya'i tshogs pa lam la chas skabs dpung khag rgya che zhing /chibs pa dang dngos po skyel 'dren byed spyad gangs gru stong phrag lhag yod/pho nya'i tshogs pa de gtso bo skabs der sngon thon yin pa'i mtsho thog gi rgyal khab stobs ldan ho lan ḍi dang / dbyin ji la song ste lta rtogaslob sbyong 141

byas/ phe ther gyis ho lan ḍi ru slebs skabs gru gzings bzo grwar song nas gru'i sgrig gzhi dang ris dbyibs 'god pa'i rig par slob sbyong byas/ khos phyi rgyal du slob gnyer byed mkhan dag dang lhan du gru gzings bzo grwar ngal rtsol byas nas dar shing gsum can gyi mtsho skor dmag gru bzos la/ spro bag gis rang gi lag par ngal rtsol gyis btod pa'i lba ba de gzhan la ston par byed/phe ther gyi dge rgan gyis kho la mthar phyin 'dzin yig ster skabs/ kho ni 8 brtson gnyer che zhing rnam rig rgod pa'i shing bzo ’ zhig red ces bshad myong / khos gru bzo'i lag rtsal slob pa las gzhan/ da dung gang sar song ste bya 'gul spel/ ho lan ḍi'i dmag don sbyang ston la ltad gzigs dang /gshags bcos khang du ltad gzigs byas par ma zad/ tha na btson mar srog khrims gcod par yang bltas/ dbyin jir 'byor rjes/ khos tshim pa med pa'i sgo nas khor yug gi don gsar mtshar sna tshogs la lta rtog byas/ chu tshod 'khor lo sgrig gtor byed sa'i lag rtsal slob sbyong dang / ki ren wi thri (0 ཿba4106pho.oṃ7tsho)yi gnam dpyad stegs bu dang sgor mo bzo grwa la ltad gzigs/ spyi tshogs steng gi mi grags can la mjal 'phrad byas/ go thos ltar na khos tshan rig pa grags can nye'u thon la'ang mjal 'phrad byed myong /dbyin ji'i gros tshogs la ltad gzigs byed skabs/ kho gros tshogs tshoms chen du 'gro ma 'dod par tshoms chen gyi klad du bud de skar khung las gros tshogs 'tshogs pa'i ngang tshul la bltas/ phe ther gyis dbyin jir gru bzo'i gzhung lugs la gtso bor sbyangs te/ rgyu mtshan ni ho lan ḍi nas gru bzo'i lag rtsal la sbyangs zin pas so//pho nya'i tshogs pa dbyin jir zla bzhi lhag bsdad de/ phyir lam ho lan ḍi ruyog nas o si khri ri ya brgyud de i ṭa lir 'gro rtsis byas/ 'on kyang lam 142

skabs su rgyal nang du 6‘srung dmag ’ gyen log byas tshul thos pas de ma nyid du 'tshams 'dri mtshams bzhag ste mgyogs myur ngang phyir log ltad gzigs tshogs pa de 1697lo'i zla 3par lam la chas pa nas/ 1698lo'i zla 8par mo si kho ru 'byor reg bar ha lam lo gcig dang phyed ka song /phe ther dang po rgyal nang du bslebs rjes mgyogs myur sgos mi rnams ha las su 'jug pa'i don chen gnyis bsgrubs/ don dang po ni gyen log pa la chad pa ya nga ba bcad/ khos bka' phab nas gyen log tu zhugs pa'i 64srung dmag nya chig stong lhag po tshang ma bzung zhing / de dag las mi bdun brgya dang go dgu srog khrims la sbyar zhing / lo bcu bzhi nas nyi shu'i bar gyi na gzhon kho na srog thar btang / mo si kho skabs shig ring khrag dri 'thul le ba byung / mi mang po zhig ni ske bcad pa'am yang na 'khor los mnan pa/ yang na rta pho bzhir lus gshags su bcug ste bsad pa yin la/ bem po khrom ston byas pa la zla ngo 'gar do bdag byed mkhan ma byung / bshad tshul ltar na gyen log ni sras mo zo hphe ya dang 'brel ba yod pas/ phe ther rang ngos nas mi khrid de dge sgrub khang du song nas sras mor 'dri rtog byas/ zo hphe ya yang gshis ka rgod po can zhig yin pas gtan nas ngos len ma byas/ phe ther gyis bem po gsum sras mo'i sge'u khung gi phyi rol tu nyin zhag gsum la dpyang ste bzhagadon gnyis pa ni sma ra breg pa ste/ phe ther phyir 'byor rjes gzhis ku'i bdag po dang sku drag rgyal rgyud blon chen rnams rten 'brel zhu ru yong / phe ther gyis khe gri bzung ste kho tsho'i gam du song nas de dag gi sma ra brjid po rnams re re bzhin bregs/ skabs der u ru si'i skyes pa rnams kyis sma ra stug po 'jog pa ni gzi brjid dang zil shugs kyi mtshon byed du lta la/ sma ra 'breg pa ni mi chos dang 'gal ba chen po zhig tu brtsi/ phe ther gyis rgyal rgyud blon 143

chen gyi sma ra bregs par ma zad/ sma ra 'jog mkhan gyis nges par du sma ra'i khral 'jal dgos pa khyab bsgrags byas/ sma ra bregs pa de ni phe ther gyis nub gling la slob sbyong byed rgyu'i chod sems dang / bcos sgyur byed rgyu'i sngon brda red/ phe ther gyi bcos bsgyur de chab srid dang dmag don/ dpal 'byor/rigaganas slob gso sogs phyogs mang por rag las yod/ chab srid kyi cha nas/ khos rgyal khab kyi las khungs bskyar sgrig byas te krung dbyang gi dbang cha gcig sdud la shugs snon byas shing / zar rgyal gyis bsko bzhag byas pa'i lte gnad las khungs 'dzugs rgyu khyab bsgrags byas/ krung dbyang gis gling dgu btsugs pa re rer phyogs so so'i las don la 'gan len byed du bcug de'i khrod kyi phyi 'brel gling dang skam dmag gling / mtsho dmag gling ni gling gtso bo gsum yin/ khos srid 'dzin gyi khul chen po brgyad btsugs shing / de'i gsham du zhing chen btsugs la/ zhing chen gyi gtso 'dzin ni zar rgyar gyis thad kur du bsko bzhag byed/ khos chos lugs las don do dam rtsa tshig bkramam shing / chos lugs do dam las khungs btsugs te chos tshogs zar rgyal gyi lag char 'gyur du bcug khos da dung 64dpon rim re'u mig ’ bkrams te sku drag rnams rigs rgyud mtho ba'i rkyen gyis dpon gnas mthon po dang phogs dngul mang po thob pa'i khyad dbang med par byas pa dang / khyim rgyud kyi tshod 'dzin gtor te byas rjes ltar dpon thob dang phogs dngul ster rgyu byas/ phe ther dang lhan du gru gzings bzo rtsal sbyangs pa'i men zhi khu hphu (sa1050'i༅'a9spro'is༅10bamangayo0g.yam502ma7kṣa rsā)yis gzhon nu'i dus su srang nas sha bag leb btsong myong la/ rta rdzi'ang byed myong la/ de phyis su kho'i skam dmag gi dmag spyir gyur ro//14

dpal 'byor thad/ khos bzo grwa btsugs shing / nyo tshong la skul lcag byas la/ phyi rgyal gyi tshan rig lag rtsal mi sna 'dren bsdu byas/ khos mi 'bor spyi bsdoms byas te mi grangs ltar khral bsdus nas rgyal mdzod yong 'bab 'phar snon btang / dmag don steng / dmag bsdu'i lam lugs lag tu bstar zhing / tshad ldan dmag dpung btsugs pa dang / skam dmag 'dzugs pa'i dus mtshungs su mtsho dmag 'dzugs pa la'ang mthong chen khyad par ba byas te/ gru dpung nus ldan zhig btsugs/ khos rnam pa gsar ba'i dmag gi slob grwa btsugs nas dmag don rkang 'dzin pa skyed bsring byas/ rig gnas slob gso'i thad/ khos slob grwa btsugs shing / phyi rgyal du slob gnyer byed mkhan slob ma mngags gtong byas pa dang / u ru si'i yi ge'i phyi mo sla bder bzos pa dang / par skrun la legs bcos byas shing / nub gling gi gsung rtsom bsgyur pa dang / tshags par par bskrun byas shing / tshan rig gling dang sman khang / gar khang sogs btsugs so//'phrod sten dang gnyen don/ 'das don la'ang khos snang 'jog byed/srang lam gad bdar byed pa'i dus tshod gtan 'khel byas pa dang / shing rtsa chen gyis dur sgam bzo ba bkag cing / bka' rgya bkram ste pha mas btsan thabs kyis ‘6'dod mos dang 'gal ba'i gnyen sdeb ’ mi chog par byas/ phe ther rang nyid kyi gnyen don ni srol rgyun gyi khyim rgyud mthun par gnyen sdeb pa la ngo rgol byas pa zhig yin te/ sngar smras zin pa ltar/ phe ther lo 17skabs kho'i a mas dbang bzung ste kho la chung ma zhig bslangs pa de la phe ther brtse dung med pas/ kho phyi rgyal nas phyir log rjes bza' 'thor byas/ 1703lor phe ther gyis men zhi khu hphu'i khyim du bran mo byed pa'i bud med btson ma zhig ngo shes la/ de'i ming la ye kha thi ren nā zer/ las skal gyis rgyal po zhig dang 145

bran mo'am bud med btson ma zhig lhan du sbrel bar gyur/ kho gnyis thog mar mnyam sdod byas la/ byi phrug bu mo zhig skyes/ 1712lor/ phe ther gyis srol rgyun gyi 'gog shugs sna tshogs khyad du bsal nas/ ye kha thi ren nā dang dngos su khyo shug tu bsgrigs/ 1724lo'i zla 5par/ phe ther gyis gzab rgyas che ba'i cho ga spel te rang dngos kyis rgyal po'i cod pan chung ma'i dbur bsgos/de'i sngon du/ 1718lor phe ther gyis bka' bsgrags te rgyal sras la rgyal khri'i rgyud 'dzin dbang med par bsgrags pa ma zad/ srog khrims kyang bcad/rgyalasras kyis kho'i bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byas pa'i rkyen gyis kho'i las don rgyun 'dzin byed mi nus la/ bu de ni zhabs 'dren bu phrug cig yin par bsams so phe ther dang po yis nang khul du bcos bsgyur sna tshogs byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ phyi phyogs su 'thab mo rabs dang rim pa bslangs/ kho ni dmag zhen che zhing g.yul 'khrug la sun pa med pa zhig yin/ khos srid bskyangs pa'i lo ngo so lnga'i nang lho 'dul byang 'thab 'ba' zhig byas shing / mtha' ma'i lo ngo gcig pu kho na la da gzod phyi phyogs su g.yul 'khrug ma bslangs/ der ma zad/ khos rgyun par rang dngos su dmag mi dang lhan du g.yul gyi gdong sner 'gro zhing / mi rnams kyis kho la 66dmag spyi chung ba ’ dang 8 dmag spyi bar ma ’’sogs su bos na shin tu spro/‘4u ru si la dgos pa ni chu'i khul yin ’ zhes pa'i tshig 'di ni phe ther dang po'i bsrung bya'i gdams ngag yin/ khos u ru si la mtsho bskyod 'jug ngogs 'thob par bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ lho phyogs su/ 1695lo dang 1696lor snga phyir thengs gnyis la tur ki dang g.yul sprad mod/ 'on kyang mtsho nag (21ཿkhu 30tha zalo)gi 'jug ngogs len ma thub/ byang phyogs su/146

ye kha thi den nā gnyis pa zhes zer ro//ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa ni chab srid kyi lag thabs la mkhas pa zhig yin/kho mos rgyal khri sra brtan yong dgos na sku drag gi mos gus thob dgos pa shes pas/ thog mar rgyal khab la dbang ba'i bran g.yog khri phrag bco lnga kho mo khri khar 'god par byas rjes yod pa'i blon po dang sku drag la gnang bgos byas shing /phyis su yang rgyun du gsol ras bstsal/ kho mos khri bzung ba'i lo ngo so bzhi'i ring khyon bran g.yog khri brgyad cu gsol ras su bstsal/ kho mos rbad chod kyis zhing bran bdag po'i khe phan la srung skyob dang / zhing bran gyis srid gzhung la zhu gtug byed par bkag 'gog byas/ 1773lor/ u ru sir phu ca cho hphu (༅504mab 7cha'i507༅5 ba5ba'i507 rsā70lkoza)yis 'go khrid pa'i zhing bran gyi 'os langs byung la/ kho mos dmag mngags te drag gnon byas/ kho mos kyang bzo tshong la bya dga' ster ba'i srid jus lag tu bstar/ phe ther rgyal chen gyi skabs su u ru si la bzo grwa nyis brgya dang so gsum yod la/ ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa 'das khar sum stong chig brgya re gcig la 'phar snon byung yod/zar rgyal gyi sger gcod ring lugs la shugs snon rgyag pa'i dus mtshungs su/ kho mos 8 mnga' bdag blo dkyil can ’ gyi tshul gyis mi sems 'gug thabs byas/ kho mos wol ther dang 'phrin 'brel btsungs shing / ti te rod kyi nyar dpe gong mthon po byin nas nyos par ma zad/ ti te rod phe ther pog la gdan 'dren byas pa sogs lta bu yin/yin na'ang blo bskyed ring lugs pa'i bsam blo'i me lce yis hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i me klong mched par gyur pa'i skabs su/ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pas khro rngam 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas hpha ran si'i gsar brje pa ni 8 smyon pa dang 'chal po ’ skor zhig yin par dmod pa dang /149

dmag chen btegs te drag gnon byed pa'i 'jigs skul btang /phyi phyogs srid jus thad/ ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pas phe ther gnyis pa'i phyi rgya bskyed pa'i las don rgyun 'dzin byas shing / ham sems chen po'i sgo nas 64gal te kho mo lo nyis brgya la 'tsho thub pa byung na/ yo rob hril bo u ru si'i dbang 'og tu bsdu nges yin nya zhes dang / ‘ tur ki pa yo rob nas phyir 'bud ma btang ba dang / krung go'i khengs pa ma bcom pa/ rgya gar dang tshong 'brel ma btsugs na/ kho mo shi yang mig zum par mi 'gyur nya zhes brjod myong / kho mos thengs gnyis la tur ki dang g.yul bkyes ①la/ thengs gnyis la tur ki pham du bcug nas/ khi le me'u (596a ma༅ཿ༅)bdag tu bzung zhing / mtsho nag 'jug ngogs kyi rgyu lam mnga' 'og tu bkod/ kho mo'i mnyam 'brel pa phu o rgyal khab gnyis dang thengs gsum ④la po lan ḍi bgo bsha' byas te/ po lan ḍi dus yun shin tu ring bo zhig nang rgyal khab stongs par gyur pa'i sdug bsngal la sbyar/ po lan ḍi thengs gsum la bgo skabs tshang mar/ ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa ni gte bo yin la/ kho mor thob pa'i sa cha de phu o rgyal khab gnyis kyi spyi bsdoms las kyang mang po yod/1796lor ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pas ham sems chen po'i sgo nas yang bskyar don chen zhig bgyi grabs byed sgang du glo bur gza' nad phog ste 'das/kho mo ma shi ba'i sngon la rang nyid la dur byang bris te/ rang nyid kyi gtum spyod dang bzang rdzu'i ngo gdong sbed gang thub byas/ dur byang du gsham ltar bris yod de/7(kye 1768lo dang 1787lo/(3 1772lo dang / 1793lo/ 1795lo/ 150

ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa 'dir gtan du gzim yod/kho mo 174lor u ru sir phebs te/ phe ther gsum pa dang khyo shug tu bsgrigs/rangaglo 14skabs/ kho mos chod sems gsum bcad de/ khyo ga'i dga' mos thob pa dang / e li dza pi spro ru 'jug pa/ rgyal yongs yid tshim par byed pa bcas so/dmigs 'ben de'i slad du/ kho mos dka' spyad sdug rus las le lo sgyid lug gtan nasabyed ma myong / kho mos dpe tshogs rgya cher bklags te lo ngo 18gyi kher skyo'i nam zla 'gro thabs byas/ kho mo u ru si'i rgyal khrir 'khod rjes/ blon 'bangs kyi bde skyid dang rangadabang / dar rgyas kyi ched du rang nus rtsal 'don byas/ kho mo ni/ blo dkyil che zhing mi la byams/ kho mo ni/ mnga' zhabs la bzod sems che la/ gshis rgyud drang zhing sems bag yangs pa dang / spyi mthun la mos shing sems rgyud bzang / kho mo la/dam pa'i grogs kyis khyim gang zhing rgyal kha'i grogs po sprin bzhin 'du/ kho mo ni/ las la spro zhing / 'brel 'dris la mos pa dang / sgyu rtsal la dga' 'o/ zhes so/'di ni rnyed dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi zur za'i dgod gtam zhig yin mod/'on kyang zhib tu bsams na/ kho mos snga mo zhig nas dbang cha 'phrog rgyu'i ham sems khog tu bcug yod pa tshor thub bo//yokha thi ren nā gnyis pa la bu gcig skye myong ste/ de ni po lo dang po (batha༅ma 1 kṣatha—tsho)yin/ kho mo gson pa'i skabs su tsha bo dang po la 'dang rtsis che/ tsha bo der kho mo'i shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod pas/ khos phyis su rmo mor lad mo byas te/ u ru si'i sku drag dang srung dmag gi 'go par lkog 'brel byas nas rang nyid kyi pha rgyal po po lo dang po bsad de pha'i bem por 'gom bzhin rgyal khrir 'khod la/ kho ni e leg zan ter dang po yin no//phyi phyogs 'brel ba'i thad nas/ e leg zan ter dang pos me thi nye dang mnyam 'brel gyis nā pho lun pham par brgyab cing / bla med mna' mthun rtsa 'dzugs byas pas/ yo rob kyi chab srid gar stegs su dus skabs shig nang 151
skad grags che ba'i mi sna zhig tu gyur ro//

bcu drug pa/ la ting a me' khalangs su btums pa'i rlung 'tshub cigami'i rigs kyi lo rgyus dus rabs 19pa'i sgo them du slebs skabs/ la ting a me ri kha (la ting me gling / 23 1ba 0 103 71rsā nyasko)ru rang btsan brtson len gyi gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub cig langs par gyur/ de'i yar sngon gyi lo ngo sum brgya'i ring / yo rob kyi mi rgyud dkar pos a me ri kha dkyil ma dang lho ma gom pa re re bzhin me ser spel yul du bsgyur/ la ting a me ri kha zhes pa'i ming 'di la'ang mi ser spel ba'i lo rgyus kyi rjes shul bkod yod de/kho lum pu yis skam sa chen po gsar rnyed byung rjes su/ gong smros kyi sa khul rnams si phen dang phor ju snyal gyi mi ser spel yul du gyur la/ kho tsho la ting mi rgyud la gtogs shing skad cha yang la ting skad khongs su gtogs pas/ a me ri kha'i dkyil khul dang lho khul la mi rnams kyis la ting a me ri kha ste la ting me gling zer/ la ting me gling gi sa khul mang che shos sngar si phen gyi mi ser spel yul yin la/ phor ju ghal gyis bhar dzil bzung yod/ lo ngo sum brgya'i ring gi mi ser spel ba'i dbangadasgyur skabs su/ si phen gyis la me nas ha lam gser spyi rgya khri nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / dngul spyi rgya dung phyur gcig khyer zhing /phor ju ghal gyis bhar dzil nas a sgor dung phyur drug ri ba'i gser dang / a sgor dung phyur gsum ribo'i rdo rje pha lam khyer/ kho pa tshos la me'i mi dmangs la bzhag pa ni gnod 'tshe dang bran bkol yin/ spyi tshogs kyi ches dma' sar mnan yod pa ni mi nag dang dbyin ti an pa yin la/ de'i gong ma ni mi rgyud 153

'dres ma dang / de'i gong ma ni yul skyes kyi mi rgyud dkar po yin/ dbang sgyur gyi go gnas 'dzin mkhan ni yo rob kyi bdag dbang can gyi rgyal khab nas yong ba'i ‘8mtho rim mi rgyud dkar po nya nyung shos yin zhing / de la 66gling phran phyed ma'i mi ’nyaru 'bod de/ rgyu mtshan ni si phen dang phor ju ghal ni yo rob kyi phi re nye'u si (21 1 003 6671༅7)gling phran phyed mar gnas pas so//si phen gyis mi ser spel yul gyi mi grangs khri phrag chig stong drug brgya lhag nang /8 gling phran phyed ma'i mi ’ yis khri sum cu tsam las zin med la/ de hpha ran si'i rim pa dang po dang gnyis par mtshungs/ kho tshos mi nag dang dbyin ti an pa/ mi rgyud 'dres ma la bran bkol byas par ma zad/ da dung yul skyes kyi mi rgyud dkar po la'ang mthong chung dang khyad gsod byas/ de bas/ mi rigs rang btsan brtson len byed pa ni skabs der mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyi thun mong gi dmigs 'ben du gyur yod/la ting me gling gi gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub de thog mar he khri nas langs /pa yin/ he khri ni nyin rdu gling tshom nub khul gyi sang tho to ming ko gling phran gyi nub khul du mchis la/ mi grangs khri lnga bcu nga gsum dang stong phrag drug gi khrod du/ mi nag gis khri bzhi bcu zhe brgyad zin yod/ he khri ni ma gzhir si phen gyi mi ser spel yul yin mod/ phyis su hpha ran ser bcad/ he khri'i gsar brje la 'go 'khrid mkhan ni mi nag to zin (tha 3sa0013 00 1ba1950103381ba ༈14)zhes pa de yin/to zin gyi pha ma ni bran nag yin pas/ khos chung dus nas bran g.yog gi dka' sdug myangs/ kho bran g.yog gi go babs la sems gting nas mi mos pas hur brtson gyis slob sbyong byas la/ hpha ran si'i blo skyed bsam blo ba'i shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod/ khos (lhorang dbang de da gzod 'jig rten 154

thog gi ches rin thang ldan pa'i 'byor ba yin nya zhes bshad/ hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i rjes su/ he khri'i bran nag gis 'os langs byas la/ to zin gyis bdag po'i gzhis ka bsregs te rogs pa tsho khrid nas gsar brjer zhugs/ kho g.yul ngor dpa' bas/ snga gzhug thengs nyi shu la rmas phog cing /mdun so gnyis kyang mdel gyis gtor yod/ kho dpa' snying che bar ma zad jus thabs kyang shin tu ldan/ hpha ran si'i mi ser spel ba'i dmag gi spyi khyab pas kyang 8 to zin zhes pa'i gte bo 'dis gang sa gang nas kyang sa zin yong ’ zhes bshad do// phyis su to zin la mi rnams kyis 88to zin lo'u wer thur’ (1053grab ༅30007 5 0ṣṭhaza ṇatram̐khri ཿlo)zhes 'bod par gyur ro// 88lo'u wer thur ’ zhes pa la hpha ran si'i skad nang ‘ gsar gtod nya dang 64gsar 'byed mi kyi don dang ldan/ to zin gyis hpha dmag pham par rgyag skabs su/si phen dang dbyin ji skabs glags dang bstun nas 'dzul yong la/ khos kho pa tsho'i chab srid dang dmag don gyi lkog g.yo re re bzhin rdul du brlags la/1801lor he khri rang btsan byas pa khyab bsgrags byas so//1802lor/ nā pho lun gyis rang la g.yul ngor rgyal kha thob pa dang /yo rob kyi gnas babs ltos bcas kyis zhi 'jags yin pa'i go skabs spyad de/sring mo'i mag pa le khi ler khi (khuḥ1070 skya༅〉lom)la dmag gru nga bzhi dang / hrag dmag sum khri khrid du bcug nas btang ste slar yang rgol bar brtsams shing / le khi ler khi yis nā pho lun gyis to zin la springs pa'i mgo 'dogs rgyur skul ba'i 'phrin yig cig khyer song bar/ to zin gyis tshig thag chod pa'i sgo nas ‘8he khri ci'i phyir rang btsan byed mi rung / a ri rang btsan byas zin pa ma yin nam ’ zhes smras/ le khi ler khi yis 'jigs skul dang bslu brid gang gis kyang ma nus pas gom gang mdun spos kyis lkog g.yo 155

bshams/ khos lag 'og gi dmag dpon zhig la to zin la 'phrin yig 'bri ru bcug ste/ zhi gros byed rgyu'i re ba bton zhing / ham zol che ba'i sgo nas ‘ khyod kyis kho bo las gzhung drang ba'i grogs po zhig rnyed mi thub ces g.yo gtam bshad pas/ to zin dogs zon med par hpha dmag gi dmag sgar du song ba na/ le khi ler khi yis g.yo bzung byas te hpha ran sir bskyal/ to zin gyis hpha ran si'i tshon mdangs gsum can gyi rgyal dar la lta bzhin 4khyod tsho'i dar cha ni kha dan rgyab skyur dang mi byed dgu byed byas pa'i ngo tsha sgrib yol las ma 'das ’ zhes smras/ 1803lor/ to zin hpha ran si'i btson khang du 'das/to zin 'das pa des gom gang mdun spos sgos he khri'i mi dmangs kyi mig dbang je gsal du btang / de'i rjes su he khri'i mi dmangs kyi mgo khrid nas mu mthud du 'thab rtsod byed mkhan ni skye khongs bran nag yin pa'i khu ri si tho hphe (50ba 1 06713 095015spri146tshe'u15)dang te sa lin na (103sa/tha09503ba033ma1 03mayorṣa/po)yin/ 1803lo'i zla 11par hpha dmag yongs su pham/zla 11pa'i tshes 29nyin he khri mi dmangs kyis 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉spel te dngos su rang btsan byas pa khyab bsgrags byas so// des rngam zil che ba'i sgo nas/ 66nga tshos gdod ma'i gzi brjid slar gso byas te/ nga tsho'i khe dbang srung skyob byas pa dang / nga tshos nga rang tsho'i khe dbang ni rgyal khab stobs ldan gang zhig la'ad mi bcol ba'i dam bca' bzhag ’ ces bsgrags so// he khri rang btsan byas rjes/ te sa lin na yis srid 'dzin dang po khur la/phyis su lkog gsod byas/ 1807lor khu ri si tho hphe yis tsung thung (9703160sa khyo po'i)khur zhing / 1811lor rtsa khrims la bcos bsgyur byas te he khri'i mi nag rgyal po byas so// khu ri si tho hphe la bkas bkod rgyal po'i dbang thang gi bsamablo shin tu tshabs chen 'dug mod/ 'on kyang mi ser spel ba'i btsan 156

/radzul la ngo rgol dang mes rgyal gyi rang btsan srung skyob byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing thad blo thag chod po yod do//he khri'i gsar brje'i rgyal kha yis la ting me gling gi rang btsan las 'gul la skul lcag chen po thebs shing / nā pho lun gyis si phen dang phor ju ghal la btsan 'dzul byas pa yis la me'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i bya 'gul la skul 'ded byas/ 1810lor bslebs pa na/ si phen la gtogs pa'i mi ser spel yul rgya chen po de'i gang sa gang du'ang rang btsan las 'gul langs/de'i khrod skad grags che ba'i 'go 'dzin mi sna ni me gil gyi tal ko (51rtsa501516martsa0 ཿcho7 ṣācalo༅ )dang / hphu ran se zi kho zhi me ran ta(khya7thab01༅0 5178sa6tha 76khyayomi1skyo / stso1 sna'u༅ca)/ zhi mong bho li lbir(bya146 8011 8 spyo1ṣṭhakhyi ma'ilko/tshe medo)/ jo ze ti san mar thin (/036 60byathas 3 1sayo༅ cho zobra1)bcas yod/1810lo'i zla 10par/ meg si ko yi rgyal gces mi sna rnams chos 'chad pa hi tal ko yi 'go khrid 'og gsang stabs kyis 'os langs kyi gra sgrig byas/ 'on kyang ngo log pas zhu gtug byas te gsang ba phyi gyar byung zhing dza drag shin tu che ba'i tshe/ hi tal ko yis 'phral thag chod pa'i sgo nas dus chad snga snur gyis 'os langs byas/ zla 9tshes 16nyin/ kho brel myur ngang chos khang du song ste/ mchod pa byed bzhin pa'i dbyin ti yan gyi mang tshogs rnams la 8 khyod tsho rang dbang gi mir 'gyur 'dod dam/ lo ngo sum brgya'i sngon la/sdang par 'os pa'i si phen gyi mis nga tsho'i mes po'i sa gzhi 'phrogs pa la/khyod tsho mos mthun yin nam ’ zhes brjod pa na/ mang tshogs khong khro 'bar gyin 66si phen gyi jag tshogs de dag ske gcod dgos ’ zhes bshad la/ hi tal ko yis skad gsang mthon pos 88me gling khri lor shog ’ ces bsgrags/ de ni 157

meg si ko yi lo rgyus steng skad du grags pa'i ru to lo re si'i 'bod sgra 7zhes pa de yin/ ‘8to lo re si’’ (00107ཿ ༅tshoṣṭha༅)zhes pa ni grong brdal zhig gi ming yin la/ hi tal ko ni chos khul de'i chos 'chad mkhan yin/ skabs der kho rang lo lnga bcu yol yod na'ang gsar brje'i snying stobs shin tu chen po yod/ kho'i 'go khrid kyi 'og tu 'os langs dmag mgyogs myur ngang mi grangs khri phrag brgyad lhag la bud cing / mkhar grong mang po zhig blangs/ 1811lo'i zla 3par/ hi tal ko ngo log pas g.yo 'tshong byanu'ipas zla 7par dgra bos bsad/ hi tal ko shi na'ang / ‘‘to lo re si'i 'bod sgra ’ de mi sems la zab mor zug yod/ 1821lor meg si ko rang btsan thub pa byung / 8 to lo re si'i 'bod sgra ’ bsgrags pa'i zla 9tshes 16nyin meg si ko'i rgya la ston gyi nyin mor gtan 'khel byas so// nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung gis si phen la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i gnas tshul de si phen la gtogs pa'i mi ser spel yul du thos par gyur skabs/ we ne dzu la (50ba022018 zol74)nas rang btsan las 'gul gyi dpal 'bar sgron par gyur to// 1810lo'i zla 4par/ rgyal sa kur ka si (08 4༄ me04mekhya46)yi grong mis mi ser spel ba'i srid dbang mgo rting slog ste lag bstar u yon lhan khang ste/ hon ṭha (15ba tha 7ོ)zhes pa btsugs/ hon ṭha yis bho li lbir dbyin jir pho nyar mngags shing / dbyin jir yul gyar ba'i la ting me gling gi gsar brje'i snga rabs pa me ran ta phyir mes rgyal du gdan drangs/1811lo'i zla 7par/ we ne dzu la 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉la gros mthun byung zhing / me ran ta gtso byas pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung btsugs/me ran ta ni we ne dzu la'i tshong pa zhig gi khyim du skyes shing / phyis su si 158

phen nas sku drag gi khyim rgyud yin pa'i bden dpang yi ge thob mod/ 'on kyang kho'i mi tshe gang bo'i bya spyod ni sku drag gral rim dang rgyab 'gal kho na yin/kho la hpha ran si'i blo skyed bsam blo ba'i shugs rkyen thebs shing / spro bag chen pos a ri rang btsan 'thab 'dzing la rgyab skyor byed myong la/ wa hrin thon dang ngo shes su gyur/ kho da dung hpha ran si'i gsar brjer zhugs myong la/g.yul 'thab khrod byas rjes rabs dang rim pa bzhag pas dmag dpon hra'o cang gi go sa thob pa dang / phyis su kho'i ming yig pha ri si'i rgyal kha'i sgo mo'i ( 0 60 11104960 lolko / ka)steng du'ang brkos/ 1806lor/ khos a ri nas gru dpung zhig khrid de a me ri kha lho mar bskyod nas/ mi dmangs la ‘ drag shul can mthar skrod pa dang / nga tsho'i lus la bcings pa'i lcags sgrog gtor ran song / lcags sgrog 'di ni si phen gyis nga tshor btsan gyis bcings pa zhig red nya’ces skul slong byas/ thog dang po'i rgyang skyod la mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi med pas 'bras med du gyur/ ring po ma 'gor bar thengs gnyis pa rtsa 'dzugs byas la de yang 'bras med du gyur/ yin na'ang kho yid ma zhum par sngar mus bzhin phyi rgyal du la me rang btsan kyi las 'gul spel/ we ne dzu la rang btsan byas par bsgrags pa'i skabs su/ kho lo na mthon po yod mod/'on kyang spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas mi rigs bcing 'grol gyi las don la rang lus phul/1812lo'i zla 3par/ rgyal sa kur ka si la sa yom chen po byung / si phen gyi chos spel bas bya 'gul sna tshogs spel te srid gzhung gsar ba slog ci thub byas/ bho li khrir sogs kyis me ran ta ngo log pa yin par dogs te kho btson du bcug phyis stabs ma legs par si phen gyi lag tu shor te yo rob tu brdzangs skyel byas shing / si phen gyi mis kho lcags thag gis mun btson gyi 159

gyang ngor btags/ 1816lo'i zla )tshes 14nyin/ kho si phen gyi btson khang du 'das la/ nyin de ni hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis pa si thil btson khang blangs pa'i nyi ma yin/ we ne dzu la spyi mthun rgyal khab mgo rting slog rjes su/ bho li khrir yang phyi rgyal du bros byol mi byed thabs med byung / 1813lor khos dmag dpung drangs nas phyir we ne dzu la ru log cing / kur ka si mgyogs myur ngang bcing grol btang ste/ we ne dzu la spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis pa btsugs/ 1814lor/spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis pa yang bskyar gtor/ 1816lo'i zla 12par/ khos he khri'i tsung thung gi rogs skyor 'og slar yang we ne dzu lar dmag drangs shing /thog mar ke ya na (6737thab cho༅smokhya)zhing chen bcing grol byas shing / spyi mthun rgyal khab gsum pa btsugs/ si phen gyi mi ser spel ba'i dmag dpung rtsa med du gtong ched/ thengs der khos dus bzhir gangs kyis bzung ba'i an ten si ( sa60thab3 za7lo)ri bo brgal te dgra bo'i nang snying gha re ne ḍa gsar ba (sa04 6 8ba368 locho༅wa ca ste/ deng skabs kyi ko lom bhi ya/)la dpung rgol bya rgyu dang / de nas slar we ne dzu la ru log rgyu'i sems thag bcad/an ten si ri bo brgal rjes/ 1819lo'i zla 8par/ khos dgra bos mi tshor bar byas te rgol thengs gcig gis po ku ta (60rtsa0 tha opong) blangs/182)lo'i zla 8par/ kta re ne ḍa gsar ba dang we ne dzu la yis ko lom bhi ya ( / 6 /1tshe'im32)spyi mthan rgyalakhabagrubacing sgolilbiragyisatsang/༷rwa(3 rte'u 1361 1/spro /bye/ ra pa / ra ri thung gi 'gan khur/ lo gnyis par/ we ne dzu la'i mnga' khongs hril bo bcing grol btang / skabs der bho li wir gyis tsung thung gi go gnas gzhan la sprad de rang nyid kyis dmag sna drangs nas lho ru bskyod/ 1822lor/ e kho khor1 ༵༵ ko lom bhi ya spyi mthun rgyal khab tu zhugs te/ ko lom bhi ya chen po
