grub/ lo de'i zla 7par/ bho li wir gyis e kho khor gyi kwa ya cel (0587la511lo༅lhu'ilo)du a me ri kha lho ma'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo gzhan zhig ste san mar thin la mjal 'phrad byas/ de'i rjes su/ bho li wir gyis mu mthud du pe ru la dpung 'jug byas/ pe ru stod ma rang btsan byas pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/bho li wir la dran gso bya ched rgyal khab kyi ming bho li wi ya (3011ma1 3 74lko1ཿkrokhru)zhes par gtan 'khel byas shing / mi rnams kyis kho la ‘8bcing 'grol mkhan nya dang ‘ a me ri kha lho ma'i wa hrin thon zhes bstod bsngags byed do//bho li wir gyis si phen la gtogs pa'i mi ser 4spel yul gyi byang khul du g.yul 'gyed byed skabs su/ san mar thin gyis kyang lho khul nas si phen gyi dmag dpung la g.yul sprad de khrab bskyur rmog dor du btang / san mar thin ni ar jen ḍi na ( 20ba 1ba3 ayo༅)ru skyes shing / pha ma gnyis ka si phen gyi mi yin/ kho lo drug gi skabs su pha ma dang lhan du ma ti rid (586116 6oṃ spri1)la spos shing / si phen gyi dmag gi slob grwa nas mthar phyin pa yin/ kho si phen mi dmangs kyis nā pho lun la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing du zhugs la/dpa' zhing g.yul la 'jon pas dmag dpon krung zho zhes par go gnas 'phar zhing / phyis su dmag tshogs kyi spyi khyab par bskos/ skabs der kho dmag dpung du a me ri kha lho ma'i skyes chen dam pa zhig dang ngo shes su gyur nas/ a me ri kha lho ma'i rang btsan 'thab 'dzing 'gag gnad kyi dus su yod pa rtogs par gyur/ 1812lor/ khos blo thag rbad chod kyis si phen dmag tshogs kyi spyi khyab pa'i go gnas mthon po bskyur te ar jen ḍi na la yong ste/ a me ri kha lho ma'i bcing 'grol las don la rang lus phul/1813lo'i zla 2par/ kho rang dngos kyis mda' thogs skya dmag ru khag la sbyong brdar dang 'go khrid byas te lo lun zi (zokhyazo)la dpung rgol byas shing 161

thog ma'i rgyal kha chen po blangs/ de'i rjes su/ khos slar yang si phen gyi spyi khyab kyis phyir rgol byas pa bstud mar pham pas/ byang khul dmag gi spyi khyab chen mor bskos so //san mar thin gyis bltas na/ ar jen ḍi na'i rgyal kha sra brtan du gtong dgos na/ nges par du byang skyod byas te an ten si ri bo brgal nas chi li bcing 'grol gtong ba dang / si phen gyi a me ri kha lho ma'i tshang rnying ste pe ru gtor bshig gtong dgos so// de bas/ khos spyi khyab dmag dpon gyi cod pan bskyur te byang khul du yong ste khu yo (0570 sgotram̐gi)zhing chen gyi dpon po byas shing / ‘ an ten si dmag ’ 'dzugs bskrun dang sbyong brdar byas/1817lo'i zla dang por/ sum cha'i gnyis mi nag yin pa'i an ten si dmag dpung de gangs rlung 'dres mar 'tshub pa'i an ten si ri bo brgal nas khra kha pu kho (06mi026000 catshe.oṃ༈4 )ru bslebs te 'thab thengs thog ma'i rgyal kha lon/ zla 8par/ san mar thin gyis dmag dpung khrid de san the a ko (5tha 1thartsa0 zolo༅mo)la dpung 'jug byas/ 1818lor chi li rang btsan byas pa khyab bsgrags byas so//chi li bcings 'grol byas rjes/ san mar thin phyir pu ye no si e re si (300ba0331 nga03oṃng7༅4lko/lo)la log si phen gyi tsung tu'u ( khyo 0)yis chi li la slar yang rgol bas san mar thin phyir chi li la phebs/ zla 4par/ me pu (53195 lo yo)bde thang gi g.yul thengs der rgyal kha chen po thob/ der mthud nas san mar thin gyis byang phyogs su pe ru la dpung 'jug byas/ si phen gyi mi ser spel ba'i dmag dpung ni phub ma rlung khyer bzhin 'thor zhing /1821lo'i zla 7par/ san mar thin gyi dmag gis ral gri khrag gis sbags ma dgos par li ma (༅1 8 8/6)ru bca' sdod byas/ pe ru rang btsan byas 162

rjes/ san mar thin la 88rgyal srung bdag po ’ zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/san mar thin gyis a me ri kha lho ma'i ar jen ḍi na dang chi li/ pe ru bcas rgyal khab gsum gyi mi rigs bcings 'grol las don thad byas rjes khyad du 'phags pa bzhag pas ar jen ḍi na'i mi dmangs kyis kho la ‘8rgyal yab ’ kyi ming gis bsngags/ 'on kyang khos mtshan snyan mi 'dod la/ nang sgos su rang nyid dang mi rgyud rjes mar rgyu nor gsog nyar byed mi 'dod/1822lor khos bho li wir dang mjal 'phrad byas rjes/ dmag dbang kho la sprad cing / pe ru'i rgyal srung bdag po zhes pa'i mtshan gnas kyang phyir phul/las don grub rjes dgongs pa zhus te chung ma'i bem sa'ang shul du bzhag nas gsos phrug bu mo khrid de yo rob tu spos/ bhel jam gyi pu ru sel (21033013 oṃsproḥlo)du sdod skabs/ khos rang nyid la shing las byed sa chung chung zhig gnyer te 'tsho thabs bskyangs/ a me ri kha lho ma'i mi dmangs kyis khos 'thab 'dzing byed myong ba'i sa ru yong ste tshe mjug bde skyid ngang rol rgyu'i gdan 'dren yang yang zhus kyang / khos re re bzhin ngag 'jam pos bzlogs/ khos 'di ltar bris yod de/ 88kho bo rgyal khab 'di dag rang btsan ched lo ngo bcu phrag 'gar g.yul la zhugs pa yin la/ de'i dmigs yul nyag gcig ni kho tsho rang nyid kyi khrims lugs kyis rang nyid kyi rgyal khab bdag skyong do dam byed pa kho na yin mi zhes so// 1850lo'i zla 8tshes 17nyin/ kho hpha ran si'i pu lon (oṃ&)du tshe las 'das/ phyis su ar jen ḍi na'i mi dmangs kyis bem rus phyir pu ye no si e li si la gdan drangs te/ lnga pa'i thang chen du dur 'jug byas/1826lor/ khi'u bha dang / po to ri ki ke ya na bcas sa khul las gzhan/ la ting me gling gi sa khul mang che shos snga gzhug tu si phen dang / phor 163

ju ghal/ hpha ran si bcas kyi mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur las grol te rang btsan kyi rgyal khab rabs dang rim pa btsugs/ bhar dzil ni 1822lor rang btsan byas pa yin/ la ting me gling hril bor khebs pa'i rang btsan las 'gul de ni a ri'i rang btsan g.yul 'thab dang / hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i gzhug gi gsar brje thengs shig yin la/ des la ting me gling gi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las 'gan che long tsam grub bo// 164

bcu bdun pa/ 'khor 'os sna drangs pa'i gsar brje zhigayo rob tu/ hpha ran si'i gsar brje 'ur 'ur zing zing ngang sngon du skyod bzhin pa'i skabs der/ dbyin jir 'khor los sna drangs pa'i lhing 'jags kyi bsgyur bcos shig bgyi bzhin mchis/ bsgyur bcos thengs de'am gsar brje thengs des/ mi'i rigs kyi yar rgyas la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen dang /mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen/ spyi tshogs skul 'ded thad thon pa'i nus pa bcas ni gsar brje gang zhig las kyang mi dman no// gsar brje thengs de ni cung zhi 'jam zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de'i nus zil gyi shugs ni gsar brje gang zhig las kyang cung tsam yang mi chung la/ de spel ba na 'du 'dzi yang shin tu che ste/ de ni bzo las gsar brje yin/bzo las gsar brje dang spyi tshogs kyi chab srid gsar brje bsdur na/de la ya mtshan skyed pa'i don rkyen med la/ lam rtags rdo ring du byed pa'i ya mtshan can gyi bsgrags gtam dang gros chod cig kyang med/ de ni dal lhing ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i brgyud rim zhig yin/ dbyin ji nas/ brgyud rim de che long tsam du bshad na/ dus rabs 18pa'i dkyil nas dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil gyi bar du da gzod rags tsam grub pa yin/ gsar brje thengs der gtso 'dzin gyi mi sna zhig kyang med par/ tshan rtsal mi sna phal ba skor cig gis khyim dang las khang / tshod lta'i khang bcas su dal 'jags ger bgyis pa yin/ 'on kyang bzo las gsar brje la'ang spyi tshogs gsar brje 165

dang 'dra bar lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang spyi tshogs kyi khor yug nges can zhig dgos/ dus rabs 18par/ dbyin ji ni 'dzam gling gi bzo las gsar brje byed pa'i cha rkyen ches 'dzoms pa'i rgyal khab cig yin/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyis dbyin jir ma rtsa ring lugs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i bgrod lam legs bskrun byas yod cing / dbyin ji'i tshong zog mtsho phyi'i tshong rar bkrams zin yod/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed mgyogs por 'phel ba la ltos te brjod na thon skyed nus pa phyi phyir rjes su lus par mngon yod/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed de lag shes bzo las thon skyed nas 'phrul chas chen po'i thon skyed du thod brgal byed dgos pa byung zhing / thod brgal de 'grub par byed pa ni bzo las gsar brje yi 'gan khur yin te/ tshan rig lag rtsal yang thon skyed nus shugs yin par ma zad/ da dung thon skyed nus shugs dang po yin pas so// bzo las gsar brje la lam rtags rdo ring mngon gsal zhig med pas/ deng skabs bltas na shin tu sla bde yin pa'i 'khel 'thag 'phrul 'khor zhig gsar bzo byas pa nas 'chad par bya'o//1733lor ming la khe ye (106ba 537maṣā)zer ba zhig gis myur 'khel thags khri (khya71brtsa 360/ 10 ༄ṣṭha)gsar gtod byas te ras 'thag pa'i nus pa je mthor btang / dus rabs 18pa'i dkyil du/ dbyin ji'i 'khel 'thag las rigs su ‘8seng ras kyi mu ge ’ byung bas/ seng ras 'thag pa'i nus pa mgyogs por je mthor 'degs dgos pa byung / nyin zhig shing bzo hā ki re we si (/tha703 batha7rdzu 03ma03 khyacho༅༅)yis chung ma'i 'thag 'khor khyim na 'gyel yod pa de'i 'phang shing da dung langs yod la/ 'khor lo da dung 'khor gyin 'dug tshul de stes dbang gis mthong / stes dbang gi tshor rtogs des shing bzo de'i blo sgo phyes la/ khos 'phang shing skor cig gral bstar gcig 166

tu bsgrigs te 'khor lo gcig gis bskor chog pa'i bsam blo skyes/ de nas khos 'khor lo la brten nas bskor zhing 'phang shing brgyad can gyi 'khel 'thag 'khrul chas jus 'god bzo bskrun byas/ 'phrul chas de byang cha ldan pa'i bzo pa zhig gis spyad na bud med brgyad kyis sngar gyi 'khel 'thag 'phrul chas rnying ba de spyad pa'i 'khel 'thag gi nus pa dang 'dra mtshungs yin/ hā ki re we si yis kho'i chung ma'i ming gis 'phrul chas der ming btags te/46jen nye (10bab7 ༅༅)'khel 'thag 'phrul 'khor mi zhes btags so/ de ni ha lam 1765lo'i yas mas yin/ 66jen nye 'khel 'thag 'phrul 'khor ’ gyis 'khel 'thag nus pa ldab brgyad je mthor btang bas/ las rigs gcig pa'i khyim mtshes rnams kyis mthong rjes rang gi kha phor 'phrogs dogs te khyim rje rub yong ste de bcag ta lam gsar byung dngos po gang zhig yin kyang srol rgyun gyi stobs shugs rnying ba skor zhig la phog thug 'byung zhing /gnad don gsar ba re'ang rgyun du 'byung rgyu yod/ dbyin ji'i skabs de'i spyi tshogs de lta bu zhig gi nang / gnad don gsar ba de dag ni thag gcod byed thabs bral ba zhig yin pas/ hā ki re we si khyim mi rnams thabs zad de sa cha gzhan du song nas/ jen nye 'phrul 'khor bzo bskrun dang legs bcos/'grem tshong byed pa'i mgo brtsams/ phyis su jen nye 'phrul 'khor legs bcos byas te chabs cig tu seng skud brgya 'thag thub par gyur ro// ha lam de dang dus mtshungs par dbyin ji'i ming la ar khi re thi (51068 6 164 1rtsa6 la༅ma3rnya)zhes pa'i skra bzhar zhig gis chu shugs la brten nas 'khor lo bskor ba'i ‘8chu shugs 'khel 'thag 'phrul 'khor ’ gsar gtod byas/ khos 'phrul 'khor de rigs gsar gtod byas rjes skra ma bzhar bar bzo grwa zhig btsugs la/ mgyogs myur ngang rgyu 'byor rgyas/ phyis 167

'khel 'thag gi nus pa ches cher mthor 'degs byung la/ des kyang 'khel 'thag 'phrul chas kyi legs bcos la skul 'ded byas so// 1785lor/ ming la khar thi re thi (khya6la5baspu 03 4nga1rtsa6 ོ/rha7༈rnya)zhes pa'i chos spel mkhan zhig gis ras 'thag 'phrul chas shig gsar gtod byas la/ des ras 'thag pa'i nus pa skad cig gis ldab bzhi bcu spar ro// 'khel 'thag las rigs kyi seng 'khel ba dang ras 'thag pa gnyis ni phan tshun 'brel zhing phan tshun tshod 'dzin thebs pa'i sde tshan gnyis yin pas/ phan tshun la skul lcag dang / gcig rjes gcig snyeg gi sgo nas rim bzhin 'khel 'thag las rigs de lag shes bzo las thon skyed nas 'phrul chas chen po'i thon skyed kyi dus rim la thod brgal byung / shong bzo dang skra bzhar/ chos pa rnams 'khel 'thag 'phrul chas kyi gsar gtod par gyur pa des skabs de'i dbyin ji'i spyi tshogs la gsar gtod gsar skrun de rigs dgos mkho shin tu che ba gsal bor mtshon thub bo//bzo las gsar brje rgyun chad med par sngon du bskyod pa'i tshe sgul shugs kyi skor ni gnad don gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ 'khel 'thag 'phrul 'khor gsar gtod byas rjes kyi dus skabs shig nang sgul shugs gtso bo ni chu shugs la brten pa yin/ 'on kyang chu shugs la rang byung cha rkyen gyi shugs rkyen sna tshogs thebs shing shin tu stabs bde zhig ma yin/ dper na chu skam pa'am yang na chu log dang 'phrad tshe/ bzo grwas las mtshams 'jog dgos pa lta bu yin/ de bas nges par du rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyis chu shugs 'phrul 'khor gyi tshab byed dgos pa byung / rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyi gsar gtod byed mkhan ni spyir btang du jem si wa thi (/7 03 yo3 ṭha7lo slo༈rsha)yin par brjod mod/ don 169

dngos thog wa thi yis rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor la legs bcos byas pa yin te/kho'i yar sngon du'ang dbyin jir cung rtsing bo dang sla bde yin pa'i rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor byung yod/ wa thi yis bzo skrun byas pa'i rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor la gsar gtod dang legs bcos 'gangs chen byas yod pa dang /lhag par gal che ba zhig ni wa thi yi rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyis bzo las gsar brje'i khrod thebs pa'i shugs rkyen dang nus pa la sngar gyi rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor rnams gtan nas 'gran thabs bral/ de bas kho gsar gtod byed mkhan yin zhes brjod na'ang ma chog pa cher med do//wa thi ni bzo pa zhig gi khyim du skyes shing / chu tshod 'khor lo'i tshong khang gi slob g.yog byed myong zhing / phyogs ston dpyad chas dang 'phred gzhung 'jal chas sogs bzo bskrun byed myong la/ 'phrul chas kyi rmang gzhi'i rigs pa skor zhig la nges cha yod/ rjes su kho ki la si ko slob grwa chen mo (01ཿphya0yo6 150131/7lo7lomomarha )ru song ste khrid chas tshod lta ba byas te/ rgyun par dge slob rnams dang lhan rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad don la rtog zhib byas pas/ rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya nges par gyur/khos skabs de'i rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyi zhan skyon gtso bo ni rlangs snod 'khyag 'thas su gyur nas tsha nus ha cang mang po zhig chud zos su 'gro ba de yin pa rtogs/ wa thi yis thabs bkod sna tshogs kyis legs bcos byas te rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gsar ba zhig bzos/ khos rlangs pa sbug sgo zhig brgyud de 'khyag 'thas byed spyad cig tu drangs la/ rlangs snod gtso bo ru tsha tshad nges can zhig rgyun 'khyongs yong du bcug de'i mtshungs su khos rlangs snod kyi zhib tshags je cher btang ste srub mda' dang sbug sgo bzos pa'ang ngos 'jam zhing zhib tshags che ba zhig yin/ 1769lor/ wa thi yis kho'i rlangs 170

sgul 'phrul 'khor thog ma bzos pa la mi rnams kyis ‘ gdon 'dre ’ zhes su btags te/ des me dud 'byin rngub byed par ma zad/ 'gul skyod kyang gdon 'dre dang mtshungs pas so// 1782lor/ khos slar yang sdeb sgul gyi rnam pa'i rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor zhig gsar gtod bzo bskrun byas te/sbug sgo sprad pa la rlangs pa'i gnon shugs la brten nas srub mda' snga gzhug tu sgul 'ded byed cing / 'khor lo 'khor sgul byed du 'jug thub pa zhig byas/ rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor de rigs bzo las kyi sde khag so sor spyad de mgyogs myur ngang lag rtsal gsar brje zhig langs su bcug go/'phrul chas dang rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gsar gtod dang bkol spyod byas pa yis/ de dang 'brel ba'i sol lcags bzo las kyi dar rgyas la skul 'ded byas/ sngar bud shing du byed pa ni shing cha dang / lcags bzhu bar spyod pa ni sol ba yin pa las/ rdo sol rko ba shin tu dkon/ de bas skabs der lcags kyi thon tshad mthon po med/ shing cha ni ring po mi 'gor bar rdzogs par 'gyur bas dbyin ji ba rnams kyis rdo sol spyad de shing cha'i tshab byed pa'i tshod lta byas/ lcags mgar zhig gis rdo sol sreg sol du bsgyur te sol ba'i tshab byas te lcags bzhus pa na thon tshad dang spus tshad gnyis ka mthor 'degs chen po byung / sreg sol gyi 'bar drod je mthor gtong ched/ 'khor sbud bzhu thab chen po spyod mgo brtsams shing / lcags bzhu'i las rigs la dar 'phel chen po byung / rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor dang lcags bzhu'i las rigs/ rdo sol rko rngog las rigs kyi 'phel rgyas kyis kyang 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren las rigs kyi 'phel rgyas la rmang gzhi bting / 1807lor/ a me ri kha'i phel thon (ja060 kha51 0ba tshilo/lko)gyis 'khor gru gsar gtod byas shing / dbyin ji'i mis mgyogs myur ngang lag rtsal de bed spyad de rang nyid 171

kyi 'khor gru bzos/ 1814lor/ si the hphen son (000 25 5 0960ba30ba ༅cho༅ཿ)gyis me 'khor gsar gtod byas/ me 'khor dang 'khor gru gsar gtod dang bed spyod byas pa las skyel 'dren las rigs dang tshong las thad kyi gsar brje bslangs/ de ltar du/ bzo las lag rtsal thad kyi phan tshun rten 'brel gyi 'brel ba dam po 'di las/ 'khel 'thag las rigs nas mgo brtsams pa'i lag rtsal gsar brje des rim bzhin bzo las dang skyel 'dren/tshong las sogs sde tshan yod do cog gi lag rtsal gyi bcos bsgyur chen po zhig bslangs so// dbyin ji'i bzo las gsar brje de dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du phal cher legs par grub/ bzo las gsar brje yi mjug 'bras ni/ dbyin ji'i thon skyed nus shugs mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas byung zhing / spyi tshogs la'ang shugs rkyen gting zab thebs/ 'phrul chas gral du bsgrigs shing du ba stug po gtong ba'i bzo grwa phyi phyir je mang du gyur te/ gsar dar gyi bzo las grong khyer gcig rjes gcig mthud kyis byung ba dang / mi rnams zhing sde nas greng khyer du bskrad la/ byis g.yog dang skyes ma'i bzo pa 'bor chen bkol ba dang /las 'chor gyi nyen khas dus dang rnam pa kun tu khyim tshang mang por 'jigs snang skyed kyin mchis/ lag bzo'i ngal rtsol pa rmang gzhir byas pa'i grong sde'i khyim tshang bzo las dang las khang nyams rgud du gyur zhing / zhing sde khom dal du gyur/ lag bzo'i ngal rtsol gyis 'tsho thabs byed pa'i mi mang po zhig rim gyis 'tsho thabs zad de dbul phongs dang dka' sdug gi g.yang du lhung bas/bzo las gsar brje yi mjug 'bras su 'byor med gral rim dang bzo las 'byor ldan gral rim byung bar gyur/bzo las gsar brje yis dpal 'byor gzhung lugs la'ang dar 'phel 172

chen po byung du bcug a tam si smi zi (4684 5 1 6 ༅zo ༅oṃ)dang ta wed ri kur to (03516 5108 60 ma༅ ཿcho )yis mtshon pa'i dpal 'byor smra ba'i gzhung lugs kyis bzo las 'byor ldan gral rim gyi re ba mtshon yod/ a tam si smi zi yi tshab mtshon brtsams chos ni 〈〈rgyal phyug smra ba 〉〉zhes pa de yin/ khos bltas na/ rgyal khab cig 'byor phyug che min ni/ de la gser dngul rin chen ci tsam yod pa'i cha na med par ngal rtsol thon skyed nus stobs kyi 'phar snon steng na yod pa dang / ngal rtsol ni 'byor phyug gi 'byung khungs dang tshong zog gi rin thang gzhal byed tshad gzhi yin par 'dod/ a tam si smi zi ni deng rabs dpal 'byor rig pa'i srol 'byed mkhan yin no//5

bcongargyad pa/ yo rob kyiste rabs 'o rgyus steng gi gzhi rgya ches cheba'i gsar brje'i drag rlung shig‘ bla med mna' mthun mi gyis mtshon pa'i yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs kyis lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun du 'khor ba bkag ste/ yo rob kyi dngos rgyud bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs kyi gnam 'og gcig 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs byed rtsis bgyis la/ me thi nye ni stobs shugs rnying ba de'i 'thus tshab yin no// khos i ṭa li ‘8sa rgyus steng gi tha snyad ’ cig tu bsgyur ci thub byas shing / 'jar man dbye phral kha thor du gtong ba dang / yo rob shar ma'i mi rigs so so sngar mus bzhin ha pi si pur rgyal rabs kyi bran 'og tu 'jug pa/ por pon rgyal rabs kyis mu mthud du hpha ran si dbang du bsgyur re dang / u ru si nub phyogs su bskyed par bkag 'gog bcas byas so//yin na'ang me thi nye yi 'dod don de ni dar cig las don smin yong mi srid de/yo rob kyi bzo las dang yo rob kyi dmangs gtso'i yar thon stobs shugs sna tshogs/ yo rob kyi mi rigs rang btsan dang mi rigs gcig gyur las 'gul mu mthud du dar rgyas 'byung bzhin pa ni dper na shag shag tu rgyu ba'i chu bo bzhin mtshams chad med par klung chen gcig tu 'dres te dus dang rnam pa kun tu me thi nye dang ‘ bla med mna' mthun nya khur 'gro srid pas so//1848lor/ drag klung de gzhi nas 'ur 'ur rgyug par gyur ro//1848lo'i zla 2par/ pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis ‘8ke'u cod (2 8 0013snga101 0 05153540 05120 ཿṣṭha)pham par rgyob ’ ces sgrog gin khrom skor 174

byas la/ 'thab 'dzing de mgyogs por drag chas 'os langs su 'phel/gnas tshul de we en na nas thos rjes/ me thi nye'i lcam mo dngangs 'tshab skyes te ‘ gal te ke'u cod pham par brgyab na nga tsho'ang pham par nges ’ zhes bshad/ kong jo'i lcam mo 'dis bshad pa don dngos dang mthun te/ gsham nas nga tshos ke'u tsod ji ltar pham par brgyab tshul nas gleng bar bya'o//nā pho lun gyi tshab tu rgyal khrir 'god mkhan lu'i zi bco brgyad pa 1824lor 'das la/ kho'i nu bo rgyal khrir 'khod pa la thra li bcu pa gsol/hpha ran si'i gsar brje skabs/ thra li bcu pa ni yul gyar sku drag gi 'go pa yin la/ kho'i rgyal rabs slar gso dang sger gcod kyi tshad de phu bo las kyang lhag po 'dug me thi nye yis kyang kho la sger gcod thal drags na nyen kha yod ces gdams zhu byas/ mjug mthar 1830lo'i pha ri si'i zla bdun pa'i gsar brje'i 'tshub rlung gis kho pa sdod thabs med pa bzos pas dbyin jir bros byol mi byed ka med byung / zla bdun pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su/ hpha ran si'i srid dbang ni dngul rtsa'i 'byor ldan gral rim chen po'i lag tu shor zhing kho tsho spyi mthun la skrag pas/ thra li bcu pa'i rgyang spun lu'e mi gle li phi (༅0013261519༅༅skya ཿ7stsa)rgyal por bkur ba la/ lo rgyus steng 88zla bdun pa'i rgyal rabs ’ zhes brjod/ lu'e gri ddha li phi ni sngar ol lang kong jo yin la/ sngon chad kyi gsar brje'i khrod rang dbang ring lugs pa zhig gi tshul du snang zhing / dngul rtsa'i 'byor ldan gral rim chen po dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ zla bdun pa'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyal srid las khungs su blon chen zhig yod pa'i ming la ke'u tsod zer zhing / phyis su lu'e bra tī li phi yi dbu blon byas/mi de sngar slob dpon chen mo mkhas pa zhig yin la/ smra mkhas ldan zhing gros 175

tshogs kyi chab srid la byang ba/ shes rgya yangs pa zhig yin pa dang / rig gzhung thad grub 'bras g.yur du za ba yod de/ 〈〈zho rob kyi rig gnas lo rgyus 〉〉dang / 〈〈hpha ran si'i rig gnas lo rgyus〉〉/ 〈〈dbyin ji spyi mthun rgyal khab dang khi rom wel dus skabs kyi lo rgyus 〉〉sogs brtsams yod/ kho ni hpha ran si'i slar gso'i dus skabs su gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi bsam blo 'don mkhan lo rgyus smra ba grags can zhig yin te/ nye rabs lo rgyus kyi rtsa ba'i don dngos ni gral rim 'thab rtsod kyis grub yod par 'dod/ ke'u tsod chab srid gar stegs su bud rjes/ kho'i go gnas je mtho dang dbang shugs je cher gyur pa dang bstun nas bsam blo nyin bzhin mkhregs 'dzin du gyur/ khos 'byor ldan gral rim chen po nyung shas shig gi khe phan srung skyob dang / dbul po'i 'dems bsko'i dbang cha la tshod 'dzin byed pa rgyun 'khyongs byed la/ mngon sum 'dzem med du ‘ sku zhabs rnam pa/ myur mor 'byor phyug lpel zhig dus der bslebs tshe khyod tsho 'dems dmangs su 'gyur nges red ’ ces kyang brjod myong / de lta bu'i mi zhig dbu blon byas tshe mi rnams mi sdang ba ci la srid/de bas/ 1848lo'i zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i khrod/ kho pa tshang ma'i 'ben du gyur pa la'ang ya mtshan rgyu ci yang med do// pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis ‘8ke'u tsod pham par rgyob ’ ces bsgrags rjes/ slar yang 8 lu'e mi the li phi pham par rgyob nya ces bsgrags shing / rgyal po'i khri sa yang pa si thil btson khang thang chen du spos te me ru bsregs/zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su hpha ran sir spyi mthun rgyal khab 176

btsugs pa la lo rgyus steng zla gnyis pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab ④ces zer/dbang 'dzin mkhan 'byor ldan gral rim chen po rnams hpha ran si'i bzo pa gral rim gyi 'os langs khrod mngon pa'i stobs shugs la shin tu 'jigs dngangs skyes/ kho tshos thabs zad kyis bzod sgom khe ster bgyi ba'i dus mtshungs su/ lkog nas drag chas spel 'dzugs dang / log spyod kyi srid jus spel bar shugs snon byas nas/ 'gal 'du nyin bzhin dza drag tu btang ngo //zla 6tshes 23nyin/ pha ri sir 'byor med gral rim gyi zla drug pa'i 'ong langs byung / 'os langs pas ‘(spyi tshogs dmangs gtso spyi mthun rgyal khab ’ 'dzugs rgyu'i 'bod pa bton/zla drug pa'i 'os langs khrod/ phyogs gnyis kyi stobs shugs la khyad par chen po yod/ pha ri si'i 'byor med gral rim stobs shugs chung bar ma zad da dung nar son po byung med la/ lu'e zi po lan khi (/03ba — /03096006tha1103 ༅0713 81thab0 phoskya 7yo)sogs skabs 'tshol ring lugs pa'i shugs rkyen thebs cing / phul du byung ba'i 'go 'dzin pa mang po zhig kyang btson du bcug yod/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyis khrag dri 'thul ba'i drag gnon byas te skyogs dpung gis rub rgol byas/ 'os langs pas nyin gsum la dpa' ngar ngang 'thab 'dzing byas mthar ya nga ba'i sgo nas drag gnon byas/mi chig khri chig stong lhag bsad cing / nyis khri lnga stong lhag btson 'jug gam rgyang 'phud du btang / 'byor med gral rim zhes pa rang tshugs kyi gral rim zhig tu byas nas 'byor ldan gral rim la ngo rgol byed skabs/ 'byor ldan gral ① gsar brje chen po'i phyis su btsugs pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab ni spyi mthun rgyal khab dang po yin la/ phyis su nā pho lun btsan rgyal gyis tshab byas so/ 177

rim gyis ya na med pa'i gtum drag gi lag thabs spyad de ya lan slog nges pa la dngos don gyi steng nas bden dpang byas so//skabs de'i yo rob ni bud shing skam po zhig dang 'dra zhing / pha ri si'i zla gnyis pa'i 'os langs ni me lces bud shing la zin pa dang mtshungs par yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i gsar brje'i me dpung sbar ro// zla 3tshes 13nyin we en na'i mi dmangs kyis khrom skor byas te/ ‘ me thi nye pham par rgyob mi ces dang / ‘ rtsa khrims lag tu bstar dgos ’ zhes bsgrags par ma zad rgyal po'i pho brang yang bskor/ me thi nye khong khro rab tu 'bar gyin u tshugs mtha' 'khyol gyis ‘8kho bos rang gi rgyal khab la zhabs 'degs lo ngo bzhi bcur bsgrubs la/ kho bo gyen rgol gang zhig la'ang mgo bo dud ma myong / kho bo da lta'ang mgo bo dud mi srid ’ ces bshad mod/ 'on kyang thengs 'dir kho'i skad cha de kha pho tsam du song / hphu ran sis zi dang po'i rjes su rgyal khrir 'khod mkhan hpher ti nan dang po (khya0 61ba3sa6 1 07tshe—tsho)mi dmangs kyi zil shugs la 'jigs te phyi bshol mi byas ka med byung nas me thi nye la las 'khyur byed du bcug me thi nye shin tu ya mtshan zhing de ni rang gi snyan grags la shin tu gnod pa'i don zhig yin par bsam/ rgyal po rgan pa 'das khar me thi nye la yang dang bskyar du kho'i bu la rogs skyor bya rgyu'i bcol gdams byas shing /rgyal po gsar ba la'ang me thi nye ni kho'i gzhung drang ba'i blon po dang lo ngo du ma'i ring gi blos thub yin pas/ mi sna bed spyod phyogs kyi don chen rnams me thi nye ma brgyud par gtan nas thag gcod mi rung ba'i bkod gdams byas pa dang / ‘8rgyal khab kyi sgrig gzhi'i rmang gzhi bsgyur mi chog pa dang / thabs 'di ltar rgyal khab bskyangs dgos pa las bcos bsgyur gang yang byed mi chog ’ par gdams/ rgyal po rnying zhen can des rnying ba mkhregs 'dzin byas 178

na da gzod ‘ btsan rgyal dka' sdug dus skabs kyi 'tshub rlung las thar thub ri par 'dod do// me thi nye yis rgyal po rgan pa'i bcol gdams chud zos su ma btang bar blo sems dkar po'i ngang nas ha pi si pur rgyal rabs srung skyob byed pa dang / mig snga'i rgyal po gsar ba dang rgyab 'gal mi byed pa'i dam bca' brtan por bkod kyang / skabs de'i rgyal po gsar bas ‘ kho bo ni gang ltar rgyal khab cig gi mnga' bdag yin pas/ nges par du kho bos thag gcod dgos mi zhes bshad do// lo na 75la son pa'i skyes bu mgo dkar der thabs zad de dbyin ji'i mi zhig tu brdzus nas 'ur zing che ba'i we en na nas bros byol byas shing / ya nga med pa'i lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mor thim par gyur to//pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyi 'os langs dang me thi nye lhung ba yis 'jar man mi dmangs la skul lcag chen po thebs/ zla 3tshes 13nyin/ per lin (807/1sa83rkyene)mi dmangs kyis gzhi rgya che ba'i khrom skor byas la/ de yang mgyogs myur drag po'i 'os langs su 'phel 'gyur byung / rgyal po hphi re ti re khri wi lim bzhi pa (khya 106 105 yo11601 ya tshokhri༈rnyami/ 7yismokhyiyashu/)yis thabs zad de bzod bsran gyis phyi bshol byas te skabs shig ring drag chas per lin nas phyir 'then zhing / 'os langs khrod shi ba'i mi rnams la zhwa mo phud nas mya ngan zhus/ ha lam de dang dus mtshungs su 'jar man gyi rgyal phran gzhan dag ste/dper na lba ten (83602 ༅rsā)dang / lba hpha ri ya/ (8tha 'i41 3malko/༅)hphu theng pog (31yirnyi96)sogs rgyal phran du snga phyir mang tshogs las 'gul byung ba dang / 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang dbang ring lugs pa rnams dus skabs shig nang tshang ma snga gzhug tu rgyal phran so so'i srid dbang du zhugs pa lta bu'o// 179

ha pi si pur rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur 'og gi o si khri ri ya btsan rgyal ni mi rigs kyi btson khang ming don mtshungs pa zhig yin/ o rgyal gyis 'di ltar brjod myong ste/ ‘4kho bo'i mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs ni phan tshun 'dres thabs med/ kho bosahang gha ri (ma5sartsatha77 oṃpolko1)yi mi i ṭa li la mngag pa dang / i ṭa li'i mi hang gha ri la mngag par bya/ mi rigs so sos rang nyid kyi khyim mtshes rgyal phran la lta rtog byed cing / kho tshos phan tshun rgyus mi lon zhing / phan tshun dgra ru blta zhes bshad mod/ yin na'ang 1848lo'i gsar brje'i skabs/ o si khri ri ya dang hang gha ri'i khongs kyi gnya' gnon myong mkhan mi rigs so so phan tshun lta rtog dang phan tshun dgra ru 'dzin pa ma yin par/ de las log ste phan tshun byams pa dang phan tshun rgyab skyor byas pas ha pi si pur rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur la rdung rdeg tsha nan thebs so//i ṭa li'i mi dmangs kyis 1848lo'i zla dang por si ze le gling phran du 'os langs byas te mgyogs por gling phran yongs bcing grol btang / zla 3pa'i nang / me thi nye go gnas phab pa'i gnas tshul des i ṭa li'i mi dmangs kyi o si khri ri yar rgol ba'i 'thab 'dzing la gom gang mdun spos kyis skul 'ded thebs pa dang / zla 3tshes 18nyin me lan mi dmangs kyi 'os langs dang / tshes 22nyin we ni se ru 'os langs byung ba dang / tshes 24nyin sār ten (38 60spru tha ma1)rgyal khab kyis thog mar o si khri ri ya la g.yul brda sprad/ sa khul gzhan te dper na thu ren (1071ba0 lozo)dang / rom/na phi le si sogs grong khyer du'ang snga gzhug tu gzhi rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi las 'gul byung / gang sar mched pa'i me rlabs la gdong gtad de/ ha pi si pur rgyal rabs ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas zing zing lang long du gyur/ 180

'on kyang i ṭa li'i gsar brje thengs der mgo 'khrid mkhan 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang dbang ring lugs pa rnams mang tshogs skul slong byed par 'jigs la/ mi dmangs la brten nas o si khri ri ya dang g.yul 'gyed mi phod par/ re ba chos rgyal dang rgyal phran so so'i rgyal rgyud sku drag gi steng du bcol/ rgyal phran so so'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur pa rnams rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur go gnas rgyun srung yong rgyur 'bad pas myur mor mi dmangs dang rgyab 'gal du langs te/ g.yul sa nas dmag dpung phyir 'then/ o si khri ri yas skabs de dang bstun nas phyir rgol byas pas gsar brje'i rlabs phreng de skabs shig ring je dman du gyur/ skabs der mā tse ne (010309༅ 5421ba1 bra 6༅) gtso byas pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso pa dag gis mi rigs bcing 'grol gyi re ba ni rgyal rgyud sku drag gi steng du bcol mi rung ba rtogs par gyur/ sār ten rgyal pos o si khri ri ya la mgo btags pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ mā tse ne yis 88rgyal po'i g.yul 'thab mjug bsgril song yang / mi rigs kyi'am yang na mi dmangs kyi 'thab 'dzing ni mgo brtsams pa yin ’ zhes bshad/ zla 8pa'i rjes su/ mā tse ne yi 'go khrid 'og gsar brje'i mtho rlabs slar yang 'phyur/ zla 11par/ rom du 'os langs byung ste chos rgyal bhe si dgu pa (91 53 5 ༅7༅tsho)chos gos brjes te bros byol byas/ 1849lo'i zla 3par mā tse ne gtso byas pa'i rom spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs/ we ni se dang tho si khan ne (15༅77 ༅lolo༅)ru yang snga gzhug tu spyi mthun rgyal khab tshugs/ bros byol byas pa'i chos rgyal gyi sems cung lhod la babs rjes/ mgyogs myur ngang hpha ran si dang 'gab 'brel byas te/ hpha ran si'i dmag dpung khri phrag bzhi yi rgyab skyor 'og zla 7par rom blangs/ o si khri ri ya'i dmag gis skabs glags de spyad nas i ṭa 181

li'i rgyal phran so so'i mnga' bdag dang 'gab 'brel byas shing snga gzhug tu we ni se sogs sa khul gyi gsar brje'i srid dbang kha lo bsgyur/pha ri si dang we en na'i gsar brje'i me dpung gis cheg (0༅༅5 cho༅)dang tang gha ri la'ang gsar brje'i me son btab/ 1848lo'i zla 3par/phu ra ki (973rtsab0 oṃ7pho)dang pu ta phe sid (3ba63༅3 oṃ ca'༅)tshang mar gzhi rgya snga na med par che ba'i mang tshogs kyi las 'gul byung / de'i khrod hang gha ri'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje yis zar rgyal u ru si dang dbyin ji la 'jirgas dngangs chen po skye ru bcug go/ 1848lo'i zla 3tshes 12nyin/ hang gha ri'i rgyal sa pu ta phe sid kyi mi dmangs kyis mi rigs rang btsan brtson len byed pa'i khrom skor byas te re ba don tshan bcu gnyis bton/ tshes 15nyin phe sid khul gyi mi dmangs kyis rgyal gces snyan ngag pa phe to hphi (90 011 36ba60 ཿzaḥ)sogs kyi 'go khrid 'og 'os langs byas te par khang bzung zhing / 〈〈re ba don tshan bcu gnyis 〉〉dang phe to hphi yis bris pa'i gsar brje'i snyan ngag 〈〈mi rigs kyi glu dbyangs 〉〉 zhes pa par 'grem byas/ nyin de'i phyi dror/ drag char mdun gyis bsus te phe to hphi yis rgyal khab dngos mang bshams ston khang thang chen du mi grangs khri phrag lhag gi mdun du rang nyid kyi 〈〈mi rigs kyi glu dbyangs 〉〉zhes pa gyer 'don byas la/ der/yar la bzhengs shig tang gha ri'i mi rnams/ mes rgyal gyis khyod la 'bod pa gtong /dus la ran song / yang na da lta bgyi la/ yang na gtan du mi bgyi'o//rang dbang gi mi zhig byed dam/ yang na bran g.yog byed/gnad don 'di la/ khyod tsho rang nyid kyis gdam nga gnang 'tshal/182

snyan ngag pas mi dmangs kyi tshab tu lan 'di ltar btab ste/hang gha ri'i mi rnams kyi dkon mchog mdun/nga tshos dam bca' 'jogang tshos dam bca' 'jog nga tsho ni/bran g.yog gtan nas mi byed/mang tshogs kyis mi sems 'gul ba'i 'bod pa der nyan gyin khrag dron 'khol zhing / mes rgyal gyi bcings 'grol las don ched rang lus kyi khrag dron gtor bar yang spro ba rgyas/ skabs der mi zhig gis dmag dpung bslebs byung zhes skad brgyab pa na dngangs skrarga skye mkhan med la/ brol byol byed mkhan ni de bas kyang med par ma zad/ mang tshogs 'dus kyin 'dus kyin je mang du phyin/ tshang mas mgrin gcig tu ‘ mtshon cha lag tu 'dzin/ drag chas lag tu spras ’ zhes brjod la/ phe to hphi yi 'go khrid 'og mang tshogs nyis khri lhag rngam brjid ldan pa'i ngang nas pu ta'i spyi khyab khang gi phyogs su bskyod/phe to hphi yi nyin tho ru skabs de'i gnas tshul 'di ltar bkod yod de/ ‘ spyi khyab khang gi dpon pos rngam zil che ba de mthong nas ngo mdangs shor zhing 'dar gsig byas/ skar ma lnga tsam gyi ring la mjal 'phrad byas rjes/ re ba tshang mar mos mthun mi byed ka med byung song zhes bris yod la/ khos da dung ‘6de'i grub 'bras kyi steng nas bshad na/ nyin de ni hang gha ri'i lo rgyus khrod nam yang rjes dran bya rin yod pa'i nyi ma zhig tu gyur ro nya zhes kyang brjod yod/ o si khri ri ya'i dbang sgyur pas thabs zad nas bzod bshol byas shing /hang gha ri yis srid 'dzin las khungs tshugs te zhing bran lam lugs rtsa med 183

lu'u zhun gyis 〈〈brjed zin pa'i dran rten ched 〉〉ces pa'i rtsom du pe mang (sbyoo)gis bsgyur ba'i phe to hphi yi snyan ngag tshig rkang bzhi drangs yod pa 'di ltar/tshe srog rin thang che/brtse dung de las lhagagal te rang dbang ched/gnyis ka 'dor du rung /phe to hphi yis mjug mthar rgyal khab ched lus srog gtong ba la brten nas rang nyid kyi snyan ngag 'di'i khrod mtshon pa'i gzi brjid kyi dam tshig de lag tu bstar ro//yo rob skam sa hril bor mched pa'i 1848lo'i gsar brje de pham mod/'on kyang des yo rob kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs la rdung rdeg drag po btang zhing / ‘ bla med mna' mthun ’ gyis hur srung byed pa'i sgrig srol rnying ba nyams rgud du btang ngo // gsar brje thengs des da dung 'byor med gral rim la sbyong brdar thob ste/ 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje la lag len gyi nyams myong phan sam tshogs po thob tu bcagadaming chirdo mi ra nga 185

bcu dgu pa/ mar khe si dang / yen ke si/tshan rigasung khran ring lugs byungab/‘6rnam shes shig ste/ gung khran ring lugs kyi rnam shes shig yo rob tu rgyu bzhud 'dug ces pa ni 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉gyi tshig dang po yin/ lo ngo brgya phrag gcig lhag gi ring la/ 'dzam gling gi log spyod stobs shugs yod tshad kyis rnam shes de mthar skrod gtong ci thub sgos bla med mna' mthun du bsdongs mod/ 'on kyang ya mtshan pa zhig ni/ rnam shes des rgyun chad med par rgyal kha'i glu gzhas gcig gzhug gcig gis mthud kyin btang song / deng skabs de yo rob tu rgyu bzhud byed pa ma yin par 'dzam gling gi sa khul mang po zhig nas 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha blangs song /1847lo'i zla 11par/ 8 gung khran ring lugs pa'i mna' 'brel nya gyis lon ton du 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bsdus la/ mar khe si dang en ke si yang gdan drangs te tshogs 'dur zhugs/ mna' 'brel la gzhung lugs dang lag len thad nas tang gi sgrig srol 'bri rgyu'i don de tshogs chen gyis khong gnyis la bcol/ 1848lo'i zla 2par/ khong gnyis kyis bris pa'i rtsom yig lon ton du bskur te par du btab pa de ni 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉zhes pa de yin/ 〈〈bsgrags gtam 〉〉du 'thus tshang ba'i sgo nas tshan rig gung khran ring lugs kyi gzhi rtsa'i bsam blo brjod yod la/ de ni rgyal spyi'i gung khran ring lugs las 'gul gyi rtsa 'dzin rang bzhin gyi yig cha zhig yin/ 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉spel ba yis tshan rig gung khran 186

ring lugs dngos su byung ba mtshon no//tshan rig gung khran ring lugs gyi gzhung lugs btsugs pa de mi re gnyis kyi 'dod mos las byung ba zhig ma yin par lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi g.yol du med pa'i mjug 'bras shig yin/ dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs 30pa dang 40par/ yo rob kyi 'byor med gral rim de bzo las gsar brje mtshams chad med par dar 'phel byung ba dang bstun nas stobs shugs rgyas la/'byor med gral rim dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'gal ba de rim bzhin dza drag je cher gyur/ 1831lo dang 1834lor/ hpha ran si'i le un (khu70ba3 tsho.e)gyi bzo pas thengs gnyis la 'os langs byas pa dang / 1844lor 'jar man gyi zhi le zhi ya'i (yo23tusgograme)'khel 'thag bzo pas 'os langs byas/1836lo dang 1848lor/ dbyin jir 'ur 'ur zing zing gi rtsa khrims las 'gul byung ba de ni mang tshogs rang bzhin dang chab srid rang bzhin gyi 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul zhig red/ 'thab 'dzing de dag gis rgyal spyi'i 'byor med gral rim yang chab srid kyi stobs shugs rgya che zhing rang tshugs pa zhig tu byas nas lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su slebs pa mngon par mtshon thub/ yin na'ang skabs de'i 'byor med gral rim da dung nar son po med la/ rang gi gral rim gyi lo rgyus go gnas dang lo rgyus 'os 'gan la da dung tshan rig dang mthun pa'i ngos zin med pa dang / 'thab 'dzing gi bgrod lam dang thabs tshul yang dag pa zhig kyang mi shes/ de bas tshan rig gung khran ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs 'dzugs pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'gan khur de mi rnams kyi mig sgor gtad yod/ mar khe si dang en ke si yis de 'gan du blangs par ma zad da dung lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan de legs par grub thub pa byung /187

khal mar khe si (53 1 5tha tshelo bra༅ wu)ni 1818lo'i zla 5tshes 5nyin phu ro zi rgyal khab kyi re in zhing chen thi rer (1 161ṅgernyalko/lo)du skyes la/1883lo'i zla 3tshes 14nyin tshe las 'das/ mar khe si ni yi'u tha'e (156357pāzhu)pa zhig yin la/ pha ni dag sel pa dang ma ni ho lan ḍi'i yin/ mar khe si chung ba'i dus nas slob gnyer la brtson 'grus che zhing / bsam gzhigs byed rgyur dga'/ khos slob 'bring gi skabs su bris pa'i rtsom yig la'ang bsam blo gzi 'od 'phro ba yod/ khos rtsom yig tu/ nga tshos mi'i rigs la phan bde ches chen po bskrun slad ngal rtsol byed pa'i las rigs de bdams par 'os zhes bris yod/ phyis su mar khe si per lin slob grwa chen mo'i bca' khrims sde khag tu zhugs/ kho'i a phas bu yis phyis su rang gi las mjug bskyang ste dag sel pa zhig byed re bcangs/ 'on kyang mar khe si de la spro ba ci yang med/khos bca' khrims sbyangs pa las gzhan/ lo rgyus dang mtshan nyid rigs pa/sgyu rtsal brtsams chos sogs la lta klog rgya cher byas/ de ru he kel (600 3yo1 16014 kha 1067106 ma0rtsa01 zatsholo)gyi mtshan nyid rigs pa'i gsung rtsom gyis kho'i yid ches cher drangs la/ na gzhon he kel pa'i rtsa 'dzugs ‘ 'bum rams pa'i mnyam spro khang ’ zhes par zhugs/ khong slob grwa chen mo nas mthar phyin skabs kyi 'bum rams pa'i dpyad rtsom ni 〈〈ti mo khi li thi yi rang byung mtshan nyid rigs pa dang e pi je lu yi rang byung mtshan nyid rigs pa'i khyad par 〉〉zhes pa yin la/ rtsom de'i nang du ‘ lha'i dbang thang la mi 'jigs shing / glog zhags la mi skrag pa/ nam mkha'i thog char la'ang mi skrag go ’ zhes bris yod/ dpyad rtsom khrod 'thab 'dzing lha med smra ba'i bsam blo bstan yod/ mtshan nyid rigs pa'i sde khag gi 'go pas dpyad rtsom la gdeng 'jog byas par ‘ shes rab khyad du 'phags shing lta ba gting zab la/ shes sgo khod 188

yangs ’ zhes bris yod/ de las kho la 'bum rams pa'i mtshan btags thob bo//1842lor mar khe sis 〈〈re yin tshags par 〉〉gyi gtso sgrig khur zhing /〈〈shing nags rku 'phrog khrims kyi dag sel 〉〉sogs rtsom yig rabs dang rim pa spel te/ phu ro zi rgyal khab kyi log spyod bo 6bo la ther 'don dgag rgyag dang ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khe phan srung skyob byas/ skabs der/ kho sems gtso ring lugs pa nas dngos gtso ring lugs par 'gyur mgo brtsams la/gsar brje dmangs gtso ring lugs pa nas gung khran ring lugs par 'gyur mgo brtsams so/1843lor/ mar khe sis chung 'dris grogs mo je ne trin we si thi hpha lin (1'ibs7 yo63 96ma0sa ma ༅ /phyo tsho༅ṅgertse4khya)dang gnyen bsgrigs/je ne sku drag gi khyim rgyud du skyes la/ kho mo'i pha ni phu ro zi'i srid gzhung gi mtho rim dpon po zhig yin zhing / phu bo nang blon chen mo byed myong yang /brtse dud gi gshog rlabs de khyim rgyud kyi 'obs rim zab mo las 'phur brgal byas so// mar khe sis dungs pa zab mo'i sgo nas je ne la springs pa'i 'phrin yig tu 64'jig rten 'dir khyod kho na/ bdag la mtshon na skul lcag gi 'byung khungs yin zhing / bdag la mtshon na lhan skyes shes rab kyi dbugs dbyung yang yin ’ zhes bris yod/ bla na 'phags pa'i phugs 'dun dang / zol gyis ma gos pa'i brtse dung gis 'gog rkyen sna tshogs sel te/ kho gnyis skyid sdug mnyam myong gi blos thub grog4po dang 'thab grogs su 'gyur du bcug go/gnyen bsgrigs rjes kho gnyis la byis pa bdun skyes kyang 'tsho bar dka' ngal che bas gson thub pa gsum tsam las ma byung / 1843lo'i ston gar/ mar khe si pha ri sir phyin/ de'i gzhug lor/ 189

khong dang he kel g.yon phyogs ring lugs pa ru ke ( 72016 1brtsa0 ṇacho)mnyam 'brel gyis 〈〈ti hpha lo deb〉〉(ba0ba 305 — ga 3020313050 /tha57650601tsho'itshonda༅)dang po par bsgrigs byas/ dus deb der spel ba'i rtsom yig las/ mar khe si gsar brje ba zhig tu byas te 66da yod kyi thams cad la ya nga ba med pa'i sgo nas dgag pa rgyagadagos shing / nang sgos su 88drag chas kyis dgag pa rgyag dgos ’ pa'i lta ba bton/ pha ri si ru sdod skabs mar khe sis gzab nan sgos dbyin ji'i gna' dpe ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor smra ba a tam si smi zi dang ta wed ri gar to yi ngal rtsol rin thang smra bar zhib 'jug byas shing / sen si mon (01tha560 000 60 ba00 07’ 00 0 6034sa 3170ba cham/ ka)dang / hphu re er(06tha 103 khya0bab01 khya4khya/)/ o'u wen (za060 040 khrukhu)rngo)sogs kyi stong bsam spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rigs pa dang / de min hpha ran si'i slar gso'i dus skabs kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i brtsams chos la zhib 'jug byas shing / he kel gyi sems gtso ring lugs la gom gang mdun spos kyis dgag pa brgyab/marakhe si'i gsar brje'i bya spyod kyis yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i srid gzhung la 'jigs dngangs skye ru bcug skabs der khong la rgyal khab so so'i log spyod pas gnod pa brtsams te thengs mang por yul phyir bskrad pas/yul gyar 'khyams sdod kyi 'tsho ba rol/ 1847lo'i dpyid gar/ khong dang en ke si (khya1106ma05 ༅sartsa013 zla chom)gnyis lhan du 66gung khran ring lugs pa'i mna' 'brel ’ du zhugs shing / 1848lo'i zla 2par 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉spel/ per lin gyi zla gsum pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su/khong dang en ke si slar khi ron du log ste 1848lo'i gsar brjer zhugs shing /'jar man gyi 'byor med gral rim la lag len gyi rtsa 'dzin te/ 〈〈gung khran 190

tang gis 'jar man la bton pa'i re ba 〉〉zhes pa rtsom 'bri byas/gsar brje pham rjes/ mar khe si dbyin jir byol bzhugs byas shing /lon ton du rgyun sdod byas/ lo rabs 50pa'i mgor/ khos 1848lo'i gsar brje'i nyams myong gi spyi sdom gtsor byas te 〈〈1848/de1850lo'i hpha ran si'i gral rim 'thab rtsod 〉〉ces pa dang / 〈〈lu'e zi po na phad kyi smug zla'i tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi srid 'gyur 〉〉sogs gsung rtsom bcoms/ de'i rjes su khong gis 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉'bri ba gtso bor gnyer/ dpe cha de'i slad du khong gis dka' ba mang po khyad du bsal zhing / ha las pa'i spobs shugs la brten nas dbul phongs dang na ba 'dres ma'i gnon shugs chen po'ang khur du bzod par byas so//khong gis grogs po la/ 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉'bri ba'i ched du/ nam yang dur sa'i 'gram du 'chag 'chag byed bzhin yod tshul brjod myong /1865lor/ khong gis 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉kyi ma phyi yongs su grub la/1867lor deb dang po par du bskrun/ mar khe sis deb de'i gleng gzhi'i nang ‘ tshan rig gi thad na khod snyoms kyi lam chen zhig med la/ dka' sdug la mi 'dzem par g.yang gzar gyi ri lam brgyud kyin yar 'go ba'i mi kho na la da gzod gzi 'od 'phro ba'i yar rtser bsleb re yod ’nya ces bris yod/1882lo'i zla 2par/ mar khe si a hphe ri kha'i ( 1ba0thadzakhrim)al cir si ( 1rtsa10 3 7lo༅lo)la ljongs rgyur thengs gcig phebs te zla gnyis la bsdad/ phyir lon ton du log rjes/ khong gi mi tshe tha ma'i stobs shugs rtsal 'don sgos 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉kyi ma phyi legs bsgrigs byas la/ lo phyi mar rang nyid kyi bzhugs stegs su lhing 'jags ngang 'jig rten dang gtan du tshurmis skras// 191

hphu re ti ri zhi en ke si (kha 106 106 ༅2rtsa0/37tshoḥ༅lko wupolo)ni 182)lo'i zla 11tshes 28nyin phu ro zi'i re yin zhing chen gyi lba men du skyes shing / mar khe si las lo gnyis kyis chung la/ khong gi pha ni 'khel 'thag bzo grwa zhig gi bdag po yin/ en ke si chung dus nas bzung sbyang brtson che zhing sbyang 'bras kyang phul du byung la/ nang sgos su skad yig gi 'jon thang gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa zhig ldan/ khong slob 'bring gi skabs su hpha ran si'i skad dang ghi ri si (0 0ཿ0tshotsho)yi skad/ la ting gi skad sogs skad rigs mang po shes/ na tshod dar la babs rjes/ khong gis skad rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis spyad de bgro gleng dang rtsom 'bri byed thub la/ skad rigs nyi shu'i yi ge klog thub bo//en ke sis dang thog slob grwa chen mo 'grims bsam kyang / khong ni bu che ba yin la pha yis blo gcig sems gcig gis pha yi las rgyun bskyang dgos par gdams shing / 1837lor khong la btsan thabs kyis slob mtshams bzhag nas tshong gnyer du bcug skabs der slob 'bring thomathar phyin rgyur da dung lo gcig yod/ 965 gseng gi dus su en ke sis dka' spyad kyis slob gnyer byed pa mu mthud du rgyun 'khyongs byas te dpe cha sna tshogs la rgya cher gzigs/ 1841lor/ khong per lin la dmag zhabs zhu ru phyin la/ khom skabs spyad nas per lin slob grwa chen mor zur mnyan byas te/ he kel gyi mtshan nyid rigs par zhig 'jug byas pas/ khong yang he kel la yid rton pa zhig tu gyur/ 1842lor/ en ke si dbyin ji'i man khri si thi (53ba0603 0 ༅oṃloḥ)la song ste de ga'i pha yi bzo grwa'i las sgrub khang du bya ba bsgrubs/de nas bzung khong dang dbyin ji'i bzo pa'i las 'gul bar 'brel ba byung ste/spyi tshogs ring lugs pa zhig tu gyur to//192

1844lor/ en ke si phyir 'jar man du log skabs pha ri ༄ brgyud la/de nas mar khe si dang thug 'phrad byung / de nas bzung khong gnyis blos thub kyi 'thab grogs su gyur/ de ru khong gnyis mnyam 'brel sgos dpe deb 〈〈ngo mtshar che ba'i khyim rgyud 〉〉ces pa brtsams shing / lo rjes mar en ke si'i 〈〈dbyin ji'i bzo pa gral rim gyi gnas babs 〉〉zhes pa par du bskrun/en ke sis yun ring bor lon ton nas tshong gnyer ba de'i rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig ni dpal 'byor gyi steng nas mar khe si la 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉brtsams grub 'byung bar rgyab skyor byed ched yin/ mar khe sis khong gi lhag bsam gsal bor rtogs la/ khong gi bla na 'phags pa'i bsam blo der sems 'gul chen po thebs/ mar khe sis en ke sir springs pa'i 'phrin yig tu ‘ bdag gi sems gshis ni nam rgyun rmi 'dres mnan pa ltar ljid tig ger snang ste/ rgyu mtshan ni khyod kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rnam dpyod de gtso bo bdag gi ched du da gzod tshong gnyer gyi phyogs su chud zos gtong zhing / da gzod skam rgud du 'gyur bzhin pa ma zad/ da dung bdag gi phran tshegs kyi dka' sdug thams cad kyang khur du len rogs byed dgos pas so mi zhes bris yod do//en ke si ni mar khe si dang 'dra bar 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i gzhung lugs de tshan rig gi rmang gzhi'i steng brtan por btsugs shing /khong gis tshan rig gi rnam grangs shin pu mang por zhib 'jug bgyis yod de/rang byung tshan rig nas spyi tshogs tshan rig dang / dmag don dang rang byung rtsod sgrub rigs pa/ mtshan nyid rig pa/ dpal 'byor/ lo rgyus sogs nas rtsom rig dang skad cha bcas la'ang zhib 'jug byas yod/ khong gi skad grags che ba'i gsung rtsom la 〈〈tu reng (537/20rtsa0 755smo102༈1oṃ)la ngo rgol byas 193

tshul smra ba pa 〉〉dang / 〈〈khyim tshang dang sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs/ rgyal khab kyi 'byung khungs〉〉/ 〈〈lu ti we ki gle khor pa ha (༅56415 kha050 630kho lkolkoḥlko yolo ༅ṣā) dang 'jar man gyi gna' dpe ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa mjug bsgril ba 〉〉sogs yin/zugabasdo kheb cos byenge 95thag shuraspradathag thejothag/ 3 ji 〉 rnye zlo sgro 〉〉tso lha rtso ༷ji byezo 7kho / tt+waṃsmo:skuspyoñtsa en ke sis rang nyid kyi zhib 'jug ༷ 4 tsho zlo 〉 ༷swā rmātsho zug/rgyabaka thab/sdubasdo te shestethabathag ro/bkabasdo skyesad rga ce/rnya 4gyi snyu tshe mi3 ཿ༵ nirwa ོ ོ bton nas 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉skyo — deb gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i legs bsgrigs dang kha gsab/ par bsgrigs kyi bya ba gnyer/ khong gis mi lo hril bo bcu gnyis spyad de da gzod mar khe si'i mjug legs par ma grub pa'i las don 'di bsgrubs pa yin/ le nyin gyis bshad rgyur/ en ke sis par du bskrun pa'i 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam mar khe si dang je ni cin we si thi ho lin/bshad 〉〉kyi deb gnyis pa dang gsum pha pha 1pa ni/ khong gi skyes thob kyi shes rab 'bar ba'i grogs po la bslangs pa'i rngam brjid can gyi dran rten rdo ring zhig yin la/ khong gis kyang bsam bzhin ma yin pa'i sgo nas rang ming yang bslab tu med par brkos yod/ de ltar te/tshan rig gung khran ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs ni mar khe si dang en ke si thun mong gis gsar du btod pa yin la/ gzhung lugs de'i phyogs so sor khong gaṭwāṃ~X kyi zungs khrag gis bran yod/ rigs pa der mar khe si'i ming gis

btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ en ke sis 88mar khe si ni nga tsho su las kyang sdod sa mtho la mig rgyang ring ba dang / rtog zhib byas pa mang zhing myur mo yod/mar khe si ni lhan skyes kyi shes rab 'bar ba zhig yin la/ nga tsho mang mthar yang byang ma tsam las ma 'das/ mar khe si med na nga tsho'i gzhung lugs 'di da lta bu zhig gtan nas yong mi srid/ de bas/ gzhung lugs 'di la khong gi ming gis btags na don dang mthun pa yin mi zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// mar khe si 'das rjes/ khong gis yang bskyar 8 mar khe si 'tsho dus su/ bdag gis rol mo ba gnyis pa byas ’ zhes brjod/ khengs dregs mi mnga' ba'i 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje ba'i sems khams dang gshis rgyud ni ji 'dra'i khod yangs shing rnam par dag pa zhig red ang /rang rgyal du mar khe si zhes pa 'di thog mar ngo sprod byas pa ni 1899lo'i zla 3tshes 15nyin gyi hrang he'i 〈〈rgyal khab brgya yi spyi'i tshags par〉〉(zo༅yi41)gyi rtsom yig cig tu 4 bzo ba brgya phrag gi gtso 'dzin grags pa can ni/dbyin ji ba mar khe si'o ’ zhes bris yod pa de yin/ skabs de'i krung gos 'dzam gling la rgyus lon shin tu chung bas mar khe si dbyin ji'i mir nor ba la ya mtshan rgyu med do// 1902lo'i zla 9par/ leng chi khru'o ( ༅ ༅lo)yis 〈〈dmangs gsar tshags par 〉〉(ཿ6ṭha75ma)zhes par rags bsdus kyi mar khe si'i rigs gzhung ngo sprod byas la/ ‘ mar khe si (zaphoca)ni 'jar man pa yin la/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tog rtse yin minyazhes brjod yod/ 1906lo'i zla dang por/ sung krung hran gyis 'go khrid pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i las khungs kyi tshags par 〈〈dmangs kyi tshags par 〉〉deb gnyis pa'i steng / kru'u kri zhin (lkom/tho)gyi 〈〈'jar man gyi spyi tshogs gsar brje ba ngo sprod rags bsdus 〉〉zhes pa spel te/ cung 'thus tshang ba'i sgo nas mar khe si dang en ke 195

nyi shu pa/ stodalwa dmarapha can gyi dpa'a'/1844gro'i zla 1tshes 1nyin/ 1848lo'i gsar brje'i khrod byung ba'i rom spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khrims 'dzugs gros tshogs kyis brel myur sgos tshogs 'du bsdus te/ nyen tshabs che ba'i gnas babs la gros mol bgyis/lus yongs khrag gis sbags shing / rngul chus lwa ba 'byar ba'i dmag dpon zhig thad kuro tshogs rwar phebs yong / kho'i lwa bar ral gris u khung du ma phug yod la/ kho'i lag gi bkod 'doms ral gri de yang gug por gyur te phyed ka tsam las shub tu 'jug ma nus pas phyed ka phyir mngon yod/ mi rnams kyis spro sems 'khol ba'i thal mo brdabs te g.yul ngo nas thad kur tshogs rwar phebs pa'i dmag dpon de la dga' bsu zhus/ kho ni i ṭa li'i skad grags che ba'i stod lwa dmar po can gyi dpa' bo ka ri pal rdi (0103099068 16761 shākhya༅ོ7)red/ mar khe sis kho la 88i ṭa li'i skyes thob kyi shes rab can ’ zhes bsngags/1807lo'i zla 7par/ ke'u ze the ka ri pal rdi ni ne zi (ma100 ༅lo)zhes pa'i yul du gru ba zhig gi khyim du skyes/ phyis su khos kyang gru ba byas/ mtsho steng gi dka' sdug 'tsho bas kho'i brtan brling gi gshis ka skyed bsring byas/1833lor/ lo na gzhon pa'i ka ri pal rdi yis 66na gzhon i ṭa li tang ’ gi gtso 'dzin mā tse ne ngo shes shing / kho'i shugs rkyen zab mo thebs te/ mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul la hur thag gis zhugs/ khos mā tse ne yi mdzub ston 'og sār ten rgyal rabs kyi mtsho dmag nang song ste gsang ba'i sgo 197

nas mtsho dmag gi 'os langs bslang ste sa lpo ye (38ma07mayoṣā)rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur mgo rting slog rgyu'i jus bkod 'then/ 1834lor 'char gzhi phyi gyar byung zhing / kho a me ri kha lho mar mi 'bro thabs med byung la/ sār ten rgyal pos do bdag zhugs med bzhin du srog khrims bcad/ a me ri kha lho mar khos i ṭa la'i dmag khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ a me ri kha lho ma'i mi rigs bcing 'grol 'thab rtsod du lo ngo bcu bzhi'i ring la zhugs/ khos mgo bor 'dabs yangs pa'i zhwa mo zhig dang / lus la stod lwa dmar po zhig gyon yod pas/ ngo mtshar can gyi stod lwa dmar po'i dpa' bor gyur pa yin no//1848lo'i gsar brje'i skabs su/ ka ri pal rdi spro shugs gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa rgyas shing / de ma thag tu lam la chas te phyir mes rgyal du logakhos spro hur chen po'i sgo nas dang blangs dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas te o si khri ri yar ngo rgol byed pa'i g.yul 'thab tu zhugs/ 1849lor rom spyi mthun rgyal khab srung skyob byed pa'i g.yul 'thab khrod/ khos sna drangs te dpa' bar gyi sgo nas 'thab 'dzing byas pas stobs shugs rang phyogs las ldab kha shas kyis lhag pa'i dgra bo'i tshur rgol thengs bcu phrag 'gar bzlog cing / dmag don thad kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i 'jon thang dang ngo mtshar ba'i spobs stobs rnam par mngon/ gsar brje de pham rjes kho a ri la byol sdod byas/ dang thog nye'u yog tu bzo pa zhig byas shing / rjes su tshong gru zhig gi gru dpon la bsdad/1848lo'i gsar brje pham pa'i rjes su/ i ṭa li sngar mus su kha thor du gnas/ o si khri ri yas byang khul gyi lom pa ti dang we en na la mu mthud du dbang sgyur byas zhing / dkyil khul gyi rgyal phran dag kyang kha lo sgyur bzhin yod/ si phen gyi por pon khyim rgyud kyis lho khul gyi si ze le rgyal phran dbang du bzung yod pa dang / rom dang de'i mthar skor chos rgyal gyis bdag tu bzung 198

yod par ma zad/ hpha ran si dang o si khri ri ya'i dmag dpung kyang bsdad yod/i ṭa li'i rgyal phran dag gi khrod sār ten rgyal phran gcig pu tsam ni phyi rgyal gyis dbang bsgyur med pa'i rgyal phran zhig yin la/ de ru da gzod rang dbang ring lugs kyi rtsa khrims rgyun 'jog byas yod do// sngar ten rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs su sa dbus rgya mtsho'i steng gi sār ten gling phran dang / skam sa'i steng gi phe meng thi yod/ de'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor cung dar rgyas che zhing / dmag stobs ches che ba yin/ 1852lor 'jon thang ldan pa'i ka sbyor (03la150 80ba30’ 00ba 0 61 03ma007 me'itshi7)gyis sār ten rgyal khab kyi dbu blon khur bas/ i ṭa li'i mi phyi phyir mang po zhig gis sār ten ni i ṭa li'i dkyil snying yin par lta'o//ka lpor ni sku drag gi khyim rgyud du skyes shing / yo rob nub ma'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen zab la/ dbyin ji'i mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs la gong bkur chen po byed pa dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor spel ba la hur sems shin tu che/ kho rang nyid kyis kyang hur thag gis rang gi zhing gzhis de ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rnam pa'i zhing ra zhig tu bsgyur bar brtson pa byed/ khos da dung bzo grwa dang dngul khang / lcags lam sogs 'dzugs gnyer byas pas/ 'byor ldan gral rim du gyur pa'i sku drag rnam dag cig yin no// gral rim gyi go gnas nyis sbrags de las kho'i chab srid lta ba la'ang ngos gnyis kyi rang bzhin mngon gsal dang ldan/ khos ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor spel dgos par 'dod la/ khyab khongs nges can zhig nang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas te spyi tshogs yar rgyas la skul 'ded gtong zhing / rgyal khab gcig gyur dang mi rags 199

bcing 'grol gnyer mod/ 'on kyang / khos tshad mthon po'i dmangs gtso'i gsar brjer ngo rgol byed cing / spyi mthun la rgol ba dang / mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs lag tu bstar te/ 'byor ldan gral rim dang sku drag gi mna' 'brel de spyi tshogs kyi srog shing du 'gyur re 'chang ba dang / sār ten rgyal pos 'go khrid cing / i ṭa li ni gong nas 'og rim du gcig gyur bya 'dod do//lo rabs 50pa'i smad du/ i ṭa li'i mi rigs bcing 'grol dang rgyal khab gcig gyur gyi las 'gul de yang bskyar mtho rlabs gsar ba zhig tu bslebs/ ka lpor gyis hpha ran si dang o si khri ri ya'i 'gal ba bed spyad nas o si khri ri ya la ngo rgol byas te lom pa ti dang we ni se phyir blangs/ 1858lor ka lbor gyis nā pho lun gsum pa dang o si khri ri yar ngo rgol byed pa'i gsang ba'i chings yig bkod la/ sngar ten gyis hpha ran sis dmag drangs nas o si khri ri yar rgol ba la sa lpo ye dang ne zi bcad ster byas so// 1859lor o rgol g.yul 'thab byung //ka ri pal rdi 1854lor slar i ṭa li la log yo rgol g.yul 'thab khrod/ka lbor gyis ka ri pal rdi'i mtshan grags dang dmag don gyi 'jon thang bed spyad nas dmag dpung bsdu 'dzugs dang / g.yul 'thab la bkod 'doms byed bsam bcangs nas/ ka ri pal rdi la mi grangs sum stong long pa'i dmag dpung zhig sprad/ o rgol g.yul 'thab kyi thog ma'i dus su/ star ten rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung gis g.yul 'gyed pa la dka' khag byung bas/ ka ri pal rdi yis dmag dpung khrid de lom pa ti la phyin nas mi dmangs skul slong gis 'os langs byas la/ tshur 'phrog pa'i dgra bo'i drag chas kyis rang nyid la drag chas spras pa dang / bstud mar rgyal kha thob ste 'thab kyin 'thab kyin stobs shugs rgyas/ o dmag lom pa ti nas phyir mi 'then ka med byung zhing / we ni 200

ser 'then te 'gog srung byas/o rgol g.yul 'thab kyi rgyal khas mgyogs myur ngang i ṭa li'i sa khul so so'i gsar brje'i las 'gul la skul lcag thebs te/ tho si khan ne dang /phar mā/ (93 la3 skokhripaṃ) de min da dung chos rgyal gyis dbang bsgyur pa'i sa khul 'gar yang 'os langs byung ste bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin srid dbang mgo rting slog ste gnas skabs srid gzhung btsugs/ i ṭa li hril bor khyab pa'i gsar brje'i 'tshub rlung chen po des nā pho lun gsum pa dngangs su bcug pa dang / khos i ṭa li dngos su gcig gyur byung tshe hpha ran si'i ngo zlar yong ba'i dgra chen zhig tu 'gyur bar sems khral byas/ de bas/ kho mgyogs myur ngang mna' chings dang 'gal te sngar ten la btsan thub sgos o si khri ri ya dang mthun thabs byed du bcug de ltar gnas babs legs po de nā pho lun gsum pas g.yo 'tshong byas so// ka ri pal rdi shin tu khro ba skyes te hpha ran si dang star ten gyi mnyam 'brel dmag las phyir 'bud rgyu khyab bsgrags byas/thengs de'i g.yul 'thab kyi 'bras bu ni/ o si khri ri yas gzu ba nā pho lun gsum pa brgyud de lom pa ti phyir sār ten la sprad cing / we ni se sngar mus bzhin o si khri ri ya'i lag tu dbang ba dang / nā pho lun gsum pas sa lbo ye dang ne zi bdag gir bzung ngo // yin na'ang thengs de'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i las 'gul brgyud de i ṭa li'i dkyil dang byang khul gyi tho si khan ne dang / phar mā/ lo man na sogs rgyal khab sār ten gyi khongs su bsdus te/i ṭa li'i dkyil byang don dngos thog gcig gyur byung yod/nā pho lun gsum pa rgyab 'gal byas pa des i ṭa li'i mi dmangs kyi 'thab 'dzing 'gog thub med/ 1860lo'i zla 4par/ si ze le gling phran gyi pa ler mu (9ma0 la0 0oṃ༅)ru 'os langs byung / ka ri pal rdi yis ka lbor la 201

dmag dpung zhig mngags te si ze le'i mi dmangs la rgyab rogs byed rgyu'i re bton yang / ka lbor gyis dang du ma blangs/ ka ri pal rdi yis rang ngos nas dang blangs dmag stong phrag gcig bsdus te gru gzings gnyis su bsdad de kre ni we (66ba0sathamasmokhyayo)'jug ngogs nas rgyang skyod kyi mgo bcoms te si ze le la dpung 'jug byas/ de ni skad grags che ba'i 64stod lwa dmar po'i dmag ’ gi rgyang skyod ces pa de yin/ka ri pal rdi'i stod lwa dmar po'i dmag si ze le nas skam sar bud rjes/mi dmangs kyi dga' bsu chen po thob cing / thung myur du mi grangs stong phrag 'ga' kho'i rgyang skyod dmag nang zhugs/ kha la tha rlem (༈41tholkoḥ)tshur blangs rjes pa ler mu la dpung 'jug byas/ pa ler mu ni si ze le gling phran gyi rgyal sa yin la sa babs btsan pa dang / dgra bo nyis khri lhag gis srung yod/thengs de'i g.yul 'thab khrod ka ri pal rdi yis dmag thabs kyi 'jon thang ches cher mngon te/ khos thog mar mkhar gyi lho nub nas rgol te dgra bo'i dmigs pa der bskor zhing / de nas 'thab zhor 'then zhor gyis dgra bo mkhar dang thag ring sar brid nas rjes 'ded gtong du bcug de nas glo bur du dmag dpung chung chung zhig gis dgra bo der khegs su bcug ste rang nyid kyis gtso shugs khrid nas lam kyag kyog brgyud de bsam yul las 'das pa'i sgo nas mtsho rgyud kyi shar lho'i phyogs nas drag rgol byas pa dang / mkhar nang gi mi dmangs kyis 'os langs gzhogs 'degs byas pas/ ka ri pal rdis stod lwa dmar po'i dmag khrid nas mkhar nang thon la/ pa ler mu nas srang 'thab nyin zhag hril bo gnyis la byas te dgra bo yongs su tshar bcad/khos 66sger gcod lam lugs kyi srung dmag nyis khri yis grangs 'bor mang po med pa'i grong khyer gyi sdod dmangs la mgo mi 'dogs ka med byang ba de ni ngo rwakyi()rwakyi ra

mtshar sgos gleng rin 'dug ’ ces brjod byung /si ze le bcing 'grol byas pa'i rgyal kha rlabs po che des i ṭa li'i mi dmangs la skul lcag chen po thebs shing / gsar brje'i me dpung gang sar mched la/ dmag mi'i dpa' gdeng yang kun nas rgyas su bcug ka ri pal rdi rgyal kha dang bstun nas me ze na (50331ba3 cha.osmokhya)mtsho 'gag brgal te/thad kur du si ze le gnyis kyi rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa na phi le si la dpung 'jug byas/ skabs der ka ri pal di'i stod lwa dmar po'i dmag gi stobs shugs la thags thogs med pas/ lam skabs su dgra dmag gang gis kyang bkag 'gog ma byas par myur du na phi le si la 'byor ba dang / si phen gyi por pon khyim rgyud kyi rgyal rabs rtsa 'thor bzos/ mi dmangs chu bur brdol ba bzhin mkhar nas thon zhing gral phreng bstar te mi rigs kyi dpa' bo 'di la dga' bsu byas/ka ri pal rdi yis 'thab 'dzing khrod byings dang mi 'dra ba'i dmag thabs kyi 'jon thang mngon zhing / kho ni spyang grung kun nas ldan pa'i dmag spyi zhig yin no// de'i mtshungs su/ khos mes rgyal dang mi dmangs la rnam par dag cing shugs drag pa'i lhag bsam zhig bcangs yod la/ i ṭa li'i rgyal khab gcig gyur dang mi rigs bcing 'grol las don la byas rjes khyad 'phags bzhag 'on kyang chab srid steng kho la'ang mig rgyang ring po med par snang ste/ sār ten rgyal por thal drags pa'i sgo nas blo dkar ba dang / na phi le si bcing 'grol byas rjes/ khos ma gzhir spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs te gom gang mdun spos kyis rom la dpung 'jug byas nas mi dmangs kyi 'dun ma ltar i ṭa li gcig gyur byed 'os la/ mā tse ne yis kyang kho la de ltar gdams mod/ 'on kyang khos de ltar ma byas/ de las ldog ste/ na phi le ser 203

bslebs rjes kyi bka' rgya dang po ni si ze le gnyis kyi rgyal khab kyi dmag gru dang tshong gru tshang ma sār ten rgyal khab la brgyud sprod byed rgyu de yin/ de'i rjes su/ kho slar yang ka lbor gyi spyi dmangs la 'dems shog 'phang du bcug ste si ze le gnyis kyi rgyal khab sār ten du 'jug dgos pa'i lta ba la mos mthun byung / ka lpor gyis de mur sār ten gyi dmag dpung lho ru btang nas ka ri pal rdis bcing 'grol byas pa'i sa khul du bslebs/ 1860lo'i zla 11par/ sār ten rgyal po na phi le si la phebs pa na/ ka ri pal rdis srid dbang phul te stod lwa dmar po'i dmag gtor zhing / gyes zhu'i gtam bshad spel/ de'i rjes su dmag mi nyung shas tsam khrid de rang nyid kyis bcing 'grol btang ba'i grong khyer btang ste/ kha phu li gling phran (charsā༅yi)du zhing pa'i 'tsho ba rol du phyin/ i ṭa li'i mi dmangs dang lo rgyus gang zhig gis kyang sger sems dang zhum pa med la/ rang nyid kyi mi tshe gang bo mes rgyal la phul ba'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo 'di brjed mi srid do/ /1861lo'i zla 3par/ i ṭa li rgyal khab thu ren du btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / i ṭa li'i rgyal po ni sār ten rgyal po yin/ 1866lor/phu ro zi dang o si khri ri ya'i g.yul 'khrug langs la/ i ṭa lis phu ro zi la rogs byas te o si khri ri ya pham zhing / we ni se phyir blangs/ rom chos rgyal gyi rgyal khab de da dung i ṭa li'i mnga' khongs su ma 'dus par rang btsan su lus yod/ mi la las rom med na i ṭa li la srog snying med pa dang 'dra zer/1870lor phu ro zi dang hpha ran si'i g.yul 'thab byung zhing / nā pho lun gsum pas rom chos rgyal gyi rgyal khab tu sdod pa'i hpha dmag drangs song ba'i tshe/i ṭa lis skabs glags de spyad nas rom blangs shing / ‘ rmongs dad dang rnam g.yeng che la/ spyang grung chung ba'i ’ chos rgyal tha ma bhe si dgu pa bde 'jags 204

ngang lba te kyang (53 103ba ༅chol)la bskrad/ 1871lor rom i ṭa li'i rgyal sa yin par dril bsgrags/ i ṭa li gcig gyur gyi las don chen po de de nas bzung yongs su grub pa yin/1871lor pha ri si'i krung hre byung zhing / ka ri pal rdi yis spro ba'i sgo nas kung hre'i gsar brje la rgyab skyor byas/ kho kung hre'i tshogs thog tu med bzhin du rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gi spyi khyab chen mor bskos/1882lo'i zla 6tshes 2nyin/ ka ri pal rdi kha phu li gling phran du tshe las 'das shing / skabs der dgung lo 75yin/ 205

nyer gcig pa/ zhon pu ron gyilas don/1859lo'i zla 12tshes 2nyin/ a ri'i khrar le si 'on (063 103 0ba zolo46rsāsmo)btson khang du sma ra ring zhing lo na mtho ba'i rgan po zhig gis rngam brjid can gyi kha chems 'di ltar bzhag ste/ ‘6kho bo ste/ jon pu ron (/06ba8 0yobatram̐gis lolo)bdag da ni khrag dron gyis da gzod rgyal khongs 'di'i nyes pa 'khrud par nus pa la rbad de yid ches song / sngar kho bos khrag shin tu mang po zhig ma bzhur kyang de ltar nus par bsam mod/ da lta bsam tshul de don dngos dang mi mthun pa rtogs song ngo ’ zhes bris tshar rjes/ srog khrims gcod sar 'gying nger byon song / nyin der/ dgun kha'i nyi 'od la drod khol ci yang med cing / sa gzhi yang shin tu lhing 'jags ger 'dug me mda'i kha gri bslangs pa'i rgyal dmangs nyen srung ru khag gi dmag mi sum stong gi ru mtshon gral du bsgrigs pa'i rno dbal ngogs nas kho bag phebs ngang phyin/khos lan len ri rtser rgyang lta byed bzhin dungs pa shin tu zab mo'i sgo nas 8 'di ni mdzes sdug ldan pa'i rgyal khab cig red/ kho bor de ring da gzod don dngos su don 'di rtogs pa'i skal ba ldan byung ’ zhes bshad/gshed mas kho la 8 'gegs thag 'then skabs khyod la brda ster e dgos ’ zhes dris/rgan pos bab brling ngang na mi dgos/ bde myur 'khyug pos bsgrubs pas chog ’ ces lan btab/ 206

dmangs gtso dang rang dbang / dpal yon can du 'bod pa'i a ri nas/ rgan po 'dis yang snying gu yangs gtong thabs bral ba'i nyes pa ci zhig bsags te ya nga ba'i gsod khrims sbyor dgos pa byung ba yin nam zhe na/khul gtso yis khos ‘ mi bsad pa dang / gyen log byas pa/ bran g.yog ngan skul byas te nyes skyon bgyi ru bcug pa'i nya nyes pa yod par gtug yod/ des na nga tshos rgan po 'dis bsags pa ni ji lta bu'i mi bsad gyen log gi nyes pa zhig par blta bar bya la/ gnad don 'di gsal bor bshad ched/ 'dir a me ri kha'i lo rgyus la phyir 'dang rags tsam rgyag go/a me ri kha'i rang btsan g.yul 'thab la rgyal kha thob pa des a ri dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur las thar te/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs shing / a ri'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas kyi gegs rgya gtso bo med par bzos/ lho byang dmag 'khrug gi snga rol tu/ a ri'i lcags kyi thon tshad tun khri brgyad cu gya gsum la bslebs shing / rdo sol tun khri chig stong brgyad brgya la bslebs yod/ lcags lam gyi spyi'i ring tshad spyi le bzhi khri brgyad stong la bslebs pas 'dzam gling gi ang dang po yin/ 'on kyang skabs der a ri'i bzo las kyi brgya cha'i dgu bcu dang / lcags lam gyi sum cha'i gnyis byang khul du 'dus yod la/ lho phyogs su ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo las dang kha sprod du gyur pa'i bran g.yog gi 'debs 'dzugs gzhis ga'i dpal 'byor spel bzhin yod/ rang btsan g.yul 'thab kyis bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gnad don thag chod byung med la/ 〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉〉du bran g.yog gi skor yig 'bru gcig kyang brjod med pa dang /〈〈bsgrags gtam 〉〉'bri mkhan je hpher son rang nyid ni bran g.yog bdag po zhig yin/ de las ldog ste/ a ri rang btsan byas rjes/ bran nag lam 207

lugs de lho khul 'debs 'dzugs gzhis pa'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas phyi phyir je dar du song / 1790lor/ a ri'i bran nag gi mi grangs ni khri drug cu re dgu dang bdun stong yin la/ 1860lor mi khri bzhi brgya la 'phar yod/ bran g.yog yong khungs gnyis yod de/ gcig ni hphe gling nas nyo 'dren byed pa yin te/ 186)lo gcig pu'i nang yang khri nyer lnga la bslebs yod pa dang / gzhan zhig ni skye 'phel yin/ bran g.yog bdag pos lus sha rgyas pa'i pho bran rnams 6‘rgyud spel mi nag tu byas te dud 'gro bzhin gzhis ka so sor khrid de ru sdeb sbyor ’ byed la/ mi nag bud med rnams ‘ mo phyugs ’ su byas te btsan thabs kyis bu phrug skye ru 'jug go thos ltar na mo bran zhig yod pa des mtshe ma bstud mar skyes te/ kho mo rang lo zhe gcig lon skabs phru gu bzhi bcu zhe gcig skyes yod skad do//bran nag rnams gtso bo lho khul 'debs 'dzugs gzhis ku'i dpal 'byor phyogs bkol/ kho tshos snga langs 'phyi nyal sgos nyin re bzhin ngal rtsol dus tshod bco brgyad nas bcu dgu la byed dgos/ 1860lor/ bran nag gcigagis thon skyed byas pa'i thon thang a sgor chig stong bzhi brgya nas nyis stong bar yin la/ kho tshor lo gcig la thob pa'i cha snyoms 'tsho ba'i gron dngul a sgor nyi shu tsam las med/ 1860lo'i skabs su/ a ri'i bran g.yog 'debs 'dzugs gzhis gas sring bal kho na thum khri lnga brgya thon skyed byas la/sring bal phyir gtong byas pa'i yong 'bab a sgor dung phyur gsum dang khri sum stong yod pa des phyir gtong spyi'i thon 'bab kyi brgya cha'i nga bdun zin yod/a ri'i 'debs 'dzugs gzhis ku'i bran g.yog lam lugs de ni gna' rabs kyi bran g.yog lam lugs dang mi mtshungs la/ rang btsan kyi spyi tshogs rnam pa zhig kyang ma yin par/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor la brten 208

cing gnas pa'i dug skran zhig red/ yin na'ang bran g.yog gi go gnas ni gna' rabs bran g.yog dang bsdur na mi 'dra ba chen po med/ kho tsho ni bran g.yog bdag po'i nom pa yin te/ tshong zog dang sgo phyugs ltar ci 'dod du nyo tshong dang / lcag gis gzhu ba sogs gcar rdung yang byed chog pa zhig yin/'dir kho pa tshos ji ltar rang nyid kyi nom rdzas gson po de dag nyo tshong byed par blta bar bya'o//‘ ltos dang / sus gong ster rgyu ri nyo 'bod kyi khrod du mi nag bud med cig nyo stegs su khrid 'ong la/ nyo stegs de ni don dngos thog cog tse zhig red/ kho mo'i skyes pa stegs bu'i gsham du langs yod/ kho mo'i rkang lag bzhi bo gtum spyod kyis stegs bu'i gsham gyi nyo mkhan tshor ston du 'jug nyo mkhan gyis rta la dpyad pa bzhin du kho mor reg pa dang rdeb pa/ lta rtog byed la/ bed spyod pa'i tha snyad kyang rta dpyad skabs spyod pa dag las ma 'das/ring po ma 'gyangs par kho mo btsong song / de nas kho mo'i skyes pa stegs bur kri/ da pa na/ khos re ba'i mig gis rang gi chung ma nyo mkhan gyi mi der lta bzhin kho nyo ba'i re ba zhus na'ang / kho mi gzhan zhig gis nyos song / khos bdag po gsar bar zhu ba byas te rang gi chung ma dang lag 'ju'i sgo nas gyes tshig brjod chog par zhus kyang / 'dod thog tu 'gror ma bcug kho shin tu sdug bsngal gyi nyams kyis mdun phyogs su rgyugs pa na bdag po gsar bas khro rngam chen pos lcag gis lan 'ga' gzhus/ kho'i sems shugs nyams te/ shi bo bzhin bdag po gsar ba'i rkang 'og tu 'gyel/ 'di ni skye khungs bran g.yog yin pa'i bran gtor ring lugs pa zhig gis brjod pa'i dper brjod cig red/ 'di lta bu'i nyo tshong byed tshul ni skabs de'i a rir rgyun du mthong thub/bros byol ni bran g.yog gis rgyun du spyod pa'i ngo rgol byed thabs shig 209

yin/ de bas skabs der a ri'i tshags par steng bros shor gyi bran g.yog 'dzin rgyu'i bsgrags yig gang sar bkod yod pa ni dper na deng dus kyi nub gling spyi tshogs kyi tshong las bsgrags yig dang gnyis su med/ dbyin ji'i rtsom pa po tis khen si (96371— 01050 3 7zolo)yis 1842lor a rir ltad bzhud byas rjes 〈〈a rir bzhud pa 〉〉zhes pa bris shing / de'i khrod bsgrags yig de rigs mang po bkod yod de/ 'dir 'ga' zhig bkod na/‘6lo na 12yas mas kyi mi nag byis pa zhig bros song / kho'i mgrin pa na khyi'i ming rtags can gyi phreng ba zhig bskon yod la/ byang rtags de'i steng ‘ti lang phe thi ’zhes pa'i yi ge bris yod/’ 6 kho bo'i bran g.yog e sa thi 'dzin thub pa la a sgor nyer lnga'i bya dga' ster rgyu yin/ kho'i mgrin par rma shul chen po zhig yod la/ rgyab tu dkrum mdas rmas shul zhig yod/’ ru mi nag byis mo zhig bros song ba'i ming la mā re zer/ kho mo'i mig gi gong du rma shul zhig yod la/ so mang po zhig lhung yod/ 'gram pa dang thod par gsal byed yi sreg tham bkod yod/’ khrag dri 'thul ba'i bsgrags yig 'di dag mthong ba na/ bran g.yog bdag po'i gtum drag dang bran g.yog gi sdug bsngal ji 'dra yin tshul gyi tshig gzhan gcig kyang ci la dgos te mi dgos so// bran g.yog bdag po'i gtum drag gi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog gis bran g.yog gi ngo rgol drag po slong nges can red/ don dngos steng /1619lor bran nag skor dang po wer ke ne'u khul du skyel 'dren byas pa nas bzung / bran g.yog gi ngo rgol 'thab 'dzing gtan nas 'chad ma myong /brol byol 'thab 'dzing de thog mar kher rkyang du bros byol byed pa nas phyis su 210

rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas bros byol byed par gyur/ de dag las shugs rkyen ches che ba ni dus rabs 19pa'i stod du dar ba'i 88sa 'og lcags lam ri las 'gul zhes pa de yin/ ‘8sa 'og lcags lam ’ zhes pa ni gsang rgya dam po can gyi rtsa 'dzugs shig yin la/ des ched dmigs sgos bran nag bros byol byed par rogs 'degs byed pa dang / kho tsho bde blag ngang byang khul gyi rang dbang sa khul lam yang na khe na ṭa (03ba36sku shākhyanghru7)la skyel/ 88sa 'og lcags lam ’ gyi 88las 'dzin pa ’rtani bros byol la rtsa 'dzugs byed mkhan yin la/ ‘6me 'khor zhabs zhu ba ’ ni lam khrid pa/ 88mgron po ’ ni bros byol byed mkhan bran g.yog ‘ 'bab tshigs mi ni lam skabs su za 'dug 'don sprod byed mkhan gyi bar lam tshigs mal yin no// 88sa 'og lcags lam ’ dar ba'i skabs su las byed mi sna sum stong yod myong / 1810lo nas 1850lo'i bar brag nag khri bcu ‘ sa 'og lcags lam ’ brgyud de bran g.yog bdag po'i lag 'og nas thar ro// bran g.yog 'bor chen bros byol byas pa'i dus mtshungs su/ bran g.yog gi 'os langs kyang rgyun du byung / sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ rang btsan g.yul 'thab nas lho byang g.yul 'thab kyi snga rol bar du rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i bran nag 'os langs thengs brgya dang drug cu lhag byung / dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs 50pa nas bzung / bran nag gi 'os langs 'thab rtsod phyi phyir je mang du phyin/ lo rabs 50par khan sa si (53ba3ཿ 7lo༅)khul du mi rgyus med gnyis lhan du 'phrad pa dang / ngo 'phrad pa'i gus srol la nam rgyun phan tshun bo'u kha gotad de 'di ltar du/ bran g.yog lam lugs la gong bkur byed dam ngo rgol byed/ ces 'dri/ lan btab rjes rgyun par me mda' rgyag de las a ri'i rgyal nang du bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gnad don gyis 211

bslangs pa'i chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod shin tu dza drag che ba de shes thub/ jon pu ron ni de lta bu'i gnas babs shig khrod mi nag dang mi dkar skor zhig gi 'go khrid nas 'os langs byas pa yin no//jon pu ron ni mi rgyud dkar po'i khyim tshang dbul bo zhig tu skyes/kho'i mes po rang btsan g.yul 'khrug la zhugs myong ba dang / pha ni brag gtor ring lugs pa hur thag can zhig yin pas/ kho tshang ‘4sa 'og lcags lam ’ kyi 66bar lam tshigs mal ’ du gyur/ khyim tshang gi shugs rkyen 'og pu ron chung dus nas bran g.yog la snying rje che zhing / dar la babs rjes hur thag gis bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing du zhugs/phyis su kho'i bu dang mag pa yang bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi gdong len pa brtan po zhig tu gyur/1858lo'i zla 5par/ pu ron gyis khe na ṭa'i khra thi mu zhes par gsang ba'i gros tshogs bsdus te gsar brje'i rtsa 'dzugs btsugs pa dang / 'os langs kyi 'char gzhi gtan 'khel byas la/ kho spyi khyab bkod 'doms par bsko bzhag byas/ khos da dung ma 'ongs pa'i gsar brje'i srid gzhung la gnas skabs kyi rtsa khrims shig bzos yod la/ de'i nang du/ 8 bran g.yog ni rang btsan dang rang dbang yin la de ltar yin kyang 'os te/ 'jig rten byed po'i gtan du 'gyur ba med pa'i bca' khrims su mi re re tshang ma rang btsan dang rang dbang yin pa'i re ba bton yod pa ji bzhin no ’ zhes gsal bor bstan yod/ 'os langs 'char gzhi de khongs mi rnam dag ma yin pa byung ba dang / gron dngul dkon pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis mngon du 'gyur ma thub/ 1859lo'i zla 10tshes 16nyin/ lus po zhan la nad mang zhing lo na 59la son pa'i pu ron gyis mi nyer gnyis yod pa'i dpung khag cig khrid de/212

wer ke ne'u khul gyi hār phu si (5tha ༅ 3 ṣāḥ༅)gru kha ru 'os langs byas/'os langs khrod kyi mi gsum ni kho'i bu yin/ kho tshos mdel rdzas mdzod khang 'phrog la/ bran g.yog bdag po bzung nas grong brdal de dbang du bzung /'on kyang sngon la 'char gzhi zhib tshags med pa dang / mang tshogs skul slong gi bya ba ma bsgrub pa'i rkyen gyis 'os langs dpung khag mgyogs myur ngang rgya bskyed ma byung bar ma zad/ de las ldog ste dgra bos mgyogs myur ngang dmangs dmag chig stong lhag dang dmag dpon hra'o zho zhig gis bkod 'doms byas pa'i mtsho dmag brgyad cu bsdus yong ste 'os langs pa rnams bskor/'os langs pas nyin zhag gnyis la dpa' ngar gyis 'thab 'dzing byas la/ pu ron gyis dpa' ngar bskyed de 'thab cing / lus la rmas skyon lci mo thengs 'ga' byung / ches mjug mthar/ kho g.yul ngor 'das pa'i bu zhig gi gam du 'greng ste/ lag gcig gis srog 'chad la nye ba'i bu gzhan zhig gi khrag rtsa gnon gyin lag gzhan zhig gis me mda' btegs nas dgra bor brgyab/ 'os langs de mthar thug mang sna nyung gis ma brten par pham mo//pu ron bzung rjes dgra bos kho la 'dri rgyur/ 8 khyod kyi dmigs yul ci yin/’ ‘8kho bo ni bran g.yog bcings 'grol gtong du yong ba yin/ ’ ‘8gal te khyod kyis rang nyid ni ngan skul pa zhig dang / gyen log pa zhig yin pa mi shes sam/’ 88kho bos bran g.yog bcings 'grol don du gnyer ba yin/’ khrims khang du/ pu ron gyis dag sel byas te bshad rgyur/ ‘8ngas dbul bo'i ched 'thab 'dzing byas pa yin la/ kho bos bltas na 'di ni drang 213

don zhig yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho tshang ma khyod tsho'i khrod kyi mi su zhig las kyang tha shal zhig ma yin pas so// da lta/ gal te drang don gyi las don gom gang mdun spos kyis skul spel byed pa'i ched du kho bo'i tshe srog gtong dgos pa byung na/ kho bos phangs sems ci yang med par tshe srog 'bul nges yin ’nyazhes bshad do//pu ron shi ba yis a ri'i mi dmangs khri stong mang po sad du bcug la/bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing la gom gang mdun spos kyis skul 'ded byas so// bran gtor ring lugs pa grags can zhig gis 'di ltar bshad de/ ‘6dus skabs 'dir nga tshor thob pa'i bslab bya ni gyen rgol byed pa de yin ’ zhes so// pu ron shi ba'i phyi lor lin khon ( 6126thayi 61sa0010 oṃ6)a ri'i tsung thung du bdams/ ring po ma 'gor bar/ 'ur 'ur zing zing gi a ri'i lho byang g.yul 'thab byung ste/nyes pa stong ldan gyi bran g.yog lam lugs de g.yul 'thab 'di'i khrod du dur sbed byas so// pu ron shi ba las mched pa'i a ri'i bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i las 'gul de ni skabs de'i 'dzam gling steng byung ba'i ches rlabs che ba'i don chen zhig yin no//214

nyer gnyis pa/ yin khon —skye khungs ches dman pa'i a ri'i tsung thung /jon pu ron 'chi ba la 'jigs skrag ci yang med par gsod khrims gcod sar 'gro ba'i skabs de ni/ lin khon gyis hur thag sgos a ri'i tsung thung skabs bcu drug pa 'dems 'gran byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i tsung thung des pu ron gyi 'os langs la ji ltar lta'am zhe na/ skabs der pu ron gyi bran g.yog lam lugs la rgol ba'i 'thab 'dzing la yi rang byed cing / kho'i mi gshis la mos gus byed mod/ 'on kyang / khos bltas na 8 pu ron gyi 'jab rgol ni nor 'khrul yin te/ rgyu mtshan gnyis yod/ rgyu mtshan dang po ni de bca' khrims dang 'gal yod pa dang / rgyu mtshan gnyis pa ni de yang 'jab rgol gzhan dag thams cad dang 'dra bar/ nyes pa tshabs chen gang zhig kyang med par gtong mi nus so ’ zer/ de las gsal bor rtogs thub pa ni/ lin khon gyis drag thabs la brten nas bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed par ngo rgol byed do/ 'di ni lin khon gyis nang 'khrug ma byung sngon la 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i rnam 'gyur red ces brjod chog yin na'ang /skabs de ra a ri'i gdong gtad pa'i gnad don ni/ bran g.yog lam lugs gang byung mched du bcug nas mna' 'brel gyi mnga' khongs yongs su dar du 'jug gam/ yang na bezo las ma rtsa ring lugs la lho phyogs bcos bsgyur byed du 'jug rgyu de yin/ lo rgyus kyi gdam ga de lta bu zhig gi 'gag mdo nas/drag thabs spyod rgyu yin min ni nam rgyun mi'i blo mos kyis thag gcod mi nus 215
