pa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ don dngos kyang de ltar red/ lo rgyus kyis lin khon gyi sna drangs te dpa' bo zhig gi ngang tshul ston du bcug la/ zhi bde'i lam nas 'gal 'du thag gcod dgos par lta ba'i mi sna 'di drag po'i g.yul 'thab kyi gdong sner bkod do//a pu ra hām lin khon ( 6 353la 61sa001ba a/khri7༅ oṃzlo)ni 1809lo'i zla 2tshes 12nyin a ri'i khen tha ke (50sa 00khu7 dzilo6)khul gyi zhing ba dbul bo zhig gi khyim du skyes/ kho'i pha'i ming la thom zi lin khon (1604ཿ ༅1ba00/sa)zer zhing / sa rgod zhing sar slog mkhan stobs can zhig dang shing bzo zhig yin/ kho'i mes po'i ming la'ang a pu ra hām lin khon zer la/ rang btsan g.yul 'thab skabs su dmangs dmag gi dmag dpon hrang we zhig yin/ mes tsha gnyis ming gcig pa de krung gor mtshon na blor 'char dka' ba zhig yin tshod 'dugalin khon chung dus nas ngal rtsol du zhugs te/ chu 'khur ba dang bud shing gshags pa/ yur ma yur rogs sogs byas shing / lo bcu lhag la bud skabs pha la rogs byas te sdong bo gcod pa dang / sa rgod slog pa/ zhing 'debs pa sogs byas/ ngal tshegs che ba'i zhing las kyi 'tsho thabs kyis kholi'agyur med sra brtan gyi gshis khar sbyong brdar thebs la/ gzhungs drang dang dka' spyad kyi gshis ka bzang po yang goms su bcug— lin khon lo 9la son skabs/ kho'i ma tshe las 'das shing / ring po ma 'gyangs par phas bu phrugagasum gyi ma ru gyur yod pa'i yugs mo zhig ma yar du blangs/ ma༄ra de'i ngang rgyud 'jam zhing / lin khon ming sring tshor rang gis dngos su skyes pa ltar gces pa dang / nang sgos su lin khon la byams po yod cing / kho la slob sbyong legs po byed rgyu'i skul ma rgyun du gtong / lin khon la de'i shugs rkyen 216

zab mo thebs yod la/ phyis su'ang de nam rgyun gleng bar byed/ lin khon gyis mtshams chad kyin chad kyin slob grwa 'grims myong mod / khos bshad pa ltar na bsdoms tshe'ang lo gcig tsam yang mi longs zer/ khos gtso bo dka' spyad kyis rang sbyong byas pa yin/ chung dus bye thang dang gangs kyi steng du yi ge bris pa yin te/ bris rjes bsubs la/ bsubs rjes slar yang bris/ ngal rtsol gyi khom skabs su khos nam rgyun dpe cha klog 'don byed/ phyis su khos bshad rgyur/ kho'i rig gnas yon tan ni ‘6gang byung du btus pa ’ yin zer/lin khon nar son rjes/ shing gshags te ra ba skor mkhan dang / gru ba/ yig skyel ba/ sa zhing 'jal mkhan/ tshong g.yog bcas byed myong la/dmag mi yang byed myong / phyis su khos tsung thung 'gran 'dems byed skabs mi la las kho la ‘6shing gshag ra ba bskor ba'i gdam zhugs pa ’ dang /88gzhungs drang ba'i a pu nya zhes zer/ lin khon gzhungs drang ba ni skad du grags yod/ kho tshong g.yog byed skabs/ thengs shig la bud med cig gis skar 'ga' lhag mar byin yod pa shes rjes/ khos skar de 'ga' phyir sprod ched dbyin le drug gi lam thag la ma 'dzem par song / yang thengs shig khos nyo mkhan zhig la ja yang se bzhi ①nyung ngur gzhal song ba shes rjes dbyin le 'ga'i lam thag tu song nas kha gsab byas/ kho lo 27skabs su/ rgyugs sprad pa brten nas dag sel pa'i las btags thob/ phyis su lo ngo nyi shur dag sel pa byed skabs su/ kho gzhungs bzang dang drang po yin pa las skad du grags yod do//1834lor lin khon we ki (yo51 rtsa ཿcho)tang la zhugs/ 1834 lo () ha lam srang gnyis dang 'dra/ 217

nas 1842lo'i bar/ khos skabs bzhi la e le no si (1111sa013 77/ oṃ7)khul gyi gros mi bstud mar khur/ skabs der/ khos chab srid kyi steng nas bran g.yog lam lugs rgya bskyed par ngo rgol byas mod/ 'on kyang kho ni bran gtor ring lugs pa zhig min/ khos bltas na ‘8bran g.yog lam lugs ni gzhungs drang ma yin zhing nor 'khrul gyi chab srid rmang gzhi'i steng btsugs pa zhig yin kyang / bran gtor gyi lta ba bsgrags spel byas na bran g.yog lam lugs kyi nyes pa 'phar snon gtong ba las je nyung du gtong mi thub ’ par 'dod/1846lor lin khon e le no si khul gyi we ki tang gi rgyal tshogs gros mi gcig pur 'dems thon byung / kho rgyal tshogs gros mir 'dems thon byung ba'i skor la gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig khyab yod de/ len khon chos lugs kyi 'du tshogs shig la zhugs/ tshogs 'dur 'go 'dzin mkhan gyi chos 'chad pa de ni kho'i 'gran ya yin/ chos 'chad pa des mang po zhig brjod rjes su/8 rang sems dkon mchog la 'bul 'dod mkhan dang lha yul du bgrod 'dod mkhan thams cad yar la bzhengs rogs zhu ’ zhes brjod pa na/ mi rnams tha thor du langs byung / yang khos ‘8dmyal khams su lhung mi 'dod mkhan tshang ma yar la bzhengs rogs zhu mi zhes brjod pa na mi rnams myur du yar la langs shing / lin khon gcig pu tsog nas bsdad/ chos 'chad pa shin tu ya mtshan nas 'dri rgyur/ 6 sku zhabs lin khon lags/ kho bos khyod la dri ba zhig 'don chog gam/ khyod gang la 'gro rgyu yin nam ’ zhes dris pa na/lin khon gyis lan du 88kho bos bltas na chos lugs steng gi gnad don la bsam gzhigs nan mo byed dgos/ nga la gang du 'gro rgyu zhes dris na/ngas ha cang drang mo'i sgo nas lan 'debs 'dod de/ nga rgyal tshogs su 'gro 218

'dod do ’ zhes smras/1856lor/ lin khon spyi mthun tang du zhugs/ spyi mthun tang ni 1854lor gsar du tshugs pa yin la/ ring po ma 'gor bar 'byor ldan gral rim gyis dbang bzung / tang des bran g.yog lam lugs rgya bskyed par tshod 'dzin byed pa'i re ba 'don/ 1858lor len khon gyis spyi mthun tang gi tshab byas nas dmangs gtso tang gi si te hphin to ki la zi (ba00phya1tha33 4tshozo ༅khi4༅)dang e le no si khul gyi mna' 'brel gros mi 'gran 'dems byas la/phyogs gnyis nas 'chad 'gran thengs shig byas/ lin khon gyis skad grags che ba'i 88khyim tshang gyes thor ’ zhes pa'i gtam bshad spel/ khos 64rang mir dgra ru lta ba'i khyim tshang zhig yun ring du gnas thabs bral/ kho bo la yid ches yod pa zhig ni/ bran bkol phyed tsam dang rang dbang phyed tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng / srid gzhung 'di yang yun ring gnas mi srid pa de yin/ kho bos mna' 'brel 'thor zhig tu gyur na mi 'dod la/ khyim tshang 'thor zhig tu 'gyur bar re ba mi byed/ 'on kyang kho bos dngos gnas de 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba mtshams bcad na 'dod do ’ zhes bshad/ lin khon gyis gtam bshad 'di'i nang rtsal du bton nas gsal bshad byed 'dod pa ni/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur la nges par du srung skyob byed dgos pa dang /bran g.yog lam lugs de rang ngos nas byung zhing rang ngos nas med par 'gro ru 'jug 'os mod/ 'on kyang de rgya bskyed pa nges par du 'gog dgos pa de yin/ skabs der lin khon gyi ming grags de 'dra chen po med la/ to ki la zi ni skad grags chen po yod pa zhig yin/ mthar to ki la zi la rgyal kha thob/gros mi 'gran 'dems de'i khrod lin khon pham na yang / kho'i chab srid kyi lta ba la spyi mthun tang mi'i mos mthun chen po thob/ 1860lor/ lin 219

khon spyi mthun tang gi tsung thung gi gdam byar 'dems/ spyi mthun tang gi phyogs ni tang gsar mi gsar yin zhes bshad chog la/ dmangs gtso'i tang gi phyogs kyi gdam bya ni ming thob mtho ba'i to ki la zi yin te/ lin khon gyi e le no si khul gyi 'gran ya rnying ba de yin/ to ki la zi yis bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gnad don thad ngo gnyis ma'i langs phyogs bzung bas/ mjug 'bras ni phyogs gnyis gang yang dga' bo ma byung / lin khon gyis spyang grung ldan pa'i sgo nas kho dang to ki la zi gnyis kyis e le no si khul gyi gros mi 'gran 'dems byed skabs kyi rtsod gzhi ste 〈〈lin khon/deto ki la zi'i rtsod gleng phyogs bsdus 〉〉zhes pa par du bskrun te dril bsgrags byas/ mtha' 'bras ni/thengs 'dir lin khon pham kha nas rgyal khar gyur te a me ri kha'i tsung thung skabs bcu drug par bdams so//lin khon gyi rgyal kha yis gtso bo bzo las 'byor ldan gral rim gyi stobs shugs che ba mtshon pa yin/ srid dbang rtsod pa'i gnad don steng / skabs de'i 'byor ldan gral rim dang bran g.yog bdag po ni phan tshun dgra ru lta zhing phan tshun bzod sgom gtan nas mi byed/ lin khon tsung thung du bdams rjes stobs shugs do snyoms gtor nas/ 'gal 'du dang phog thug de dza drag shin tu che bar phyin/ lin khon bdams thon byung rjes bshad rgyur/ ‘4kho bo ni tsung thung gi khri thog tu bsko bzhag byas pa'i mi rnams khrod skye khungs ches dman pa zhig yin/ yin na'ang kho bos 'grub dgos pa'i 'gan khur de kho tsho su zhig dang bsdur na'ang lci zhing tshegs che zhes bshad la/ don dngos su'ang de ltar 'dug lin khon bdams thon byung ba'i gnas tshul khyab par gyur pa na/ lho phyogs bran g.yog bdag pos gtum zil ston gyin 'ud 'di ltar brgyab ste /220

‘6lin khon la ngo rgol byed pa ni dkon mchog la gus 'dud byed pa yin ’ zhes dang / kho tsho'i dmag dpung gis ‘8dbyin khru bcu phrug gi mthug tshad longs la sha khrag nyog pa'i bem po rdzi bzhin ’ thad kur du rgyal tshogs kyi tshoms chen mdun sgor 'gro rgyu yin la/ ‘ lho khul ni nam yang a pu ra hām lin khon gyis dbang bzung ba 'di lta bu'i brnyas bcos dang ngo tsha'i mdun du zhum 'dud byed pa min no ) zhes 'ud brgyab/ lin khon gyis da dung dam bca' bzhag nas 'gan dngos su ma khur gong du/ lho khul gyi khul bcu gcig gis snga gzhug tu mna' 'brel dang kha gyes pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / mngon sum du kha bral gyi dar cha sgreng ste lho khul gyi mna' 'brel btsugs la/ bran g.yog bdag po chen po je dhe we si (101107300 ba3ma13 nga matram̐khrilo)tsung thung du bdams/ zla 3tshes 4nyin/ lin khon gyis dam bcas nas tsung thung gi 'gan khur/ zla 4tshes 12nyin/ lho phyogs ngo log dmag gis thog dang por dpung 'jug byas te/ sam thir (bya5la/0 lo7༈sto)mkhar rdzong la sgyogs rdung byas shing nang 'khrug dngos su langs/ zla 4tshes 15nyin/ lin khon gyis dang blangs dmag bsdus nas zing 'khrug drag gnon byed rgyu'i bsgrags yig spel/'ur 'ur zing zing gi a ri'i lho byang g.yul 'thab dus yun lo ngo bzhi ste/1861lo'i zla 4pa nas 1865lo'i zla 4pa'i bar brgyab/ de ni a ri'i lo rgyus steng rang btsan g.yul 'thab kyi phyis su byung ba'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje thengs gnyis pa yin/ g.yul 'thab kyi ngo bo'i cha nas bshad na/byang khul ni drang phyogs pa yin/ des bran g.yog lam lugs med par btang zhing / a ri'i marna' 'brel gyi gcig gyur srung skyob byas/ phyogs gnyis kya'i stobs shugs gshib bsdur gyi cha nas bshad na/ byang khul de lho khul las chen 221

po yod/ yin na'ang / g.yul 'thab kyi thog ma'i dus su/ 7mna' 'brel srid gzhung gi dmag dpung la bstud mar pham kha reg 1861lo'i zla 7pa dang 1862lo'i zla 7par/ phyogs gnyis kya'i dmag dpung wa hrin thon lho —nub kyi pul ron (6511 55ba oṃlokhya)gtsang bor g.yul bkyes pa na byang khul gyi dmag thengs gnyis kur pham 'then byed dgos pa byung / mna' 'brel dmag gi pham kha de dmag don thad kyi bkod 'doms ma legs pa dang g.yul gyi dus babs nar 'gyangs shor ba sogs kyi rkyen la rag las pa las gzhan/ ches gtso bo zhig ni lin khon dang srid gzhung ni bran nag bcings 'grol gtong ba'i gnad don thad the tshom dang g.yo 'gul gyi tshul du gnas pa de yin/ kho tshos rgya che ba'i sgo nas mang tshogs skul slong byed mi phod la/skabs shig ring bran g.yog bcings 'grol gtong ba sogs gsar brje'i byed thabs spyad de stobs shugs rtsa 'dzugs sgos bran g.yog lam lugs dur sbed bya rgyu'i blo thag chod ma nus/ 1862lo'i zla 8par/ lin khon gyis mi zhig la springs pa'i 'phrin du da dung kho'i 88dmigs 'ben thog ma ni mna' 'brel skyob pa yin pa las/ bran g.yog lam lugs skyob pa'am gtor ba ni ma yin no ’ zhes bshad yod/ yin na'ang / mi dmangs mang tshogs mna' 'brel srid gzhung gi 'dod mos dang 'gal te gsar brje'i las don gting zab tu spel/ g.yul 'thab langs pa'i rjes su/ rgya che ba'i mi nag rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud du dmag nang zhugs pa dang / bran g.yog 'bor chen skor skor du gzhis ka dang gyes nas g.yul ngor zhugs/ kho tsho byang khul dmag dang lhan du mdun du bskyod la/ mtshams la lar bros yong ba'i bran g.yog gi mi grangs kyis dmag dpung gi phyed kha'ang zin/ g.yul gyi mdun sa'i dmag dpon la las kyang 222

dmag don gyi gnas babs kyi dbang gis nam rgyun mna' 'brel srid gzhung gi bka' dang 'gal te bran nag dmag dpung du bsdu bzhin yod do// rgya che ba'i bran gtor ring lugs pa'i 'thab mo ba dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi yar thon gleng phyogs rnams kyis kyang bran g.yog lam lugs med par gtong rgyu dang /mi nag la drag chas spras rgyu'i re ba shugs drag 'don/ mi nag gi mgo pa zhig gis mi sems 'gul ba'i gtam brjod 'di ltar byas yod de/ 88 ‘skabs glags ni 'chor mi 'os shing / shor ba na slar thob par mi 'gyur rizhes pa ltar/ ‘mi dkar gyis nga tshor byin pa'i rang dbang de ni 'od mdangs phyed ka nyams pa zhig yin la mi ‘rang dbang 'thob 'dod na/ nges par du rang nyid kyis 'thab 'dzing byed dgos/ rang dbang gi slad du 'chi ba las/ bran du bkol bzhin gson 'dod med/) tshig 'di dag ni nga tsho'i dpa' ngar ldan pa'i mi nag cig gi sems gtam red do ’ zhes bshad/ gsar brje'i mtho rlabs drag po de yis lin khon la rim bzhin du 88gal te byang khul gyis mgyogs por gsar brje'i byed thabs ma spyad na/ rdung rdeg gnad du phog pa zhig thebs nges yin ’ pa rtogs par gyur pas/ lin khon thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i gom pa zhig spos par gyur te/ 1862lo'i zla 9tshes 22nyin 〈〈bran nag bcing 'grol gtong ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉〉spel te bran g.yog khri phrag bzhi brgya bcing 'grol btang / de'i sngon du khos da dung 〈〈gzhis zhing bca' khrims 〉〉zhes pa bkram la/ de'i thag bcad ltar na/ nub khul du song nas sa rgod slog pa'i re ba zhu mkhan a ri'i spyi dmangs shig yin phyin/ mi res a sgor bcu yi lag 'khyer sgrub yon sprad pa na dbyin mu'u brgya dang drug cu'i sa zhing rmon 'debs byed chog la/ bdag gnyer lo ngo lnga la byas rjes rmon 'debs pa la dbang ba yin no zhes bkod yod/ lin khon ni a ri'i lo 223

rgyus thog gi mi rlabs chen zhig yin/ kho rlabs che ba ni khos lo rgyus gsar du bskrun pa ma yin te de ni dpe mi srid/ kho rlabs che ba ni kho lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs dang mi sems kyi mos phyogs dang bstun pa de'i cha na yod/ de nas bzung / lho byang g.yul 'thab dus rim gsar ba zhig la bslebs/1863lo'i zla 7par/ mna' 'brel srid gzhung la shar phyogs kyi ki the si rdzong (60 7360 rtsatho3rhalo༅)dang nub phyogs kyi we khi si rdzong (5106bya65 6tram̐ṣṭham༅ཿ)du bstud mar rgyal kha chen po thob ste/ g.yul 'thab kyi gnas babs rtsa ba nas 'gyur/ mi nag khri phrag nyer gsum mna' 'brel dmag tu zhugs shing /kho tsho dpa' ngar che zhing g.yul la 'jon pa dang / dka' tshegs dang 'chi bar mi skrag pa'i sgo nas mi nag gi dpa' bo'i rang gshis mngon par mtshon/1864lo'i zla 11par/ rgyal kha'i skya rengs mdun ngo na 'od du 'tsher ba'i skabs su/ len khon thengs gnyis par tsung thung du bdams/1865lo'i zla 4tshes 3nyin/ mna' 'brel dmag gis lho khul mna' 'brel gyi rgyal sa ris khri man (5106la0ba6 tsho ཿ)blangs/ zla 4tshes 9nyin lho phyogs dmag mgo btags/ rgyal khab yongs su rgyal kha la rten 'brel zhu ba'i dga' spros khengs pa'i sgang der 8 thag ’ ces me mda'i skad cig grags shing / nag nyes brjod kyis mi lang ba'i mde'u zhig lin khon gyi klad rgyab tu 'dzul zhing /dus rabs shig gi rlabs chen mi sna de bsgyel byung ngo // don de ni rgyal kha thob rjes kyi nyin lnga pa ste/ 1865lo'i zla 4tshes 14nyin yin/bshad na mi rnams mi rlom tshod du 'dug ste/ lin khon lkog gsod byas pa'i nyin gnyis gsum zhig gi sngon/ kho rang dngos kyis nye 'khor rnams kyi 'du tshogs shig steng rmi lam ngan pa zhig bshad/ 64'di phyogs shin tu lhing 'jags red/ kho bos rmi lam khrod mi mang po zhig ngu skad 'don pa thos la/224

ngus pa shin tu skyo bo yod/ kho bo'i bsam par/ de ni ci'i phyir yin nam snyam/ de bas/ kho bo rang nyid kyi khang pa nas sgor bud/ phyi'i khang pa na 'gyogs byams shig bzhag yod la/de'i steng na bem po zhig yod pa'i mthar mi tshogs kyis bskor nas ngu bzhin yod/kho bos dmag mi zhig la ci'i phyir ngu ba dris pa na/ dmag mi des lan 'debs rgyur/ ‘tsung thung lkog gsod byas lin khon/song ’zer ’ zhes bshad/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su/ len khon gyi rmi lam ngan pa de ya nga ba'i dngos don du gyur ro//lkog gsod pa de'i ming la jon wel po zi (106 smyo11khuḥ 800 6 ༅ ༅ ༅ thulo)zer zhing / kho 'khrab ston pa byed myong la/ bran g.yog lam lugs kyi blo dkar ba'i srung skyob pa zhig dang / srog la mi 'dzem pa'i smyo ham can zhig yin/ khos bran g.yog lam lugs la ngo rgol byed mkhan tshang mar sdang sems 'chang / jon pu ron gyis rang srog blos gtong skabs/ kho pa ched dmigs kyis gsod khrims gcod sar song nas gshed ma la ngar slong byas myong / len khon gyis 'go khrid pa'i a ri'i mi dmangs kyis nyes dgu 'dzoms pa'i bran g.yog lam lugs dur sbed byas pa la po zi khro ba rus gting du zug pa skyes te/ lin khon lkog gsod byas te bran g.yog bcing 'grol btang ba'i 'khon lan slog rgyu'i sems thag bcad yod/ zla 4tshes 14nyin gyi nyin gung / khos tsung thung dgung mor hphu thi 'khrab ston khang du gar la lta ru 225

phebs rgyu yin pa thos pas/ de ma nyid du 'khrab ston khang gi sa babs la bltas te mgyogs myur ngang gra sgrig byas/ gar 'khrab ston byed mgo brtsams rjes/ po zi yis bar khyams na yod pa'i tsung thung gi sku srung ba zhig chang 'thung du song ba'i go skabs bed spyad de mgyogs myur ngang tsung thung gi zur bzhugs khang pa der brgyugs nas nyes can gyi me mda' de brgyab pa red/lin khon gyi bem po kho'i pha yul gyi cha ra'i nags sgang gi bang sor bcug yod/ 'das skyel byed pa'i me 'khor wa hrin thon nas chas te dbyin le chig stong bdun brgya'i lam thag brgyud pa de ni/ khos lo ngo bzhi yi sngon rgyal sar phebs te tsung thung gi 'gan bzhes skabs brgyud pa'i lam de yin la/ lo ngo bzhi yi rjes su kho sngar lam ded de slar rang nyid gso skyong byas pa'i pha yul du log nas gtan du gzim/ lam skabs kyi sa tshigs so so dang / grong mkhar che chung dag dang / mang tshogs stong phrag dang khri phrag khri phrag bcu phrag brgya phrag long pa rnams kyis grang rlung gdong gis bsus shing / mtshan smag lag pas nyul ba/ drag char mgo bos bsu bzhin bsu skyel dang gyes mjal zhu ru yong / mi rnams yun ring bor 'greng ste/ zhwa mo phud nas mya ngan byed cing /bem skyel me 'khor de rgyang thag ring bo'i bar mig skyel byas/ sngon chad kyi bran g.yog rnams ni de las kyang ngud mo dbugs 'gag tshod du byed do//lin khon gyes song mod/ 'on kyang nyes can gyi bran g.yog lam lugs de gtan du slar gson med la/ dgra bos lin khon gyi tshe srog 'phrog song mod/'on kyang kho'i lo rgyus kyi mdzad rjes rdo ring de nam yang a ri'i mi dmangs kyi sems khong du krong nger 'greng nges pa ni/ mi sus kyang gsal bor rtogs so//226

nyer gsum pa/ u ru si'i zhing bran lam lugs med par btang ba/1825lor/ ye kha thi ren nā gnyis pa'i tsha bo zar rgyal e leg zan ter dang po 'das te/ nu bo ne ku ra dang pos khri sa bzung / ne ku ra dang po khri khar bud ma thag rnying ba mkhregs 'dzin pa'i rnam pa mngon par bstan byung /phe ther pog gi na gzhon sku drag dmag dpon skor zhig gis 'os langs la brten nas zar rgyal gsar ba de khrir 'god par bsu ba byas shing / kho tshos zhing bran lam lugs med par gtong dgos pa dang / mnga' bdag khrims 'dzugs mngon du 'gyur ba byed dgos pa/ khon si than thin (00sa3 3sa 1ba0tshi༅༈bra1)la khrims 'dzugs mnga' bdag byed du 'jug rgyu'i re ba bton/khon si than thin ni ne ku ra dang po'i phu bo yin zhing / spyir rgyal srid de khos rgyud 'dzin byed 'os mod/ 'on kyang khos po lan ḍi yi bud med cig chung mar blangs pas/ thag bcad ltar kho'i bu yis rgyal khri rgyun 'dzin byed mi chogade bas rgyal khri kho'i nu bo ne ku ra dang por byin pa yin no// 'os langs ni lo de'i zla 12par byung ba yin pas/ lo rgyus steng 'os langs pa la thu zla bcu gnyis pa'i tang ’ zhes 'bod do// ne ku ra dang pos khrag dri 'thul ba'i sgo nas zla bcu gnyis pa'i tang la drag gnon byas te/ mi la la bsad cing /lhag ma rnams za'e pu re'u la spyugs/ snyan ngag pa phu'u hri khin ( 10za3sa607253561ba stsa7༅)gyi 〈〈za'e pu re'u yi btson ma la springs pa 〉〉zhes par 'di ltar bris yod de/227

khyed tsho'i skyo sdug gi las don dang gzengs sumatho ba'i sems phyogs de/de ltar du yal gtan nas misrid ljid chags pa'i lcags sgrog grol bar nges la/mun gtibs pa'i btson khang thal bar brlag nges/rang dbang gis khyed tshor spro dga'i ngang sgo drung nas bsu ma byed nges la/spun zla tshos rno dbal ral gri khyed tsho'i phyag tu gtad nges so/rgyang 'bud du btang ba'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tang mi zhig gis phu'u hri khin gyi snyan ngag bklags rjes snyan ngag cig bris nas gzhogs skyor byas la/de'i khrod du ‘ nga tsho'i skyo sdug gi las don ni 'di ltar du yal ci la srid/ me stag chung chung gis mgyogs por spang thang 'ur 'ur du sbar bar 'gyur ba la ngang blta gyis shig ces bris yod/ de las mngon pa ni/ zhing bran lam lugs gnas pa ni gyen rgol gyi me rlabs mched pa'i 'byung rtsa yin/ zar rgyal gyi khrims srung dmag gi spyi khyab kyis ne ku ra dang por ‘4zhing bran gyi gnas babs ni rgyal khab kyi rkang zhabs su sbas pa'i 'gas rdzas kyi mdzod du nges so 7zhes snyan seng zhus pa la'ang ya mtshan rgyu med do// ne ku ra dang pos ci thub kyis zhing bran lam lugs srung skyob byas te/bsgyur bcos kyi bsam blo thams cad 'joms rgyu'i stong bsam bcangs dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du/ u ru si la zhing bran khri phrag nyis stong lhag yod cing / de'i khrod zhing bdag zhing bran gyis ha lam phyed ka zin yod/ u ru si'i zhing bran ni rgyu rdzas ltar du rgyal dbang zhing bran dang / mnga' gzhis zhing bran/ zhing bdag zhing bran gsum du dbye yod/ mnga' gzhis zhing bran zhes pa ni rgyal rgyud kyi zhing bran te/ don dngos thog zhing bdag chen po'i zhing bran yin no// zhing bran la bshu gzhog byed pa'i rnam pa ni ha lam brgya 228

cha'i bdun cu zin pa'i zhing bran gyis 'u lag zhing bogs rgyag pa ste/ kho tshos rang nyid kyi sa zhing chung chung de 'debs gnyer byas nas 'tsho thabs skyong ba las gzhan gyi dus tshod rnams su zhing bdag gi sa zhing du son las byed du 'gro dgos/ 'u lag ma brgyab na 'u lag gi tshab tu bogs dngul sprod dgos so/zhing bran gyi gnas babs shin tu sdug po yin te/ nga tshos u ru si'i zhing bdag gi gtum thal che ba'i lag thabs la rags tsam blta bar bya'o//men si khu khul gyi bud med zhing bdag cig gis rang gi zhing bran la so 'debs pa dang / lcags thag gi kho tsho'i ske bcing ba/ chu khol ma kho tsho'i dpral bar 'pho ba/ btsan drag gis kho tshor grog ma za ru 'jug pa/ lcags sreg gis kho tsho'i lus po la tham sreg gtong ba sogs byas/ lo na gzhon pa'i bud med zhing bran rnams rgyun par zhing bdag gis dud 'gro ltar 'dod log spyod yul du 'gyur te/ zhing bdag cig gis rang gi zhing bran bu mo la btsan g.yem byas pa'i mi grangs nyis brgya lhag la bud yod pa dang / zhing bdag la las rang gi gzhis gar dus rabs bar ma'i 8 zhag dang po'i dbang cha mi lag tu bstar ba lta bu'o// zhing bran gyi 'tsho ba ni rta nor dang 'dra la tha na rta la'ang mi do/ chos 'chad pa zhig gi nyin tho'i nang / khos zhing bran gyis bza' ba'i bag leb phag la byin pa na/ 88phag gis kyang snom tsam snom tsam byed pa las/ za mkhan gcig kyang ma byung /nya rgyu mtshan ni zhing bran gyi bag leb la bzhi cha'i gsum gyi rtswa rigs skye dngos bsres yod pas so zhes bris yod/ 'di lta bu'i gnya' gnon lci mo'i 'og tu/ zhing bran rnams kyi thon skyed spro ba dang hur sems ji lta bu zhig yin pa dpag sla'o// zhing bdag la las zhing bran sa zhing du nyal nas ngal gso ba 'gog ched skabs rer kho tshor shing 229

sgrom g.yogs/ des thon skyed kyi nus pa mtho ru 'degs ga la nus/ mi la las tshod lta byas pa'i mjug 'bras ni/ mi glas nas las ka 'gan len byed du bcug pa'i las chod zhing bran las ldab gnyis gsum gyis mtho la/ kho tshos ngal gso yun gyi dus tshod zhing bran las lhag par ring po 'dug 'on kyang zhing bdag gi bsam blor zhing bran bed spyod pa ni rta zog bed spyod pa las kyang 'gro gron chung bas/ zhing bdag cig gis bshad rgyur/ ‘4'bru len 'phrul 'khor la 'gro song mang po yod de/ de zhig gso byed dgos par ma zad/ rta yang gso dgos/ zhing bran la las su bcug na skar gang yang gtong mi dgos ’ zhes bshad/ de bas zhing bran lam lugs gnas pa yis u ru si'i thun skyed nus pa 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba la gegs rkyen chen po bzos yod/ dus rabs 19pa'i stod du/ u ru si'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor da dung zhing bran lam lugs kyi khongs su dal mor 'phel bzhin mchis/skabs der/ u ru si'i bzo gter khe las khrod snang tshul ya mtshan can zhig yod de/ 88rang dbang gla pa ’ zhes pa ni mang shos bogs tshab 'u lag rgyag pa'i zhing bran yin/ bzo grwa'i bdag pos rin thang lhag ma skor zhig zhing bdag la sprad pa na yang bskyar thon skyed rgya bskyed du byed mi dgos/ de'i mtshungs su zhing bdag gis rang gi zhing bran gang 'dod du phyir 'gug chogade bas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor lam lugs dang zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'gal ba yang phyi phyir dza drag tu 'gyur bzhin yod/ne ku ra dang pos dbang sgyur skabs/ zhing bran gyi drag po'i gyen log 'byung ba je mang du 'phar/ 1825lo nas 1854lo'i bar/ zhing bran gyi 'os langs thengs bdun brgya dang dgu byung zhing / zhing pas zhing bdag bsad 230

pa'i don rkyen yang mi nyung ba byung / 1836/de1851lo'i lo ngo bcu drub/ nang /nang srid pu'u yi sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ zhing bdag gam zhing bdag tshang gi gnyer pa brgya dang so dgu bsad la/ kha cig me nang 'phangs pa'ang yod/zhing pas rang dbang la re smon byed tshad phyi phyir je cher phyin/mun nag shin tu che ba'i dbang sgyur gyis gral rim gyi 'gal ba dza drag tu btang / zing 'gyur che ba'i dus rabs der spyang grung can gyi mi sna skor zhig byung / dus rabs 19pa'i u ru si ru/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tang gi rjes su slar yang gsar brje'i dmangs gtso ring lugs pa'i bsam blo pa dang rtsom rig pa skor zhig byon/ phul tu byung ba'i mtshon byed la go gol (khu1khu013700phya01 〉(me 'i91)dang / thol si then(༅0za 750ma'i07༅5 10ma0105 —6746tshwa4)/ phe len si ke(2༅00na9༅0༅ 195kha0907༅ba yangamaya5055༅ rmi/1lkokṣiskoyolhu'i)heb chin (sa ༅ ༅0a0༅ ཿpolha)/ to pho lo le'u po hphu/ (ba༅zlo0ma'ima'am0nga07zangag7ya5 'a①༅yo002 ༈1lha/tsho tsho yoza) khreb ne zho hphu si ke(ma྾0mthamangathatha95ma09 5509ba6ཿ0༅77 sgolo2nd+ra〉loḥ)sogs yod/zar rgyal srid gzhung la rtsom yig gi tshags ma shin tu zhib mo zhig yod cing /tha na rtsom yig nang gi 8 rang byung nus pa ’ dang ‘ sngon thon ’nyalta bu'i yi ge'ang 'gog par nus mod/ 'on kyang u ru si'i bsam blo ba rnams kyis 'gog rkyen sna tshogs bsal te mang tshogs la thog rgod ltar gyi 8 rang dbang gi u ru si'i gleng gzhi ’ bton/ 1857lor heb chen gyis lon ton du 〈〈cong sgra 〉〉zhes pa'i dus deb bton zhing / kho'i dus deb gnyer ba'i rtsa don ni ‘8thog mtha' bar gsum du rang dbang gnyer zhing gtum spyod la dgag pa dang / rigs rtogs gnyer zhing phyogs lhung la dgag pa/ tshan rig gnyer zhing rmongs dad la dgag pa/ dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin mchis pa'i rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs 231

dang lhan du rgyal khab so so'i rul sungs kyi srid gzhung la rgol ba ’ yin par brjod/ heb chin gyis bltas na/ u ru si'i 88thog ma dang / nges par du dgos pa/ dal 'gyangs byed mi rung ba'i las rim ’ ni 88gleng brjod de rtog zhib kyi lam lugs 'og nas bcing 'grol gtong dgos pa dang / zhing pa rnams zhing bdag gi gnya' gnon 'og nas bcing 'grol gtong dgos pa/khral 'jal mkhan rnams gcar rdung mnar gcod khrod nas bcing 'grol gtong dgos pa ’ yin par 'dod/ 〈〈cong sgra 〉〉u ru si hril por khyab ste/u ru si'i sa gzhi chen po'i bran g.yog ltar gyi lhing 'jags de dkrogs shing /zhing bran lam lugs la 'chi brda sbran no//ne ku ra dang pos phyi phyogs la rgya bskyed pa las bgrod lam 'tshol 'dod bcangs te/ 1854lor khib li me'u (596a ༅༅ཿ༅)g.yul 'khrug bslangs la/ mjug 'bras su pham kha chen po myong / dbyin ji dang hpha ran si la dmag don 'thab rtsal thad nus rtsal chen po yod pas/ g.yul 'thab kyis zhing bran lam lugs kyi rul sungs kyi nang mtshang lhag par dmar rjen du bton la/ zhing bran lam lugs kyi nyen babs je lcir btang / ne ku ra dang po 1855lor skyo gdung gis shi ba dang / kho'i bu e leg zan ter gnyis pa rgyal srid la 'khod/e leg zan ter gnyis pa la'ang kho'i pha las lhag pa'i 'jon thang chen po med mod/ 'on kyang ya nga ba'i dngos don des kho la thabs tshul rnying ba ltar song na rgyal srid mi brtan pa nges su bcug rgyal srid la 'khod rjes kyi lo gnyis par khos sku drag rnams la bshad rgyur/ 8 'khyar gtam du kho bos zhing pa la rang dbang ster rgyu red zer ba ni skad cha drang po zhig ma red/ khyod tshos ci 'dod du de gleng mol byed chog mod/ yin na'ang/ bkra mi shis pa 232

zhig ni zhing pa dang zhing bdag bar phan tshun dgra ru lta ba'i bsam blo 'dugang tshos snga 'phyi gang ltar yang don 'di thag gis gcod dgos pa la kho bos sems thag chod yod/ gong nas don 'di thag gcod pa ni gsham nas thag bcad 'ong ba dang bsdur na legs snyam yod ’ ces bshad/1857lor/ e leg zan ter gnyis pas gsang ba'i sgo nas u yon tshogs 'du bsdus te/ zhing bran bcing 'grol byed thabs la gros mol dang thabs jus 'bri 'god byed mgo brtsams/ bcos bsgyur byed pa la 'gog shugs ni nam yang med mi srid pa zhig yin/ gsang ba'i u yon tshogs 'du'i khrod kyi lag bstar 'gan 'dzin pas zar rgyal la gsang nas bshad rgyur/8 lag pa bcad kyang rung / zhing pa sa zhing dang bcas bcing 'grol gtong ba la 'thad mos kyi ming rtags gtan nas 'god rgyu min zhes bshad/ 'on kyang skabs der zar rgyal gyis gal te zhing bran bcing 'grol ma btang na rmang gzhi'i steng nas zhing bdag gral rim gyi dbang sgyur la gnod tshabs skyel nges pa gsal por rtogs pas/ ‘4rim bzhin gyi sgo nas dang / 'gyur zing chen po med pa'i sgo nas ’ zhing bran bcing 'grol gtong rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas so//1861lo'i zla 3par/ e leg zan ter gnyis pas zhing bran lam lugs med par byas pa'i bka' yig la ming rtags bkod de bkrams/ de'i gnad snying ni/ 1 zhing pa la rang dbang gi sgo nas mi sger dang khyim tshang gi don thag gis gcod pa'i mi lus rang dbang thob pa dang / 2 zhing pa la rang dbang gi dus mtshungs su bgos skal sa zhing zhig dang sdod khang gi 'gram nas sa zhig thob la/ zhing skal de bca' khrims steng sngar mus su zhing bdag la dbang ba dang / zhing pa la ‘4gtan du bed spyod dbang ’ yod/ sdod khang 'gram gyi sa de rang 'dod ltar blu nyo byed chog la/ zhing skal la zhing bdag 233

mos mthun 'byung dgos shing / zhing sa blu ba'i gan rgya 'god dgos par ma zad blu yon mthon po zhig kyang sprod dgos/ de'i sngon la zhing pas zhing bdag la mu mthud du 'os 'gan bsgrub dgos so// 2 bcings 'grol byas pa'i zhing pa do dam bgyi ched/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gis sde tsho'i rtsa 'dzugs rnying ba bed spyod pa dang / sde tsho'i gong du zhang rtsa 'dzugs byas/ sde tsho dang zhang ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi gsham du gtogs shing / srid gzhung gi bka' khrims lag tu bstar dgos/ zhing bdag sku drag rnams ‘8'dum gzu pa mirtazhes pa'i ming gis sa gnas srid gzhung la lta rtog byed dbang yod pa sogs so// zar rgyal srid gzhung gis da dung zhing bran bcing 'grol gtong ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng 'byor ldan gral rim gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bcos bsgyur gzhan pa skor zhig kyang byas/1861lo'i u ru si'i zhing bran lam lugs bcos bsgyur byas pa de ni mthar thug pa zhig min/ des zar rgyal sger gcod ring lugs kyi ngo bo bsgyur :ste/ /khye/(15 /sde//྅dropa /byeste 88/bye/ nya da la ༄la sa nas gnas babs dang bstun nur cung byas pa tsam mo// yin na'ang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi cha nas bshad na/ thengs de'i bcos bsgyur ni yar thon gyi bya ba zhig yin la/ de ni u ru si bkas bkod kyi thon skyed byed stangs nas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed byed stangs su thod brgal byed pa'i dkyog mtshams shig yin no// 234

nyer bzhi pa/ 'jar pan gyi ming kri khri lo'i gsar bcos las 'gul/kho lum pu yi dus skabs der/ nub gling gi rgyal khab dag tu ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam lugs da dung tshugs med la/ kho tshos shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i mtsho lam 'tshol ba ni/ gtso bo gser dngul dang zhim rdzas ham gnyer byed pa dang / krung go dang 'jar pan/ rgya gar sogs rgyal khab la nyo tshong gi 'brel lam 'dzugs ched yin/ skabs der rgyal khab de dag gis krung go dang 'jar pan sogs shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab dag gi spyi tshogs rmang gzhi dang thon skyed 'brel ba bsgyur rtsis byed pa ni ma yin no (nus pa'ang ma yin)// 'on kyang dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du/ nub gling gi rgyal khab dag gis gru dpung dang skyogs chen thogs nas krung go dang 'jar pan gyi sgo lcags brgyab pa'i sgo mo rdung skabs su/ kho tsho'i dmigs 'ben ni de tsho nub gling gi mi ser spel yul du bsgyur ched yin/ skabs der krung go dang 'jar pan du ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor byung ba'am yang na ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor gyi myug mgo 'bus yod na'ang / gzhi rtsa'i steng nas bshad na rjes lus kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal khab cig las ma 'das la/ phyogs la la nas cung 'dra bo yod/ dper na krung go dang 'jar pan rgyal khab gnyis kyis phyi phyogs su rgyal sgo sdom pa'i srid jus spyod pa lta bu yin/ dbang sgyur pas srid jus de spyod pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rang gi rgyal khab kyi mi dmangs dang 'dzam 235

gling bar 'brel ba 'byung ba bkag ste rang gi dbang sgyur go gnas sra brtan gtong ched red/ 'on kyang mtha' 'bras ni dbang sgyur pa rang nyid kyi mig dbang yang bsgribs te lhag par rmongs rtul du btang yod/1840lor dbyin ji4 krung gor nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug bslangs/ ching srid gzhung ni rnying zhen dang rul sungs/ rgyal 'tshong pa zhig yin pas/ krung go mi ser spel yul phyed tsam dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin phyed tsam gyi rgyal khab cig tu gyur/ der mthud nas btsan rgyal stobs shugs kyi kha phyogs 'jar pan la bskor/ 'jar pan gyi mi skor zhig krung go dang 'dra ba'i las skal zhig mgor 'bab par dngangs skrag skyes/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs de 'dra zhig gi khrod/ 'jar pan spyi tshogs su bcos bsgyur gyi rlabs rgyun zhig langs par gyur zhing / spyi tshogs kyi bcos bsgyur gting zab mo zhig legs par grub/don de 'jar pan gyi gnam bskos gong ma ming kri (watshozaza)yi skabs la khel yod pas lo rgyus thog de la ru ming kri khri lo'i gar bcos (501 31 503 0 8 10sa watshooḥ)zer ba yin/ ming kri gsar bcos skabs su/gsar bcos pa dang rnying zhen pa'i bar gyi 'thab 'dzing ni gnam bskos gong ma'i go gnas kyi gnad don dang bstun nas 'phel ba yin/ de bas/ nga tshos gnam bskos gong ma las brtsams te gleng bar bya'o//gnam bskos gong ma'i lugs kyis 'jar pan gyi lo rgyus la shugs rkyen gting zab mo thebs yod/ dpe zhig bkod nas gsal bshad byas na/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa mjug bsgril skabs/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyis 〈〈pho tshi tam (20 36tha4 ༅7pho)spyi bsgrags 〉〉spel te 'jar pan la cha rkyen med pa'i sgo nas mgo 'dogs dgos pa'i re ba bton/ 'jar pan gyis 〈〈pho tshi tam spyi bsgrags 〉〉dang len zhu skabs re ba gzhan ma bton 236

par/ ‘8bzod gsol ’ zhig kho na zur du bkod de/ gnam bskos gong ma'i lugs sor 'jog bya rgyu'i re ba bton/ 'gog shugs je nyung du gtong ched phyis su a ri don dngos thog re ba der 'thad pa byung bas/ gnam bskos gong ma'i lugs da lta'i bar sor 'jog byas yod do//gnam bskos gong ma (zaza)ni 'jar pan gyi rgyal po'i mtshan yin la/ngag rgyun ltar na lha yul du pho lha zhig dang mo lha zhig yod la/ de gnyis kyis 'jar pan gyi mnga' khongs bskrun cing / lha gzhan pa mang po zhig skyes/de'i khrod nyi ma mtshon byed lha mo zhig yod pa de ni ‘8gnam 'od lha chen ’ yin/gnam 'od lha chen gyis kho mo'i 66gnam tsha nya 'jar pan du phab pa dang /‘6gnam tsha nya yi yang tsha ni 'jar pan gyi gnam bskos gong ma thog ma ste/88lha zil gnam bskos gong ma’’(gotshozatsho)yin la/ khos ta hu rgyal khab (mam༅)btsugs/ don dngos su lha zil gnam bskos gong ma zhes pa'ang ngag rgyun khrod kyi gnam bskos gong ma ma yin te/ don dngos su byung myong ba'i gnam bskos gong ma thog ma ni rgyal rabs bcu pa ste lha bkur gnam skos gong ma (lkokhozaza)yin no// mi yul mnga' bdag la lha'i gzi 'od bsgo ba'i snang tshul de rigs mi rigs gzhan dag gi lo rgyus su'ang rgyun du mthong rgyu yod la/ de'i dmigs yul ni mnga' bdag la gzi zil bsnan te kho'i dbang sgyur sra brtan du gtong ba las ma 'das so//bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi thog ma'i dus su/ gnam bskos gong ma ni khyad 'phags rgol du med pa'i chab srid dang bsam blo'i steng gi dbang sgyur pa zhig yin/ dus rabs 11pa'i smad kyi rjes su/ 'jar pan sa gnas kyi bkas bkod bcad bzung stobs shugs rim bzhin je cher gyur te/ches che ba'i dpa' rgod 64dmag spyi ’ gtso byas pa'i rgyal yongs kyi dbang sgyur 237

las khungs tsa mu hphu ’ ( kho)zhes pa btsugs/ mu hphu yis dbang sgyur skabs gnam bskos gong ma'i dbang shugs rim bzhin je chung du song / dus rabs 17par ti khron mu hphu btsugs rjes gnam bskos gong mas chab srid thad dri ba tsam yang 'don mi rung la/ chab srid steng gi mtshon byed cig dang chos lugs kyi dad rten tsam du gyur/mu hphu skabs su/ dmag spyi yi thad gtogs mnga' khul las gzhan da dung rje bo mang du yod de/ yul rje'i ( cho༅)mnga' khul yang yod/ yul rje la ming chen (༅tsho)zer/ mu hphu'i dmag spyi dang ming chen gyi lag 'og tu khyim blon 'bor chen bdag skyong byas la/ der dpa' rgod (maca)zer/ dpa' rgod ni ched las dmag mi yin zhing spyi tshogs steng brtsi mthong chen po yod pa dang / de tshor thob thang mtshon byed kyi ral gri yod/ dpa' rgod kyi steng du bdag po la blo dkar zhing mtshan snyan la rtsis chen dang 'chi bar rtsis chung byed pa/ dpa' rtsal la mthong rtsis che ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi kun spyod 'du shes shig mchis pa de la 66dpa' rgod lugs kyi snying stobs (yo77cho7)zer/ dpa' rgod la lar dmag spyi dang ming chen gyis kho tshor bstsal ba'i rgyud 'dzin gyi sa khul yod la/ la las phogs dngul len/ kho tsho ni mu hphu rgyun srung yong ba'i rmang gzhi yin no//ti khron mu hphu yi dus mjug tu/ 'jar pan gyi grong mkhar du ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lag shes bzo grwa dang las khang / yid rton dngul bun/ tshong zog dpal 'byor bcas rgyun 'byams su byung / de ltar/ 'jar pan gyi spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi la rim bzhin 'pho 'gyur byung ste/ 'byor ldan gral rim dang 'byor ldan gral rim rang bzhin gyi zhing bdag byung / skabs der/ dmag spyi dang ming chen gyi nor srid nyin bzhin je sdug tu gyur te rgyun par tshong pa phyug po 238

las dngul bun len dgos pa byung / dpa' rgod dma' rim gyi go gnas la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste/ la las tshong pa phyug po dang 'brel ba btsugs te kho tsho'i bu tshab byas pa dang / la las rang nyid kyis tshong las gnyer ba dang / yang la la las ka shor ba'am dbul bor gyur zhing / tha na dpa' rgod kyi thob thang dang ral gri yang btsong dgos pa byung / des gzhi rtsa'i steng nas mu hphu yi dbang sgyur la g.yo 'gul btang ngo //dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du/ nub gling gi btsan rgyal dag 'jar pan gyi sgo 'gram du bslebs shing / de dag las thog dang por nang du 'dzul yong mkhan ni a me ri kha red/ 1853lor/ a ri'i mtsho dmag gi dmag spyi hro cang pe re (53 504 016 31 6 20 77 /khri81)yis rlangs gzings dmag gru bzhi khrid nas 'jar pan gyi phu hi gru khar yong ste thad kur du mu hphu'i dmag dpon dang gros mol byed rgyu'i re ba bton zhing / gal te 'thad mos ma byung tshe ‘ thung myur g.yul sprad de rgyal pham thag gcod rgyu ’ yin tshul smras/ mu hphu'i dpon rigs rnams thog dang por 'jigs zil can gyi nub gling btsan 'dzul pa mthong ba yin la/ dngangs 'tshab chen po'i ngang mos 'thad ma byung ka med gyur/ lo gnyis par/ 'jar pan gyi hrin nee khron du mtsho sgo phyes nas nyo tshong spel rgyu'i 〈〈'jar a zhi mthun chings yig 〉〉bkod/ der mthud nas dbyin ji dang u ru si/ hpha ran si sogs kyang thon yong ste/ 'jar pan gyi rgyal sgo phyes par gyur/ 'jar pan gyi bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin spyi tshogs ni bem sgam du yun ring bcug pa'i ro skam ltar glo bur du byung ba'i phyi yul gyi mkha' dbugs des myur mor 'gyur ldog 'byung du bcug mi skor zhig ste/de'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig ni bsam blo dang ldan pa'i dpa' rgod dma' rim yin la/ de dag gis nub gling pa'i rngam zil mthong ba na 'dzam gling la rgyus 239

lon byed bsam skyes la/ de'i mtshungs su mu hphu dpon rigs kyis khengs gtum can gyi nub gling bar gus gus zhum zhum byed cing / ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa'i ngang tshul mthong ste/ bsgyur bcos byed rgyu'i re sems kyang skyes par gyur ro// 'jar pan gyi nye rabs lo rgyus steng shugs rkyen zab mo can gyi bsam blo ba ji then sung dbyin (tshi༅79)ni de lta bu'i tshab byed mi sna zhig yin/ a ri'i dmag gru phu hi gru khar sdod skabs su/ ji then sung dbyin gyis gnas tshul de thos 'phral myur mor de ru chas shing / mu hphu la zhu yig phul nas rgyal srung bcos bsgyur byed rgyur 'bad dgos tshul zhus par ma zad/ mtsho bgrod mi byed pa'i bka' rgya dang 'gal te mtshan mor lkog tu a ri'i gru gzings steng song nas/ a ri'i dmag gru la bsdad de mtsho phyir slob gnyer byed rgyu'i re ba zhus/ pe re 'thad mos ma byung bar kho phyir bskrad pa dang / rjes su mu hphu yis btson du bcug ji then sung dbyin gyi bya spyod des dpa' rgod khrod shugs rkyen rgya chen po thebs so//'jar pan ni lo rgyus kyi bzhi mdor gnas pa'i sgang der/ yar thon gyi dpa' rgod dang shes ldan mi sna/ tshong pa/ zhing bdag skor zhig gis krung go'i lo rgyus kyi bslab byar bsam nas gang sar gyen langs byas shing / mu hphu mgo rting slog pa dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam du bgrod de/ nub gling btsan rgyal dag gi mi ser spel yul lam mi ser spel yul phyed tsam du mi 'gyur bar byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ skabs der/ bcos bsgyu ra byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa'i mi la 88mdzangs rtul (lo )zhes 'bod cing /dpa' rgod las byung ba'i ‘8mdzangs rtul ’ la 'khyam rtul (khom)zer/mu hphu yi dus mjug tu/ 'jar pan du ‘ gong bkur phyi 'gog ’ ces pa'i kha g.yang byung / ‘8gong bkur ’ zhes pa ni dpa' rgod dang mi ser gyis 240

ming chen la bkur ba dang / ming chen gyis dmag spyi la bkur ba/ dmag spyi yis gnam bskos gong mar bkur ba'i don dang / ‘ phyi 'gog ’ ces pa ni 'ol spyi'i sgo nas phyi mi phyir 'bud gtong ba la zer ba yin/ 'on kyang phyis su bcos bsgyur byed mkhan mdzangs rtul rnams kyis ‘8gong bkur phyi 'gog gi kha g.yang bed spyad de mu hphu bsgyel la/ phyi 'gog ces pa'ang 'ol spyi'i sgo nas phyi mi 'gog 'bud byed pa zhig ma yin no// dper na/ 1861lor gsar bcos pa'i 'go pa ga'o hran cin tso zhes pa zhig krung go'i hrang he la ljongs rgyur thengs shig phebs shing / hrang he dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i mi ser spel yul du gyur yod pa mthong bas tshor rtogs chen po skyes la/ ching rgyal rabs ni ‘8rnying zhen ’’gyis 66rang rgud ’ btang ba yin pas/ 'jar pan gyis de las bslab bya blangs nas nges par du mgyogs por 8 phyi rgyal gyi 'jar pan gsar bcos rig pa ’ tshur blangs te rang stobs rgyas su 'jug dgos pa'i 'dod tshul byung / de ltar/ bkas bkod phyi 'bud kyi phyi 'gog smra ba'i khrod mi rigs rang btsan srung skyob byed pa'i rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam blo dang ldan par gyur/8 gong bkur phyi 'gog ’ smra ba ches 'phel che sa ni bzo las dang tshong las cung dar zhing nub lhor gnas pa'i khrang kru'u (ṣṭhanya5)dang za mo/ (rṣaḥ) thu tso ( yo)sogs kyi yul yin/ dma' rim dpa' rgod kyis don dngos thog nub lho'i yul so so'i yul srid bzung yod la/ dpa' rgod las byung ba'i mdzangs rtul khrod skad grags ches che ba ni zhi zhang long hrin (lo༅ṣṭha༅)dang / ta ci'u po le thung (mamaḥlko1lo)/ mu ho zha'o yon (ཿkhaḥ༅)bcas yin/ kho tsho ni ming kri gsar bcos la mdzad rjes chen po 'jog mkhan yin pas/ mi rnams kyis 66gsar bcos pa phul byung gsum mi’du 'bod/ zhi 241

zhang long hrin dang ta ci'u po le thung ni za mo yul gyi dma' rim dpa' rgod yin/ kho gnyis rjes su yul srid la zhugs shing hur thag gis mnyam 'brel byas te mu hphu mgo rting slog pa'i gsar bcos las 'gul la byas rjes chen po bzhag mu ho zha'o yon ni khrang kru'u yul gyi dpa' rgod cig yin la/ phyis ming chen du spar nas yul srid kyi gtso 'gan khur/mu hphu yis mu hphu mgo rting slog pa'i las 'gul la drag gnon byas/1859lor/ mu hphu yis ji then sung dbyin sogs mdzangs rtul la srog khrims bcad/ de nas bzung / mu hphu mgo rting slog pa'i las 'gul lhag par dza drag tu gyur/ khrang kru'u yul gyi dpa' rgod skor cig gis gnam bskos gong ma la dmag dpung spyod du bcug nas mu hphu mgo rting slog bsam bcang kyang /mjug 'bras ni de las ldog ste/ 1863lor mu hphu srid gzhung gis rgyal sa nas bskrad/ thengs der/ mu ho zha'o yon sprang chas spras te smad 'tshong ma zhig (phyis kyi mu ho'i lcam mo ) gi rogs ram 'og da gzod thar thub pa byung /skabs der mu ho zha'o yon la nges par du za mo sogs yul drag po rnams dang mnyam 'brel byas te mu hphu mgo rting slog dgos pa'i bsam blo 'byung mgo brtsams/ 1866lor kho rang dngos su rgyal sa cin tu ru song ste zhi zhang long hrin sogs dang gros mol byas te mna' 'brel btsugs/ mu hphu mgo rting slog pa'i stobs shugs nyin bzhin je rgyas su song bas/ mu hphu yi drag gnon 'thab 'dzing la bstud mar pham kha byung ste snyan zil nyams par gyur to//1866lo'i zla 7par/ mu hphu'i dmag spyi ti khron ca mo (ṣṭha)//za༅)nad kyis shi zhing / ti khron chen zhi (ཿ)//lozlo)'gan khrir 'khod/ lo de'i zla 12par/ mu hphu mgo rting slog par drag gnon byed mkhan zha'o men gnam bskos gong ma (dngha wa za༅) yang ci yin ma shes par tshe las 'das te/242

gzhon nu bsam med (lo na 14tsam ) ming kri gnam bskos gong ma khri sar bkod/ mu hphu mgo rting slog pa'i phyogs kyis skabs glags bzang po de bed spyad nas srid 'gyur slong rgyu'i 'char jus bkod/ 1867lo'i zla 10par/ lho nub kyi yul so so'i dmag dpung gis rgyal sa cin tu la dpung gis bcar zhing / de'i mtshungs su zhi zhang long hrin dang ta ci'u po le thung sogs kyis rgya sa cin tu nas ‘ rgyal srid slar gso pa'i ’ yan tshang ci hri (7waṃzam)dang lkog gros byas te/ gnam bskos gong ma'i ming gis khrang kru'u dang za mo gnyis kyi yul la mu hphur rgol ba'i lkog bka' btang / mu hphu'i dmag dpon gyis gnas babs mi legs pa shes te rgol ba'i lag snga brtsad nas zla 10tshes 14nyin rang 'gul gyis dmag spyi'i 'gan khur 88dgongs zhu ’ byas te srid dbang sprod rgyu'i re ba zhus/ zhi zhang dang / ta ci'u po/ mu ho sogs gsar bcos pa'i mdzangs rtul rnams kyi bsam par/ drag chas la brten nas mu hphu rtsa slog ma btang na/ srid dbang gsar ba ni brtan 'jags yong thabs bral lo snyam nas mu mthud du mu hphu la dpung rgol byas/zla 10pa'i mjug tu/ rgyal sa cin tu dang / ta pan/ shar mtsho'i lam/cang hu sogs sa khul du gnam nas ‘4lha'i srung 'khor ’ mang po lhung byung zhing /sus de rnyed pa na su la bde skyid 'byung nges tshul gyi 'khyar gtam zhig dar bar gyur/ de bas mang tshogs rnams nyin mtshan med par phyi rol du rgyug ste spro skyid dga' rtsed byas te/ 8 skal ba bzang song / skal ba bzang song nya zhes pa'i glu tshig gsang mthor blangs/ rgyal sa cin tu dang / ta pan/ hin pen/ cang hu/ men ku wo sogs sa khul de ma nyid du srid nus nyams par gyur/ 1868lo'i zla 1tshes 3nyin/ mu hphu slog mkhan phyogs kyis srid 'gyur bslangs te/ ‘‘rgyal srid slar gso ’nyabyas pa'i khyab bsgrags byas shing / mu 243

hphu'i dmag spyi med par btang pa dang / krung dbyang dbang cha gcig sdud kyi gnam bskos gong ma'i srid gzhung sgrig 'dzugs byas/1868lo'i zla 4par/ gnam bskos gong mas 〈〈mna' tshig don tshan lnga 〉〉zhes pa bkram ste/ bcos bsgyur bya rgyu dang / ma rtsa ring lugs spel rgyu'i bsam pa bstan/ de'i rjes su gnam bskos srid gzhung gis bcos bsgyur rabs dang rim pa byas te/ yul gyi lam lugs (chom)med par btang nas rgyal yongs srid gsum dang rdzong don gnyis su bgos te/ krung dbyang gis thad kur du 'go khrid rgyu dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'gag rdzong med par byas te bzo tshong la skul slong byed pa/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rim gras med par btang nas sa zhing rang dbang gis nyo tshong byed chog pa sogs byas/ming kri'i srid gzhung gi dus mgor/ srid dbang bzung ste bcos bsgyur byed mkhan rnams spobs stobs 'dzoms pa'i gzhon dar lo na 30nas 40yas mas can 'ba' zhig yin/ yul med par btang ba khyab bsgrags byas pa'i lo ste 1871lor/ ta ci'u po le thung rang lo 41dang / zhi zhang long hrin rang lo 43/ mu ho zha'o yon rang lo 38/ ye theng po win (khyaḥlo4)rang lo 30yin la/ lo na ches che ba'i yan tshang ci hri yang rang lo 46tsam las ma yin pa dang / gzhan rnams rang lo 30lhag can tag tag yin/ nub gling la slob sbyong byas te mu mthud du bcos bsgyur byed ched/1871lo'i zla 11par/ ming kri srid gzhung gis mi grangs zhe brgyad long ba'i pho nya'i tshogs pa zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas nas yo rob dang a me ri khar mngags la/ mi grangs nga dgu can gyi slob gnyer ba yang tshogs pa de dang lhan du phyi rgyal la slob gnyer du chas/ dbang cha thams cad mnga' ba'i pho nya ba chen po ni g.yas blon chen mo yan tshang ci hri yin zhing / gzhon pa ni ta ci'u po le thung 244

dang mu ho zha'o yon/ ye theng po win bcas yin pas/ de dag tshang ma srid dbang gi gros chod mi sna mtho gras red/ pho nya'i tshogs par 'gan khur gnyis yod de/ gcig ni chings yig la bzo bcos byed pa dang / gnyis ni nub gling gi rig gnas la lta dpyod byed pa yin/ kho tsho a me ri kha dang dbyin ji/hpha ran si/ bhel jam/ ho lan ḍi/ 'jar man/ u ru si/ ḍin mag i ṭa li/ o si khri ri ya/ su'e ten/ si we tser lan sogs la 'tshams 'drir phyin/ dus yun lo ngo gnyis tsam ste/ 1873lo'i zla 9par tshang ma phyir rgyal nang du log chings yig bzo bcos byed pa'i gros mol la grub 'bras ma byung mod/ 'on kyang thengs der phyi rgyal du 'tshams 'drir song bas gtso 'dzin mi sna'i bsam blo bcos bsgyur byed pa la nus pa chen po thon yod/ nub gling rgyal khab kyi gru gzings dang / me 'khor/ shing bzo khang / dar rgyas che ba'i grong khyer chen po sogs kyis grong sde'i mtha' 'khob pa ltar gyi 'jar pan pa rnams kha gdangs mig cer du bcug kho tshos 'jar pan dang nub gling rgyal khab kyi bar khyad mthong ste ha lam ‘8bsnyeg thabs bral ba'i ’ bsam blo skyes/'jar man du kho tshos pi si mar ④gyis nyam chung gi phu ro zi ni che bas chung ba za ba'i rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs khor yug tu ji ltar byas te 'jar man btsan rgyal du 'tshar long byung ba'i 'thab 'dzing gi lo rgyus bshad par nyan/ des pho nya'i tshogs par shugs rkyen zab mo bzhag kho tshos 'jar man ni 'jar pan gyi ‘4rgyal phyug dmag hrag ’ gi dpe gzhir 'os te/ rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul la () 0 0༅60tha 6 2609016 kha54 50ba 3134810ji—5050sa685༅ba༈sgo463zu ste/phu ro zi'i dbu blon(1862—1890)dang / 'jar man btsan rgyal gyi blon chen(1871—1890)khur myong /245

don dngos thog 'dra sa yod snyam pa byung / ta ci'u po le thung gis bshad rgyur/pi si mar gyi gtam la nyan rjes su 'jar pan gyi mdun lam la yang re ltos 'cha' rung ba'i bsam blo skyes zer/ de ltar/ 'jar pan de nas bzung ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo las can gyi bgrod lam du bskyod pa'i dus mtshungs su/ 'jar man dang 'dra bar dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi khyad chos drag po dang ldan par gyur ro//ming kri gsar bcos de 'jar pan gyi lo rgyus steng shin tu gnad che ba'i dkyog mtshams shig red la/ des 'jar pan mi ser spel yul du ma gyur par ma rtsa ring lugs 'phel rgyas kyi lam du drangs so// de la de ltar du grub 'bras thob thub pa ni/ 'jar pan rang ngos kyi rgyu rkyen ni thag gcod rang bzhin can yin pa smos med yin pa las gzhan/ da dung lo rabs lnga bcu pa dang drug cu pa'i rgyal spyi'i khor yug kyang de la shin tu phan po byung yod/ skabs der a me ri kha la lho byang g.yul 'khrug byung yod pa dang / e sha ya ru gsar brje'i 'tshub ma langs pa/ krung gor zhi bde gnam rgyal gyi gsar brje byung ba/rgya gar du dmag mi'i 'os langs byung ba/ i ran (1 3ba ṣālo)du pab ①pa'i 'os langs byung ba tshang mas nub gling gi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs la rdung rdeg thebs pa dang / nang sgos su krung go'i zhi bde gnam rgyal gsar brje yis dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i stobs shugs la khegs thogs 'byung du () 206 ༅mokhri ste/ 1844lor/ a le mo ham mad(51 120 ‘ 6 ma06tha4 86 61spri1 ṣṭha༅zaḥ)kyis rang nyid la ‘ pab ’ ces btags te rang gi bla ma ze ye ti kha tsem(587716541 zaḥ5 1 cho༅cho cazo7)gyi tshab tu zhe hu grub mtha'i gtso 'dzin du bsdad pas/ grub mtha'ader pab chos lugs su grags so// pab ces pa ni sgo yi don te/ 'jig rten mgon pos ru sgo ’ de brgyud nas khong gi dgongs pa mi rnams la bsgrags pa'i don yin/246

bcug 1848lor dbyin ji'i hrang her sdod pa'i gzhung tshab rabs gnyis pa a le ku (a rsha( )phyis su dbyin ji'i thog dang po'i 'jar pan du sdod pa'i gzhung tshab par bsdad/ khos krung go'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i 'tshub ma mig gis mthong myong la/ 88ye sha ya'i mi rigs gang yin kyang / da lta'i bar du ngo rgol mtha' 'khyol ma byas par yo rob la 'dud pa zhig med do ’ zhes bshad pa dang / btsan rgyal gyis drag chas kyi gnon shugs la brten nas 'jar pan las rgyal thabs byas na/ 66'dul sgyur mkhan dang 'dul bsgyur myong mkhan gyi 'brel ba'i ngos nas/ 'jar pan pa dang yo rob pa'i bar gyi 'grig mthun gang yang 'byung mi srid do ’ zhes khas len pas/ 'jar pan la gnon shugs lhag par chen po ma byin par lhod mor bzhag go/ming kri gsar bcos kyi gdeng 'jog thad/ krung phyi'i lo rgyus smra ba rnams khrod lta tshul mi mthun pa yod/ mi la las de ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi legs bcos las 'gul zhig yin par lta ba dang / la las de ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i gsar brje zhig yin par 'dod/ yin na'ang /ming kri gsar bcos las 'gul ni yar thon zhig yin pa dang / 'jar pan gyi lo rgyus mdun du skyod byed cig yin pa la ha lam mi mthun pa med do //247

nyer lnga pa/ pab dang pab chos pa'i 'os langs/i ran gyi pab chos pa'i 'os langs dang / rgya gar gyi mi rigs 'os langs/ krung go'i zhi bde gnam rgyal gsar brje yis/ dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil gyi e sha ya'i mi dmangs kyi mi rigs bcing 'grol las 'gul gyi thengs dang po'i mtho rlabs grub pa yin/ 'dir nga tshos thog mar i ran gyi pab chos pa'i 'os langs ngo sprod par bya'o//i ran la krung go'i lo rgyus su par zig (7༅)gam stag gzig zer/1794lor i ran la kha trar (566)67 tshe༈67)rgyal rabs kyis dbang sgyur mgo brtsams/ kha trar rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur de 1925lo'i bar rgyun 'khyongs byung zhing / de'i rjes su pa le we (98513༅1 ༅sto/1tshokhri)rgyal rabs kyis tshab byas/ lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis/ dus rabs 18pa'i mjug ste ha lam kha trar rgyal rabs btsugs pa'i rjes su/ i ran nye rabs lo rgyus dus rim du bslebs par 'dod/ de nas bzung / i ran la bzo las ma rtsa ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs mgo brtsams shing / rim bzhin du yo rob btsan rgyal dag gi chab srid stobs shugs kyi sa khongs su gyur te/ mi ser spel yul phyed tsam dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin phyed tsam gyi spyi tshogs su gyur ro// ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor nang 'dzul byung ba yis/ i ran gyi bkas bkod rang byung dpal 'byor la gtor bshig tshabs chen gtong gin mchis pa dang / grong brdal gyi khyim tshang lag shes bzo las snga gzhug tu nyams par gyur/ nub gling gi tshong zog nang du rgyug mgo brtsams pa'i skabs 248

dang chos lugs dam du 'brel bar byed/ de bas/ gnas babs la mi tshim pa dang gyen rgol yod tshad la'ang chos lugs kyi khyad chos shig gis nges can du bsgo bar byed/ pab chos kyi chos don dang de'i phyis su byung ba'i pab chos pa'i 'os langs kyis dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil gyi i ran mi dmangs kyis bkas bkod dbang sgyur la mi mos pa dang ngo rgol byed pa mtshon pa yin la/kho tsho'i 'dra mnyam bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i re sems mtshon pa zhig kyang yin no//pab ces pa'i ming dngos la ze ye ti a le mo ham mad (33771651 76 6 11 7063la4tha6 7༅༈stso latsho ṣṭha༅maḥ)zer/ kho hri ra tsi (551162 yo4ca)grong khyer gyi sring ras tshong ba zhig gi khyim du skyes la/ nar son rjes kho rang gis kyang grong brdal zhig tu rang btsan sgos lo lnga la tshong gnyer/ 1843lor/ kho dad sa'i grub mtha' de'i 'go 'dzin pa tshe las 'das shing rjes 'dzin pa da dung nges gtan byas med/ 1844lo'i zla 5par/a le mo ham mad kyis rang nyid la 88pab mi’ ces pa'i ming btags/88pab ’ ces pa ni a rab kyi skad khrod ‘4sgo mi’yi ming yin la/ dbyi si lan chos lugs kyi 'jig rten mgon po bcu gnyis pa mā ha di ( 3661 6ཿlo)'byon nye zhing / rang nyid ni de'i ‘ sgo ’ ste kho rang brgyud nas khong gi dgongs pa dad 'bangs la sgrog par 'gyur ba'i don yin/ bshad tshul ltar na/ rtogs ldan mā ha di ni lo ngo chig stong la sbas pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ste/khong slar yang 'byon pa ni mi yul gyi 'dra mnyam loyin pa med par btang nas/ bde skyid tshul mthun gyi 'jig rten gsar ba zhig 'dzugs ched yin skad do//ze ye ti a le mo ham mad kyis rang nyid la pab tu btags rjes/kho'i bu slob rnams dang lhan du sa gnas so sor song ste rang gi chos don 250

gsar ba dril bsgrags byas/ kho tshos 'jig rten mgon po thung myur byon te 'dra mnyam ma yin pa med par btang nas/ mi re re bzhin 'dra mnyam yin pa'i phugs bsam gyi spyi tshogs shig 'dzugs rgyu yin pa dril bsgrags byas/pab chos kyi chos don gyis dbul phongs mi ser gyi sems shin tu 'gug nus pas/ dad mkhan rim bzhin mang du 'phel/ 1847lor/ pab kyis rang nyid ni rtogs ldan mā ha ti yin par bsgrags pa na/ dad ldan rnams spro ba lhag tu rgyas so//pab kyi chos don dang chos spel bya spyod kyis dbang sgyur gral rim la dngangs 'tshab skye ru bcug 1847lor i ran gyi dbang 'dzin pas kho btson du bcug btson khang du pab kyis 〈〈zur bstan deb〉〉(yo357 malorsā)ces pa bris te kho'i chos lugs kyi dgongs pa 'thus sgo tshang ba'i sgo nas bstan/ 〈〈zur bstan deb 〉〉ni 〈〈khu ran gsung rab 〉〉la lad mo byas nas bris pa zhig yin la/ phyis su pab chos pa rnams kyis 'phags pa'i gsung rab tu bkur/ pab kyi 'dod tshul ni/ mi'i rigs spyi tshogs ni dus rabs gcig nas gcig tu rgyun chad med par tshab 'gyur byed pa zhig yin zhing / dus rabs so so tshang mar rang rang gi bca' khrims dang lam lugs yod pa dang /dus rabs phyi ma de gang ltar yang dus rabs snga ma las legs po yod/ dus rabs gsar bas dus rabs rnying ba'i tshab byed pa dang / bca' khrims gsar ba dang lam lugs gsar bas bca' khrims rnying ba dang lam lugs rnying ba'i tshab byed/ mi rnams kyis rang mos sgos bca' khrims dang lam lugs gtan 'khel byed mi rung ste/ de ni rtogs ldan gyis gtan du 'khel spyodagos la/ rtogs ldan gyi slob ston gnang dgos pa yin/ 〈〈zur bstan deb 〉〉ni rtogs ldan gyis mi rnams la slob ston du gnang ba'i gdams pa yin 251

du phyin te chos spel/ slob ma dge rgan las kyang lhag pa byung ste pab kyi lta ba'i dmangs gtso'i phyogs 'phel rgyas su btang / khos lam lugs rnying ba dang bca' khrims rnying ba ni nus med du gyur zin zhing / mi dmangs kyis dbang 'dzin pa la khral 'jal 'u lag rgyag mi dgos par dril bsgrags shing / mngon gsal sgos 'os langs byed pa'i 'bod pa btang bas/ dbang sgyur pas dmag dpung btang ste kho tsho gtor/ kho tsho ma tsan tu ran (5623ba68 6ba bra7oṃ9)khul gyi par hphu ru hri grong brdal ①du spos te mu mthud du chos spel/mtha' skor gyi zhing pa rnams 'tshang kha shigs shigs kyis chos su zhugs pas dad 'bangs phyi phyir je mang du gyur te grong brdal de pab chos pa'i gnas gzhi ru gyur/1848lo'i zla 9par/ i ran gyi rgyal po rgan pa tshe las 'das shing /dbangasgyur tshogs khag dbang rtsod la g.yeng ba'i skabs der/ par hphu ru hri grong brdal du 'dus pa'i pab chos pa bdun brgya yod pa des skabs glags de spyad nas drag po'i 'os langs byed rgyu'i thag bcad/ srid gzhung gi dmag dpung dang cung 'thab rjes/ 'os langs pa rnams se nyi tha par nub phyogs kyi dur ra'i nye logs nags tshal du spos nas 'obs brkos shing 'thab ra brtsigs te btsan rdzong bskrun pa dang / 'os langs dmag ring po ma 'gyangs par mi grangs nyis stong la bslebs/ pab chos pa dag gi gnas khul du 64gzhungs drang rgyal khab nya kyi phugs bsam lag tu bstar rtsis byas te/ sger la dbang ba'i rgyu nor med par byas shing / 'bru rigs gzhung la sprad de ched gnyer mi sna rtsa 'dzugs kyis do dam dang / cha snyoms kyis bgo bsha' byas/() deng skabs kyi pa po li grong khyer ro/253

gsar du khrir 'khod pa'i rgyas pos brel 'tshub ngang dmag dpung btang ste drag gnon byas/ srid gzhung dmag khag gnyis la 'os langs dmag gis snga gzhug tu mtshan rgol byas te pham par brgyab pas/ rgyal po dngangs 'tshab skyes shing / slar yang mi grangs chig khri long ba'i dmag chen btang ste/ tha par nub kyi dur ra yongs su bskor nas 'os langs dmag dang mthar skor gyi zhing ba'i 'brel lam bcad pa dang / de nas skyogs chen gyis drag tu rdung /'os langs dmag la 'bru rigs zad cing / btsan rdzong du 'thab mo ba nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam las ma lhag kyang dpa' ngar sgos rgol lan sprad/ srid gzhung dmag gi 'go pas g.yo sgyu'i bslu thabs spyad de/ lag gi mtshon cha bzhag pa na su yin yang tshe srog la gnod pa mi gtong bar brjod pas/ 'os langs pa g.yo 'og tu tshud de mtshon cha bzhag pa na tshang ma dmar gsod btang /ma tsan tu ran gyi 'os langs drag gnon byas rjes/ pab chos pa rnams kyi 'thab 'dzing ma nyams par ma zad/ rgyal yongs kyi sa khul so sor mched par gyur/ i ran gyi rgyal po dngangs tshom gyi sgo nas/ rgyal yongs su pab chos pa khri bcu yod srid rgyu red ces bshad pa dang / u ru si'i gzhung tshab pas phyir rang gi rgyal khab la phul ba'i snyan seng du/ 8 ma tsan tu ran du gang sar nyen tshabs can gyi grub mtha' 'di'i dad 'bangs kyis khyab yod la/ kho tshos dmangs don bca' khrims gtan nas khas len gyin yod pa ma red ’ ces bkod yod/ 1850lo'i zla 5par/ pab chos pa chig khri lnga stong lhag gis tsan ṭan (732636ba dzirsā)du 'os langs byas shing / zla 6par ni re zi (sa07 12༅tsho )yi chos pa rnams kyang de dang len gyis 'os langs byas pas/ skabs shig ring rngam zil shin tu chen po byung /pab kyis btson khang du dad 'bangs rnams dang 'brel gtug rgyun du 254

byas la/ kho tshor ‘8gzhungs drang gi rgyal khab ’ slad 'thab 'dzing byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang / dbu blon me ar tra ta je han zhes pas rgyal po la pab gsod rgyu'i re ba zhus/ khos zhu yig phul te/ bab nyin gcig la 'tsho bsdad na/ kho'i dad 'bangs kyi 'os langs de de bzhin du mtshams chad med cing / mtha' mjug kha trar rgyal rabs med brlag tu gtong nges red ces zhus pas/ rgyal pos kyang dbu blon gyi tshig der nyan nas/ 1850lo'i zla 7par/ pab la srog chad bcad/ skabs der pab rang lo 31tsam las med/rgyal pos pab la srog chad bcad rjes/ khri dmag gsum gyi dpung chen btang ste tsan ṭan gyi 'os langs la drag gnon byas/ srid gzhung dmag gis skyogs chen gyis drag rgol byas pa la/ 'os langs dmag gis rgol lan 'gyur med sprad de zla ngo 'ga' song / mthar 'os langs dmag gi mdel rdzas dang bza' bca' tshar te/ 1850lo'i zla 12par mgo mnan la/ ring po ma 'gor bar ne re zi'i 'os langs kyang zhi 'jags btang / lo gnyis pa'i lo stod du/ ni re zi'i thengs gnyis pa'i 'os langs byung ba la srid gzhung dmag gis ya nga ba'i drag gnon byas/ kho pa tshos g.yul sa nas bzung ba'i pab chos pa bkyigs te skyogs chen khar bskyon te 'phen gsod byed pa'am/ yang na kho tsho skor skor du brag phug tu bcug ste mer bsregs/ de'i khrod kyi mang shos ni bud med dang byis pa red/ pab chos pa'i 'os langs de 1852lo'i bar rgyun 'khyongs byas/pab chos pa'i 'os langs kyis i ran gyi bkas bkod dbang sgyur gral rim la rdung rdeg tsha nan btang / mthar 'os langs drag gnon byed thub pa byung na'ang / des dbang sgyur pa la dngangs skrag chen po skye ru bcug kho tsho mi dmangs yang bskyar yar langs te ngo rgol byed par skrag cing / 'gal 'du 255

je chung du gtong ched/ dbu blon me ar tra ta je han gyis bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char skor cig bton mod/ 'on kyang kho'i bcos sgyur des i ran mgyogs myur ngang mi ser spel yul phyed tsam dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin phyed tsam du 'gyur ba'i las skal ni bsgyur ma nus so// 256 ོ

nyer drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mi rigs 'os langs chen po/dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs 50par/ krung go'i zhi bde gnam rgyal gsar brje'i las 'gul 'ur 'ur zing zing du mched pa'i sgang der/ rgya gar du mi rigs kyi 'os langs chen po zhig thol gyis langs te/ dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul par krung gor brdzangs pa'i dmag dpung lam skabs nas kha ma bsgyur dbang med du btang zhing / i ran nas kyang dmag dpung 'then te rgya gar mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing la drag gnon byed du btang ngo //rgya gar gyi mi rigs 'os langs chen po thengs de'i khrod phul du byung ba'i bud med cig ste lā khi zhi me pa'e (23khu3641 831 4mapotsho cokhya)rgyal mo zhes pa byung / kho mo'i dpa' ngar gyi 'thab 'dzing snying stobs ni shin tu khyad 'phags shig yin/ rgya gar gyi rgyal mo 'di'i skor gyi gtam rgyud gzhug tu bzhag nas 'dir nga tshos thog mar 'os langs thengs de ji ltar byung tshul ngo sprod par bya'o//1857lo'i zla dnge por/ rgya gar gyi ka li ka ta (0703 3 7khulolhostsa)grong khyer nye logs kyi sde ba zhig tu don phran bu zhig byung ste/ rigs rgyud mtho ba'i ①dmag mi zhig gis zangs phor zhig khyer nas dmag sgar du 'gro bzhin yod la/ lam du rigs rgyud dma' ba'i gad bdar ba zhig gis chu btung phyir () rigs ni rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs rim gras lam lugs yin la/ der dbye na bram ze'i rigs dang rgyal rigs/ dmangs rigs/ gdol ba'i rigs bzhi yod/ de ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi thon dngos shig yin mod/ 'on kyang de'i shugs rkyen da lta'i bar du'ang nyams med do/257

kho la phor ba g.yar ba na/ dmag mi des ma g.yar/ de nas gad bdar bas bshad rgyur/ ‘ khyod kyi rigs rus la deng skabs ngo so ci zhig yod dam/khyod kyis de e shes/ khyod tshos ring po mi thogs par rang nyid kyi so yis glang tshil dang phag tshil bldad dgos/ mdel rdzas bzo skabs bsam bzhin du de gnyis byug yod ’ ces bshad/ dmag mis de thos pas shin tu khro ba skyes la/kho dang grogs po zhig dmag chas bzo grwar song nas dris pa na mdel rdzas la dngos gnas glang tshil dang phag tshil byug yod pa ra sprod byung bas/ dmag mi de khro ba ches cher 'bar/ma gzhir dbyin jis glas pa'i rgya gar gyi dmag mi'i khrod/ mang che shos dbyi si lan chos lugs dang rgya gar chos lugs la dad kyin yod/ chos lugs kyi goms srol ltar na dbyi si lan la dad mkhan rnams phag sha mi za zhing / rgya gar gyi chos la dad mkhan rnams glang sha mi za/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan gyis mdel rdzas thum shog steng glang tshil dang phag tshil byugs te rgya gar gyi dmag mi la bsam bzhin du brnyas dmod byas/ mdel rdzas la tshil byug pa'i don de rgya gar gyi dmag mi'i khrod khyab par gyur pas mgyogs myur ngang gsar brje'i drag rlabs 'phyur bar gyur/don dngos su/ tshil byug mdel rdzas kyi don rkyen de ni slong byed kyi me rta tsam yin la/ de dang dam du 'brel yod pa ni 'gas rdzas dngos te 'gal 'du dza drag dang ldan pa'i rgya gar spyi tshogs nyid yin no// nub gling mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul stobs shugs rim bzhin je cher gyur pa dang bstun nas/ rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs 'gal ba shin tu dza drag chen por gyur/ches thog mar rgya gar du sleb mkhan gyi yo rob pa ni phor ju ghal gyi mi yin te/ kho tshos ko a zhes par ches snga ba'i mi ser spel yul btsugs/ de'i 258

rjes su ho lan ḍi dang pho ran si/ dbyin ji rnams kyang gcig rjes gcig mthud du bslebs te/ sa cha 'phrog cing btsan rdzong brtsigs nas so so'i dbang sgyur mnga' khongs btsugs/ phyis su dbyin ji'i mis kho pa tsho'i 'gran ya pham ste rgya gar du don dngos kyi dbang sgyur go gnas zin par gyur/dbyin ji'i mis 1600lor shar rgya gar kung si zhes pa btsugs la/kung si la dbyin ji'i srid gzhung nas nyo tshong sger gcod kyi dbang cha thob la/der drag chas spras pa dang g.yul slong ba/ 'dum byed pa/ khral bsdu ba/khrims gnyer khrims bsher bcas kyi dbang cha sogs kyang yod/ ming la tshong las kung si zer yang don dngos thog de ni dbyin jis rgya gar la btsan 'dzul gyis mi ser spel byed cig yin no// dus rabs 18pa'i phyed phyi mar/ dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis shar rgya gar kung si'i dbang cha je chung du btang ste/ do dam gyi las khungs sna tshogs btsugs la/ rim bzhin du thad kur dbang bsgyur pa la shugs snon byas mod/ 'on kyang kung si la sngar mus bzhin dbang cha mi chung ba zhig yod/dbyin jis rgya gar la 'phrog bcom byas pa ni shin tu ya nga ba zhig yin/dus rabs 18pa nas brtsams te dbyin jis rgya gar la thad kur du bshu gzhog byas pa ①de rin thang mnyam po min pa'i nyo tshong gi 'phrog bcom lase kyang brgal yod do// 1757lo nas 1815lo'i bar/ des rgya gar nas dbyin pāng dung phyur bcu long pa'i rgyu nor 'bor chen 'phrog song / skabs der rgya gar du sdod pa'i dbyin ji ba rnams tshong ba dang dpon po/ jag pa gsum gcig lcogs pa yin/ lo phogs dbyin pāng nyis brgya can gyi shar rgya gar kung () gtso bo khral bsdus pa dang 'phrog khyer byas pa la'o//259

si'i las bzo ba yis kyang rgya gar gyi yul dpon sku drag dag la dbyin pāng khri bcu phrag du ma bun gtong byed nus/ dpon po mtho rim dag gis lhag par du ham 'phrog gi go skabs gtong ga la srid/ 1757lor khi le lbi (5060 0/150 malkolo)yis dbyin dmag khrid nas bhang ga la (632phya1tha6035 rtsamekhya7)ru bslebs te rgyal mdzod 'phrog bcom byas te/ dbyin pāng khri sum stong bdun brgya 'phrog pa dang / khi le lbi gcis pus kyang dbyin pāng khri nyi shu khyer ro// phyis su khos gros tshogs smad mar ngo tsha med pa'i sgo nas ‘8kho bos byon bsdoms dbyin pāng nyi shu bsnams/ da lta'i bar du'ang / kho bo da dung ya mtshan pa zhig ni skabs der de ltar chog shes che ba de yin ’ zhes bshad myong la/ des mi ser spel mkhan gyi jag pa'i ngo gdong dmar rjen du bstan yod/dbyin ji bas lag gnyis stong bar rgya gar du bslebs te/ phyir dbyin jir srog skabs phyug po chen por gyur yod/ gros mi zhig gis bshad rgyur/‘8kho tsho 'gyig sob ( tshormiphrokhyi) ba'in hin rdu gtsang bo'i 'gram nas rgyu nor 'jib yong la/ khrem zi (163la03 dnghalo )gtsang bo'i nang du btsir nya zhes ngos len byas/ dbyin jis rgya gar nas 'phrog ste thob pa'i rgyu nor 'bor chen gyis rang nyid phyug por btang zhing / rang gi rgyal khab kyi bzo las gsar brje'i 'phel rim je mgyogs su btang / dbyin ji'i bzo las gsar brje grub pa dang bstun nas/ rgya gar slar dbyin ji'i tshong ra ru gyur/ sring ras gcig pur mtshon na/ 1818lo nas 1836lo'i bar gyi lo ngo bco brgyad tsam ring / dbyin jis rgya gar du drangs pa'i sring ras de ldab lnga stong nyis brgya 'phar/ dbyin jis rgya gar gyi sngar yod spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi rtsa ba nas gtor zhing / rgya gar gyi mi dmangs la sdug bsngal dang 'chi ba bstsal/ dper na/ta kha (06363 catshe)zhes pa mi sngar skabs shig ring dar rgyas che ba'i 'khel 260

'thag gi lte ba zhig yin la/ mi grangs khri phrag bco lnga yod mod/ 'on kyang dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du/ mi grangs khri gsum bzhi tsam las lhag med/dbyin ji'i spyi 'doms shig gis ngos len byed rgyur/ rgya gar gyi ‘ 'khel 'thag bzo pa'i rus pas rgya gar gyi bde thang yang dkar po yug gcig tu bsgyur ’’zhes bshad/ 1770lor/ bhang ga la'i mu ge thengs shig khrod mi khri phrag chig stong shi la/ des yul de'i mi 'bor gyi sum cha'i gcig zin no//dbyin jis btsan 'dzul gyi dus mgor/ rang gi mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur rgyun srung yong ched rgya gar gyi mo gol ( 5phya631 zakhyaṣilo)bkas bkod rgyal rabs dang yul khams so so'i rje bo sku drag rnams bed spyod ci thub byas kyang / phyis su dbyin jis mo gol rgyal rabs dang yul rje sku drag gi stobs shugs nyams dmas su btang ste/ de dag gi khe phan la gnod pa phyi phyir chen po bskyal/ dus rabs 19pa'i stod du mo gol rgyal rabs ming tsam las don gyis stongs par gyur/ 1837lor mo gol rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po tha ma bha ha tur zha ha (236665 5666 3ṣā༈1 zayo)khri la 'khod/ dbyin ji bas kho la gang 'dod du brnyas bcos byas shing / g.yo jus la brten nas kho'i bu yi rgyal khri rgyun 'dzin byed dbang 'phrog ste/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po med par btang ngo // 1848lor rde hi si dbyin ji'i spyi 'doms gsar bar bsdad/khos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas kha g.yar sa sna tshogs btsal te mtha' 'brel rgyal phran gyi mnga' khongs bdag tu bzung zhing shar rgya gar kung si la bcad sprod byas/ de bas/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i srid jus kyis rgya gar gyi bkas bkod dbang sgyur gral rim la 'khon sems bslangs so//dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil du bslebs tshe/ dbyin jis don dngos thog rgya gar hril bo khyur mid byas zin/ rgya gar du mi rigs kyi 'gal 'du nyin 261

bzhin dza drag tu gyur la/ spyi tshogs hril bo dbyin ji la 'khon par gyur nas thun mong sgos dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i rmang gzhi grub yod/ skabs de'i rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs ni 'gas rdzas drag po ltar me stag chung chung tsam dang 'phrad pas kyang 'gas par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o//1856lor/ rgya gar mi dmangs kyis byings dang mi 'dra ba'i dngos po gnyis phan tshun brgyud kyin 'dug ste/ gcig ni chu skyes pad ma dang /gzhan zhig ni bag leb srab mo yin/ chu skyes pad ma ni dmag dpung du brgyud de/ dpung khag gcig nas dpung khag gzhan gcig tu brgyud pa dang /bag leb srab mo ni zhing sder brgyud de/ sde ba gcig nas sde ba gzhan zhig tu brgyud par byed/ chu skyes pad ma dang bag leb srab mo ni 'os langs kyi brda yin/ lag tu brgyud pa na 'os langs kyi gra sgrig byas yod pa mtshon/ 'os langs kyi dus tshod ni gcig gyur sgos 1857lo'i zla 5tshes 31nyin du gtan 'khel byas/ nyi chad de gtan 'khel dang sa khul so sor 'brel gtug byed mkhan ni rje bo zhig gi bu tshab yin la/ ming la nā na sā ha pi zer/ dbyin ji bas kho'i 'tsho rten gyi dngul med par byas shing / kho la 'jigs skul byas te nam zhig kho'i yul rje'i sa khongs gzhung bzhes byed par brjod/ de ltar du/nā na sā ha pi yi sems su dbyin ji la sdang ba chen po skyes/ khos rang nyid kyi rgyal khab bcing 'grol gtong ba'i thabs lam hur 'tshol byas te/ gang sar bskyod pa dang / zla 5tshes 31nyin rgol ba'i dus chad btab/ mi ser spel mkhan gyi gtum spyod de la rgya gar mi dmangs kyis bzod sgom byed thabs bral nas dus chad snga snur sgos 'os langs byas/ 1857lo'i zla 2par/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon gyis dpug khag bcu dgu bar phag dang glang tshil byug pa'i mdel rdzas sprad/ zla 3tshes 29nyin/262

rgyal khongs rgya gar yin pa'i dmag mi men kil pan rdi zhes pa khong khro gnon du med pa skyes te/ sbyong brdar ra ba nas dmag mi la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'bod pa btang ste dbyin ji'i dmag dpon gsum de gar bsad/ dbyin ji bas kho dpyang thag gis 'gegs gsod byas pas/ ngo rgol gyi khong khro kun nas sbar ro// zla 5tshes 10nyin/ me ru thi ( 0070/ ཿljo༈rha)ru sdod pa'i rta dmag ru dpung gsum pas dus chad snga snur gyis 'os langs byas la/ zhing pa stong longs pa yang grong mtha' nas 'dus yong / phyi nyin gyi zhogs par/ 'os langs dmag rdi li (ba0151 oṃ༅)mkhar 'gram du bslebs la/ mkhar nang gi mi dmangs kyis kyang dang len byas pas mi ser spel mkhan la 'bro sa mi rnyed pa bzos/ tshes 16nyin/ 'os langs dmag gis rdi li yongs su bzung zhing / mo gol rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po tha ma bha ha tur zha ha rgyal por bkur nas/ bka' yig bkrams te mi dmangs rnams chos lugs dad mos gang yin la ma ltos par mthun sgril gcig gyur gyi sgo nas mi ser spel mkhan phyir bskrod rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / rdi li slar thob pa'i gnas tshul de glog 'khyug pa ltar myur mor rgya gar gyi sa khul so sor khyab par gyur/ khang phir (635907oṃtsholo )dang o ti/ a lā hā pa ti( 2tha63636 a4khya༅ཿ)/ he ti ra pa ( tha160 chatha6 loṣṭha7༅)sogs khams rnams kyis kyang snga phyir dang blangs byas pas/ 'os langs de rgya gar gyi sum cha'i gnyis kyi khongs su mched par gyur la/ 'os langs kyi lte gzhi ni dkyil khul dang byang khul yin/mi ser spel mkhan rnams kyis sngar rgya gar gyi nam mkha' na sprin nag lag mthil tsam las med par snyam yang / skabs 'dir brel dngangs chen po skyes/ kho tshos sems cung lhod la babs rjes smyo ham chen pos phyir rgol byas/spyi 'doms kyis i ran nas dpung chen bkug pa dang / krung gor bgrod pa'i 263

btsan 'dzul dmag kyang tshur drangs la/ zhi khin (bya1khub khyum)dang gor ṣa'i mis grub pa'i glas dmag btsugs te/ mang me (53la6tha1 zloza)dang / ka li ka ta/ phun ṭib (20ba3cha zo ོstsa)bcas nas lam la chas te/ gtum zil che ba'i sgo nas drag gnon byas/ mi ser spel mkhan gyi gtum spyod la gdug rtsub shin tu che zhing / kho tsho gcan gzan las gnag cing / mi bsad pa gzi brjid du brtsi la/ mi gsod pa mos phyogs su 'dzin no//dbyin ji'i dmag dpon zhig gis grogs por springs pa'i 'phrin du/‘ khyod tshos gnas tshul 'di thos tshe yid shin tu tshim po yong nges red/ kho bos sde ba nyi shu rmeg med du btang ’ zhes bris yod la/ dmag mi gzhan zhig gis ‘8nga tshos gsod pa'i dbang cha chen po bzung yod la/ kho bos khyo da la dam bca' thub pa zhig ni/ nga tshos gcig kyang rgya yan du shor med/ nga tshos khrims bcad pa'i nyes can rlangs 'khor du bcug nas sdong 'og tu khrid de/ kho'i mgrin par dpyang thag bskon zhing / de nas thag pa sdong bor btags rjes/ rlangs 'khor bskor song ba na/ kho bar snang du dpyang yong ngo ’ zhes bris yod/ dbyin dmag gis a lā hā pa ti blangs rjes dmar gsod chen po byas/ kho tshos ngos len byed rgyur/ ‘8bem po skyel ba'i rlangs 'khor brgyad la/ nyi ma re re bzhin snga mo nas dgong mo'i bar srang dang khrom du dpyang shir btang ba'i bem po bskyal la/ zla gsum la bstud mar bem po drug stong lhag de ltar du bskyal ba yin rinyazhes bshad byung / mi ser spel ba'i jag pa la las ya nga med pa'i sgo nas bzung ba'i 'os langs pa spyogs chen gyi khar btags nas brgyab/'os langs dmag gis mi ser spel ba'i jag tshogs kyi smyo ham che ba'i drag gnon la zhum pa med pa'i rgol lan sprad/ zla 6pa'i mgor/ dbyin 264

dmag gis 'os langs kyi lte gnas rdi li bskor mod/ 'on kyang zla ngo gsum la mkhar nang du rgol ma nus/ zla 9tshes 14nyin dbyin dmag gis rdi li'i mkhar nang rgol ba na 'os langs dmag bis sa lag ma thil tsam gyi don du'ang shi 'thab byas pas/ le dbar nyis brgya tsam gyi srang lam chung chung zhig dbyin dmag gis yang yang rgol na'ang len mi thub la/ srang lam dbyin dmag gi bem pos gang ba byung / dbyin dmag gis mu mthud du dbyi si lan gyi chos khang zhig la rgol ba na/ chos khang du 'dus pa'i chos pa rnams ral gri phyung ste mdel char mdun gyis bsus nas dgra bo'i steng ma/chong bas/ dbyin dmag rnams me mdar mde'u rdzongs dbang ya nga ma byung bar pham 'then mi byed la med byung / zla 9tshes 14nyin gyi nyin gang bor/ mi ser spe' mkhan gyi dmag dpon drug cu re drug dang / dmag mi chig stong chig brgya lhag bsad pa dang /dbyin dmag si bkod 'doms pa gtso gras bzhi la rmas phog pa dang / de las gcig ring po ma 'gor bar shi song /rdi li shor rjes/ 'u ga nob (6506ba07 oṃ༅lko)dang trang zhi (/ta3ba31 spyoyo)'os langs kyi lte gcir gyur/ 1858lo'i zla 3par/ dbyin dmag gis dmag mi nyis khri dang skyogs chen brgya dang brgyad cu la brten nas lug nob bzung zhing / mkhar nang 'dzul rjes 'phrog bcom gza' 'khor gnyis la byas/zla 3pa'i mjug tu/ dbyin dmag gis trang zhi la rgol mgo brtsams/trang zhi'i yul khams kyi 'os langs la mgo 'khrid mkhan ni rgyal mo lā khi zhi me pa'e yin/ kho mo sngar yul khams kyi rje bo'i btsun mo yin la / 1853lor rje bo tshe las 'das skabs kho mo rang lo 18tsam yin/ dbyin ji'i shar rgya gar kung sis kho mo'i bu tshab la srid khri/ rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha med par 265

snyad btags nas trang zhi yi mnga' khongs bdag tu bzung / lā khi zhi me pa'e yis dbyin jis yul khams khyur mid gtong bar ngo rgol byas la/ yul de'i mi dmangs kyis gdung sems mnyam skye'i sgo nas rgyab skyor byas/ 1857lor rdi li slar thob rjes/ kho mos sngar gyi mnga' 'bangs la 'brel gtug byas te zla 6tshes 4nyin trang zhi mkhar phyir 'phrog pa dang / phyis su kho mo bu tshab kyi lta skyong ba byas te trang zhi'i srid khrir 'khod nas/ dbyin dmag gi rgol ba thengs du mar rdul du brlags/ 1858lo'i zla 3par/ dbyin dmag gis lug nob blangs rjes stobs shugs hrag bsdus kyis trang zhi la dpung 'jug byas/ rgyal mos nyen kha'i skabs su dngangs pa med pa'i sgo nas g.yul 'thab la bkod 'doms byas/ zla 4tshes 3nyin mkhar shor/ rgyal mos mkhar rdzong steng pho chas spras shing / lo na gzhon pa'i rje bo bu tshab de sked par bsdams te rta dkar po zhig bcib cing / rta ba bcu lhag khrid de mkhar nas phyir thon te nub phyogs su bskyod/ dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon krung we zhig gis rjes 'ded mtshams med btang ba na/ lam skabs nas rgyal mo phyir 'khor nas ral gri gcig gis dbyin dmag gi dpon po de'i mgo bo bcad pa na/ gzhan rnams rjes 'ded gtong mi phod par gyur/ zhogs pa nas dgong mo'i bar rta tshegs tsam yang ma gsos par dbyin le brgya dang gnyis kyi lam thag bgrod la/ka per zhes pa la bslebs tshe kho mo'i bcib rta de ma nyid du shi song /rgyal mo lā khi zhi me pa'e yis ka per du thang the'u jo phe (13ba 13 1091 ṣṭha༅rsā ༅66)sogs 'os langs pa dag dang 'brel gtug byas te/ mu mthud du dbyin dmag la zla ngo gcig lhag ring ngo rgol byas/ zla 6tshes 18nyin/ kwa ler (64ma10 lozolo)mkhar shor bas/ rgyal mos rta ba bcu grangs shig khrid de dpa' 'dzing byas pas slar yang dgra bo'i bskor rgol las 266

thar/ kho mo bya 'phur ba ltar mgyogs por bskyod skabs su glo bur du mdun na 'obs zab mo zhig yod/ skabs der rgyal mo'i chibs pa ni rta gsar zhig yin pas mchong brgal byed ma nus par 'obs 'gram du tshom ste bsdad pas/rjes 'ded dmag gis kho mo rub bskor byas/ dbyin dmag cig gis ltag rgyab nas kho mo'i mgo bor ral gri zhig btab pa na/ khrag dmar chu bur bzhin brdol byung yang / kho mo khro ba 'bar bzhin mtha' mjug gi stobs shugs rtsal du bton nas kho mor ral gri 'debs mkhan dbyin dmag de ral gri gcig gis rta thog nas bsgyel/ rgyal mos de ltar du rang srog btang /trang zhi'i rgyal mo 'das rjes/ mi ser gyi 'os langs 'go 'dzin thang thezhu tho phe yis byang cha ldan pa'i sgo nas nges med rgol rdung gi 'thab rtsal spyad de rgya gar dkyil khul gyi sa khul so so nas 'thab 'dzing byas pas/ dbyin dmag gar rgyug med par gyur nas sdug skad rgyun chad med par rgyag go/1859lo'i zla 4par/ kho ngo log pas bslus te dgra lag tu thebs/ zla 4tshes 18nyin dbyin dmag gis kho la dpyang gsod kyi khrims gcod pa'i nyin der/mi grangs khri stong longs pa'i rgya gar mi dmangs kyis phyogs bzhi'i ri phran steng nas rang nyid kyi dpa' bo gyes skyel zhus la/ thang the'u 'o phe 'dzum bag dang bcas dpyang stegs su 'dzegs/ sa srod skabs mi skor zhig gis kho'i skra nyag 'ga' re blangs te dpa' bo'i dran rten du nyar ro//1857lo'i rgya gar mi rigs kyi 'os langs chen po de mthar pham par gyur mod/ 'on kyang des dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur la rdung rdeg drag po btang zhing / rgya gar mi dmangs kyi dbyin rgol snying stobs la shugs snon byung ste/ rgya gar mi rigs rang btsan las 'gul gyi 'phel rgyas la skul lcag nus ldan btang ngo //267
