nyer bdun pa/ mā ha di'i 'os langs dang kor ton gyi mtha' 'bras/1884lo'i zla dang por/ dmag dpon hra'o cang kor ton (05tha 103600 rtsa0 00160 ༅ tsho)lon ton dang gyes te lam skabs su khe ro brgyud nas blo khengs yid tshim ngang su ḍan (5563ba lorṣa)du spyi 'doms 'khur du phyin/kor ton zhes pa'i mi 'di la/ nga tsho'i krung go'i mi rnams cha rgyus med pa zhig min/ 1863lor khos ‘ phyi mda' ru khag gi spyi pa khur myong la/ man ching srid gzhung dang ngan 'brel gyis hrang he'i mtha' skor du zhi bde gnam rgyal gsar brje la drag gnon byas pas/ krung go mi dmangs la khrag gi bu lon chad yod/ kor ton ni nub gling gi nyen mchong ba dang mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs kyi rgyug khyi mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yin/ mi ser spel yul gang zhig nas gsar brje byung ba na/ wo/ pa der phyin te drag gnon byas/ dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis kho pa su shen gyi spyi 'doms su mngags rgyur bsam blo gtong skabs/ khos lkog tu bhel jam gyi rgyal po dang gros mthun byung ste/ sgyel jam gyis kho pa gla spyod byed rgyu dang blangs sgos/ hphe gling gi kong gho (00ba60 khri//lko)ru glas dmag byas nas stel jam gyi dbang sgyur bar gzhogs 'degs kyi sgo nas kong gho mi dmangs la drag gnon byed rgyu khas blangs yod/ rjes su dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis kho pa bkag nas/ su ḍan du spyi 'doms la mngags te mā ha di'i 'os langs la kha gtad gachog tu bcugamā ha di ni skabs der su ḍan mi dmangs kyi 'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin 268

yin la/ kho'i thog ma'i ming la mo ham mad a ha mad (5053༅la36 5la86ṣṭha0maḥ ༅ṣā༅ཿ)zer zhing / gru bzo pa zhig gi khyim du skyes/ su ḍan ni hphe gling byang shar gyi dbyi si lan chos lugs la dad pa'i rgyal khab cig yin/skabs de'i su ḍan gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ slob gso/ lha chos rig pa rnams gzhi gcig tu 'brel yod de/ dbyi si lan chos lugs kyi dgongs don ni dbang chod ches che ba yin/ de bas/ lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen de 'dra zhig 'og spyi tshogs kyi bcos bsgyur gang zhig bgyi yang de chos lugs kyi rnam pa la brten dgos kyi yod/ e ha mad kyis khu ran gsung rab slob grwar slob gnyer byed skabs spyi tshogs kyi rul sungs bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad yod/ khos chos spel ba'i thob blangs rjes rgyal yongs kyi sa khul so sor song ste chos sgrog spel byas la/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyi gtum spyod dang mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal dngos su mthong ste 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i ngang tshul de la nang sems nas skyo ba chen po skyes shing / mi yul gyi 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i snang tshul de rigs rtsa med btang ste mi re re bzhin 'dra mnyam yin pa'i spyi tshogs shig 'dzugs rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ phyis su khos rang nyid ni 8 kun gyis re ltos byed sa'i mā ha di ’ yin par smras/ 8 mā ha di ’ zhes pa ni mu si len chos pa'i khrod ngag rgyun du rgyug che ba'i 'jig rten mgon po yin la/ e ha mad kyis ming de spyad nas rang nyid kyis bslangs pa'i las 'gul der ngo mtshar gyi bkrag mdangs bsgos shing / 'bod skul gyi nus pa je mthor btang / khos kho 'jig rten du skyes pa ni gzhungs drang dang 'dra mnyam lag tu bstar ched yin pas/ chos pa rnams kyis khos log spyod stobs shugs la ngo rgol byed par rogs skyor bgyi dgos pa'i re ba bton/ khos da dung kho rang nyis lha yi bka' bkod dang len byas pa yin pas/ mthar thug kho'i phyogs la rgyal kha 269

'thob nges par brjod/ 1881lo'i zla 6par/ khos a bhal ( 6tsha 7༅)gling phran du 'os langs kyi dar cha blangs shing / dar gyi steng du 8 rtogs ldan gyi ha li hpha (khu5ma1136ṣātsho༅)rgyun 'dzin pa/demo ham mad a ha mad ’ ces bris yod/ de nas bzung mā ha di zhes pa'i ming de grags khyab tu gyur/su ḍan ni skabs der ming thog tu i jib kyi dbang khongs su gtogs kyang / i jib rang nyid kyang dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du gyur yod pas/dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs 70pa'i rjes su/ su ḍan la don dngos thog dbyin jis dbang du bsgyur zhing / dbyin ji'i stobs shugs kyi mnga' khongs su gyur yod do// su ḍan gyi dbang sgyur pas mā ha di 'os langs byas pa'i gnas tshul thos rjes/ zla 8par dmag dpung btang ste a bhal gling phran la drag gnon byed du chas/ mā ha di yis rang dpung khrid de skung rgol byas nas/dmag mi brgya dang nyi shu dang / dmag dpon drug bsad de/ g.yul thengs dang por rgyal kha blangs/mā ha di ni spyang grung shin tu ldan pa'i mi sna zhig yin/ khos pham thengs des dgra bo'i yid mi 'chi bar lhag par dmag dpung 'bor chen btang ste skyin lan sprod du 'ong ba shes la/ rang nyid ni gsar du gyen langs byas pa yin pas da dung stobs shugs nyams chung yin pa dang / a bhal gling phran yang srid gzhung gi lte gzhi dang thag nye che ba sogs 'thab jus thad nas bltas na 'khos zhan par 'dug pa bcas kyi rkyen gyis gdong gtad kyis drag 'thab byed mi rigs pa'ang gsal bor shes/ khos rgyal kha thob pa'i phyi nyin chos pa rnams khrid nas nub khul gyi ri khul du spos te gnas gzhi btsugs shing stobs shugs spel/ de bas srid gzhung gi dmag 'bor chen a bhal du btang ba de stong bar gyur ro//270

mā ha di yi 'bod pa ni/ 88tshe srog stong phrag bsdo dgos kyang / khral dngul skar gang sprod mi byed ’ zhes pa yin la/ der dbul phongs zhing pa rnams kyis rgyab skyor chen po byed cing / chos pa mang po zhig dmag nang du zhugs pas 'os langs dmag gi dpung stobs rgyun chad med par 'phel rgyas su gyur/ 'os langs dmag rtsa 'dzugs byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ mā ha di yis mi 'bor chen mngags te rgyal yongs kyi sa khul so sor kho'i lta ba dril bsgrags byed du bcug la/ mi dmangs g.yul 'thab tu zhugs rgyur 'bod skul dang rtsa 'dzugs byas/gra sgrig tshags su chud pa byas rjes/ mā ha di yis dpung khag khrid nas lho phyogs su spos/ 1882lo'i zla 9par/ 'os langs dmag gis khir to hphan (50 6018ba sko4lo༅༅)zhing chen gyi lte gzhi o bhe ti (6༅16 'u༅khyaḥ)yi mtha' bskor/ mā ha di yis thog mar btsan rgol byas pas tshur ma lon/phyis su khos 'thab jus bsgyur te o bhe ti mkhar yongs su bskor nas/ srid gzhung gi srung dmag mkhar nang dam por bcug 1883lo'i zla dang por/srid gzhung dmag thabs zad de mgo btags/ mā ha di la me mda' lnga stong lhag thob pa dang / bzung dmag sum stong lnga brgya thob pa de 'os langs dpung gral du bcug pas/ stobs shugs lhag par chen por gyur/mā ha di yis su ḍan gyi grong khyer chen po gnyis pa o bhe ti blangs rjes/dgra bo shin tu dngangs skrag skyes te/ mi 'bor chig khri nyis stong can gyi dpung chen la sgyogs chen dang skya dmag kyang bkod sgrig byas nas/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon hrang zha'o yi thob yod pa hi khi si (yo151 3 510khu3 2ཿ5thalko༅lo)yis sna drangs te/ o bhe ti'i phyogs su bshar yong / mā ha di yis ldem 'khyug ldan pa'i 'thab rtsal spyad de dgra bo nang khul du bslu 'khrid byas/271

1883lo'i zla 11par/ dgra bo'i blo yul las 'das pa'i sgo nas o bhe ti yi lho phyogs sa khul du dgra dmag rgol thengs gcig gis rdul du brlags shing / hi khi si yang g.yul du bsad/ mā ha di la rgyal kha chen po de thob rjes/ thad kur dpung btegs nas rgyal sa khār thom (nga68 004 tshu ṣṭha)la dpung 'jug bya rgyur thag bcad/hi khi si shi ba'i gnas tshul de lon ton nas thos rjes/ dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur shog khag la ya mtshan mi dman pa skyes/ gnas babs de lta bu zhig gi nang / kho tshos kor ton su ḍan du mngags/kor ton su khan du 'byor rjes/ lag tu skabs shig nang dmag dpung med pas/ gnas skabs su kho'i gshed ma'i ngo gdong gab ste/ 'os langs dmag kha bral gtong rgyu'i ngan g.yo'i sbyor ba brtsams/ khos mā ha di la 'phrin yig btang ste/ kho la dbyin pung khri gcig byin chog par ma zad/ da dung khir to hphan zhing chen gyi gtso 'dzin du bskos bzhag byed chog par brjod ces bshad pa dang / mā ha di khir to hphan zhing chen gyi gtso 'dzin dang / kor ton rang nyid khār thom gyi spyi 'doms yin pas/ phan tshun mdza' mthun mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa sogs brjod/ mā ha di la 'phrin yig 'byor rjes/kor ton la ‘8dka' spyad pa'i ’ phyu pa ring po zhig bskur te/ kho pa sdig spong dge sgrub byed dgos pa mtshon zhing / 'phrin lan btang ste/ kho pas nges par khrar thom sprad de 'os langs dmag la mgo 'dogs par bshad/ kor ton gyi g.yo khram lam 'gro ma rgyug pas/ khos gong rim la 'phrin yig btang ste/ ‘8gal te kho bor dbyin dmag gi rgyab rtsa yod na/ zing cha zhi 'jags yong ’ tshul bshad la/ dbyin ji'i srid gzhung la dbyin ji dang a ri'i 'byor ldan rnams la 'bod pa btang ste/ kho tshor dngul gtong bcug ste tur ki nas 272

dmag glas te mā ha di la drag gnon byed par rgyab rogs byed du 'jug rgyu'i blo bton/ don dngos thog kho pa su ḍan du 'byor rjes/ gsar brje'i stobs shugs mig mthong byung ba las 'jigs dngangs skyes nga/sa gang thub sgos rgyab dpung la re bcol byed pa red/mā ha di yis dbyin ji'i rgyab dpung bsleb pa 'gog ched/ khār thom bskor nas song ste i jib tu bgrod pa'i lam bcad pa dang / g.yul 'thab kyi go skabs legs po dam 'dzin sgos rim bzhin du khār thom bskor sdom gyi rgya je chung du btang / de ltar byas pas/ kor ton ni rdza khog nang gi rus sbal bzhin 'bro sa med par gyur/ 1884lo'i zla 12tshes 14nyin/ kor ton gyis 'phrin yig tha ma bris la/ der yi chad pa'i sgo nas 88bya ba 'grub pa'i re ba med/nya da ni kho bos khyod tshor ‘8gyes tshig brjod ’ ces bris yod/1885lo'i zla 1tshes 26nyin/ mā ha di yis khār thom la spyi rgol byas shing / mchong rgo' thengs dang pos dgra bo gtor pham btang / mā ha di yi dmag mi skor zhig thad gar du spyi 'doms khang du mchong ste/ thog khang du yod pa'i lor ton gyi mal shag tu shar rgyug byas/ skabs der kor ton tag tag thog khang nas mar yong bzhin yod la/ khos glo bur du mā ha di yi 'thab mo ba ma/thong bas hang sangs par gyur/ snying nad khog bcang gi 'thab mo ba rnam/sa kyis mdung ring kor ton gyi snying khar btsugs te kho pa de ma nyid du bsad/ lag pa gnyis la krung go dang su ḍan mi dmangs kyi khrag gis sbags pa'i gshed ma des mjug mthar 'bab 'os pa'i mtha' 'bras nyams su myangs so//mā ha di yis khur thom rgol te blangs rjes/ mu mthud du dpung dmag byang bskyod byas te su ḍan gyi mnga' khongs mang shos bcings 'grol btang /273

khos mes rgyal slar gso'i don chen 'grub bzhin pa'i sgang der/ 1885lo'i zla 6par/ glo bur du tshe las 'das la/ skabs der rang lo 41yin/ mā ha di yis yongs su ma grub pa'i las mjug de kho'i lag rogs ab tu lā ( 66ma535557118 7— 53661 a khaṣṭha4)yis bskyangs te grub par byas shing /rang btsan kyi mā ha di rgyal khab btsugs/ 'on kyang phyis su dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs pas slar yang rgol te/ 1899lor mā ha di srid dbang mgo rting bslogs shing / su ḍan slar yang dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du gyur ro//

nyerabargyad pa/ pi si mar gyis ras dmar g.yob payis//glang rgod nā pho lun gsum par khroja bslangs///de/phu hpha dmag 'khrug 1870lo'i zla 1tshes 13nyin/ hpha ran si'i phu ro zir sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mos rang gi rgyal khab kyi rgyal po nā pho lun gsum pa'i bka' bkod ltar/ brel 'tshub ngang em si (༅43༅7༅)chu tshan bsti gnas su song ste/de na ngal gso bzhin pa'i phu ro si'i rgyal po wi lim dang po la mjal 'phrad byas/ hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab chen mo'i thengs de'i bzhud don ni/ wi lim dang po'i nye 'brel rgyal rgyud le'o pol ti (2009016ska/tshotshoyo)yis si phen gyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa 'gog ched yin/ rgyu mtshan ni 1868lor si phen gyi rgyal mo khri nas phab ste rgyal khri stong bar bzhag yod/ phu ro zi'i blon chen pi si mar gyis phu ro zi'i rgyal rgyud ho hang tso len (5060ba2010nga rsāstotshokhya)khyim rgyud kyis si phen gyi rgyal khri 'dzin rgyu'i bsam pa mtha' 'khyongs bzung ba la/ nā pho lun gsum pas ngo rgol drag po byas/ phu rgyal wi lim dang po la rgyun 'khyongs byed bsam med pas/ le'o pol ti la si phen du rgyal khri rgyun 'dzin byed du mi 'gro ba'i slob gso byas mod/ 'on kyang hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab chen mos nā pho lun gsum pa'i dgongs 'char bsgrags te/ phu rgyal la yig thog nas khag theg 'bri dgos pa'i lta tshul rgyun 'khyongs byas/ re ba de rigs ni spyir btang gi phyi 'brel gus srol las brgal yod pas/ wi lim dang pos gtan nas 'bri ma mos mod/ 'on kyang mu mthud du gros mol byed rgyur 'thad 275

mos byung / mjal 'phrad kyi rjes su/ phu ro zi'i rgyal pos kho dang hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab chen mo'i skad cha'i nang don de per lin du mchis pa'i pi si mar gyi sar glog 'phrin gtong du bcug glog 'phrin gyi ma yig ni tshig sgros cung 'jam zhing / si phen gyi rgyal khri rgyun 'dzin skor gyi gnad don de phu ro zi dang ‘4'brel ba chen po med ’ tshul brjod yod pa dang / hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab chen mo yang bskyar yong ste kho la khag theg byed rgyu'i re ba 'don srid na/ khos ‘ sne len mi byed ’ tshul bkod yod/ glog 'phrin gyi snga phyi'i nang don la bltas na/ thams cad 8 sne len mi byed pa rinyam yin par de la sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yod pa zhig red/ pi si mar la rgyal po'i glog 'phrin 'byor rjes/ skabs glags rnyed song par snyam ste/ de ma thag tu sems zhib mos bzo bcos byas/bzo bcos byas rjes kyi skad cha mjug ma ni 'di ltar te/ ‘8rgyal po mchog nas slad phyin hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab la sne len mi byed par thag bcad cing /nyin res pa la hpha ran si'i gzhung tshab la/ slad phyin rgyal po mchog la ci yang brjod rgyu med pa brgyud bsgrags byed du bcug ’ ces so// tshig sgros de la hpha ran ser brnyas smod dang 'gran slong gi rang bzhin shin tu chen po yod/ nyin gnyis pa ste/ zla 1tshes 14nyin ni tag tag hpha ran si'i rgyal ston yin la/ pi si mar gyis dmigs btsugs te nyin de bdams nas glog 'phrin khyab bsgrags byas/ mjug 'bras ni pi si mar gyis bsam pa ji bzhin/ nā pho lun gsum pa zhes pa'i 8 glang rgod de ras yug dmar po mthong ba ji bzhin de ma nyid du khro ba rab tu 'bar ’ zhing / pi si mar gyi jus 'og tu rbad de tshud song / zla 1tshes 19nyin/ khos phu ro zi la g.yul brda sbran/ yo rob kyi nye rabs lo rgyus thog shugs rkyen shin tu zab pa'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug ni de ltar du byung ba yin/ nā pho lun gsum pa dang pi si mar ni g.yul 'thab phyogs 276

gnyis kyi mi sna gtso bo red/ 'dir mi sna 'di gnyis la phyir gzhigs kyis ngo sprod rags tsam bya dgos pa 'dug ste/ thog mar nā pho lun gsum pa rags tsam gleng bar bya'o//nā pho lun gsum pa'i sngar gyi ming la thra li lu'e zi nā pho lun po na phad (05tha 103 60513— khra390100ba 30satha98 0zo༅ phoskya nghru.o9 yoḥ༅)zer zhing / nā pho lun dang po'i tsha bo ste/ nā pho lun gyis ho lan ḍi'i rgyal por bskos pa'i nu bo lu'e zi po na phad kyi bu yin/ kho chung dus nas mes po'i pho brang du nar son zhing / pho brang gi rgyas spros che ba'i 'tsho bar goms yod/nā pho lun dang pos khri sa shor rjes/ po na phad khyim rgyud phyi rgyal du spyugs/ lu'e zi nā pho lun gyis snga dus kyi gzi brjid mi brjed pas/ mes po'i rgyal rgyun bskyangs te/ phyir hpha ran sir log ste rgyal po byed rgyu'i bsam blo skyes/ 1836lor/ khos a mes kyi bzo lta spras te mgo ru nā pho lun gyi zhwa mo zur gsum ma gyon zhing / lus la dmag la skya bo gyon te/ nā pho lun gyi 'khor 'bring rnying ba 'ga'i rogs ram la brten nas/ hpha ran si'i mkhar grong zhig tu log ste gab sdod byas shing / de nas dmag mi rnams la gtam bshad byas nas/ zla bdun pa'i rgyal rabs mgo rting slog ste kho rgyal por bkur rgyu'i skul ma btang / mtha' 'bras ni/ bzhad mo slong mkhan de bzung ste me gling du sgyugs/ phyis su khos lam yig rdzun bzo byas te yo rob tu log nas gab sdod byas/ 1840lor/ khos yang bskyar dgod bro'i 'khrab ston zhig byas pa ni/g.yog 'khor 'gar hpha ran si'i dmag lwa bskon nas/ kho tsho khrid nas hpha ran si'i pu lon nas skam sar bud de/ slar yang kho hpha ran si'i rgyal por bkur rgyu'i re ba bton/ thengs der kho bzung rjes tshe btson gyi chad pa bcad/ kho 277

btson khang du lo drug la bsdad rjes bros byol byas nas thar/lu'e zi nā pho lun la kho'i a mes ltar gyi chab srid dang dmag don gyi 'jon thang med mod/ 'on kyang nyen mchong dang g.yo thabs la 'jon pa zhig red/ khos hpha ran si'i chab srid zing yom che ba dang / mi rnams kyis kho'i a mes nā pho lun gyi mdzad rjes la yi rang rjes dran byed pa de skabs glags bzang bo zhig tu shes nas/ de bed spyad nas nā pho lun gyi mtshar gtam mang du bzos te rang gi go babs je mthor btang / khos 〈〈nā pho lun gyi bsam blo 〉〉dang 〈〈dbul phongs med par gtong ba 〉〉zhes pa'i deb ci cha med pa gnyis brtsams nas/ rang nyid nā pho lun gyi khrims mthun rjes skyong ba dang dbul phongs pa rnams kyi srung skyob par bzhengs bkod byas/1848lo'i gsar brje pham rjes/ hpha ran sis lo de'i zla 12par tsung thung 'dems bsko byas la/ lu'e zi nā pho lun phyir rgyal khab tu log nas 'dems bskor zhugs la/ rang nyid 'dems bya ru bkod/ mtha' 'bras ni 'dems shog ches mang po thob ste/ hpha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis pa'i tsung thung du bskos so// mi phal ba dgod bro ba zhig gis mi sna dpa' bo zhig gi 'khrab ston par byas pa de ni/ skabs de'i mi mang po zhig gi ngor dngos gnas blo yul las 'das pa zhig red/ mar khe sis lo rgyus kyi gar sdug 'di'i 'khrab ston dngos su mthong bas/ kho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lugs dang lo rgyus dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mig dbang rnon por brten nas rnyog 'dzing che ba'i lo rgyus kyi snang tshul de la phugs brtol ba'i dbye zhib byas te/hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim dang / nang sgos su zhing pa rnams sems drang mo'i sgo nas nā pho lun dang kho'i tsha bo lu'e zi nā pho lun gnyis lhan du 278

sbyar te/ nor 'khrul gyi sgo nas 'dems shog tshang ma nā pho lun gyi tsha bor 'phangs/ rgyu mtshan ni sgo nā pho lun ni zhing pa rnams kyi snang ngor mi sna zhig ma yin par rtsa don zhig yin pas so ’ zhes dang / nā pho lun gyi khrims yig gis zhing pa rnams kyi sa zhing chang chang de'i dbang ba'i lam lags la srang skyob byas ༄༄pa zirab rirab ༄༄bapas/ zhing pas kho la gong bkur byed tshad ni rmongs dad kyi tshad du bslebs yod ces bstan yod/ de ltar/ lu'e zi nā pho lun zhing pa'i rmongarlo 'joms la brten nas tsung thung gi khri stegs su 'dzegs pa yin/ lo ngo bzhi'i rjes te/1852lo'i zla 12par/ khos yang bskyar khram pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ dpon dmag bslu brid dang / gros mi 'dzin bzung / srid 'gyur slong ba sogs byas te/ yun thung ba'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gnyis pa'i tshe rnga bsdus shing /rgyal po'i phyi pa lus la bsgos nas hpha ran si btsan rgyal gnyis pa'i rgyal por bsdad de/ ming la nā pho lun gsum pa btags/en ke si yis skyes thob kyi shes rab 'bar ba'i brtsams chos su brjod pa'i 〈〈lu'e zi nā pho lun gyi smug zla'i tshes 18nyin 〉〉zhes pa ni mar khe sis bris pa yin la/ deb de'i mtha' mjug gi tshig ni 'di ltar te/ 88gal te rgyal po'i phyi lwa de mtha' mar lu'e zi nā pho lun gyi phrag tu lhung ba na/ nā pho lun gyi zangs sku de wan tom ka blum ( tha 0010bab0 50sa60la0 7khyo457) khukhyi)gyi steng nas sar 'phangs pa yin no ’ zhes so// mar khe si yis lu'e zi nā pho lun rgyal por ma bsdad pa'i sngon te zla dgu'i sngon la tshig 'di bshad pa yin zhing / mjug 'bras ni de ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ro// nā pho lun gsum pa de nā pho lun dang po dang bsdur na dngos gnas lo rgyus la phyi nur chen po zhig byung bar snang ngo //nā pho lun gsum pa rgyal por bsdad rjes/ bstud mar baṭwāṃbhe 9'dzul

g.yul 'thab bslangs shing / rang dngos kyis dmag dpung khrid de meg si ko la dpung 'jug byas pa dang / dbyin ji dang lhan 'brel sgos krung go la nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa bslangs/ pe cin gyi yon men yon (༅nyo63)me ru sreg mkhan gte bo zhig ni kho pa red/ yo rob kyi skam sa chen por/khos blo sems gcig gis 'jar man gyi gcig gyur la bkag 'gog byas shing /1870lo'i zla 7par gong du brjod pa'i phu hpha g.yul 'khrug bslangs pa red/gsham du/ nga tshos kha phyir 'khor te nā pho lun gsum pa'i ngo ya pi si mar ngo sprod rags tsam bya/o tho wen pi si mar (0 0 260376 ༅009016’ khya013 50ba 6134mi106— bya060ba63530sa tsho༅ /thu khulo7)ni phu ro zi'i rong khi'i ①sa bdag khyim rgyud du skyes shing / chung dus nas bsam blo u tshugs dang mkhregs 'dzin che la/ gshis spyod rtsub cing rbad thag chod po zhig yod/ bshad tshul ltar na slob grwa chen mo'i skabs su/ khos mi gzhan dang dmar 'dzing thengs bcu phrag du ma byas myong / 1851lor kho chab srid kyi las la zhugs te/ phu ro zi'i hpha ran khu hphu (kha7thasakhu(5 cho༅mtsho)ru sdod pa'i mnyam 'brel gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi khur/ khos sger chod kyi srid lugs ni ches legs pa'i rnam pa yin zhing / hpha ran khu hphur mnyam 'brel gros tshogs lag tu bstar mi 'os par 'dod/ khos phu ro zi'i rgyal pos 8 mun 'obs las thon pa'i mi (mnyam 'brel gros tshogs ) rgyal po'i 'ja' sa dang len mi byed par rgyab skyor byas/① tshimaste/ rong khi zhes pa ni dang thog yel pe gtsang bo'i (2 ༅1༅skya46kho)shar rgyud dbang du bsdus te jo thob ldan pa'i skya rgod kyi rgyud pa la zer te 6 bdag po gsar ba 7zhes pa'i don yin zhing / phyis sgra 'gyur te rong khi ste/ sku drag sa bdag gi don du gyur ro/ 280

kho'i 'dod tshul du/ 'jar man la nges par du phu ro zi'i rgyal pos gong ma lha yi bka' bcol khur du blangs nas dmag dpung gtos che ba rtsa 'dzugs byas te drag chas la brten nas gcig gyur byed dgos pa dang / 'jar man de nges par du phu ro zi'i rnam pa can dang dmag rgyal ring lugs can du bsgyur dgos shing / dmag rgyal ring lugs la brten na 'jar man gnas thub cing dar rgyas 'byung thub snyam/ kho'i bsam blo ni de 'dra zhig yin no//1862lor pi si mar gyis phu ro zi'i blon chen dang phyi 'brel blon po gcig lcogs su khur/ de las kho par rang gi 'jon thang rtsal 'don dang phugs 'dun mngon par bsgrub pa la go skabs ches legs po zhig thob/ rgyu mtshan ni gsar du rgyal khrir 'gos pa'i phu ro zi'i rgyal po wi lim dang po'i bsam blo ni kho dang 'dra bar mkhregs 'dzin che zhing / rang nyid kyi dbang cha ni 88lha yis gnang bar ’ snyam mkhan zhig yin la/ dmag don la spro zhing /rang nyid kyis mgo khrid de drag thabs spyad nas 'jar man gcig gyur byed rgyu'i 'dod blo 'dzin/ spyir wi lim dang po 'jon thang phal ba zhig tu snang na'ang / lag lhod de pi si mar dang blon chen gzhan dag tshor bsgrub tu 'jug nus pa bcas kyis so//pi si mar las khri ru 'dzegs ma nyid nas bzung / rang lta mkhregs 'dzin dang thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas 1848lo'i gsar brje'i shul rjes bsub snyam bzung ste/ gros tshogs la srid gzhung dbang du bsgyur mi 'jug par ma zad gros tshogs kyis kho'i bkod 'doms la nyan rkyang byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ khos 66'jar man ni phu ro zi'i rang dbang ring lugs la brten pa ma yin par/ de'i btsan drag la brten pa yin pa dang / mig snga'i gnad don chen po ni stong gtam dang 'dems shog mang shos la brten nas 281

thag gcod thub pa zhig ma yin par/ /de'adi ni 1848lo dang 1849lo'i zhan skyon yin//delcags dang khrag la rag las pa zhig yin ’ zhes gros tshogs kyi ngos thog tu gsal bsgrags byas/ de bas pi si mar la ‘8lcags khrag blon chen mi zhes su grags so// pi si mar gyis 'jar man gcig gyur byed pa la re re bzhin rdul du rlog pa'i thabs spyad/ de yang gom rim gsum du phyes yod/ gom pa dang po ni/khos 1864lor o si khri ri ya dang mnyam 'brel sgos ḍin mag pham par brgyab cing / 'jar man mi rigs kyis mang shos zin pa'i rgyal phran ri le zu yog dang hul si the dbyin gnyis bdag tu bzung / 'on kyang lag tu thob pa'i rgyal khab de gnyis ji ltar bya rgyu'i gnad don thad phu ro zi dang o si khri ri ya'i bar yang bskyar rtsod gleng byung / me thi nye yis o si khri ri ya'i srid 'dzin skabs phu ro zi la 'jar man mna' 'brel khrod thog mtha' bar gsum du margo 'bur du mi 'jug pa'i khar/ da dung o rgyal la 'jar man mna' 'brel khrod srol rgyun du grub pa'i shugs rkyen zab mo yod/ de bas/ gom pa gnyis pa ni/pi si mar gyis o si khri ri ya 'jar man gyi las don khrod nas phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i thag bcad/ 1866lor phu hpha g.yul 'khrug byung zhing / sa to wa (33605tha rṣa7mo )yi g.yul thengs der phu dmag gis o dmag yongs su pham ste/ zhi chings ltar o si khri ri ya 'jar man mna' 'brel las phyir 'bud du bcug pi si mar gyis o si khri ri ya de hpha ran si'i phyogs su 'dor mi 'os pa shes pas de la gnod pa chen po ma bzos shing / 'jar man dang o sikhri ri ya'i 'gal 'du thung myur ngang yal du bcug yo si khri ri ya 'jar man mna' 'brel las phyir phud rjes/ pi si mar gyis phu ro zi gtso byas pa'i 'jar man byang ma'i mna' 'brel btsugs shing / rang nyid kyis blon chen 282

khur/ skabs der bslebs pa na/ 'jar man lho khul gyi lba hpha ri ya dang / hphu theng pog lba ten/ he sin(stanālkocho)bcas rgyal phran bzhi tsam mna' 'brel gyi khongs su tshud med par rang btsan byas yod/ skabs de'i gnad don gtso bo ni hpha ran si'i nā pho lun gsum pas gegs rkyen bzos te 'jar man gcig gyur yong bar bkag 'gog byas/ de bas gom pa gsum pa ni/ pi si mar gyis nā pho lun gsum pa pham nyes su gtong ba de yin/ 1870lo'i zla )tshes 13nyin/ em si'i glog 'phrin gyis tag tag kho par glags 'tshol ba'i go skabs bzang po zhig sprad/ khos ras yug dmar po g.yug g.yug byas pa na glang rgod nā pho lun gsum pa kho'i phyogs su mchong yong ste g.yul 'khrug bslangs so//nā pho lun gsum pa kho'i mes po dang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ dmag don gyi 'jon thang chen po med/ khos 'go khrid pa'i hpha dmag de phu ro zi'i dmag gi ngo ya gtan nas mi yong / phu hpha g.yul 'khrug langs ma thug tu/ hpha dmag la bstud mar pham kha byung ste phu dmag mgyogs por hpha ran si'i mnga' khongs su 'dzul/ zla 9tshes 1nyin/ ze tan (5063ba thuzo)g.yul 'khrug tu hpha dmag la pham gyong shin tu chen po thebs shing / nā pho lun rang nyid kyang ze tan du bskor bcug byas/ khos dar cha dkar po sgreng ste ngo tsha med pa'i sgo nas phu rgyal la 'phrin yig phul don/ 64bdag gi mdza' zhing brtse ba'i spun mched lags/ bdag rang nyid kyi dmag dpung khrod 'chi ma nus pas/ da ni rang nyid kyi ral gri sku nyid la 'bul ba las thabs gzhan med/ bdag gis mu mthud du sku nyid kyi spun mched bzang bo bgyi mi zhes so// zla 9tshes 2nyin/hpha ran si'i rgyal po dang dmag spyi/ dmag dpon so dgu bcas dmag dpung khri phrag bca dang lhan du pha dmag gi bzang dmag tu byas/ nā pho lan gsam rigasu rari ra pa ra//kyi/rteX) ra ga

pa 'jar man gyi wi lim mkhar(shākritshejo0lnga)du btson du bcug 1871lo'i zla 3par/ kho 'jar man gyis btson grol btang rjes dbyin jir 'khyams sdod byas/ 1871lo'i zla 1tshes 18nyin/ phu ro zi'i rgyal po wi lim dang pos sku dngos kyis 'jar man gyi rgyal phran so so'i rje bo dang blon chen sku drag khrid de pha ri si la bslebs shing / wer se le'i me long pho brang du rang nyid ni 'jar man btsan rgyal gyi rgyal po yin par khyab bsgrags byas shing / pi si mar yang 'jar man btsan rgyal gyi blon chen du gyur ro// 'jar man gyi gcig gyur don chen de nas bzung yongs su grub song ngo //pi si mar gyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i lo rgyus ni nā pho lun gsum pa las ring po 'dug phu hpha g.yul 'khrug gi rjes su/ pi si mar ni yo rob kyi chab srid gar stegs su mu mthud du lo ngo nyi shu la bsdad de 1890lor bslebs tshe da gzod dgongs pa zhus te las gnas dang gyes/ kho 1898lo'i zla 7par tshe las 'das/ lo rgyus smra ba la las/ 8 pi si mar gyi chab srid myong brgyud kyi mgo brtsams pa nas kho 'chi reg bar du/ me thi nye yi 'tsho ba rol tshul dang tha na de shi rjes kyi shul brnyan yang kho dang thog mtha' bar gsum du 'grogs yod ’ ces bshad la/ mi la las me thi nye yi chab srid kyi myong brgyud khrod/ru em si yi glog 'phrin lkog bcos byas pa lta bu'i nongs pa med ’ ces zer ro// pi si mar gyis em si'i glog 'phrin la bzo bcos byas pa'i nang rgyus de yun ring por mi rnams kyis mi shes la/ kho shi ba'i lo der kho'i phyir dran zin tho 〈〈bsam gzhigs dang phyir dran 〉〉zhes pa par du bskrun pas da gzod don dngos gsal rjen du bstan pa yin no/284

nyer dgu pa/ pha' si kung hre'i gsar brje/1871lo'i zla 3tshes 18nyin/ hpha ran si'i rgyal sa pha ri si nas dus rabs 'byed pa'i nus pa thon pa'i gsar brje zhig ste/ pha ri si kung hre'i gsar brje zhes pa byung / de'i snga nyin pha ri sir 'byor ba'i krung go'i ching srid gzhung gi lo tsā ba zhig gis gsar brje thengs de byung tshul dngos su mthong la/ khos 〈〈mtsho bskyod mtshar gtam 〉〉gyi deb gsum par ①nyin de'i gnas tshul 'di ltar 'khod yod de/ ‘4bshad tshul ltar na de ring rgyal srid khang gis gros thag bcad de/ pha ri si'i rgyal dmangs rang srung ru khag gtor rgyu'i bka' phab pa dang / dmag ru so so nas dpung dmag bzhi khri me mda' dang bcas pa bsdus te/ bho li lbi ya dang / pe meng / we le ce/ kyang ma ri 'dabs (meng ma thir mtho sgang ) bcas lam bzhir bgos nas/ sgyogs chen bzhi brgya bo 'phrog par bcoms/ phyogs bzhi tshang ma rgyal dmangs rang srung ru khag gis bzung yod pas so// dpon dmag rnams bslebs pa'i tshe rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gis bkag 'gog byas pa na/ dmag dpon gyis me mda' rgyag dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang dmag mis me mda' ma brgyab cing bka' dang len ma byas par ma zad/ rang srung dmag gi phyogs su lhung bas/ dmag dpon la thabs zad de/ gnas skabs dmag phyir bsdu ba'i ① da lta 〈〈pho nya dang lhan du hpha ran sir bskyod pa'i zin bris 〉〉zhes pa'i deb ming gis par du bskrun yod/ 285

bka' phab/ rang srung dmag gis rjes 'ded btang ste/ dpon dmag bcu phrag 'ga' bsad pa dang / drag dpon gnyis bzung ba las/ gcig gi ming la li kong thi dang / gcig gi ming la le meng to zer zhing / tshang ma me mdas bsad ’ ces pha ri si kung hre'i gsar brje'i byung tshul bris yod pa de pho nya ba gzhan gyi ngag dang yongs su mthun zhing / de ni dngos su mthong mkhan gyis rlabs che ba'i gsar brje de yig lam du bkod pa snga gras shig yin par gdon mi za'o/krung go'i lo tsā ba de'i ming la krang ti dbyi (lkochoza)zer zhing / kho'i dpon thob ni 64zas6rnyeṣeyonyaṣekhrikhya’yin/ kho thengs der ching srid gzhung gi dponachen khrung ho'u (lkoṭha)dang lhan du hpha ran sir phebs te ‘8then cin chos don nya thag gcod du song ba red/ 1870lor then cin chos don 'byung skabs/ khrung ho'u yis hpha ran si'i then cin du sdod pa'i gzhung tshab hphin ta ye dang gros gtug byed myong la/ kha ta tshig 'ga' byas pas hphin ta ye yis lag dkrum phyung ste bstud mar gnyis brgyab kyang mdel ma phog pas tshe srog la skyon ma byung / phyis su khong khro 'bar ba'i then cin mang tshogs kyis krung go'i bdag dbang la rdog brdzis gtong mkhan btsan rgyal ring lugs pa de bsad/ching srid gzhung gis khrung ho'u yis thengs de'i don rkyen mgo gnon ma thub par gyod gzhi chen po bzos pas/ kho bzod gsol zhu ba'i pho nyar ched du btang la/ na gus phyag byed pa'i phyi 'brel ri la de las 'tsham po zhig med par snyam pa yin no// 1871lo'i zla 3par/ khrung ho'u 'khor bcas sbor to ru bslebs shing / krang ti ye sngon la mngags te sdod gnas gra sgrig byed du bcug pa red/ krang ti ye zla 3tshes 17nyin pha ri ser 'byor zhing / phyi nyin pha ri si'i kung hre'i gsar brje byung bas/ kho ni deng gi bar lo rgyus deb ther du 286

rnyed pa'i pha ri si'i gsar brje dngos su mthong mkhan gyi krung go ba gcig pu red/ma gzhir 1870lo'i zla 9tshes 2nyin hpha ran si'i rgyal po nā pho lun gsum pa 'jar dmag gis bzung rjes mang tshogs la khro ba ches cher skyes yod/ zla 9tshes 4nyin mi dmangs kyi 'os langs byung ste btsan rgyal gnyis pa'i log spyod dbang sgyur gyi mgo rting slog ste ‘8rgyal srung srid gzhung ’ btsugs/ hpha dmag nyams 'thor du gyur zhing / pha ri si 'jar dmag gis bskor ba'i dza drag che ba'i gnas tshul 'og pha ri si'i bzo ba gral rim gyis dmag khag brgya dang dgu bcu go bzhi rtsa 'dzugs byas par khyon bsdoms rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag khri sum cu yod cing / ma dngul rang sgrig byas nas skyogs chen bzhi brgya lhag bzos te/ meng ma thir mtho sgang sogs su bkod sgrig byas nas/'jar man gyi btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed pa'i sta gon tshags su chud pa byas la/ rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gis da dung krung dbyang u yon lhan khang 'dems bsko byas te mi dmangs kyi drag po'i stobs shugs la mgo khrid yod par byas so//zla 9tshes 4nyin gyi 'os langs kyi rjes su byung ba'i rgyal srung srid gzhung de phyis su 'byor ldan gral rim gyis dbang du bsgyur/ 1871lo'i zla 2par/deb bcu can gyi 〈〈pho ran si'i gsar brje chen po'i lo rgyus 〉〉zhes pa dang deb nyi shu can gyi 〈〈srid skyong gis dbang sgyur ba'i lo rgyus dang hpha ran si btsan rgyal gyi lo rgyus 〉〉zhes pa bris te skad grags shin tu rgyas pa'i the er ( 0513— 60/950 1kho1073oṃkhrilo)gyis rgyal srung srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin khur/ kho khrir bud ma nyid nas bzung rgyal 'tshong gi sbyor ba mang du brtsams/ khos 'jar man dang zhi chings bkod de/ al sa si ( 13300 7lorṣalo)dang lo 287

ren (/0 sgyutha1 0 tsho.oṃ)gyi khag gcig bcad de byin la/ hpha lung dung phyur lnga bcu'i dmag stong 'jal rgyur khas blangs/ the er gyis gtos su che ba'i bzo pa'i drag dpung zhig rang nyid kyi gam du nyin re bzhin sdod pa'i ngang tshul der lta bzhin sems la dngangs skrag skyes te bde thabs med par gyur pas de rtsa med gtong rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ de bas khos thog mar meng ma thir mtho sgang sogs su nyar 'jog byas pa'i rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gi skyogs chen bzhi brgya bo 'phrog rgyu'i bka' phab la/ rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gis ngo rgol mtha' 'khyol byas te gzhung dmag phyir bskrad/ gnas tshul de ltar dza drag che ba'i skabs der/ zla 3tshes 18nyin pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis 'os langs byas so//nyin der/ rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gis pha ri si grong khyer yongs su bzung zhing / srid gzhung las khungs dbang du bsgyur/ pha ri si'i grong khyer du sdod pa'i thi er gyi dmag dpung phyogs bzhir byer la/ thi er gtso byas pa'i dpon po che chung rnams kyis gnas tshul mi legs pa mthong ste khyi ldom bzhin wer se le'i phyogs su bros/ krang ti ye yis tshul de 'di ltar bris yod de/ 88ngo rgol byed mkhan rang srung dmag pha ri si grong khyer gyi dbus khul du thon zhing / pho brang g.yon gyi wan tom thang gi zangs ga'i 'gram du bslebs la der mi grangs stong phrag du mas 'ur zing 'khrigs/ sngar gyi zhi drag dpon gnas rnams kyang rang srung dmag gis tshab gnyer byas/ dpon rigs rnams skrag thag chod de wer se le sogs su sbas skung byas pas/ pha ri si'i srid gzhung las khungs stongs par gyur/ ngo rgol byed mkhan rang srung dmag gis/ dpon dmag rnams la nges par me mda' rtse rting bslogs te btegs nas mgo btags pa mtshon dgos pa'i bka' phab ’ ces so// skabs der/ 288

pha ri si ni 'byor med gral rim gyi gnam 'og tu gyur ro// pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyis zla 3tshes 18nyin srid dbang bzung rjes/brel myur sgos srid dbang de dmangs kyis 'dems bsko byas pa'i las khungs la sprod rgyur rngam ste/ tshang ma kung hre 'dzugs pa'i gra sgrig gi bya bar brel nas/go skabs bzang po de bed spyad nas gsar brjer ngo rgol stobs shugs kyi gnas mal wer se le tshar gcod ma byas so//zla 3tshes 26nyin/ pha ri si nas kung hre 'dems bsko byas te u yon brgyad cu gya drug bdams thon byung zhing / de'i khrod grags che ba'i 'go 'dzin mkhan lngar len (60513 — ༅5rtsa0ba0 5mi 6sa lol༅)dang / hphu ran khel(tha 8baji01200nyasgo༅tsho'ilo)/ )le khu lu zi(༅0013—0537103ba010༅10༅0〈sbyo 77bla༅)/ tom pu rob si ke (ba046 043khu1 lko.oṃ༅zalo7)bcas yod/ skabs der kung hre'i nang mtshan snyan shin tu che ba'i pu lan khu'i (༅0013 5rtsa53 0 3/thab551 43spome'i)zhes pa de tshogs 'dur ma bslebs kyang bdams thon byung ngo // pu lan khu'i ni stong bsam spyi tshogs ring lugs pa zhig yin te/ kho mi nyung shos shig gi jus bkod la brten nas gsar brjer rgyal kha thob thub par yid ches brtan po yod/ de ni nor 'khrul zhig yin pa smos ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang kho ni gsar brje'i 'thab mo ba dpa' brtan 'gyur med cig yin zhing / 1830lo'i gsar brje dang / 1848lo'i gsar brje/ 1871lo'i pha ri si kung hre bcas dngos su brgyud myong pa dang / mi tshe gang bor lo ngo so bdun la khrims khang du bsdad la/ thengs gnyis la srog khrims gcod myong ngo (phyis su tshad med btson 'jug tu bsgyur)//1870lo'i zla 10tshes 31nyin/ khos mgo khrid de rgyal srung srid gzhung mgo rting bslogs te/ kung hre'i drag po'i stobs shugs btsugs3'ang ring po ma 289

'gor bar pham par gyur/ pha ri si'i kung hre'i gsar brje 'byung ba'i snga nyin/kho btson du bcug kung hre tshugs rjes kho mtshan 'dzin krung zhir bdams so//pha ri si'i kung hre tshugs rjes bka' khrims rabs dang rim pa bkram la/rgyal srung stobs shugs rnying ba rtsa med du btang ste kung hre'i mgo khrid 'og gi u yon lhan tshogs sna tshogs btsugs pa dang / rgyun tshugs dmag dpung rnying ba gtor te rgyal dmangs rang srung gis tshab byas pa dang / nyen rtog dpon ngan las khungs rnying ba gtor te/ khrims 'dzin u yon tshogs pa dang bde srung u yon tshogs pas tshab byas shing / dmangs don khrims khang gsar ba btsugs pa dang / chos dang srid so sor phyes shing slob grwa'i chos lugs bya 'gul bkag pa sogs byas/ kung hre'i u yon dang mgo khrid pa gzhan dag tshang ma 'dems bsko byas te thon dgos shing / 'gan mi lcogs pa dag go gnas phab chog nyung hres da dung thabs sna tshogs shig lag tu bstar te/ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khe phan la srung skyob byas/ ngo bo'i cha nas bshad na/pha ri si'i kung hre ni bzo pa gral rim gyi srid gzhung zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang skabs der spyi tshogs su go gnas gtso bo zin mkhan ni pu lan khu'i ring lugs pa dang phu ru ton (210 0—/03096 2 0 650bachosbyolko)ring lugs pa yin/kung hre ni chab srid thad 'thus tshang po byung med de/ dper na/ des hpha ran si dngul khang gi hpha lung dung phyur sum cu bo gzhung bzhes ma byas pa dang /dus thog tu wer se le la dpung 'jug ma byas pa/ thabs jus nus ldan spyad de bzo zhing mna' 'brel la shugs snon ma brgyab pa sogs lta bu yin no//pha ri si kung hre'i 'os langs kyis pha ri si'i bzo pa gral rim gyi dpa' 'dzing rtul phod dang gtum drag la mi zhum par rang srog blos gtong ba'i snying stobs mtshon yod mod/ 'on kyang 'byor med gral rim stobs shugs da dung 290

chen por rgyas med la/ dgra bo'i stobs shugs de ltos bcas kyis shugs che ba'i rkyen gyis/ mthar thug pham par 'gyur ba ni g.yol du med pa zhig yin/mar khe sis pha ri si'i mi dmangs kyi dpa' ngar zhum pa med pa'i gsar brje'i snying stobs la bsngags pa ches cher brjod pa'i dus mtshungs su/ de pham par 'gyur nges pa sngon rtogs byung yod do//thi er wer se le ru bros pa'i dus mgor/ rang gi stobs shugs kyis mi 'dang bas mngon thog tu rgyal dmangs rang srung dmag gi dogs zon lhod du 'jug thabs byas kyang / lkog tu dus tshod dam 'dzin sgos dmag dpung bsdu rub byas te kung hre la drag rgol byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/ zla 5tshes 10nyin/ thi er gyis pi si mar dang ngan 'brel byas nas phu dmag la btson du bzung ba'i hpha dmag khri phrag bcu bo phud du bcug la/ hpha dmag de dag phu dmag gi g.yul sa brgyud de pha ri si la byang phyogs nas 'dzul du bcug pa dang /'jar man gyis kyang thi er la rgyab rogs byas te pha ri si kung hrer drag gnon byas tshul de yang krang ti ye yis brjod yod de/ khos 'jar man gyis ‘ 'jar dngul dus thog tu rtsis sprod byed mi nus par dogs nas rgyab dpyang byas te mgyogs myur ngang mgo mnan no ’ zhes bris yod do//zla 5tshes 20nyin/ wer se le'i dmag gis pha ri si la spyi rgol byas/tshes 21nyin hrin khu lu sgo blangs shing / phyi nyin pha ri sir 'byor ba'i wer se le'i dmag dpung hri bcu gnyis la bslebs yod de/ ha lam mi grangs khri phrag dgu'am bcu yod/ tshes 21nyin nas tshes 28nyin bar ni 'dzam gling la 88khrag gi zla lnga pa ’ zhes ming du grags byed yin/ pha ri si kung hre'i 'thab mo ba rnams dpa' ngar zhum med kyis kung hre srung skyob byas te/ srang 'thab dza drag che ba bgyis shing / srang re re dang thog khang re re/ tha na dur ra re re 291

yang dgra bo cham la 'bebs sa'i btsan rdzong du gyur/ 'thab 'dzing khrod/bsngags glu 'bul 'os la mchi ma'ang 'don 'os pa'i don gang mang byung /dper na/ rang lo 14can gyi en si thi dang rang lo 17can gyi hphe le khi si phu nu gnyis kyis 'thab grogs rnams dang lhan du btsan rdzong zhig la rgol ba lta bu ste/nu bo dpa' bar gyis mchong ste dar dmar zhig btsan rdzong gi steng du btsugs tshe/ mdel gyis phog ste dpa' ngar sgos rang srog btang ba na/ phu bos kyang mdel char mdun gyis bsus te dgra phyogs su mchong zhing rang srog btang /kho gnyis kyi pha yis gnas tshul de shes rjes mig chu ma bton par lag gi me mda' dam du bzung ste/ 'thab mo rnams khrid nas dgra bo'i 'thab rar shar rgyugs byas pa lta bu yin/kung hre'i u yon rnams dmag dpung gi gdong len byas/ te le khu lu zi yis nyen kha'i skabs su dmag don 'thus mi khur la/ zla 5tshes 25nyin srang rdzong du tshe srog btang ba dang / lbar len gyis kho'i las 'gan rjes 'dzin byas te ltogs skom dang ngal dub la mi 'dzem pa'i sgo nas mjug mtha'i srang rdzong gcig po de dgra lag tu 'chor reg bar 'thab 'dzing rgyun 'khyongs byas shing / dgra lag tu thebs rjes gcar rdung sha rus nyog pa btang ste mig 'bras kyang sar lhung du bcug la/ mthar dgra bo'i me mda' kho'i brang khar gtad pa'i skabs su'ang ngag nas 88kung hre khri lor shog ’ ces kha g.yang gsang mthor bsgrags shing / bstud mar mdel gnyis phog skabs su da dung mtha' ma'i nus pa rtsal du bton te 'bod pa thengs shig sgrog par snyam pa'i tshe/slar yang mde'u gsum pa phog ste dpa' bo 'di'i tshe srog 'phrogs song / tom pu rob si ke zhes pa ni po lan ḍi'i skad grags che ba'i gsar brje ba dang kung hre'i ches khyad du 'phags pa'i dmag don bkod 'doms pa zhig yin/ kho 292

kung hre la blo sems gcig tu dkar mod/ 'on kyang sems rgya gu dog pa'i mi kha shas kho la yid mi rton zhing ngo log pa yin par snyad btags te kho btson du bcug myong / phyis su ring po ma 'gyangs par btson grol btang na'ang /kho'i yid la bsub tu med pa'i rma kha zab mo btod song bas/ rang gi tshe srog gtong ba la brten nas kung hre la 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam zol med de mngon par mtshon rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ tshes 23nyin/ khos rta pho lcag gis skul te dgra bo'i mdel char khrod bsres pas lto bar mdel mang du phog ste tshe srog btang / kho'i bem po chos 'chad pa lā khye zi'i dur sa (01 0/1010 60 20 0 630681 ༅ 4zo7go༅༅lo)ru bkod de/ kung hre'i 'thab mo ba rnams kyis kho la skyo gdung chen po'i ngang nas 'das sgo rgya chen po spel la/ bde srung u yon mo le ar zhes pas gtam brjod byas te 6 'di ni kho yin te/ 'di ni mi rnams kyis ngo log pa yin par nyes gtug byas pa'i mi de red/ da ni 'di gar bde bar gzim song / kho ni ches snga mor rang nyid kyi tshe srog kung hre la 'bul mkhan mi rnams kyi gcig yin ’ zhes bshad/ tom pu rob si ke'i skor yang krang ti ye yis bris yod de/ khos 8 rang srung dmag gi khrod nas thams cad la jus 'doms byas mi zhes bris yod do//zla 5tshes 27nyin/ mi grangs nyis brgyar mi long ba'i 'thab mo rnams chos 'chad pa lā khye zi'i dur ra btsan rdzong du byas te dgra dpung mi grangs lnga stong long ba la phyir rgol byas/ tshes 28nyin/ 'thab mo ba brgya dang zhe bdun gyis dur ra'i gyang logs su dpa' 'dzing dus tshod phyed kur byas rjes tshang mas gzi brjid ngang rang srog btang la/ ngag nas 8 kung hre khri lor shog ces skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags/wer se le'i dmag gis kung hre'i srang rdzong mtha' ma blangs rjes su skya 293

mdangs kyi 'jigs zil gyis pha ri si hril po g.yogs par gyur/ bem po ri bzhin spungs shing khrag dron gyis se nā gtsang bo dmar por bsgyur/ bsad pa dang btson du bcug pa/ rgyang phud du btang ba'i kung hre'i 'thab mo snga gzhug khyon bsdoms mi grangs khri phrag bcu la bslebs/ 'thab mo ba mang po zhig gis dgra lag tu phebs rjes 'byor med gral rim gyi dpa' nyams ring lugs mngon par bstan la/ tshul de krang ti ye yis thengs du mar gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas brjod yod pa las 'ga' zhig bshus na/ ‘8yang 'og khang nas ngo rgol pa ①chig stong nyis brgya bgrol/ de'i khrod bud med gral phreng gnyis yod la/ de dag gon pa hrul zhing ngo gdong thal rdul gyis g.yogs yod na'ang dpa' spobs kyi nyams brjid mig mdangs las mngon yong /’ zhes dang /‘ yang ngo rgol pa nyis stong lnga brgya lhag bgrol pa'i khrod/ du ba 'then mkhan yod la glu gzhas gtong mkhan yang yod de/ tshang ma bzung yod na'ang zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs bstan yong ’ zhes dang / 88'og khang nas ngo rgol pa chig stong brgyad brgya lhag bgrol song / de'i khrod bud med brgya lhag cig yod pa rnams gon pa khrag gis smug yod na'ang spobs nyams gzengs su mtho la/'jigs zhum ston mkhan gcig kyang med ’’ces bris yod/ 'di dag ni krung go'i mig mthong ba zhig gi zin bris red/ khos bris pa la bkas bkod dpon nyams kyi tshig sgros yod kyang / kung hre'i bud med 'thab mo ba'i 'chi bar ci mi snyam pa'i dpa' nyams de mig sgor bstar yong ngo // dpa' bo 'di dag spyi tshogs gsar ba'i sngon gshegs pa gzi brjid ldan pa zhig tu byas te mi rnams kyis gus bstod byed la/ kho tsho bzo pa gral rim gyi sems khong du nam yang rdo ① kung hre'i 'thab mo ba la'o/294

ris bzhin brkos yod do//zla 5tshes 30nyin/ gshed ma thi er gyis dmag ston mdzad sgo rgya che ba spel te kho'i gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi grub 'bras la dga' ston rten 'brel zhus/de ni thi er sogs spro ba snga thal ba yin te/ don dngos thog sngar lo rgyus smra ba yin pa'i kho ni skabs der gshed mar byas te lo rgyus kyis khyad gsod byed pa'i ka bar gtan du btags so// des gsar brje la phyi 'gyangs btang ba tsam las gtan 'gog byed ga la nus te/ kho dmag ston ldings char sdod pa'i dus mtshungs der/ pha ri si'i grong mtha'i bzo pa zhig gi sdod khang du log spyod pa mtha' dag skrag 'dar 'chor du 'jug pa'i 'byor med gral rim gyi 'thab glu ste/ 〈〈rgyal spyi'i glu 〉〉sgra bsgrags byung ngo //yar la longs shig ltogs skom bsnol mas mnar ba'i bran g.yog tsho/yar la longs shig 'dzam gling hril bo'i sdug bsngal myong mkhan tsho/nang khong nas khrag dron mched cing skyoms byung /da ni bden don slad 'thab 'dzing byed la ran/〈〈rgyal spyi'i glu 〉〉yi rtsom pa po ni pha ri si kung hre'i 'thab mo ba u ren pho ther (༅5rtsa0ba0—khya640ba620 10 a/nga ma7༅)yin/ kung hre pham rjes su/ kho thabs zad de grong mtha'i grogs po bzo pa zhig gi sar sbas sdod byas/dgra bo'i smyo ham che ba'i dmar gsod dang 'thab grogs tsho'i dpa' bo'i spyod pa yis kho'i sems rlabs 'phyur zhing khrag rgyun khol par gyur pas/ kung hre pham pa'i nyin mgo ma 'ga'i nang la 'thab glu 'di bris pa red/ 1889lor rgyal spyi gnyis pa tshugs pa'i tshogs 'du pha sde si nas 'tshogs la/ hpha ran si'i 'thus mi rnams kyis rngam brjid ldan pa'i 〈〈rgyal spyi'i glu 〉〉'di len bzhin tshogs rar zhugs/ dus rabs gcig gi ring la/ 〈〈rgyal spyi'i glu 〉〉 295

yis 'byor med gral rim rnams la ‘ en thi ne hrin nol ’ (1ba 0 batha 10bam ṭha.aṣā༅cha ༅)te/ rgyal spyi'i gung khran ring lugs mngon du 'gyur ched snga rabs pa'i rjes mthud de dpa' ngar ngang mdun du bskyod par skul ma btang ngo 296

sumacu pa/ rgyal spyi dang po dang rgyal spyi gnyis pa/rgyal spyi dang po ni ‘6rgyal spyi'i bzo pa'i lhan tshogs ’ kyi bsdus ming yin la/ de ni 1864lo'i zla 9par tshugs shing / rgyal spyi'i 'byor med gral rim gyi mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi gsar brje'i rtsa 'dzugs shig yin/ mar khe si dang en ke si yis 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉du 64'dzam gling hril bo'i 'byor med pa rnams mnyam 'brel gyis shig ’ ces pa'i 'bod skul btang rjes 'thab rtsod kyi lag len brgyud de/ dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs drug cu pa'i mgor bslebs pa na/ 'byor med gral rim gyi rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi bsam blo la nyin re bzhin rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim gyis ngos zin dang rgyus lon byung / skabs der byung ba'i don gnyis kyis gnas tshul de gsal bor mtshon thub ste/ don dang po ni a ri'i lho byang g.yul 'thab skabs su a ri'i lho khul gyi sring bal phyir gtong je nyung du phyin pas dbyin jir sring bal gyi than pa byung ba dang / dbyin ji 'i 'byor ldan gral rim srid gzhung gis lho khul gyi 'debs 'dzugs gzhis ga'i bdag po la mngon gsal du snying rje'i bsam blo bcangs te/ lho khul gyi bran bdag gis lin khon gyis mgo khrid pa'i mnyam 'brel srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed par rgyab skyor bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa dang / dbyin ji'i bzo pa gral rim gyis rang gi rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung gi log spyod bsam blo der sun 'byin byas nas/ a ri'i byang khul gyi drang bden 'thab rtsod la rgyab skyor byas/ de ni don dngos thog a ri'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la snying rje dang rgyab skyor byas pa zhig yin/ don gnyis pa ni zar 297

rgyal u ru ses khrag dri 'thul ba'i sgo nas po lan ḍi mi dmangs kyi 'os langs la drag gnon byas pa na/ dbyin hpha sogs rgyal khab kyi bzo pa gral rim mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas po lan ḍi'i mi dmangs kyi drang bden 'thab rtsod la ngag rogs byas te/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gi gtum spyod la dgag pa drag po brgyab pa de yin/ rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim gyis nges par du rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa'i ngos zin nyin re bzhin je cher gyur/de'i mtshungs su/ yo rob kyi rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa'i bar gyi 'brel gtug kyang nyin bzhin je mang du gyur/ 1862lor lon ton nas rgyal khab khri'i bkram ston tshogs 'du zhes pa bsdus shing / hpha ran si dang 'jar man gyi bzo pa'i 'thus mi der ltad gzigs su phebs te/ dbyin ji dang hpha ran si sogs rgyal khab kyi bzo pa'i 'thus mi dang bar 'brel 'dris kyi go skabs byung zhing / kho tshos rgyal spyi'i bzo pa gral rim ji ltar mthun sgril byed pa sogs gnad don thad bsam blo brje res byas/ 1863lo'i zla 7par/ dbyin ji'i bzo pa yis po lan ḍi'i mi dmangs kyi 'os langs la ngag thog nas rgyab skyor byed ched hpha ran si'i bzo par 'phrin yig btang zhing / rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim rnams bya spyod thad mnyam 'brel dang mthun sgril la shugs snon byas nas po lan ḍi'i spun zla la rgyab skyor byed rgyu'i 'bod pa btang ba dang / dbyin ji'i bzo pa rnams kyis bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo nas hpha ran si'i bzo pa la 64nga tsho spun zla ji bzhin mdza' mthun yong bar byed ’’ ces brjod la/ hpha ran si'i bzo pas kyang gsar brje'i spro sems brtas pa'i 'phrin lwan bris te/ ‘8nga tsho mthun sgril byas te rang nyid skyob dgos mi’zhes bshad pa dang / hpha ran si'i bzo pas da 298

dung 'thus mi'i tshogs pa zhig mngags te/ gzab rgyas kyi ngang nas 'phrin lan de lon ton du bskyal/ 1864lo'i zla 9tshes 28nyin/ dbyin ji'i bzo pa'i mna' 'brel gyis lon ton gyi sin mā ten tshoms chen du po lan ḍi'i mi rigs bcing 'grol las don la ngag skyor bgyi ba'i rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin gyi bzo pa mang tshogs kyi tshogs 'du bsdus la/ mi grangs nyis stong lhag tshogs 'dur zhugs par ma zad/ hpha ran si sogs rgyal khab kyi bzo pa'i 'thus mi la dga' bsu zhus shing / kho tsho'i 'phrin lan la gzab nan gyis nyan/tshogs 'dur zhugs pa la hpha ran si dang 'jar man/ i ṭa li/ po lan ḍi bcas kyi bzo pa'i 'thus mi yod cing / mar khe si yang gdan zhus ltar tshogs 'dur zhugs/ tshogs chen der mthun sgril mdza' gcugs kyi ngang nas phan tshun bsam 'char brje res byas/ hpha ran si'i 'thus mis dus thog der rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin gyi bzo pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig 'dzugs rgyu'i gros mgo bton pa la tshang mas mos mthun byung / de bas tshogs chen gyis gnas skabs rang bzhin gyi u yon lhan tshogs shig btsugs te sgrig yig gi ma phyi 'bri bar 'gan 'khur rgyu byas/ phyis su tshang mas rtsa 'dzugs de'i ming la ‘8rgyal spyi'i bzo pa'i lhan tshogs ’nyate/ bsdus ming la 66rgyal spyi ’ 'dogs rgyur gtan 'khel byas/ tshogs chen du zhugs mkhan khrod ring lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pas/ u yon lhan tshogs kyis sgrig yig gi ma phyi 'bri ba'i rmang gzhi cung zhan/ mar khe si la ma phyir bzo bcos gnang rgyu'i las bcol zhus so// mar khe sis las bcol khur du blangs nas/ 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉gyi rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / grub mtha' dang ring lugs so so'i bsam 'char la brtsi 'jog byas te/ bskyar du 〈〈rgyal spyi'i bzo pa'i lhan tshogs tshugs pa'i bsgrags gtam 〉〉dang 〈〈gnas skabs rtsa 'dzin 〉〉— 299

gyi phyi mo bris/ phyis su u yon lhan tshogs mar khe sis bris pa'i phyi mo'i yig cha de la gros mthun byung / de las mar khe si ni rgyal spyi dang po'i bla srog yin pa gsal bor shes thub bo//rgyal spyi dang po tshugs pa'i rjes su 'thus mi'i tshogs 'du thengs gnyis dang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs lnga la 'tshogs/ mar khe si dang en ke si'i 'go khrid 'og rgyal spyi dang pos 46'dzam gling gi 'byor med pa rnams mnyam 'brel bgyi ba'i dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim dang mthun sgril byas la/ rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod la rgyab skyor byas pa dang / tshan rig spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsamablo hur brtson gyis dril bsgrags byas la/ phu ru ton dang / bha khe nye(7644sposam050'i 'a༅bapo5240gastus ༅loo)/ lusal(ga0 61sa8ba66ཿ3ma04rṣa7)sogs skabs 'tshol ring lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa rnams dang 'thab rtsod lhod med byas/ rgyal spyi dang po gnas pa'i ring la/pha ri si kung hre'i gsar brje byung ba yin pas/ rgyal spyi dang pos shugs chen po'i sgo nas kung hre'i gsar brje la rgyab skyor byas/ pha ri si kung hre pham rjes su'ang kung hre'i 'thab mo ba skyob pa'am ngag skyor byed pa'i thabs sna tshogs spyad la/ kung hre'i gsar brje'i rtsa don srung skyob byas so// pha ri si kung hre pham rjes su grub pa'i chab srid kyi gnas babs des rgyal spyi dang po gnas pa'i cha rkyen med par gyur pas/ 1876lo'i zla 7par 'thor ba khyab bsgrags byas so//rgyalaspyi gnyis pa ni rgyal khab so so'i spyi tshogs tang gi rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel rtsa 'dzugs zhes pa'i bsdus ming yin/ 1889lo'i zla 1tshes 14nyin ni hpha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis pa si thil btson khang blangs te lo 'khor brgya lon 300

pa'i rjes dran gyi nyi ma yin la/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs ring lugs pas nyin der pha ri si nas 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bsdus te rgyal spyi gnyis pa btsugs/dus rabs 19pa'i phyed gzhug mar/ rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa'i dpung khag shugs cher phyin pa dang mar khe si ring lugs rgya cher bsgrags spel byung ba dang bstun nas/ rgyal khab so sor snga gzhug tu bzo pa gral rim gyi srid tang btsugs/ dper na/ 'jar man du spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo tang / a rir a ri byang ma'i spyi tshogs ring lugs bzo pa'i tang / hpha ran sir spyi tshogs ring lugs bzo pa'i tang / u ru sir ngal rtsol bcing 'grol khang /dbyin jir spyi tshogs dmangs gtso mna' 'brel dang hphe pe khang btsugs pa sogs lta bu'o// spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi las 'gul grangs tshad je mang du 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ las 'gul gyi chab srid chu tshad je dma' ru 'gro ba'i 'phel phyogs mngon par gyur/ srid tang la la'i 'go khrid la 8 gros tshogs kyi smyo nad ’ phog ste/ gros tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod nus pa la yid ches rmongs dad kyi tshad du bslebs pa 'chang tshul ni/ gros tshogs 'thab rtsod kyis 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i gzhi rtsa'i gnad don thag gis gcod thub par 'dod pa lta bu yin/ de bas/ skabs de'i kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don zhig ni mar khe si ring lugs kyi rigs pa bed spyad de srid tang la bsam blo'i drag chas spras rgyu dang / gcig gyur gyi srid jus 'don pa/'thab rtsod la gcig gyur gyis 'go khrid byed rgyu de yin/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa ni de lta bu'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs shig 'og byung ba yin no/ /1883lo'i zla 3par mar khe si 'das rjes/ en ke si yis rgyal spyi'i bzo pa'i las 'gul gyi sne 'khrid pa'i 'gan khur/ khos 'phrin yig bskur ba dang rtsom yig spel ba/ mi sger ngos kyi bgro gleng sogs kyi thabs la brten 301

nas rgyal khab so so'i srid tang la tshan rig spyi tshogs ring lugs dril bsgrags byas shing / bye brag gi mdzub ston sna tshogs byas/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa 'dzugs pa'i gra sgrig gi bya ba rabs dang rim pa ni en ke sis thad kur 'go khrid byas te bsgrubs pa yin mod/ 'on kyang kho 〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉〉deb gsum pa rtsom sgrig dpe skrun byed par brel ba'i rkyen gyis pha ri si nas tshogs pa'i rgyal spyi gnyis pa tshugs pa'i tshogs 'dur zhugs ma thub/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i thengs dang po'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen la zhugs mkhan khrod yo rob dang me gling gi rgyal khab nyi shu lhag nas yong ba'i 'thus mi bzhi brgyar nye ba zhig yod pas snga na med pa'i tshogs 'du rgya che ba zhig yin/tshogs chen thog gros gzhi gal chen 'gar gros 'cham byung / de'i khrod rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim gyis nges par du rang nyid kyi srid tang btsugs te srid dbang 'phrog pa dang / thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs rtsa med gtong dgos pa nan bshad byas/ tshogs chen de'i lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i gros chod gzhan zhig ni zla 5tshes 1nyin 8 rgyal spyi'i ngal rtsol dus chen ’ du gtan 'khel byas pa de yin/ de ni 1886lo'i zla 5tshes 1nyin a ri'i bzo pas dus tshod brgyad kyi las ga'i lam lugs brtson gnyer ched spyi'i las mtshams bzhag pa la rjes dran byed ched yin no// gros chod kyis ‘6rgyal khab so so'i ngal rtsol pa rnams rang rang rgyal khab kyi cha rkyen dang 'tsham pa'i rnam pa spyad denya / lo re bzhin ‘ lnga gcig ’ khrom skor rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ rgyal spyi'i 'byor med gral rim gyi mthun sgril stobs shugs ngom ston byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang / 'di ni 6 lnga gcig dus chen ’ byung tshul yin/rgyalaspyi gnyis pa tshugs rjes su/ rgyal khab so so'i bzo pa gral rim gyi 302

mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi rtsa 'dzugs te/ dper na bzo tshogs dang mnyam las khang / bzo pa'i klog deb sogs char rjes kyi sha mo bzhin byung /1890lor hpha ran si na las bzo pa'i tshogs pa chig stong lhag yod pa dang /ḍin mag gi kho phen ha ken (00khya0sa6thartsa0ba sorṣaṣātsho)sa khul gcig pu na mi grangs nyis khri lhag zhugs pa'i bzo tshogs yod la/ si we tser lan na bzo pa'i klog deb rigs bco lnga yod/ yin na'ang de'i mtshugs su/ rgyal khab so so'i skabs 'tshol ring lugs kyi stobs shugs kyang mgo 'degs mgo brtsams so//1893lor/ rang lo 72la son pa'i en ke si dzo re khi (75ba05 loḥtsho)yi thengs gsum pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen la zhugs shing / 'thus mi rnams kyis 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar gyi thal sgras khong la dga' bsu dang gus sems bstan/ en ke sis tshogs thog tu gsung bshad nyung bsdus shig gnang ste/ rgyal khab so so'i 'byor med gral rim gyis 'thab rtsod khrod gros tshogs ring lugs dang chab srid legs bcos ring lugs la mtho drags pa'i gdeng 'jog byed mi 'os pa'i nyen brda btang / 1895lo'i zla 8par/ en ke si tshe las 'das la/ khong rang gi zhal chems ltar rus thal 'byams su klas pa'i rgya mtshor gtor ro//en ke si tshe las 'das rjes su/ rgyal khab so so'i skabs 'tshol ring lugs pa mgo bo btegs shing / rgyal spyi gnyis pa g.yon phyogs pa dang g.yas phyogs pa/ dkyil phyogs pa gsum du gyes/ g.yas phyogs bzo bcos ring lugs pa ni pon si then (༅75316 80la3 01ba /khye khyalopho)'thus tshab tu byas te mar khe si ring lugs la 6 bzo bcos ’ byed rgyu'i re ba mngon gsal du 'don zhing / bzo bcos ring lugs kyi lta ba'i gtso gnad ni legs bcos 303

dang / 'gab mthun byas te 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje dang 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa las ma 'das so//pon si then gyis gzhung lugs 8 gsar gtod ’ byas la/ hpha ran si'i skabs 'tshol ring lugs pas de lag tu bstar ro// 1899lor/ 8 spyi tshogs ring lugs pa ’ me le ran (༅ 10bab0 10 306 0 5150 3sa6ཿ7༅)pho ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi log spyod srid gzhung du zhugs/ don 'dis rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i nang khul du rtsod gleng chen po bslangs / de ni 88me le ran don rkyen zhes pa de yin/ dkyil phyogs pa ni kha'o tshi ke (5tha71 635 3khu7 rsā1cholhung)'thus tshab byas te/ ngos thog nas mar khe si ring lugs la mos mthun gyis kha nas tshig snyan po brjod na'ang / rnam 'gyur ngo gnyis ma'i rang bzhin ldan la/ don dngos thog g.yas phyogs par rgyab skyor gyis mar khe si ring lugs la ngo rgol byed/ mi de dag la mgo bskor gyi rang bzhin chen po dang ldan pas gsar brje'i las 'gul la nyen tshabs shin tu che'o// g.yon phyogs pani tse thi ken (013 3 70 ji1ba chung༈rnya༅)dang/ le pi khi ne sri(yo116014 1066saḥ6 ཿ khi༅layo)/ pe nal( 5rtsa53 20601lkoyolo)/ la hpha ko (9tha51 2313 rtsa507chocho)bcas 'thus tshab byas shing / tshan rig spyi tshogs ring lugs srung skyob byas te/ pon si then dang kha'o tshe ke'i skabs 'tshol ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs la mthun thabs med pa'i 'thab rtsod byas mod/ yin na'ang skabs der g.yon phyogs pa da dung phyogs la la nas nar son po byung med la/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i khrod mi grangs kyang mang po med pas/ 'go khrid kyi dbang cha pon si then dang kha'o tshi ke sogs kyi lag tu shor te/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa de rgyal spyi'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bran g.yog lta bur gyur ro//304

dus rabs 20pa'i mgor/ le nyin gyis gtso byas pa'i sgor hri we khi ④tang gis rgyal khab so so'i g.yon phyogs pa dang mthun sgril byas te/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i khrod kyi skabs 'tshal ring lugs pa la rbad chod kyis 'thab rtsod byed mgo brtsams/ 'thab rtsod dza drag je cher gyur pa dang bstun nas/ rgyal khab so so'i bzo bcos ring lugs pa rnams gom gang mdun spos kyis rang rang rgyal khab kyi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi phyogs su langs te btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'thab la rgyab skyor byas/ rgyal khab so so'i g.yon phyogs pa rnams mthun sgril dam zab sgos 'thab rtsod byas pas/ 1912lor bha sel (8ཿ01 ༅tshipo)du 'tshogs pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen steng / 〈〈bha sel bsgrags gtam 〉〉la gros 'cham byung ste/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab so so'i g.yul gshom gra sgrig la kha rdung drag po btang zhing / rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs mthun sgril byas te btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug la ngo rgol byed rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / 1914lor/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po byung / rgyal khab so so'i skabs 'tshol ring lugs pa rnams de ma nyid du ngo 'bagaljun ma dor te 8 mes rgyal srung skyob kyi kha g.yang sgrog gin rang rang rgyal khab kyi log spyod srid gzhung la rgyab skyor dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'thab tu zhugs nas/ phan tshun gsod res byed mkhan spyi tshogs hra ④ skyil440 ྾7lo6ngamazhes pa ni u ru si'i skad de/ ‘6mang phyogs pa zhes pa'i don yin/ 1༅3lor u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso bzo tang gi 'thusami'i tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa'i steng krung dbyang gi 'go khrid las khungs 'dems bsko byed skabs le nyin la 'dems shog mang shos thob pas de ltar thogs shing / kho'i bsam blo'i ma lag la'ang ‘ stor hri we khi ring lugs 7(le nyin ring lugs zhes pa dang mtshungs )zer ba yin/305

wen ring lugs par ⑦gyur pas/ rgyal spyi gnyis pa rtsa nas 'thor ro//'khrug chen skabs su/ le nyin gyis rgyal khab so so'i g.yon phyogs pa dang mthun sgril gyis mu mthud du 'thab rtsod byas shing / 'byor med gral rim gyi rgyal spyi'i ring lugs rgyun 'khyongs byas/ 1915lo dang 1916lor/ si we tser lan dze mer wal ti (7 16 mongazedritshe'irṣa9kṣi)dang khen thal 1pa'i1ba45) tsheg 71 4 (510ba 7 ṭhalolo)so sor rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs ring lugs pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs gnyis 'tshogs/ tshogs 'du de gnyis steng sra brtan gyi g.yon phyogs pa grub mgo brtsams la/ de ni don dngos thog rgyal spyi gsum par ljang myug 'bus pa yin no| 1919lo'i zla 3par/ le nyin gyi mgo khrid 'og tu/ rgyal spyi gsum pa ste/ gung khran rgyal spyi zhes pa tshugs/ 'di ni 'dzam gling gi deng rabs lo rgyus su gtogs pas 'dir zhib tu mi spro'o/ /(bye hra wen ring lugs pa ni/ g.yul 'khrug la shin tu dga' ba'i mi rigs ring lugs pa zhesapa'i don te/ hpha ran si'i nā pho lun skabasakyi dmag mi rgan pa hra wen(ma1 006khya 0580 1 ba skya'isteng)zhes pa nā pho lun gyi dbang sdud g.yul 'khrug la bsngags shing g.yul ngor dpa' ba/ lus yong4rma yis gang ba zhig yod pa de'i ming las byung ba zhig go/ 306

so gcig pa/ ((men ri rtags can gyi dmag gru gas gtor byung༄lasabaslangs pa'i g.yul 'thab shig1898lo ste/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su dus rabs nyi shu par brgal bar 'gyur ba'i lo der/ krung go dang 'dzam gling hril bo gang la'ang don chen byung ste/ krung go ru khang yu we (lolto7)dang lāng chi khra'o ( ༅zapo)yis gtso byas pa'i sa khyi lo'i lugs sgyur ('aṭharsātsho)las 'gul byung ste/ mthar pham kha las mjug bsdus pa dang / a me ri kha nas a ri dang si phen gyi g.yul 'khrug langs te mthar a ri rgyal te mjug bsdus pa lta bu yin/ sa khyi lo'i lugs sgyur gyi pham khas skabs de'i krung go'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spobs stobs ha cang zhan pas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur gral rim la legs bcos dang bzod gsol cung re bgyi ba'i re ba bton pa'ang 'grub mi nus pa mtshon pa dang / skabs de'i nub gling gi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rgyal khab gtso bo rnams kyi 'byor ldan gral rim de sger gcod 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dus rim du 'phel brgal byung zin zhing / mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod kyi 'thab 'dzing byed mgo brtsams yod la/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i dus rabs su bslebs pa mtshon byed a si'i g.yul 'khrug de ni a ri'i dmag gru zhig 'gas gtor byung ba las bslangs pa red/ 4307

1898lo'i zla 2tshes 15nyin gyi dgong mor/ a ri'i rim gras kha pa la gtogs pa'i 'thab gru 64men (54sas0 gro1ṭha)rtags can de dal 'jags ger khi'u bha'i hā lba nā (ṣāthosmokhya ༅tha ༅chathab8)'jug ngogs su bsdad yod la/gru gzings steng gi dmag dpon mang shos der bslebs ma thag pa'i 8 wa hrin thon ’ rtags can steng mgron du phebs song / dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu dang skar bzhi bcu'i thog glo bur du ldir sgra zhig grags te ‘4men ’ rtags can gas gtor byung zhing / mi nyis brgya dang drug cu re bzhi shi zhing / mi dgu bcu lhag rmas pa dang / 'thab gru mtsho la bying bar gyur/ skabs der a ri'i 8 dmag gru ni dal 'jags kyi dgong mor mthong du med pa'i stobs shugs shig dang 'grel bshad byed mi nus pa'i thabs tshul zhig gis gtor byung ’ zhes brjod la/ phyis su a ri'i ‘ rtog dpyod ’ snyan seng du/ 66men ’ rtags can ni chu 'bom gyis phog ste gas gtor byung bar brjod yod/ 8 men 7rtags can de yang snying ji ltar gas bying byung ba ni lo rgyus kyi 66gab tshig 7cig tu gyur yod par brjod do// don dngos thog shes ldan rnams kyis/don rkyen de a ri gcig pus bslangs pa yin pa gsal bor rtogs nus/kho lum pu yis skam sa chen po gsar rnyed byung ba nas bzung / khi'u bha ni si phen gyi mi ser spel yul du gyur yod/ 1895lor/ khi'u bha ru jo ze ma te (/0tsha 580tha 53 1 96 02lo166 bra.oṃ)yis 'go khrid pa'i mi rigs rang btsan don gnyer byed pa'i g.yul 'khrug langs shing / 1898lor 'os langs byas pas rgyal khongs kyi sum cha'i gnyis bcing 'grol btang / tag tag skabs der/ a ri'i lag pa khi'u bha'i phyogs su bsrings/ a ri'i rgya4 don 'go 'dzin (blon chen )khon si a tam si yis 6‘khi'u bha de si phen dang gyes pa na/ a ri'i 'dren shugs thebs te a ri'i pang du bsnyes srid la/ de 308

las thabs lam gzhan mi srid pa dang / a ris kyang de rang gi pang du mi len mi srid do ’ zhes brjod la/ gros zhugs pa a pe —rlu le kru yis 6 a ri'i bzo grwas a ri'i mi dmangs kyis bed spyad mi tshar ba'i dngos po thon skyed byas pa dang / a ri'i sa gzhi ru kho tshos zos mi tshar ba'i dngos po thon skyed byas/ las skal gyis nga tshor nga rang tsho'i srid jus bkod sgrig byas/ 'dzam gling gi nyo tshong bya ba de nges par du nga tsho'i yin la/ nga tshor dbang yang 'os/gal te des skar rtags can gyi dar cha de pā na mā mis bzos gtsang bo'i (03bam60 2thab373 ༅4bra 7kho)steng dang / hi wa i ( tha44 1 zatsholko)yi nam mkha'/ khi'u bha dang nub mtsho bcas kyi mkha' dbyings su bskyod pa mtshon na/ nga tshos de dga' ba 'bum gyis bsu 'os la de mngon du 'gyur slad 'bad par 'os so ’ zhes gsal bor brjod yod/ gros zhugs pa 'dis a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis rang gi stobs shugs rgyas pa dang bstun te phyi phyogs la rgya bskyed pa'i ham sems dmar rjen du bstan yod do//a ri'i lho byang g.yul 'khrug gi rjes su/ bzo zhing las kyi thon skyed 'phe'/ rgyas de dngos gnas gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mgyogs po zhig yin/ lo ngo sum cu yang ma long ba'i dus yun thung thung zhig nang / ‘6'dzam gling gi bzo grwa mi ru 'bod pa'i dbyin ji las brgal te 'dzam gling gi ang dang por bslebs/ yin na'ang a ri'i dmigs pa rang gi rgyal khab nas phyi rgyal du phyogs pa'i skabs su/ 'dzam gling snga mo nas bgo bsha' byas zin pas/ a ris mi ser spel yul bdag tu 'dzin dgos na/ btsan rgyal gzhan gyi lag nas 'phrog pa las thabarsha gzhan med do// de bas phyi rgya bskyed pa'i dmigs 'ben ham 'tshol byas la/ thog mar 'dems pa ni si phen gyi mi ser spel yal khi' bha dang ci li dzin (951 ཿṣṭha4)yin te/ skabs de'i si sngar ra༅ rnga4 111)1)111()3 sna ༄ ༷)()sbyo/

phen nyams rgud du gyur nas kha gtad gcog sla bas so//1897lo'i zla 12par/ a ri'i hā lba nā ru sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mos a ri'i srid gzhung la dmag gru mngags te khi'u bhar yong nas 8 phyi sdod rang mi srung skyob ’ byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ 1898lo'i zla 1tshes 25nyin/skyogs chen nyer bzhi bkod yod pa'i 66men ’ rtags can de si phen dbang 'dzin pa'i mos mthun ma brgyud par hā lba nā 'jug ngogs su bslebs/6‘men mi rtags can hā lba nā ru bsdad rjes/ thabs brgya jus stong gis glags btsal/ dang thog men ’ rtags can gyi ded dpon de a ri'i gzhung tshab chen mos 'gro rogs byas te hā lba nā'i glang 'dzing ra bar 'gying rngam chen pos song ste glags btsal nas/ si phen gyi mir khro ba slong thabs byas kyang / glang 'dzing byed sa'i mi rnams glang 'dzing kho na la ma gtogs mos pa med pas/jus de ma grub pas jus gzhan btsal/ zla 2tshes 8nyin/ 66nye'u yog nyin re'i tshags par ’ du glo bur du si phen gyi a rir sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mo ti lo me (wotsho.oṃ)yi sger 'phrin zhig bkod cing / de'i nang don ni a ri'i tsung thung meg ken le (yo151 3 5061ba107 zo༅lko)la ngan smras byed pa ste/meg ken le ni ‘4dga' phyogs la bstun nas rang bkur thob thabs byed mkhan zhig dang / rang mthong che ba'i srid tshong ba nya zhig tu brjod yod/'phrin yig de ni ti lo me yis si phen gyi ma ti rid 〈〈gdong mchong tshags par 〉〉gyi rtsom sgrig cig la bskur ba zhig yin la/ rtsom sgrig pa de hā lba nā ru mgron khang du sdod skabs shig la/ 'phrin yig de khi'u bha'i na gzhon zhig gis brkus shing / khi'u bha'i nye'u yog tu sdod pa'i 'thus tshab la sprad pa zhig yin no// 'phrin de mngon bsgrags byas rjes/ a ri nas de ma nyid du 'du long 'khrugs te/ si phen gyi phyi 'brel pho nyas sdod yul rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin la 310

ngan smras byas par dgag pa brgyab/ si phen gyis de ma thag tu bzod gsol zhus par ma zad pho nya ba de yang phyir bkugs/ a ris don de las gnad don chen po zhig bzo mi nus mod/ 'on kyang spyi dmangs khrod si phen la rgol ba'i gleng phyogs slong rgyu'i dmigs yul 'grub/64men ’ rtags can 'gas gtor byung rjes/ a ri'i btsan thabs kyis si phen la 'jigs skul sna tshogs byas/ si phen gyi dbang 'dzin pa rgyal mos mig nas mchi ma 'don bzhin o rgyal gyi rgyal po la khong ngor bud de 'dum 'grig byed rgyu dang rgyab skyor gnang rgyu'i re ba bton/ yin na'ang / a ri'i gros tshogs khrod kyi g.yul 'gyed pa'i lta ba shugs je drag nas je drag tu phyin pas/ meg ken le yis 'thab brda sbon rgyur sems thag bcad do// zla 3tshes 9nyin/ a ri'i rgyal tshogs kyis mgyogs myur byings dang mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas gros gzhir mos mthun byung zhing / a sgor khri lnga stong btang ste/ brel myur che ba'i sgo nas dmag bsdu ba dang g.yul la gra sgrig byed rgyu'i thag bcad/ zla 4tshes 20nyin/ a ris dang blangs dmag mi khri bcu gnyis dang lnga stong bsdu rgyu'i brda sbyor spel zhing / tshes 22nyin/ a ris khi'u lha'i 'jug ngogs thams cad bsdams pas/ si phen thabs zad nas g.yul brda sbran/ zla 4tshes 25nyin/ meg ken le yis dngos su si phen la g.yul brda sbran no// a ri'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyis 8 a ri'i lo rgyus thog ches yid du 'ong zhing /sdug bsngal ches nyung ba ’ ru 'bod pa'i a si'i g.yul 'khrug ni de ltar du byung ba yin no//g.yul 'khrug thengs der/ a ri'i mtsho dmag la yun ring bo'i sbyong brdar dang 'thus tshang ba'i gra sgrig yod pa dang / si phen gyi 'thab gzings ni rnying gog yin la/ sbyong brdar zhan pa/ bkod 'doms legs po med pa 311

bcas kyis a ri'i dmag dpung gi 'gran zla ga la 'ong / zla 5pa dang 6pa'i nang / mā ne la (53sa118 bra༅4)dang san the a ko'i mtsho 'thab khrod/ a ri'i mtsho dmag gis si phen gyi gzings dmag rdul du brlags la/ der mthud nas/ a ris hphi li pin dang khi'u bha'i 'os langs pa mgo bskor dang bed spyod kyi sgo nas bde blag ngang rgyal khab de gnyis kyi mnga' khongs bdag tu bzung / g.yul 'khrug der zla ngo gsum tsam las ma 'gor zhing gzhi rgya chen po med/ nyams rgud du gyur pa'i si phen gyis rang nyid pham par 'gyur bar nges shes gting tshugs skyes pas/ hpha ran si la ngor bud nas 'dum 'grig byed rgyu'i re ba bton/ a ris dmag stong shin tu mthon po dgos par brjod pas/ si phen gyis mar chag ci thub sgos zla ngo gnyis la gros mol byas rjes/stobs shugs kyis ma lcogs nas dang len mi zhu thabs med byung / 1898lo'i zla 12par/ a si gnyis kyis 〈pha ri si'i zhi chings 〉〉la ming rtags bkod/zhi chings der don tshan bcu bdun yod/ gal gnad ni si phen gyis khi'u dha gtong ba dang / khi'u bha ‘4rang btsan ’ yin pa khas len pa/ hphi li pin dang po to ri ki 'gag gling bcas mnyam 'brel rgyal khab la ‘ sprod pa ’ sogs red/ hphi li pin gyi ched du/ a ris si phen la a sgor khri nyis stong byin no// 66rang btsan ’ dang 88sprod pa ’ zer ba'i don ci yin nam zer na/gong nas drangs pa'i gros zhugs pa des chings yig la ming rtags ma bkod gong du gnas tshul dngos brjod yod de/ khos 88nyi wa i ni nga tsho'i yin la/po to ri ki nga tshor dbang bar 'gyur zhing / khi'u bha ni kho tsho'i mi dmangs kyi re mos ltar mthar nga tsho'i yin pa dang / shar phyogs kyi mtsho gling so so'i nang nas ni/ tha na thog mtha' bar gsum du e sha ya'i sgo mor gyur pa rnams las kyang nyung mthar 'bar rdzas snon sa'i tshigs mal re nga tshor dbang 'os pa dang /312

rang dbang gi srid gzhung zhig gi dar cha de hphi li pin gyi mkha' dbyings su rlung gis bskyod 'os/ ’ zhes brjod yod/a si g.yul 'khrug ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis 'dzam gling bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i g.yul 'khrug thengs dang po yin la/ des btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i dus rabs mgo brtsams pa mtshon no// g.yul 'khrug thengs de las shes thub pa ni/ mi ser spel yul bgos tshar ba'i gnas tshul 'og phyis su dar ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab kyis 66ma rtsa ltar ’ dang ‘6stobs shugs ltar ’ du mi ser spel yul yang bskyar bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i re ba 'don nges pas/ btsan rgyal ring lugs bar gyi g.yul 'khrug ni g.yol du med pa zhig yin pa de'o// a si g.yul 'khrug gi me lce gzim ma thag ste/ phyi lor a hphe ri kha nub ma nas yang bskyar dbyin por g.yul 'khrug byung / des na/ btsan rgyal ring lugs zhes pa ni/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i g.yul 'thab kyis sna drangs te byung ba zhig tu 'khums so/ ༷13

so gnyis pa/ dbyin por g.yula'athab/gong gi tshan par/ nga tshos dbyin por g.yul 'thab ces brjod pa'i g.yul 'khrug thengs de ni dbyin ji ba dang por mi'i (porami/ 800 oṃlomani ho lan ḍi'i skad kyi1 0khu6ཿ 10bzhes pa'i bsdus ming ngo // )bar gyi hphe gling lho ma'i mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i g.yul 'thab cig yin la/ a si g.yul 'khrug gi phyi lo ste 1899lor byung ba yin/ por mi ni ho lan ḍi'i ci'i ser spel ba'i ring lugs pa'i hphe gling lho mar yod pa'i rgyud pa yin la/ porā zhes pa ni zhing pa'i don yin/ ho lan ḍi'i mis hphe gling lho khul du hphe gling ṣka ches snga ba'i mi ser spel yul te/ kha'e phu (03༅ lordzo)mi ser spel yulabatsugs/ 1814lor/ dbyin ji bas ho lan ḍi'i mi'i lag nas de 'phrog song / yul de'i ho lan ḍi'i mi'i rgyud pa ste/ por mi rnams thabs zad ṣkashing rtar bsdad nas byang khul du spos te/ por pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab chung chungaganyis te/ thi ran si wal (1smotha03pha7 oṃ༅ lo)dang o ran kri ( 10khu4sa3 0 3brtsa0 5 73 4 ༅༅ lo)gnyis btsugs/ por mi'i rgyal khab chung chung de gnyis dang thog cung zhi bde yin mod/ rjes su dbyin ji ba dang 'gal 'du phyi phyir je cher song /ma gzhir yo rob mi ser spel mkhan rnams snga mo zhig nas hphe gling du bslebs te/ nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i 'gram rgyud du nyo tshong 'du gnas mang po zhig btsugs nas/ nyes pa che ba'i bran g.yog gi nyo tshong spel myong mod/'on kyang dus rabs 19pa'i smad kyi bar du/ hphe gling skam sa chen po'i bcu 314

cha'i dgu yi sa gzhi yul de'i mis bdag tu bzung yod/ ma rtsa ring lugs de btsan rgyal ring lugs dus rim du 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ yo rob kyi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab gtso bo 'ga' zhig gis su snga rtsod kyin hphe gling du bslebs shing hphe gling bgo bshal byed rgyur rngams/ skabs der hphe gling gi sa khul mang po zhig tu da dung stobs ldan gyi rgyal khab btsugs ngamid pas/ mi ser spel mkhan rnams kyis hphe gling gi mnga' khongs bdag bzung byed shin tu sla/ me mda' 'ga' 'am chang dam bu 'ga'/ tha na kha dog bkra ba'i rgyan cha kha shas kyis tsho dpon zhig bslu brid mgo bskor byas te/ kho rang gis ci yin mi shes pa'i chings yig steng ming rtags mdzub thel 'god du bcug nas/shin tu sla ba'i sgo nas sa khul zhig btsan rgyal ga ge mo zhig gi dbang 'og tu 'jug nus so// mtshams la lar yo rob kyi mi kha shas pha ri si'am/ lon ton/per lin du bsdad nas/ hphe gling gi sa khra zhig steng drang thig brgyab ste hphe gling gi mnga' khongs bgo bsha' byed la/ drang thig de dag gi rjes shul ni da lta'ang hphe gling gi sa khra'i steng gsal bor phab 'dug go/dbyin ji ni hphe gling gi mi ser spel yul 'phrog pa'i las la shin tu hur por snang / 1814lor hphe gling lho ma'i kha'e phu mi ser spel yul 'phrog rjes/ring po ma 'khor bar i jib sogs rgyal khab kyang dbang du bsdus/1871lor/ ming la ze sel ro te si (000111060 250603 ཿkhrolo ༅ཿlo)zer ba'i dbyin ji ba gzhon nu zhig hphe gling nub mar bslebs/ kho ni nyen mchong ba dpe thub cig yin/ kho ma gzhir khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor khur bo je yang du gtong ched hphe gling lho mar las ka gnyer ba'i phu bo'i sar glo gcong gso bcos byed du yong ba yin la/ tag tag skabs der hphe gling lho mar pha lam gyi gter dang gser gter phun sum tshogs po zhig gsar rnyed byung bas/ 315

lo mang po ma 'gyangs par kho gser gter dang pha lam gyi gter khar brten nas 'byor phyug rgyas te/ lag stong 'khyam po zhig glo bur du 'byor ldan du gyur/ phyis su khos da dung kha'e phu mi ser spel yul gyi spyi 'dzin dang zhor du dbyin ji'i hphe gling kung si'i las 'dzin kyang khur/ dbang stobs dang 'byor ba mgyogs myur du 'phar ba dang bstun nas kho'i ham sems kyang phyi phyir je cher gyur/ khos dbyin ji'i dngos stobs dang rgyu stobs la brten nas/ hphe gling lho ma'i kha'e phu ton (0390 10mas zastsam)nas hphe gling byang ma'i khe ro bar lcags lam zhig bskrun 'dod skyes/ ham sems che ba'i 'char gzhi des 'jar man dang hpha ran si sogs rgyal khab kha shas kyi mi ser spel ba'i khe phan la phog thug byung ba dang / por mi'i spyi mthun rgyal khab chung chung gnyis dang yang khe phan gyi 'gal 'du byung / ring po ma 'gor bar thi ran si wal nas yang bskyar 'dzam gling na dkon pa'i gser gter rgya chen po rnyed pas dbyin ji ba rnams ham sems skyes par gyur la/ dbyin ji'i gnas spo ba dag rlabs rgyun bzhin mched de mi 'bor yang sa gnas de ga'i por mi las brgal/8 gser gyi grong nya du 'bod pa'i jo han ne si (/063sab03 sbyo 1slo77)mkhar rdzong du lo ngo bzhi tsam yang ma 'gor bar mi grangs khri bcu la bslebs shing / de'i khrod mang che shos ni dbyin ji ba yin/ de ltar/ por mi dang dbyin rjo ba'i 'gal 'du lhag par dza drag tu gyur/ dbyin ji bas por mi dang 'dra mtshungs kyi 'dems bsko'i dbang dgos pa'i re ba bton la/ de ni don dngos thog mgron pos bdag po'i go gnas 'phrog pa zhig dang / por mi la tshur mgo 'dogs pa'i re ba bton pa zhig yin/ de bas o ran kri dang thi ran si wal gnyis kyi por mi'i rgyal phran gnyis mna' mthun sbrel te thun mong sgos dbyin jir rgol lan sprad pa na/ dbyin ji bas dmag dpung mngags te 316

rgol rdung byas pas/ dbyin por g.yul 'khrug byung ba red/g.yul 'khrug byung rjes su/ mi grangs kyi thad nas dbyin ji bar dge kha che na'ang/ por mi rnams sa babs la rgyus mnga' ba dang / yul 'phrod pa/g.yul la dpa' ba bcas kyi rkyen gyis/ g.yul 'khrug gi thog ma'i skabs su dbyin ji bar rdung rdeg tsha nan btang / por mi rnams mi grangs kyi cha nas nyung ba'i zhan cha yod par ma zad/ kho tsho'i bkod 'doms pa'i lo tshod kyang mtho drags te/ dper na thi ran si wal gyi ches mtho'i dmag spyi lo na re dgu yin pa dang / nub kyi g.yul sa'i bkod 'doms pa lo na re lnga lon pa lta bu yin/ dmag spyi de dag g.yul ngor dpa' zhing snyan grags mtho na'ang /g.yul thabs ni lo ngo nyi shu'i sngon dbyin jir rgol ba'i thabs rnying ba de yin pa dang / glang pos drud pa'i shing rta las g.yul chas dbor 'dren byed dgos pas dal drags la/ de gnas babs gsar ba dang mi mthun pa ni mngon gsal red/ de bas/ dbyin ji bas ring po ma 'gyangs par por mi'i rgyal sa blangs shing / thi ran si wal dang o ran kri dbang du bsdus pa khyab bsgrags byas/ yin na'ang dbyin ji bas rgyal khab de gnyis kyi srid gzhung gar song shes ma byung / don dngos ni por mi'i rgyal khab kyi dbang 'dzin lasakhungs kyang dmag dpung dang lhan du spos te nges med rgol rdung byed du chas pa red/ thi ran si wal gyi dmag spyi tshe las 'das pa dang nub khul spyi 'doms pa g.yul ngor bzung rjes/ dmag spyi gsar ba skor zhig byung ste skabs bstun gyis rgol rdung byas pas byas rjes chen po bzhag 1901lor bslebs pa na/ ho lan ḍi'i srid gzhung ngor bud de bar 'dum byas pas/dbyin por gnyis gas gzhi nas gros mol byas la/ mjug 'bras ni/ thi ran si wal dang o ran kri gnyis dbyin ji'i dbang 'og tu bsdus te dbyin ji'i mi 317

ser spel yul du gyur/ 1910lor dbyin jis mnga' khongs de gnyis dang kha dro gling zur gcig dril byas nas/ lho a hphe ri kha (505 5 (1103 tshethokhri)mna' 'brel btsugs/ 'dir zhar du smra dgos pa zhig ni/ phyis su 'dzam gling gi chab srid gar stegs su snyan grags shin tu che ba'i mi sna grags can gnyis ni g.yul 'khrug 'di'i khrod du 'jon thang thog mar mngon pa yin te/ gcig ni phyis su rgya gar gyi ‘ lhan 'brel mi bgyi ba'i las 'gul ’ dang rgyal chen tang (rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang ) gi gtso 'dzin ghan dhi (5053ba6ཿ 58134068ba663baspu615lo)dang / gzhan zhig ni phyis kyi dbyin ji'i dbu blon chir chel (055 0615 sashā7)red/ snyan dhi yis skabs der hphe gling lho ma na dag sel pa byed bzhin yod la/ dbyin por g.yul 'khrug skabs khos rgya gar gyi 'gyogs byams ru khag cig btsugs te dbyin jir rogs skyor byas/ bshad tshul ltar na g.yul 'khrug de'i khrod kho gtum spyod la zhen pa log mgo brtsams par grags so// chir chel ni g.yul 'khrug thengs de'i khrod nyen tshabs byings dang mi mtshungs pa brgyud myong / g.yul 'khrug thog mar langs skabs/ kho gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan du byas nas hphe gling lho mar yong ba yin la/ thengs shig kho sdod sa'i me 'khor la lam skabs su por mis skyogs rdeg thebs te 'khor tshigs gsum gyi 'khor lo lcags lam dang bral/ chir chel gyis dpa' snyiba'i bskyed de mdel char la ma 'dzem par me 'khor gyi gegs skyon sel bas mes 'khor bde blag ngang rmas ma rnams khyer te bgrod thub pa byung na'ang / chir chel bzung dmag tu gyur/ kho thi ran si wal gyi phe ri tho re'u (9 0 003 maso kho'ushā1krokhru)yul gyi slob grwa zhig tu bkag sdom byas/ nyin zhig gi mtshan mor/ 318
