kho gyang brgal te rdo sol 'dren pa'i me 'khor zhig steng 'gos nas phe ri tho re'u nas bros/ por mi'i dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis dbyin pung nyer lnga yi gtang rag stsol rgyu byas te nyes byol pa chir chel 'dzin rgyu'i bka' khyab bsgrags/chir chel rdo sol 'dren pa'i me 'khor steng yud tsam gnyid de/ skya rengs kyis skabs su mgyogs por bgrod bzhin pa'i me 'khor las mchong ste nags tshal chung chung zhig yod par skong / kho yang bskyar por mi'i lag tu thebs par dogs nas mi khyim gyi sgo rdung mi —phod pas/ dben gnas su nyin du mar 'khyam nyul byas mod/ skom ltogs bzod du med pas thabs zad de/lam 'gro rgyug min la thengs gcig mi lta ka med byung / nyin zhig gi mtshan mor khos nye logs khyim tshang zhig gi sgo rdung / stabs legs pa zhig ni de'i khyim bdag sol gter gyi las 'dzin pa yin zhing / le dbar bcu phrag kha shas kyi yul khams der kho rang por mi la sprod mi srid pa'i mi gcig pu la 'phrad 'dug mi des thog mar chir chel gter khron du sbas shing / phyis su ho lan ḍi'i shing tshong ba zhig brngan te kho shing cha 'drud pa'i me 'khor steng gab tu bcug ste phyir bskyal lo/ chir chel slar yang thi ran si wal du bslebs skabs su/ dbyin ji'i skya dmag gi dmag dpon krung we zhig tu gyur yod/ phyis su dbyin ji'i skad grags che ba'i dbu blon du gyur pa'i chir chel zhes pa de thog dang por mi ser spel ba'i g.yul 'khrug tu zhugs pa ni dbyin por g.yul 'khrug de yin 'dugadabyin por g.yul 'khrug ni a si g.yul 'khrug gi rjes mthud de/ mi ser spel yul slar yang bgo bsha' rgyag ched bgyis pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rnam pa'i g.yul 'khrug thengs gnyis pa yin no// 319

so gsum pa/ kho ri5'i shing rta lo'i zhing pa'i 'osalangs dang krung go dang 'jar pan gyi shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrug1894lo ni rang rgyal gyi lugs rnying gi shing rta lo yin/ lo der kho ri ya (00 0thapo༅)nas shar rig tang (lko༅7)gis 'go khrid pa'i zhing pa'i 'os langs byung zhing / lo rgyus su der 6 shar rig tang gi 'os langs mi zhes dang / ‘8kho ri ya'i shing rta lo'i zhing pa'i 'os langs ’ zhes zer la/ de dang dus mtshungs su krung go dang 'jar pan bar g.yul 'khrug cig byung ba de la/lo rgyus su ‘4krung 'jar shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrug ’ zer ro// don chen 'di gnyis kyi gzhi rtsa ded na gnyis ka 'jar pan gyi btsan 'dzul srid jus kyis bslangs pa zhig yin/'jar pan gyi ming kri gsar bcos kyi rjes su/ srid 'dzin mkhan tshang ma skye khungs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin drag rtsal pa yin pa'i gsar bcos pa yin/ mi de dag gis nang khul du 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rnam pa'i bcos sgyur byas te srog bsdos sgos rgyal phyug dmag hrag yong thabs kyis/ nub phyogs stobs ldan rgyal khab dag gi bran bkol las thar thabs byed cing / phyi phyogs su smyo ham chen pos btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed srid jus lag tu bstar/ kho tshor ‘ drag po'i rgyal khab ’ kyi 'du shes shugs drag yod cing / drag shugs la brten pa ni rgyal khab kyi gzhi rtsa yin par 'dod/ ‘8drag po'i rgyal khab ’ kyi 320

bsam blo der bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi khyad chos chen po yod/ kho tshos btsugs pa'i rgyal srung dmag la ‘8rgyal po'i dmag mi (༅31)ces btags nas/ gnam bskos rgyal por blo gzhungs dkar dgos pa nan bshad byed/kho tshos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin kyi 88drag rtsal pa'i kun spyod ’ bsam blor gong bkur zhu zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rgyal bkur gyi ‘ blo dkar ’ dang ‘4dpa' ba’ / ‘6gong bkur ’’bcas khyab spel byed la/ g.yul 'gyed tshar gcod dang / dmag zhen 'khrug slong gzi brjid du brtsi/ drag rtsal pa bcosasgyur la blo phyogs pa de dag lo rgyus kyi stegs bur 'gos ma nyid nas drag chas la brten te ‘4le dbar khri phrag gi rba klung slong ba ’ dang / ru rgyal zil phyogs bzhir bskyed pa ’ 'ud sgrog byed cing / 66skam sa chen po'i srid jus ’’gtan 'khel byas/ de'i gom pa dang po krung go'i the wan dbang du sdud pa dang / gom pa gnyis pa ni kho ri ya dbang du sdud pa/ gom pa gsum pa ni krung go'i byang shar khul dang nang sog sa khul dbang du sdud pa/ gom pa bzhi pa ni krung go'i nang logs sa khul dbang du sdud pa/ gom pa lnga pa ni go la hril bo dbang du sdud pa bcas yin/ de las kho ri ya dbang du sdud pa ni 'jar pan gyis spel ba'i ‘ skam sa chen po'i srid jus ’ kyi tshigs tshan gal chen zhig sku)na/1876lor/ 'jar pan gyis kho ri ya la btsan thabs kyis 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i chings yig dang po ste/ cang hwa chings yig ( (643rtsi༅ /601 03 7 01 5thabartsa553)bkod de/ kho ri ya'i bdag dbang la gtor bshig tshabs chen btang zhing / de nas bzung kho ri ya 'jar pan gyi mi ser spel yul phyed tsam du 'gyur mgo brtsams/1894lo'i zla 2par/ kho ri ya'i lho khul gyi ku hphu jon (41sgomatsho'i)du shar 321

rig tang gis 'go khrid pa'i shing rta lo'i zhing pa'i 'os langs byung / 'os langs pas jon srid gzhung las khungs bzung zhing / mtshon cha 'phrog pa dang / sa yig mer bsregs pa/ dpon ngan dang zhing bdag mi byed dgu byed bgyi mkhan rnams tshar bcad/ kho tsho'i kha dbyangs ni 88ngan jag mthar skrod gtong ba ’ (phyi mi dang 'jar jag mthar skrod gtong ba ) dang / 64dbang drag rtsa med bzo ba ’ (bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur pa med par gtong ba ) yin/ 'os langs thengs der 'go 'khrid mkhan ni kho ri ya'i nye rabs lo rgyus steng ches khyad du 'phags pa'i zhing pa'i gsar brje'i gtso 'dzin chon pang kron (phung1ji4khyi)zhes pa de yin/chon pang kron ni ku hphu jon du skyes shing / kho'i pha zhing pa'i 'os langs shig skabs 'dzin bzung thebs te khrims gcod drag pos 'das/ 1890lor/chon pang kron shar rig tang du zhugs/ shar rig tang zhes pa ni chen kru'u jon (yonya5ma)gyi tshi je yu (ṣṭhalo/ma)yis 1860lor btsugs shing / des 8 shar rig (shar phyogs kyi rig pa ) la dang dad kyis 8 nub rig ’ (ye shu'i chos lugs )la kha gtad gcog cing / 88dpon ngan ham shed can tshar gcod pa ’ dang / 8 'jar jag dang phyi dgra 'gog pa'i ’ re ba 'don la/88mi re re bzhin 'dra mnyam yin pa'i nya lta ba 'don/ don dam thog de ni kho ri ya'i dmangs khrod kyi btsan rgyal dang bkas bkod la ngo rgol byed pa'i gsang ba'i mna' 'brel zhig yin/ 1893lor/ kho ri ya'i zhing las la than gnod byung ste ston sdud legs po ma byung zhing / bkas bkod dbang 'dzin pas kyang ham thob shugs drag byas pas/ zhing pa rnams dngos gnas 'tsho thabs med pa'i tshad du bslebs/ 1894lor/ chon pang kron gyis shar rig tang gi rtsa 'dzugs bed spyad de ku hphu jon gyi zhing pa'i 'os langs skul slong 322

byas/'os langs dmag gis ri dkar bzung rjes su/ 'grem yig spel nas mi dmangs mgyogs por yar la langs te dpon ngan go gnas nas 'bud pa dang / btsan 'dzul pa gtum spyod can mthar skrod gtong rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / mtha' bzhi'i zhing pa dang / grong khyer gyi mang tshogs dbul po rnams kyis 'bod skul dang len byas pas 'os langs dmag mgyogs por mi grangs khri gcig lhag la bslebs/ de'i rjes su 'os langs dmag gis jon du ma zhig bstud mar bzung ste/ stobs shugs che ru rgyas shing / chon lo to (༅༅ ༅)yi srid 'dzin lte gzhi chon kru'u (༅15)la bcar/ zla 5par 'os langs dmag gis rgol thengs gcig gis chon kru'u blangs te/ kho ri ya hril bor yom 'gul btang zhing / sa khul so so'i mi dmangs kyis dang len zhus pas/ 'os langs de mgyogs por krung chin ( tso tsho)dang / chin hrang(phyutsho)/ hungahe(zolo)sogs to(ma)ru mched de/ 'os langs dar mched shin tu chen po byung /kho ri ya'i li rus bkas bkod rgyal rabs la der mgo gnon pa'i stobs shugs med pas dngangs 'tshab drag tu skyes shing / mgyogs por krung go'i ching srid gzhung la dpung grogs zhus/ g.yo sgyu che ba'i 'jar pan dmag shed can gyis dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas ching srid gzhung la kho ri yar dmag drangs te 'os langs zhi 'jags gtong ba'i skul lcag btang zhing /dam bca' brtan po'i sgo nas rang la 8 dmigs yul gzhan ’ gtan nas med tshul brjod/ rul sungs rmongs 'thoms kyi ching srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa la mgo bskor thebs te/ 'jar pan gyi g.yo jus 'og tshud/ ching srid gzhung gis thad gtogs the to(༅tho)ye kri khra'o/0/rtsa〉phya)la dmag mi 323

chig stong lnga brgya 'khrid du bcug ste mngags shing kho ri ya'i ya hran nas skam sar bud/ skabs der/ 'jar pan srid gzhung gis kyang phyi sdod rang mi srung rgyur kha g.yar nas kho ri ya la dmag mngags/ 'jar pan gyis kho ri yar mngags pa'i dmag 'bor ching srid gzhung las ches cher mang ste/ mi grangs chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya yod par ma zad/ rin khron(1nga)/ )nas han khrin( ༅7)bar gyi 'thab jus sa sgo gtso bo rnams kyang bzung / de'i mtshungs su/'jar pan gyi mtsho dmag sta gon ru khag gis kyang g.yul 'gyed pa'i gra sgrig tshags su tshud pa byas yod/de lta bu'i gnas bab dza drag cig gi 'og chon pang krin gyi 'os langs dmag gis li rus rgyal rabs dang mthun thabs byas te legs bcos kyi re ba 'don pa'i chings yig don tshan bcu gnyis bkod nas/ 'os langs dmag ston kru'u nas phyir 'then/ ye kri khra'o yis gnas tshul de thos rjes/ dmag dpung bskyod mtshams bzhag kyang / 'jar pan gyis mu mthud du kho ri yar dpung shugs bsnan/ ching srid gzhung gis kho ri ya'i don rkyen zhi 'jags byung bas/ lhan du dmag dpung phyir 'then gtong rgyu'i re ba bton/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni 'jar pan gyis kho ri ya'i nang srid bcos sgyur la gzhogs 'degs byed rgyur kha g.yar nas dmag phyir mi 'then par ma zad/da dung phen rang(cham)yang bzung / de bas/ gnas bab nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur la/ g.yul 'thab de ma nyid du 'byung ba'i nyen babs byung /skabs der krung gor dbang sgyur mkhan ni ming thog nas kong zhi rgyal po(lkolko)yin kyang / don dngos su dbang cha tshi zhi rgyal mo'i(༅tsho86)lag tu bzung yod/ rgyal mo de ni log spyod mkhregs 'dzin che zhing rmongs 'thoms yin pa dang / rul sungs rjes lus yin la dbang g.yo la dga' ba zhig yin /324

kho mos phyi phyogs la ngo g.yog rgyal 'tshong byed cing / nang la sger chod gtum drag byed pas/ rgyal khab dang mi dmangs la gnod tshabs che ba'i cha nas bshad na/ krung go'i nye rabs lo rgyus thog ang dang po'am gnyis par bgrang chog go/ 'jar pan gyis rngam zil chen pos krung gor ham lta byed cing /rgyal khab la nyen tshabs shin tu che ba'i skabs der/ kho mos rgyal khab kyi las skal la ci mi snyam par mo rang gi drug cu'i skyes skar gyi mdzad sgo'i sta gon la mgo 'khor 'dug kho mo 'jar pan la skrag nas 'gab mthun byed cing /g.yog ngan li hong krang(dngha ༅ rsā)la mngags bcol byas te nub gling gi btsan rgyal rnams ngor bud de ‘6'dum 'grig ’ la brten nas/ ‘ zhi bde nya yong thabs gnyer te/ dmag don thad nas gra sgrig ci yang ma byas/ 'on kyang 64'dum 'grig ’ gi re ba stong par gyur zhing / 'jar pan gyis gtum shugs chen pos 'brel ba bcad pa'i brda yig btang ba na/ rgyal mo tshi zhi dang li hong krang gnyis da gzod dngangs 'tshab skyes te brel 'tshab ngang ye kri khra'o la rgyab dpung gtong rgyur bsam blo btang yang / 'jar pan gyis lag snga ba'i sgo nas zla )tshes 25nyin krung go'i byang mtsho'i mtsho dmag la thol rgol byas par ma zad/ krung go'i dmag mi 'dren pa'i gru gzings 88mthor 'phags nya (6yo)rtags can bying du bcug krung 'jar gyi shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrug ni de ltar du 'jar pan gyis bslangs pa yin no//krung ri'i g.yul 'khrug lo ngo phyed tsam la bgyis/ mjug 'bras ni mi 'bor dung phyur bzhi yi rgyal khab chen po de gling phran rgyal khab 'jar pan gyis yongs su pham/ krung go'i dmag mi rnams g.yul du zhugs pa'i skabs su/rgyal yum tshi zhi yis sngar mus su skyes skar mdzad sgo rgyas spros yong ched/ mtsho dmag gi gron dngul spyad de gling ga dbyi ho yon 'dzugs skrun byas/ de lta 325

bu'i rul sungs kyi mi zhig gis dbang bzung ba na/ pham gyong chen po mi reg ga la srid de mi srid do// 1895lo'i zla 3par/ ching srid gzhung gis li hong krang mngags te 'jar pan gyi ma kon(bra༅)du song nas/ 〈〈ma kon chings yig 〉〉bkod/ chings yig gi thag bcad ltar du/ krung gos ‘kho ri ya sger tshugs’ yin pa khas blangs pa dang / krung gos the wan dang phang hu gling tshom(༅losto/1lo)/ le'o tung phyed gling(polko༅tsho)bcas 'jar pan la bcad ster byed pa/ ⑦ krung gos 'jar pan la dngul srang dung phyur gnyis 'jal sprod byed pa/ hra hri(༅/ oṃ)dang / khrung chin(rsālo)/ su'u kru'u(lom)/hang kru'u(oṃnya5)bcas tshong sgo ru 'phar snon gtong ba/ 'jar pan gyis krung go'i tshong sgo dag tu bzo grwa 'dzugs chog pa bcas byas/krung 'jar shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrub dang 〈〈ma kong chings yig 〉〉gis/krung go dang / 'jar pan/ kho ri ya gsum la shugs rkyen shin tu zab mo thebs/ de nas bzung / kho ri ya sngar las kyang 'jar pan gyi dbang bsgyur 'og tshud la/ krung go mi ser spel yul phyed tsam du 'gyur tshad sngar las tshabs che bar gyur pa ma zad/ btsan rgyal dag gis bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i nyen tshabs yod par gyur pa dang / 'jar pan la krung go'i the wan dang phang hu gling tshom/ 'jal dngul 'bor chen bcas thob pas/ stobs shugs lashugs snon chen po byang ste/ dmag rgyal ring lags kyi btsan 'dzal gom rimi mi zir mi ririg stabs je mgyogs su song ngo //mthar/ nga tshos kha phyir 'khor te kho ri ya'i zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi () le'o tung phyed gling de phyis su nub gling btsan rgyal dag gis the gtogs byas pas phyir krungagor sprad mod/ 'on kyang krung gos dngul srang bye ba gsum gyi blu rin sprod dgos pa byung mngo/ 326

gnas tshul rags tsam gleng bar bya/ 1894lo'i zla 9par/ ching srid gzhung gi dmag kho ri ya nas phyir 'then rjes/ 'jar pan gyis kho ri ya'i li rus rgyal rabs dang ngan 'brel gyis zhing pa'i 'os langs dmag la drag gnon byas/ chon pang kron gyis mi dmangs yar langs te 'jar dmag mthar skrod gtong ba dang dbang gtum med par gtong rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / khos 'os langs dmag khag so so gcig tu bsdus te slar yang rgol rdung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ zla 11par/ chon pang kron gyis 'os langs dmag khri phrag bcu khrid de byang bskyod byas te 'jar dmag dang g.yul 'thab drag po byas la/ 'os langs dmag la pham gyong chen po reg zla 12par/ ngo log pas g.yo tshong byas pas chon pang kron dgra lag tu tshud/ kho dgra bo'i gcar rdung drag po la mi skrag cing / dgra bo'i dpon thob dang phogs dngul mthon po yis kyang g.yo 'gul gtong ma nus/ 1895lo'i zla 4tshes 23nyin/ chon pang kron gyis dgra bo'i 'gegs gsod sgrom stegs su rang srog btang / srog khrims gcod la nye skabs/ kho brtan brling 'gyur ba med par dgra bor kha rdung drag tu btang ste/kho ri ya'i mi dmangs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i mi rigs kyi la rgya mngon par mtshon no//

songazhi pa/ we thegam gyi hpha rgol dpa' bo hong hwa than/1907lor/ sung krung hran la 'jar pan dang ching srid gzhung gi btsan gnon myong ste/ 'jar pan nas we the nam (510 ba3lashā'i44)la gnas spos shing / spyi 'doms las khungs ho ne (5thas01kholo)ru btsugs/ lo der/mna' 'brel tshogs pas kong tung dang kong zhi'i(yosatong)mtha' mtshams kyi hphang khrin(yoyiyi)dang krin nan kon(shādri'ob)dru)sogs sa khul gyi 'os langs la thengs 'gar 'go khrid byas pa de/ gra sgrig tshags su chud pa byung med pas/snga gzhug tu pham par gyur/ krung go'i gsar brje'i 'thab mo ba sum stong lhag skabs thog we the nan du 'then/ an hri(36shu/)sa khul gyi we the nan gyi zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi mgo 'dzin pa zhig gis sung krung hran gyi re ba zhus pa bzhin krung go'i gsar brje ba dag mdza' brtse'i ngang nas srung skyob byas/ we the nan gyi zhing pa'i mgo 'dzin pa de ni hong hwa than(rsāloḥ)yin/hong hwa than gyi sngar ming la krang win than(༅ma86)zer la/ the than(nyusbyo6khu)zhes kyang 'bod pa dang / kho ni we the nan byang khul gyi an hri'i mi yin zhing / 1845lor skyes pa red/ kho'i pha ni gla bzo zhig yin/ hong hwa than gyis chung dus nas zhing bdag la phyugs rdzi dang rtswa 'breg byas shing /phyis su yun ring gla g.yog byas/ 1885lor/ hpha ran si'i btsan 'dzul pas we the nan gyi rgyal grong hron tra(1/khu76)bzung bas/ dbus khul dang byang khul gyi zhing chen so so'i rgyal gces dpon rigs dang mi drag rnams kyis dmag dpung btsugs te drag chas la brten nas hpha rgol byas/ skabs de'i hpha rgol 328

drag chas 'thab 'dzing la rgyal rogs las 'gul(marwalo7)zer/ hong hwa thanayang an hri'i rdzong dpon hong then cin(rsā༅sbyo1)gyis 'go khrid byas pa'i rgyal rogs dmag tu zhugs te/ hpha rgol rgyal skyob kyi 'thab 'dzing khrod zhugs mgo brtsams/hpha ran si la we the nan la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ham sems snga mo nas yod/ dus rabs 17pa'i skabs su/ hpha ran sis chos spel ba mngags nas we the nan du bslebs myong / phyis su hpha ran si'i rgyal nang bde 'jags ma byung bas skabs shig ring btsan 'dzul gyi mtshams bzhag dbyin hpha gnyis kyis krung gor nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa slong skabs/ hpha ran sis si phen dang mnyam 'brel sgos 1858lor we the nan la btsan 'dzul gyi g.yul 'khrug bslangs/ 1862lor/ hpha ran sis btsan thabs kyis we the nan la 〈〈zhi kong chings yig〉〉(yorsāzo༅)dang po bkod de/ lho khul gyi pen hi dang ca ten/ ten zhang bcas zhing chen gsum bzung / 1874lor/ 〈〈zhi kong chings yig 〉〉gnyis pa bkod de/ hpha ran si la we the nan du khrims sgo rang btsan gyi dbang cha yod par thag bcad la/ we the nan gyi phyi 'brel la lta rtog byed pa dang / hong hu dang ho ne/ hi hphang / ke'u rin bcas mtsho ngogs gsum gyi sgo phye rgyu'i thag bcad/ hpha ran si'i stobs shugs rim bzhin we the nan gyi byang khul du bskyed/ 1883lor/ hpha ran sis yang bskyar we the nan la btsan thabs kyis 〈〈con hwa chings yig 〉〉(1/khu7zo7)'god du bcug ste/we the nan don dngos thog hpha ran si'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur ro//hpha ran sis ching srid gzhung la kho pa'i we the nan gyi btsan 'dzin go gnas ngos len zhu ru 'jug ched/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas krung gor btsan 'dzul byas te/ 1884lor yang bskyar krung tpa'i g.yul 'khrug bslangs/329

1885lor krung go'i rgyal gces dmag spyi grags can hphin tsi tshe(༈gizlo༈4)yis dmag dpung khrid nas krin nan kon dang leng hran( oṃl)du hpha dmag la g.yul gyong mi chung ba bzos te rgyal kha chen po blangs pas/ g.yul babs bsgyur mod/ 'on kyang rul sungs kyi ching srid gzhung gis hpha ran si dang 〈〈then cin chings yig 〉〉(zaḥzotram̐gi)bkod de/ hpha ran sir we the nan la mnga' sgyur dbang yod pa khas len zhus/hpha ran si'i btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed ched/ we the nan gyi mi dmangs kyis rgyun chad med par drag po'i 'os langs bgyis/ 〈〈hon hwa chings yig 〉〉bkod pa nas bzung hong hwa than rgyal rogs dmag la zhugs/hong cin then gyi rgyal rogs dmag la pham gyong thebs rjes/ hong hwa than gyis an hri'i zhing pa'i mgo khrid de nges med rgol rdung dmag 'thab brgyab/ khos ldem myur ldan pa'i 'thab rtsal spyad de/ nags klung dang thang chen/ 'grim 'grul lam 'gag bcas su rgol rdung bgyis pas hpha ran si'i btsan 'dzul pa 'dug bzod bde po med pa byas/1894lo'i zla 5par/ hpha dmag gis 'os langs dmag gi g.yul gzhi gtso bo yu re'u(ོska)la btsan rgol byas/ 'os langs dmag gis dpa' ngar ngang dgra bo dang 'thab ste hpha ran si'i spyi mngags dang g.yul 'doms pa 4mang po bsad rmas btang / yin na'ang / 'os langs dmag la pham gyong tshabs chen thebs te yu re'u mi gtong thabs med byung / zla 9tshes 17nyin/'os langs dmag gis ho ne nas leng hran la bgrod pa'i me 'khor zhig bde blag ngang blangs te/ hpha ran si'i mi ser spel mkhan dang / 〈〈pe chi ma 'ongs tshags par〉〉(shā6lolkolkom)gyi gtso sgrig pa zi si ne zhes pa gson bzung byas/mi ser spel ba'i dbang 'dzin srid gzhung hang sangs pa'i sgo nas hong hwa than 330

dang gros mol bgyis te 'thab mtshams 'jog rgyu'i gros chings mi 'god ka med byung / phyogs gnyis ga'i gros chings kyi thag bcad ni/ hong hwa than gyis zi si ne glod grol gtong rgyu dang / hpha ran sis 'os langs dmag la dngul sgor chig khri lnga stong sprad de/ hpha dmag an hri nas phyir 'then pa dang /ya nan dang / mo'u hran/ an li/ yu hrang bcas yul rdzong (yul rdzong ni sa gnas srid 'dzin las khungs )bzhi hong hwa than gyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa bcas yin/hpha dmag an hri sa khul nas phyir 'then rjes/ hong hwa than gyis dus tshod dam 'dzin sgos gnas gzhi sra brtan btang zhing dmag mi bsdu 'gug gis phyogs so so'i 'os langs dmag la mnyam 'brel byas pas/ dpung khag gi stobs shugs che ru rgyas/ khos da dung dar nag dmag gi lhag 'phro la mnyam 'brel gyis thun mong sgos mu mthud du hpha rgol byas/ dar nag dmag ni sngar zhi bde gnam rgyal gsar brje'i skabs su kong tung dang kong zhi'i mtha' mtshams su stobs shugs rgyas pa'i krung go'i zhing pa'i 'os langs dmag ru zhig yin la/ de'i mgo 'dzin ni li'u hru hphu(mo17shās)yin/ zhi bde gnam rgyal gyi gsar brje pham rjes/ li'u hru hphu krung we'i mtha' mtshugs su mi spo ka med byung / phyis su we the nan srid gzhung gis gdan zhus ltar dar nag dmag kyang hpha rgol g.yul 'gyed kyi gdong du bud de/ we the nan mi dmangs dang phrag pa mnyam gshib kyis chu dmar 'gram rgyud du 'thab 'dzing byas/dar nag dmag gis krung go'i mi dmangs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i gsar brje'i rang gshis 'don spel byas la g.yul du dpa' ngar che bas hpha dmag la rdung rdeg drag po thebs shing / hpha dmag gi mgo 'dzin re wer (50bgo ༅3070 za1 1070ཿtram̐khri༅)zhes pa'ang bsad pas/ we the nan gyi rgyal pos 331

li'u hru hphu la san zhan the tu'u(zazochojo)zhes pa'i go sa byin/ krung tha'i g.yul 'khrug gi rjes su/ ching srid gzhung gis li'u hru hphu rgyal nang du bkugs mod/ 'on kyang dar nag dmag gi khag cig we the nan du bsdad de mu mthud du 'thab 'dzing byas/hong hwa than gyis phyogs so so'i 'os langs dmag la mnyam 'brel byed pa'i dus der/ hpha ran si'i mi ser spel mkhan dag gis kyang an hri'i phyogs bzhir btsan rdzong bzo bar shugs bsnan te an hri rim par bskor/ 1895lo'i zla 11par/ hpha dmag gis hrang zho zhig gi bkod 'doms 'og 'os langs dmag la drag rgol byas/ hong hwa than gyis dgra bo'i bar shugs la g.yol te dmag ru thor bgos kyis nges med rgol rdung gi 'thab thabs spyad/hpha dmag dub par gyur te mgyogs myur ngang 'os langs dmag gi stobs shugs cham la 'bebs pa'i dmigs yul 'grub ma thub/ lo ngo gnyis lhag gi 'thab 'dzing brgyud de/ 'os langs dmag 'thab kyin 'thab kyin sngar las kyang stobs che bar gyur/ 1897lo'i zla 12par/ hpha ran si'i dbang 'dzin phyogs khag thabs zad de yang bskyar hong hwa than dang gros mol byas te/'thab mtshams 'jog pa'i gros chings thengs gnyis pa bkod/ der an hri sa khul gyi 'bru dngul yong 'bab hong hwa than gyi dmag dpung la dbang ba dang / hpha ran sis hong hwa than gyi dpon dmag la phogs rgyags ster rgyu dang /'os langs dmag gis ten we lcags lam ⑦gyi bzo bskrun la gtor bshig mi byed pa sogs gtan 'khel byas/() ten we lcags lam (choshā lta'itsho〉)ste/ yo nan nas we the nan bar gyi lcags lam la zer ba yin/332

thengs gnyis par 'thab mtshams bzhag rjes/ hong hwa than gyis mu mthud du hur brtson gyis gnas gzhi 'dzugs skrun dang dmag mi bsdu 'gug byed pa dang / nan tan gyis dmag sbyong byed pa/ sgrig khrims dam po bzo ba bcas byas par ma zad/ zhing las thon skyed la'ang mnyam 'jog byas shing /mi dmangs kyi dka' sdug la sems khur byas/ khos da dung we the nan gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i mi rigs dmangs gtso ring lugs kyi gsar brje ba phan phe kru(tsho.olko)dang 'brel gtug byas te/ hong hwa than yang phan phe kru yis mgo khrid pa'i gsar bcos tshogs par zhugs la/ gsar bcos tshogs pas kyang phyi phyogs nas hong hwa than la rogs skyor sna tshogs byas/ phan phe kru yi bsam blo la leng chi khra'o/ ༅cholo)yi shugs rkyen thebs myong zhing / rjes su sung krung hran dang / hong zhin(zo༅)/ krang ten len(sgo lom)sogs krung go'i gsar brje'i tang mi dang 'brel ba dam po byung / kho'i gsar bcos tshogs pa yis thengs 'gar kong kru'u ru le'u hru hphu yi khyim du tshogs 'du 'tshogs myong /kho dang krung go'i gsar brje ba'i 'brel ba de 1925lor kho 'dzin reg bar du rgyun 'khyongs byung /hong hwa than gsar bcos tshogs par zhugs rjes/ gsang ba'i sgo nas ho ne'i 'os langs jus 'god byas/ 1908lor/ ho ne'i 'os langs pham par gyur/ 1909lor/ hpha ran si'i mi ser spel mkhan gyis dmag 'bor nyis khri bsdus te an hri'i gnas gzhi sa khul du drag rgol byas/ zla 10par/leng hran gyi 'thab thengs der/ 'os langs dmag la gyong gud chen po reg ste kha 'thor mgo brtsams/ skabs der phan phe kru yi phyi rogs mtshon cha de 'jar pan nas zhang gang du dbor skabs yin pas/ hong hwa than la sprod long ma byung / 333

1913lo'i zla 2tshes 10nyin/ hong hwa than an hri'i nags khul du hpha ran sis bslus pa'i we the nan gyi myul ma zhig gis lkog gsod byas/ gla g.yog gi khyim du skyes pa'i we the nan gyi mi rigs dpa' bo des/ hpha rgol rgyal skyob kyi 'thab 'dzing lo ngo sum cur nye ba zhig la bgyis shing / kho la g.yo 'gyur byung ma myong la/ mjug mthar rang gi tshe srog kyang mes rgyal gyi mi rigs bcing 'grol las don ched btang / kho'i dpa' ngar gyi hpha rgol 'thab 'dzing des we the nan gyi nye rabs lo rgyus thog gzi brjid 'od du 'tsher ba'i shog lte zhig bkod yod do// 334

so lnga pa/ jag rkun gnyis kyis krung go'i mnga' khongs su khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab mo thengs shigabagyis pa/jar u'i g.yul 'thab/shing rta lo'i e sha ya'i shar khul yong su 'gyur ldog che ba'i dus gnas su slebs yod pa ste/ 1894lo'i zla 10par/ u ru si'i zar rgyal mtha' ma ne ku ra gnyis pa khri khar 'dzegs/ u ru si ni ne ku ra gnyis pa'i mes po e leg zan ter gnyis pas 1861lo'i zhing bran lam lugs kyi bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud de/ zar rgyal mtha' ma 'di'i skabs su bslebs pa na btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rim du bslebs yod do// ne ku ra gnyis pa ni zar rgyal khrod krung go dang 'jar pan/ rgya gar bcas su thon mkhan gcig pu yin la/ e sha yar bslebs mkhan yang gcig pu yin/ kho la rgyal nang du thu gtum rgyal ne ku ra mi zhes zer/ phyi phyogs srid jus thad nas/ khos zar rgyal rim byung gi btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed srid jus rgyun 'dzin byas te/ zar u 'dzam gling btsan rgyal gtos che ba zhig tu 'gyur ba'i ham sems 'dzin/ kho'i skam dmag gi blon chen khu'o pha thi kin (sam0500༅ba༅50yo'i03༅557༅ba'i15ya5khungatsho༅༈rnya༅)gyis bshad rgyur/ 88nga tsho'i rgyal po'i klad pa na rgya che ba'i 'char gzhi zhig yod de/ u ru sis man kru'u len ched/ kho ri ya u ru si'i mnga' khongs su bsdu ba dang / bod ljongs kyang u ru si'i mnga' khongs su bsdu ba de'o ’ zhes bshad/ yin na'ang / ne ku ra gnyis pas krung go dang kho ri yar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ham sems la gsar du dar ba'i 'jar pan gyis 335

'gran rtsod byas/ bshad tshul zhig brjes na/ 'jar pan dmag shed can gyis 64skam sa'i srid jus lag tu bstar ba des zar u la 'gog rkyen thebs zhes brjod kyang don gcig yin no// 'gal 'du dang 'thab rtsod de 〈〈ma kon chings yig 〉〉bkod pas lhag pas dza drag tu gyur/〈〈ma kon chings yig 〉〉(6cholko༅)bkod pa'i nyin der/ u ru sis 'jar man dang hpha ran si gnyis la ngan 'brel byas te/ 'jar pan la krung go'i le'o tung gling phran phyed ma gtong rgyu'i re ba bton la/ de ltar ma bgyis tshe 6 thun mong sgos dmag thabs spyod rgyu'i ’ 'jigs gtam smras/ der ོmthud nas/ des dngos gnas rang nyid kyi dmag gru 'jar pan gyi kha'o snye (rṣakha 56༅)dang chog mchan yi ge brje sar gtan 'khel byas pa'i krung go'i yan the(larsha)la zil rngam ston du bskyod/ ma gzhir u ru si la snga mo nas krung go'i shar byang sa khul du lcags lam bzos te/ le hron(lko//khu)dang ta lin(nga ca)btsan 'dzin byed bsam yod/ gal te 'jar pan gyis le'o tung phyed gling bzung ba na u ru si'i btsan 'dzul gyi 'char gzhi de stongs par gyur pa ma yin nam/ de bas/ u ru si rang nyid kyis nyin mtshan kun tu re ba'i dngos po de bltas bltas rig rig ngang gzhan la 'khyer du 'jug ci la srid/ u ru sis 'jigs skul gyi sgo nas/ gal te 'jar pan gyis rgyal khab gsum pos le'o yul phyir sprod pa'i re jus la snang 'jog ma byas tshe drag chas spyod rgyu yin tshul brjod/ skabs de'i 'jar pan gyi rgyal stobs la tshad nges can zhig yod pas/ rang nyid u ru si dang 'jar man/ hpha ran si gsum po'i do zla mi yong ba gsal bor shes/ de bas 'u thug ste le'o tung phyed gling phyir krung gor sprad mod/ 'on kyang der kha g.yar nas dngul srang khri sum stong blangs/ 336

u ru sis rang nyid la le'o yul phyir sprod pa'i thad byas rjes yod par snyam te/ skabs glags der bstun nas krung go'i ching srid gzhung la ham thob chen po zhig byas/ 1896lo'i zla 5par/ ne ku ru gnyis pa la cod pan bsgo ba'i cho ga spel/ u ru sis ching srid gzhung la li hong krang mngags te mdzad sgor rten 'brel zhu rgyu'i brda bstan pas/ ching srid gzhung gis sngar ho pe sa khul gyi dpon po wang kri khron zhes pa phe ther pog tu mngags rgyu'i 'char gzhi de mi bsgyur ka med byung ste/ li hong krang mngags la/ li hong kyang lam skabs su da dung yo rob nub khul gyi rgyal khab so sor song ste 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu byas/ li hong krang thog mar yo rob nub khul du song ste rgyal khab de dag gi shugs rkyen mi thebs par bya ched/ u ru sis ched dmigs pho nya gru gzings dang bcas mngags te so'e zi'i mi bzos gtsang bor bsu ru song zhing / kho thad kur du u ru si'i o ti sa 'jug ngogs su bsus/ u ru sir bslebs rjes/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gis li hong krang la srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin ltar gyi gus bsu byas te/ gzab sbreng ru khag la gzigs zhib byed pa dang / ched mngags rlangs 'khor gyis bsus shing / zar rgyal gyis bye brag tu mjal 'phrad gnang la/ nor srid blon chen we thi zhes pas ‘ sgur phyag gzab po byas pa dang / ne ku ra gnyis pa sku dngos kyis we thi la gsang bka' babs te/ lu pu (976༅ṇa7)khri sum brgya li hong krang brid rngan gyi ma dngul byed dgos par gdams/ rgyal 'tshong pa byang ma li hong krang la bkur gzos bla na med pa byas pas sems gting nas dga' spro 'phel/mjug mthar 〈〈krung u'i lkog chings 〉〉la ming rtags bkod de/ u ru si la he lung cang dang ci len nas nub phyogs su za'e pu re'u lcags lam chen por 'brel zhing / shar phyogs su he tshan we(loḥlo)dang 'brel ba'i lcags lam 337

zhig bskrun dbang thob pa dang / u ru si'i gru gzings dag krung go'i 'jug ngogs thams cad du bgrod chog pa sogs kyi dbang cha thob/ 1898lor/ u ru sis yang bskyar btsan thabs kyis le hron dang ta lin 'jug ngogs gla g.yodabyas par ma zad/ nan man (cho.oṃ)lcags lam 'dzugs dbang yang thob/ de ltar/ krung go'i shar byang sa khul rnams u ru si'i dbang bsgyur 'og tshud/ skabs der/ u ru sis kho ri ya na yang stobs shugs kyi mnga' khongs rgya bskyed kyin yod do//rang gi kha sgor thon pa'i bza' bca' zhim po de gzhan gyis 'phrog par 'jar pan khong khro gting nas skyes/ yin na'ang rang gi stobs shugs kyis mi 'dang bas skabs thog zhe spo khong du mi gnon ka med byung / dbu blon hran zhan yu phang (lazoo༅)gis 8 sdug nyams su myong gin ngang sgug’ (khyuṣechozolo)gi sgo nas/ dmag grabs tshags su chud pa dang / rgyal stobs je rgyas su btang ste/ ‘4bskyar dar yong bar ngang sgug ’ byed pa'i lta ba bton/ de bas/shing rta lo'i g.yul 'khrug gi rjes su/ 'jar pan gyis 'char gzhi gtan 'khel dang / gron bsri gang nus kyi sgo nas dmag bsdu g.yul grabs hur thag byas/ skam dmag ni hri thon bdun nas bcu gsum la bskyed cing / dmag gru brgya phrag gcig lhag gsar bskrun byas/ 'jar pan gyi dmag bsdu g.yul grabs kyi 'char gzhi de 1903lor bslebs tshe gzhi rtsa'i steng nas 'grub yod/'jar pan gyis hur thag gis gri brdar ba'i skabs der u ru si yang grag med du ci la 'dug u ru sis kyang krung go'i shar byang sa khul du lcag4lam bzo ba dang / le hron du sra brtan gyi btsan rdzong bzo ba/ e sha ya'i shar rgyud sa khul du dmag shugs 'bor chen 'dren pa bcas la shugs bsnan no/u ru sir khyon bsdoms dmag 'bor khri phrag nyis brgya yod la/ 1903lor 338

bslebs tshe/ e sha ya'i shar rgyud kyi dmag shugs mi grangs khri phrag nyi shu sum cu zhig la bslebs yod cing / zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung le hron dang he tshan we ru bsdad yod/ 1903lo'i skabs su/ e sha ya'i stobs shugs thad/ skam sa'i dmag shugs 'jar u gnyis phal cher do mnyam la/ mtsho dmag phyogs u ru si'i stobs shugs cung che/ 1900lor krung gor dbyi ho thon gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul byung / u ru sis ‘8khyim mtshes rgyal khab la jag pa bcom rogs byed pa ’ dang ‘8lcags lam srung skyob byed par kha g.yar nas mi grangs khri phrag bcu bdun long pa'i dpung chen krung go'i shar byang sa khul du drangs/ ne ku ra gnyis pa sku dngos kyis spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa khur zhing / skam dmag blon chen khu'o pha thi kin gyis jus 'don pa khur/ u ru sis rngam zil chen po'i ngang nas skabs glags de spyad nas krung go'i shar byang khyur mid gtong re bcangs/ phyis su krung go'i mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol drag po byas pas dmag phyir 'then par mos mthun 'byung ba las thabs gzhan med par gyur/ 'jar pan gyis kyang rang nyid kyi btsan 'dzul dgos mkhor dmigs te ngo rgol drag po byas shing /glags der brten nas g.yul 'khrug slong re bcangs la/ skabs der rang nyid kyi kho lag rdzogs yod pas/ u ru si'i 'gran zla yong bar 'dod do// u ru ses kyang krung go'i shar byang sa khul dang kho ri ya lag la dngos su 'bab dgos na 'jar pan rtsa ba nas pham du mi 'jug thabs med yin snyam byung bar ma zad/ skabs der u ru si'i rgyal nang gi gsar brje'i gnas babs kyi mtho rlabs nyin re bzhin che ru 'phyur bzhin yod pas/ mi dmangs kyi dmigs sgo bsgyur ched kyang mgyogs myur ngang g.yul 'khrug bslang 'dod skyes/ de ltar phyogs gnyis kur g.yul sprod 'dod yod la/ g.yul 'khrug kyang dngos su 339

langs par gyur to//'jar pan gyis lag snga brtsad de dgra mgo gnon pa'i thag bcad/1904lo'i zla 2tshes 8nyin/ tung zhang phen pa lang(lkotsho༈156khya)gis mgo khrid pa'i 'jar pan mnyam 'brel gru dpung gis le hron dang rin khron du sdod pa'i u ru si'i dmag gru la 'jab rgol byas pas/ 'jar u'i g.yul 'khrug langs shing / 'jar u rgyal khab gnyis kyis krung go'i bdag dbang la snang medabyas/ 'thab yun lo ngo gcig lhag dang / ya nga snga na med pa'i dmar 'thab de ni gtso bo krung go'i mnga' khongs su bgyis/ rul sungs kyi ching srid gzhung gis ‘6'brel med bar gnas ’ yin par khyab bsgrags byas la/8 'thab mo 'gyed khul ’ bgo sprod byas/ de las krung go'i mi dmangs la sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni smos med red/g.yul 'khrug mgo brtsams ma nyid du/ 'jar pan gyi skam dmag khag gcig kho ri ya nas ya lu cang gtsang bo brgal te krung gor thon zhing / khag /gcig le'o tung gling phran phyed ma nas skam sar bud de/ mgyogs myur ngang u ru si'i gtso shugs dang le hron/ ta lin gyi 'brel ba bcad la/ de'i mtshungs su hphin then ①sa khul gyi u ru si'i gtso shugs la 'gog rkyen bzos/zar rgyal gyi skam dmag blon chen khu'o pha thi kin man kru'u dmag khul gyi spyi khyab la bskos te dmag 'dren par shugs bsnan zhing / 'jar pan la nus shugs rtsal 'don sgos ya lan sprad/ 'jar dmag ni rgol ba'i tshul du gnas shing u dmag ni 'gog srung gi tshul du gnas/ 'jar dmag la bstud mar rgyal kha thob mod/ 'on kyang g.yul bgyis pa shin tu dza drag yin/ 1904lo'i ① sprin then (dnghaza)ste deng skabs kyi hrin dbyang (7ma)la'o/340

zla 9tshes 4nyin/ 'jar dmag gis le'u dbyang bzung zhing / phyogs gnyis ka so sor shi rmas ha lam nyis khri re byung / 1904lo'i zla 8par/ ne mu zhi ten(༅ngalko7)gyis mgo khrid pa'i 'jar dmag gi con gsum pas le hron la rgol rdung byas/ de ni btsan rdzong la drag rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing dza drag che zhing ya nga ba zhig yin/ ri rtse re re nas rgol 'khrug byas pas/ ri rtse re re bzhin khrag zhag 'khyil zhing dmar dris khyab pa byung / 'khrug thengs der 'jar pan gyis khri phrag bcu gsum long ba'i dmag shugs spyad la/ khyon nyin brgya dang lnga bcu nga lnga'i nang / 'jar dmag ha lam drug khri shi rmas byung /1905lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin/ le hron gyi u dmag thabs zad de dar dkar phyar nas mgo btags la/ ha lam u dmag sum khri tsam shi rmas byung /'jar dmag gis le hron bzung rjes dmag shugs gcig bsdus kyi sgo nas hphin then gyi u ru si'i gtso shugs dang 'thab mo bgyis/ 1905lo'i zla 2pa dang 3pa'i hphin then 'thab mo'i skabs/ phyogs gnyis gas khyon mi grangs khri phrag drug cu long ba'i dmag shugs spyad/ zla 3tshes 10nyin/ 'jar dmag gis hphin then blangs pas u dmag pham 'then byas/ thengs de'i 'thab mo'i nang / u dmag phyogs kyi mi grangs drug khri yas mas shig shi rmas dang / nyis khri tsam gson bzung byas pa dang / 'jar dmag phyogs mi grangs bdun khri yas mas kyi shi rmas byung /mtsho thog tu/ ne mu zhi ten gyis le hron la rgol ba'i skabs su/ mtsho 'gram gyi ri rtser rgyang 'phen skyogs chen btsugs te 'jug ngos su bsdad pa'i u ru si'i gru dpung la brgyab ste 'jug ngogs nas bskrad pa dang / de'i rjes su/ tung zhang phen pa lang gis mnyam 'brel gru dpung khrid de hong he ru u ru si'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung dang g.yul sprad de/ u ru si'i gtso shugs 341

dmag gru mang po bying du bcug cing / lhag ma rnams phyogs bzhir ci thar gyis bros/ 1905lo'i zla 5par/ 'jar pan gyi mnyam 'brel gru dpung gis ngal ba gso bzhin sgug ste yang bskyar ma he zha(braloḥ)nas mtsho le chig khri brgyad stong brgyud de yo rob gling nas rgyang bzhud byas yong ba'i u ru si'i pol this khi mtsho'i gru dpung gi gdong bsus te 'thab nas/ u ru si'i gru dpung ha lam rtsa med du btang /'jar u g.yul 'khrug mtshams der bslebs pa na/ phyogs gnyis kur mu mthud du g.yul sprod pa'i stobs shugs med par gyur/ 'jar pan la rgyal kha chen po thob mod/ 'on kyang skabs der 'khrug pas shin tu dub par gyur yod la/ 'jar pan yang phyis su dar ba'i rgyal khab chung chung zhig yin pas khyim gzhis gya nom po zhig mi 'dug thengs 'di'i g.yul 'khrug ni 'jar pan gyi dbang 'dzin pa yis 88rgyal khab kyi las skal skugs su bzhag pa'i ’ g.yul 'khrug cig tu bltas yod/ khyon bsdoms dmag shugs khri phrag brgya dang brgyad g.yul skul byas pa las/ khri phrag lnga bcu shi rmas byung la/ des ha lam g.yul la skul ba'i dmag shugs kyi phyed ka zin yod pa dang / g.yul mjug tu zhing pa'i khyim tshang gi rmon phyugs dang rlangs 'khor yang bsdu spyod byas/ g.yul 'khrug gi gron dngul la 'jar sgor dung phyur bcu bdun dang bye ba gcig sa ya drug lhag spyad cing / de'i nang gi dung phyur brgyad ni phyi bun blangs pa red/ u ru sis dmag shugs gtso bo spyad med mod/ 'on kyang bstud mar pham gyong reg pas tshang ma hang sangs par gyur pa dang / de'i mtshungs su rgyal nang gi gsar brje'i gnas babs mgyogs myur 'phel te zar rgyal gyi khri sa la'ang g.yo 'gul byung / de ltar/ thog mar phyogs gnyis kur 'thab 'dod yod pa'i g.yul 'khrug de skabs der bslebs tshe phyogs 342

gnyis gas mtshams 'jog 'dod par gyur/ tag tag skabs der/ nub gling gi btsan rgyal rnams kyang de gnyis mu mthud 'thab na mi mos par gyur/a ri'i tsang thung ze'o tor ra'o se wed (16 6 5 1 stogospragyu45 39ra pa ()(1 (11 () (1(14)()//() locho)kyis bar 'dum byed pa'i mos pa bstan/ 1905lo'i zla 9par/ a ri'i ‘6bar 'dum ’ la brten nas 'jar u gnyis gas a ri'i phor tshi mo zi (201 3405 6 ༈ṣechozo༅)'jug ngogs su 'jar u'i zhi chings bkod/ 〈〈phor tshi mo zi zhi chings 〉〉(༈ṣechostsalo7sbyoshi)la khyon don tshan bco lnga yod cing / nang don gtso bo ni/ 'jar pan la kho ri ya ru chab srid dang dmag don/ dpal 'byor bcas kyi khyad par ba'i khe dbang yod pas/ u ru sis 'jar pan gyi kho ri ya'i bya spyod la the gtogs mi byed pa dang / u ru sis le hron dang ta lin nye 'khor gyi krung go'i mnga' mtsho mnga' yul bcas dang /khrang khron nas le hron gyi lcags lam (nan man lcags lam ) dang de'i yan lag lam khul gyi rgyu nor dag 'jar pan la brgyud sprod byed pa dang / u ru sis khu ye gling phran(sgorsā6)lho khul 'jar pan la bcad ster byed pa bcas yin/ g.yul 'khrug de brgyud nas/ 'jar u gnyis kyi krung go'i shar byang sa khul dang kho ri ya'i stobs shugs kyi bsdur bar 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste/'jar pan gyi stobs shugs che ru gyur pas/ de'i phyis kyi btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed la rmang gzhi bzos so// 343

so drug pa/ mkhragangazhur༄'i gza' nyi ma 3’yis gsarangarje'i dragawung zhigangaslangs pa//de/u ru si'i 1905lo'i gsar brje/blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis rgyun du ‘8rdo bkyags nas rang gi rkang pa brdab pa ’ zhes pa'i krung go'i gtam dpe 'di log spyod pa tha dag gi rmongs spyod la dpe ru byed/ dpe de ni shin tu 'tsham po 'dug zar rgyal ne ku ra gnyis pas dang thog 'jar u'i g.yul 'khrug la brten nas rgyal nang gi mig sgo brid de/ gsar brje las thar 'dod pa yin na'ang / mjug 'bras tag tag ldog par thon/ g.yul 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus skabs su/ u ru si'i rgyal nang yud tsam ring cung lhing 'jags byung ba 'dra mod/ 'on kyang zar rgyal sger gcod lam lugs kyi rul sungs nyams 'grib thung myur lhang la bud de/ u ru si'i dmag dpung la bstud mar pham gyong byung zhing / nang sgos su le hron 'gag sgo shor rjes/ gsar brje'i las 'gul mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung / le nyin (2ma2'ayam59 23155 ma0gra ༅ kro/1ོ)gyis 88le hron 'gag sgo shor ba yis zar rgyal lam lugs kyi nyes skyon la lo rgyus kyi spyi sdom rlabs po che zhig byas yod nya ces dang / 88dmag don steng gi pham gyong des chab srid steng gi nyen tshabs shig gi mgo brtsams par mi 'gyur ga la srid ’ ces bshad do// ne ku ra gnyis pas dngos gnas rdo bkyags nas rang nyid kyi rkang par brdabs song /344

1905lo'i zla 1tshes 22nyin/ ④ le hron 'gag sgo'i u dmag gis dar dkar phyar te mgo btags nas gza' 'khor gsum tag tag long yod/nyin der/ phe ther pog gi ngal rtsol pas rgan rgon bu smad khri phrag bzhi bcu lhag khrid de/ chos 'chad pa kyo kri kā pang (༅②9nga༅5 4101ma0༅02ma5 1yo0༅lkolko 4khya༅)gi mgo khrid 'og chos lugs kyi dar rtags dang lha sku/ zar rgyal gyi 'dra sku bcas phyar te/ ngag nas 66dkon mchog gis zar rgyal skyob par shog ’ ces smon tshig sgrog gin dgun kha'i pho brang gi phyogs su bskyod/ kho tshos re zhu'i yi ge zhig bris nas gnas bab legs bcos yong rgyu'i re ba bton/skabs der phe ther pog gi srang du nyen rtog dmag gis gang yod/ skyi g.ya' ba'i ngang tshul des phe ther pog gi dgun 'khyag la lhag par grang snang zhig bsnan 'dug nyin der ne ku ra gnyis pa gnas gzhan du g.yol yod la/dgun gyi pho brang srung ba'i 'gan rgyal po'i zhang po zhig gis khur yod/ re zhu'i ru khag gis dad gus kyi lhag bsam 'chang gin dgun gyi pho brang du nye ba na/ zar rgyal gyi dmag gis glo bur du lag na 'dzer ma tsam yang thogs med pa'i mang tshogs la me mda' brgyab pas/ mi tshogs kyi phreng bstar zhig de ma nyid du 'gyel la/ srang yang khrag gis bsgyur/ gnas de ru mi stong phrag lhag bsad la/ mi nyis stong lhag rmas/ de bas/ nyin der 6 khrag bzhur ba'i gza' nyi ma ’’zhes thogs/ zar rgyal gyis rang nyid kyi mnga' 'bangs mdun du rang ngo rjen par bstan pas/ mi dmangs kyang mgyogs por rtogs sad byung / ‘ khrag bzhur ba'i gza' nyi ma ’ yis 1905lo'i gsar brje yi mgo bslangs so//① u ru si'i lugs kyi tshes 9nyin/345

'jar u'i g.yul 'khrug gis gsar brje 'byung ba je mgyogs su btang la/ gsar brje byung pa la spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen gting zab po yod/ 'dir nga tshos u ru si'i lo rgyus la phyir gzhigs cung tsam bya'o//u ru sis 1861lor zhing bran lam lugs la bcos bsgyur byas rjes/zhing pa'i gnas babs la legs bcos chen po ma byung mod/ 'on kyang des ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo las la rang dbang can gyi ngal rtsol pa mkho sprod byas/de bas/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i gzhug tu/ u ru si'i bzo las la 'phel rgyas cung mgyogs po byung / 1854lor/ u ru si'i bzo grwa'i grangs 'bor khri gcig la mi long zhing / bzo pa khri phrag bzhi bcu zhe drug tsam las med/1896lor bslebs pa na/ bzo grwa sum khri brgyad stong la 'phar zhing / bzo pa'i grangs tshad khri phrag brgya dang bdun cu la 'phar/ 1860lo nas 1890lo'i bar gyi lo ngo bzhi bcu'i nang / lcags lam ldab sum cu ring du 'phar/ dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i yas mas su/ 'byor med gral rim rang rkya thub pa'i chab srid kyi stobs shugs shig tu grub ste u ru si'i lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su 'gos/ 1883lor/ phu le han no hphu (༅༅9nga552gra0ba1྾0355kha yasa'i 02 0sto/1ṣā oṃza)yis ‘ngal rtsol bcings 'grol khang ’ zhes pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ 〈〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉〉sogs mar khe si ring lugs kyi gsung rab u ru si'i yi ger bsgyur/ lo rabs 90pa'i yas mas su/ le nyin gyis kyang 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i bya 'gul gnyer mgo brtsams/le nyin ni 1870lo'i zla 4tshes 22nyin wol ka gtsang bo'i 'gram rgyud kyi 346

zhin per si khi grong ①du skyes/ kho'i dang thog gi rus ming kha tshang la hphu lā je mur ye li che u le dbyang no hphu (2mtha'༅yo༅9yamaco55yo0 5 lko4ཿཿloṣā༅rsha 'u4lo.oṃza)zer/ hphu lā je mur ni kho'i ming yin la/ ye li chi ni kho'i pha'i ming dang / u le dbyang no hphu ni rus yin/ le nyin zhes pa ni kho'i spyad pa ches mang ba'i pur ming yin la/ de 'dzam gling yongs la nges cha ches che ba'i ming du gyur/1893lor le nyin gyis sam lā nas mar khe si ring lugs kyi tsho chung dang po rtsa 'dzugs byas/ 1895lor le nyin gyis phe ther pog gi mar khe si ring lugs tsho chung bcu gnyis yas mas shig ‘ bzo pa'i gral rim gyi bcings 'grol 'thab 'dzing lhan tshogs mi su gcig sgril byas la/ lhan tshogs kyi 'go khrid 'og phe ther pog gi bzo pas las mtshams 'jog pa'i las 'gul gyi mtho rlabs rgyas/ lo de'i zla 12par/ le nyin bzung zhing / za'e pu re'u la rgyang 'bud du btang ba'i skabs su/ khos 〈〈u ru si'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas 〉〉zhes pa sogs gsung rtsom brtsams/ 1898lor/ u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo tang zhes pa tshugs mod/ 'on kyang tang gi rtsa 'dzin sgrig srol gtan la 'bebs pa'i bya ba legs por ma 'grub/ le nyin za'e pu re'u la rgyang 'bud btang yod pas tang tshugs pa'i tshogs chen du zhugs med/ 1903lor/ u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo tang gi skabs gnyis pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen lon ton nas 'tshogs/ le nyin tshogs chen der zhugs/ tang gi rtsa 'dzin dang sgrig srol skor gyi gnad don rabs dang rim par tshogs chen steng lta ba mi mthun pa byung zhing rtsod gleng drag tunye phyis su u le dbyang no hphu si khi grong zhes ming brjes/347

po byas/ le nyin gyis gtso byas pa'i khag des 'byor med gral rim gyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed dgos pa dang / tang la nges par du dam gzab kyi sgrig lam yod dgos pa/ tang yon nges par du tang gi rtsa 'dzugs shig tu zhugs dgos pa'i lta ba bton la/ mab thob (ma yomi༅02 bralo༅za)kyis gtso byas pa'i khag des le nyin gyi lta bar dgag pa brgyab/ le nyin gyi phyogs des mang che shos zin yod pas/ pol hri web khi (204407ma5 oṃng/ sgoḥmaste/ mang phyogs pa'i don/)zhes thogs pa dang / mab thob kyi phyogs de nyung shos yin pas/ meg hri web khi (yo05rwa 0355 6sgoḥ༅ ste/ nyung phyogs pa'i don/)zhes thogs so// de ltar/ u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo tang tshugs ma nyid nas phyogs khag gnyis su gyes la/ de ni don dngos thog mar khe si ring lugs dang skabs 'tshol ring lugs kyi tang khag gnyis yin/u ru si'i 'byor med gral rim chab srid kyi stegs bur 'gos pa'i skabs der/ rgyal nang gi chab srid nyin bzhin log spyod du 'gyur bzhin yod/1883lo'i zla 3tshes 13nyin/ zar rgyal e leg zan ter gnyis pa rlangs 'khor du bsdad de phyir bskyod skabs/ dmangs bcud tang gi zo hphe ya lha lo hphu si ci (lkoḥ༅ /khrithaza7ཿ)zhes pas rlangs 'khor la 'gas rdzas shig 'phangs te/ zar rgyal 'gas bsad btang la/ e leg zan ter gsum pa dngangs skrag gi ngang nas rgyal khrir bsdad/ khos mi dmangs la drag gnon gyi srid jus spyad de/ yar thon gyi phyogs tsam yod pa'i bcos bsgyur thams cad med par byas pa dang / mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol cung tsam byas tshe gzhu rdung dang btson 'jug rgyang 'bud sogs spyad/ 1894lo'i zla 10par/ e leg zan ter gsum pa tshe las 'das rjes/ ne ku ra gnyis pa srid khri 'gos/khos pha yi log spyod srid jus rgyun 'khyongs byas te legs bcos ci yang ma byas 348

la/ khos ‘8tshang mas shes da gos pa ni/ ngas blo brtan 'gyur med ngang sger chod lam lugs kyi rtsa don rgyun srung byed rgyu yin te/ nga'i brjed thabs med pa'i yab chen ltar byed rgyu yin nya zhes spyi bsgrags byas/ 1905lo'i zla 1tshes 22nyin/ khos 8 khrag bzhur ba'i gza' nyi ma'i ’ don rkyen ya nga ba de bzos/zar rgyal srid gzhung gi gtum spyod la bzo pa rnams khong khro tshad med skyes shing / kho tshos ‘ zar rgyal gyis nga tshor ya nga med pa'i gcar rdung byed pas/ nga tshos kyang kho la gcar rdung drag po zhig byed dgos song ’ zhes bshad/zla 1pa dang zla 3pa'i nang / las mtshams 'jog pa'i mtho rlabs de rgyal yongs su mched par gyur/ zla 10par/ mo si kho nas mgo bslangs te/ rgyal yongs su chab srid rang bzhin gyi spyi'i las mtshams bzhag la/ ‘ sger chod ring lugs rtsa med gtong dgos/ dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun rgyal khab khri lor shog ’ ces pa'i kha dbyangs bsgrags/ spyi'i las mtshams bzhag pa de'i skabs/ phe ther pog dang mo si kho sogs dkyil snying gi grong khyer du/ thog dang por bzo pa'i su'u we e (loḥ༅ste/ u ru si'i skad kyi u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i don/)zhes pa'i rtsa 'dzugs byung / phe ther pog gi su'u we e yis bzo pa'i las 'gul gyi 'go khrid dbang cha bdag 'dzin byas/ kru'u zhi hu lu si tha le'o rtsu(ཿdngho1thoṭhaza)zhes pa bzung rjes/ phe ther pog gi su'u we e yis gtso 'dzon tshogs pa zhig btsugs la/ tho lo si ci(—6stan46lhu'i)zhes pa tshogs gtsor bskos/bzo pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing gi mtho rlabs 'gyur ba dang bstun nas/ zhing pa'i las 'gul la yang 'phel rgyas mgyogs po byung / 1905lo'i dpyid dbyar gyi dus su/ rgyal yongs kyi lnga cha'i gcig gi rdzong khongs su zhing pa'i 'os langs byung /349

1905lo'i gsar brje byung rjes/ u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo tang gis lon ton nas skabs gsum pa'i 'thus mi'i rtogs chen 'tshogs la/ meg hri web khi tshogs 'dur zhugs ma 'dod/ le nyin gyi 'go khrid 'og tshogs chen gyis mar khe si ring lugs kyi lam phyogs gtan 'bebs byas la/ thengs de'i gsar brje ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i rang bzhin gyi gsar brje zhig yin pa dang / de'i 'gan khur ni zar rgyal gyi sger chod ring lugs rtsa med btang ste/ dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs pa yin pa/ 'byor med gral rim gyis 'go khrid dbang cha dam por bzung ste/ zhing pa dang mna' 'brel 'dzugs dgos pa sogs kyi lta ba bton/ zla 11par/ le nyin phyir rgyal nang du log ste 'thab 'dzing la thad kur du 'go khrid byas so//1905lo'i gsar brje'i khyad chos gtso bo gzhan zhig ni zar rgyal gyi dmag dpung yang gsar brje'i nang zhugs pa de yin/ lo de'i zla 6par/mtsho nag gru dpung gi khrab ldan gru gzings 6 po cang cin ’’rtags can(‘87tsho༅’ bhaḥwaṭha)gyis 'os langs byas/ zla 10pa dang 11par/ khwa lang hri tha ti(tso4o༅skosnyomadang ze wa si tho pol (30phaḥ 0901ཿcholotsha 7lo)zhes pa'i mtsho dmag gis 'os langs byas/ dmag mi'i gsar brje'i bya spyod des zar rgyal srid gzhung lhag par dngangs su bcugargyal yongs rang bzhin gyi gsar brje'i mtho rlabs kyi brdab gsig gis ne ku ra gnyis pa la dngangs skrag chen po skye ru bcug khos rgyal phyir 'bro rgyu'i gra sgrig tshags su chud pa byas la/ rang stobs slar gso'i go skabs shig 'thob ched/ mgo bskor ba'i g.yo thabs spyad de/ zla 10tshes 17nyin 〈〈zla bcu pa'i bsgrags gtam 〉〉zhes pa bkram ste/ mi dmangs la dad mos dang 350

gleng brjod/ gsar 'gyur dpe bskrun/ mna' mthun tshogs pa 'dzugs pa sogs kyi rang dbang yod pa dang / rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi tu'u ma (༈1phoste/ u ru si'i skad kyi gros tshab las khungs zhes pa'i don/)'tshogs te/ nang srid las 'dzin gsar ba rtsa 'dzugs dang / bhe the (49nga0tho༅ma༄tha༅57༅1khuḥ༈rnya)zhes pa nang srid tsung lir bsko rgyu bcas khas blangs/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyis zar rgyal gyi ‘ gzigs skyong ’ —der yi rang nas mig chu shor la/'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul mu mthud du 'phel/le nyin phyir rgyal nang du log rjes/ drag po'i 'os langs su thad kur gzhug rgyu'i gra sgrig byas shing / zla 12tshes 7nyin/ mo si kho nas chab srid rang bzhin gyi las mtshams 'jog mgo brtsams la/ tshes 9nyin drag po'i 'os langs byed mgo brtsams/ bzo pa'i su'u we e yis 'os langs la bye brag tu rtsa 'dzugs dang 'go khrid byas te/ skabs shig ring ches grags chod che ba'i las khungs shig tu gyur/ bzo pa rnams kyis ‘4nga tshor rang nyid kyi srid gzhung yod la/ su'u we e yis ji ltar bshad na nga tshos kyang de ltar bsgrub ’ ces bshad/ mo si kho'i drag po'i 'os langs kyi dus mtshungs su/ ton pa si(8smo༅lo)sogs grong khyer du'ang 'os langs byung mod/ yin na'ang spyir btang 'os langs la gra sgrig de 'dra 'thus tshang zhib tshags shig med pas/ re re bzhin zar rgyal gyi dmag dpung gis drag gnon byas/ skabs der 'jar u'i g.yul 'khrug mtshams bzhag yod pas/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gis stobs shugs hrag bsdus kyis rgyal nang gi gsar brjer kha gtad bcag chog go/mo si kho'i zla 12pa'i 'os langs ni 1905lo'i gsar brje'i yang rtse yin/'os langs pham rjes su/ gsar brje dma' rlabs su bslebs shing / log — 351

spyod pa'i 'jigs zil gyis rgyal yongs khebs yod/ 1906lo dang 1907lo'i las mtshams bzhag pa yang snga gzhug tu mnan/ skabs dang po dang gnyis pa'i tu'u ma gang yang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la de 'dra nyan po med pas/zar rgyal gyis gtor/ 1907lo'i zla 6par/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gi gtso khur:rdzun sdig 11 cesku pheng (11 tshong 0 1lo/skyodzotsho/lnga)gibasdo ji)bsdo 019 95thalnga66tha༅5 10mchab15ma tshorgol byed mgo brtsams te/ smyo ham che ba'i sgo nas gsar brje la drag gnon byas pas/ u ru si si the le pheng gi log spyod dus skabs su bslebs so//1905lo'i gsar brje las/ u ru si'i 'byor med gral rim dang zhing pa la sbyong brdar thob pas/ le nyin gyis gsar brje der u ru si'i zla bcu pa'i gsar brje yi ‘ sbyong brdar chen mo ’ zhes brjod do//352

so bdun pa/ dgra bla'i dpung tshogs gnyis kyi grub tshul/—lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo dus rabs nyi shu bar bslebs skabs su/ 'dzam gling phyi phyir zing cha che bar gyur/ zing cha de ni mi 'gyangs par 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyi g.yul 'khrug cig 'byung ba'i snga ltas red/ de yang ma rtsa ring lugs de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rim du bslebs pa dang bstun nas byung ba zhig red ces bshad chog ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas kyi mgyogs tshad 'gyur bas/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab dag gi stobs shugs la'ang 'gyur ldog rgyun chad med par byung ste/ sngar dar rgyas mgyogs shing dngos shugs che ba'i rgyal khab ste/ dper na dbyin ji lta bur mtshon na/ dar rgyas kyi mgyogs tshad je dal du 'gro mgo brtsams shing /phyis dar gyi rgyal khab ste dper na 'jar man dang 'jar pan lta bur mtshon na dar rgyas cung mgyogs la/ nang sgos su 'jar man ni 'phur skyod rang bzhin gyis dar bar gyur/ de ltar du rgyal khab so so'i stobs shugs kyi bsdur bar 'gyur ldog byung zhing / rgyal spyi'i bar gyi stobs shugs sgrig gzhi bskyar sgrig byed mgo brtsams/ 'phel phyogs de ni dus rabs 19pa'i lo rabs 70pa'i rjes nas bzung rim bzhin byung ba red/phu hpha g.yul 'khrug gi rjes su/ 'jar man gyis yo rob skam sa chen po'i btsan dbang gi go gnas zin par gyur/ go gnas de rgyun 'khyongs yong ched/rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs khrod des mu mthud du hpha ran si nyams rgud dang khor rkyang 353

du gtong thabs byas/ 'on kyang 'jar man gyi btsan dbang ham re der u ru si'i 'gran rtsod bzung / u ru si'i srol rgyun gyi phyi phyogs srid jus shig ni lpol khen (8tsha6thab ༅lo༈)dang / sa dbus rgya mtsho/ nye shar( yolko)bcas su rgya bskyed pa yin/ 1877lor u ru si yis tur ki la g.yul bkyes te/ khon si than thin rdzong la thad 'jug byas/ 'jar man dang o si khri ri ya/dbyin ji bcas kyang sa khul de dag la ham re yod/ de mig mdun nas u ru sis sger zas byed pa la 'jar man ngor bud de the gtogs byas la/1878lora.o si khri ri ya dang dbyin jir mnyam 'brel byas te per lin nas rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'du bsdus/ pi si mar gyis tshogs 'du'i mgo 'dzin khur zhing rang gis rang la ‘6gzhungs drang gi bar mi ’ zhes su btags mod/ don dngos thog dbyin dang o sogs rgyal khab la mnyam 'brel sgos u ru si la kha nang du thon pa'i dngos po phyir bskyug tu 'jug rgyu de yin/ de'i mtshungs su u ru si la gom gang mdun spos sgos rdung rdeg byed ched/ u ru si'i 'bru rigs dang phyugs zog nang 'dren byed par tshod bkag byas pas/ u ru si shin tu khros par gyur/ 1879lo'i zla 4par/ zar rgyal gyis 'jar man rgyal por yi ge bskur te/ ‘6'jar man gyis grogs po rnying bar 'di 'dra bgyis pas/ rgyal khab gnyis kyi g.yul 'thab cig g.yol du med pa 'dra ’ zhes bshad/ lbol khen dang sa dbus rgya mtsho'i gnad don gyi thad/ 'jar man dang o si khri ri ya'i rtsa ba'i khe phan gcig mtshungs yin/ 1879lo'i zla 10par/ rgyal khab gnyis kyis 〈〈'jar o'i mna' 'brel chings yig 〉〉ces pa bkod cing / mdung rtse ni gcig na u ru sir gtad yod la/ gnyis su hpha ran sir yang gtad yod/hpha ran sis sa dbus rgya mtsho dang hphe gling byang mar snga mo nas ham re 354

bcangs yod la/ thu ni shi ya (15sa1317 za7༅)khongs su bsdus pa de la i ṭa li shin tu ma dga'/ 'jar man gyis dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas i ṭa li dang hpha ran si'i bar 'gal 'du bslangs te/ mu mthud du hpha ran si kher rkyang du phud/ i ṭa li yis rang nyid hpha ran si'i do ya mi yong ba shes pas/'jar man dang o si khri ri yar rgyab brten bcol ba de tag tag pi si mar gyi 'dod mos dang mthun po byung / 1882lo'i zla 5par/ 'jar o i gsum gyis 〈〈rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel chings yig 〉〉bkod cing / chings yig nang / rgyal khab gsum po'i nang gi rgyal khab gcig gam yang na rgyal khab gnyis la btsan rgyal gzhan gnyis (u ru si dang hpha ran si gnyis la'o/)kyis dpung rgol byas pa na/ rgyal khab gsum pos rdog rtsa gcig sgril byed rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas yod/ rgyal khab gsum po'i mna' 'brel btsugs pa yis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i phyogs su gom pa dang po spos/ yin na'ang skabs der pi si mar gyi dmigs yul gtso bo ni yo rob skam sa chen po la dmigs nas hpha ur tshod bkag byed rgyu de yin/ phyis su/ 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs mu mthud dar 'phel byung ba dang bstun nas/kho'i ham sems kyang de mthun du je cher gyur/dus rabs 19pa'i mjug tu/ 'jar man gyi bzo las dar 'phel ha cang mgyogs/ 1895lo nas 1911lo'i bar gyi lo ngo bcu drug tsam gyi nang /'jar man gyi bzo las spyi'i thon thang ldab gcig 'phar/ de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rim du bslebs pa na/ bzo las thon skyed yo rob kyi ang dang por bslebs yod de/ mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs pa rgan rabs dbyin ji dang hpha ran si las brgal yod/ 'jar man gyi khi ru phi ( 5706 5499 mazlo/khri)dmag chas kung si dang / se men si (2 ba3 yo01ba01 500 51040ba3355

yo/kar)glog chas kung si sogs 'dzam gling du skad grags che ba'i sger chod khe las su gyur te/ dbyin ji'i thon rdzas phyir 'bud mgo brtsams/ 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs rgyas rjes/ tshong rdzas kyi tshong ra gsar ba dang) rgyu chas thon yul gsar ba/ ma rtsa gtong yul gsar ba 'tshol snyeg byed dgos pa byung / 'on kyang skabs de'i 'dzam gling ni dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ u ru si sogs mi ser spel mkhan rgan rabs rgyal khab dag gis bgos tshar yod/bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul sa khul gyis 'dza mi gling skam sa'i bzhi cha'i gcig zin pa dang / u ru si'i phyi rgya bskyed pa'i sride jus las de'i mnga' khongs kyis 'dzam gling gi drug cha'i gcig zin yod ga hpha ran si la yang hphe gling dang hin rdu tsi na (polo4smokhya)ru mi ser spel yulamang du yod/ 'jar man ni de dag dang gtan nas bsdur thabs med 'jar man gnas babs de lta bu zhig la shin tu mi tshim pas/ khos dpala'abyor dang dmag don gyi stobs shugs la gzhi byas te 'dzam gling bskyar dubago rgyu'i re ba byed/ 'jar man gyi gsar du rgyal khrir 'khod pa'i rgyal po wilim gnyis pa ni 'jar man gyi sger chod 'byor ldan gral rim gyi re ba deli tshab byed pa zhig yin/wi lim gnyis pa ni 1888lor rgyal khrir bsdad pa yin/ kho yo rob skam sa tsam du btsan bdag gi go gnas thob pa la yid mi tshim par dmigs ba 'dzam gling hril bor gtad yod pas/ khos 8 'jar man btsan rgyal 'di 'dzam gling gi btsan rgyal du 'gyur dgos ’ zhes spyi bsgrags byas/ kho pa khrir 'khod rjes kyi don chen thog ma ni rgyal rabs gsum gyi blon chen pi si mar phyir 'bud rgyu de yin te/ khos pi si mar rgas shing 'khogs pas mu mthud don chen la jus bkod byed mi nus par 'dod/ de bas khos phe ro hphu (ṣṭhatsho 356

〉nga)zhes pa btsan rgyal gyi blon chen du bskos/ phe ro hphu ni wi lim gnyis pas 'dzam gling bdag dbang du bsgyur bar rgyab skyor hur thag byed mkhan zhig yin/ khos 6 mi rigs gzhan la skam sa dang rgya mtsho bgo bsha' byed du bcug ste/ nga tsho 'jar man a sngon gyi nam mkha' tsam la yid tshim pa'i dus rabs de mjug rdzogs song / nga tshos kyang rang nyid la'ang nyi ngogs kyi sa khongs gnyer dgos ’ zhes 'ur brgyab pa dang / 88'jar man mi rigs bla na 'phags pa ’ zhud sgrog byas nas 'jar man la ‘8bar snang ’ dog drags par brjod/ u ru sis za'e pu re'u lcags lam chen mo grub nye bar bltas te/'jar man gyis kyang per lin nas lbol khen dang khon si than thin rdzong brgyud de lba ki ta (3325636 phyatshanayokhri)ru bslebs pa'i lcags lam zhig bskrun te/stobs shugs lbol khen dang nye shar la bskyed pa ma zad/ da dung rgya gar la bsring nas/ dbyin ji'i ring shar gyi ‘6nor bu mi de 'thob 'dod skyes byung cadro /wi lim gnyis pa ni ‘8ser byur smra ba ri brjod mkhan yang yin/1895lor khos blo sna rtsal du sprugs te 〈〈ser byur ri mo'i 〉〉ma phyi bris shing /de nas ri mo pa khi na khi hphu si (ṭwāṃsmokhya༈4sgrosgo7|)zhes par kho'i ma phyi ltar 〈〈ser byur ri mo 〉〉dngos ma zhig 'bri ru bcug la/ yo rob tshang ma mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas mi rgyud ser bo'i gnod byur 'gog srung byed dgos zhes dang /88dkyil snying ni yo rob btsan rgyal dag gi mnyam 'brel 'gog srung steng 'jog dgos ’ zhes 'ud brjod byas/btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ming mdzod du/ 8 'gog srung ’ dang 88btsan 'dzul ’’gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs red/ 88yo rob btsan rgyal mnyam 'brel gyis 'gog srung byed dgos nya zhes pa ni ‘4yo rob btsan rgyal ༄ 357

dag mnyam 'brel byas te btsan 'dzul byed dgos ’ zhes pa dang don gcig yin la/ don dngos thog kyang de 'dra red do// 1897lor/ wi lim gnyis pas dmag dpung btang ste krung go'i chin to(tshoyam̐)bzung zhing / btsan thabs kyis jo kru wan(yicimakho) bogs g.yar ’ byas/ phyi lor/ zar rgyal u ru sis rang rgyal gyi le hron 'gag bzung / wi lim gnyis pas de shes rjes mgyogs por ne ku ra gnyis par 'phrin yig btang ste/ ru nged gnyis pa'o he wan(7lo ca)gyi 'dres mdor so pa khyad du 'phags pa gnyis su 'gyur nges red ’ ces bshad/ ji 'dra'i 8 so pa khyad du 'phags pa gnyis nya ang / des ma dris rang lab kyi sgo nas/ma gzhir mnyam 'brel gyis krung go'i mnga' khongs la btsan 'dzul byed pa der 88mnyam 'brel 'gog srung ’ zer ba yin tshul khas blangs so// krung gor btsan 'dzul byed rgyu'i gnad don thad/ skabs der 'jar man gyis sger zas bya rgyu de da dung gleng mi ran pas/ mnyam 'brel gyi dar phyar ba red/1900lor/ wi lim gnyis pas rang gi dmag spyi wal ti she ( 11 06 0 tsha50ba yo760 300khroṣṭhayo)zhes pa rgyal khab brgyad kyi mnyam 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab tu 'jog rgyur ngo sprod byas te/ mnyam 'brel gyi sgo nas krung go'i dbyi ho thon()kyim༅)las 'gul la drag gnon dang / mnyam 'brel gyis pe cin la btsan 'dzul byas/wi lim gnyis pas hur thag gis btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed byas pa'i dus mtshungs su/ srog bsdos kyis dmag bsdu g.yul grabs byas/ 1893lor 'jar man rgyal tshogs kyis khrims shig la gros 'cham byung ste/ dmag dpung gi rgyun ldan grangs 'bor khri nga brgyad dang stong dgu la bslebs chog pa byas/wi lim gnyis pas mtsho dmag la lhag par du mthong chen byed de/ 64'jar 358

man gyi ma 'ongs pa mtsho steng na yod ’ par 'dod do// khos ‘8'jar man la mtsho dmag stobs chen zhig med pa na/ shun skogs med pa'i srog chags rnyi mo zhig dang 'dra zhes bshad/ 'jar man gyis stobs chen gyi mtsho dmag cig 'dzugs pa4 dang / mtsho'i par 'gram du song ste mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod bya rgyu de ni/ mtsho ngos kyi btsan dbang lo ngo brgya phrag la bzung ba'i dbyin ji dang rtsod 'thab bya ba zhig red/ phe ro hphu yis ‘ gal te dbyin jis rgyal khab nyam chung zhig gi sder ma'i bza' ba za 'dod na/ khos nga tsho dang lhan du bza' 'os ’ zhes dmar rjen du bshad myong / dbyin ji dang rtsod 'thab bya ched/ 1998lor 'jar man gyis lo ngo nyi shu'i ring mtsho dmag rgya che ba zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi la gros 'cham byung / 1913lor mtsho dmag gi dmag gron a sgor dung phyur gnyis dang khri nyis stong la 'phar/'jar man gyi bya spyod des hpha ran si dang dbyin ji/ u ru si'i mi ser spel ba'i khe phan la 'jigs skul tshabs chen thebs/ hpha ran si ni 'jar man gyi dgra bo gtso bo yin/ phu hpha g.yul 'khrug skabs/ hpha ran sis al sa si dang lo ren shor zhing / hpha lāng dung phyur lnga bcu'i 'jal stong shor bas/ de la dgra lan slog 'dod cing / de'i mtshungs su da dung 'jar man gyi sal rdo sol gter kha(rṣalo ༅7)thob 'dod yod/ de bas/ hpha ran sis hur thag gis u ru si dang nye bar btud de/ kher rkyang las thar thabs byas/ u ru sis kyang 'jar man gyis rang la 'gran rtsod byed pa shes shing / per lin nas lba ki ta la lcags lam bskrun pa ni u ru si'i lpol khen dang nye shar gyi khe phan la ham pa yin tshul rtogs pas/ rang 'gul sgos hpha ran si dang 'brel ba bzung / gnas tshul de lta bu zhig gi 'og yu hpha rgyal khab gnyis gcig tu mthun par gyur/ 1892lor/ hpha u gnyis kyis dmag don gros chings 359

bkod de/ phyogs gcig la 'jar man nam i dang o yi dpung rgol byung tshe/phyogs gzhan des nus pa yod dgu bton te ram 'degs byas te thun mong sgos g.yul sprod par gtan 'khel byas/dbyin jis 'jar man gyi mdung rtse rang la'ang gtad yod pa mthong bas/ 'jar man la kha gtad gcog ched/ dbyin ji'i rgyal srid las khungs kyis 'di ltar gros thag bcad de/ 'jar man gyis mtsho gru gcig bzos na dbyin jis mtsho gru gnyis bzo rgyu byas so// 1905lor/ dbyin jis tun chig khri brgyad stong can gyi 88mi 'jigs 'thab gru ’ bzos/ rgyal khab so sos de la lad mo byas nas/ dmag grabs kyi mtho rlabs shig drag tu 'phyur bar gyur/dbyin ji'i srol rgyun gyi phyi 'brel srid jus ni 88gzi brjid kyi rang btsan srid jus lag tu bstar te/ skam sa snyoms po yong ba byas nas de las khe phan 'thob rgyu de yin mod/ 'on kyang skabs der/ dbyin jis kyang phyi phyogs srid jus thad 88gzi brjid kyi rang btsan ri srid jus dor te/ radzo 'gul sgos hpha ran si dang u ru sir mthun thabs byas shing / kho pa tsho'i tshi ser spel yul gnad don thad kyi 'gal 'du snyoms sgrig byas/ 'jar man gyi 'jigs skul dang / mi ser spel ba'i khe phan rgyun 'khyongs yong ba'i thun mong gi dgos pa yis/ dbyin hpha u gsum gcig tu sbrel/ 1904lo dang 1907lor/ kho pa tshos 8jabyin hpha gros chings 7 dang ‘8dbyin u gros chings ’ bkod/ de ltar/ u hpha gros chings dang dbyin hpha gros chingagadabyin u gros chings bcas yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ dbyin hpha u gsum gyis don dngos thog rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel dang kha gtad du langs pa'i grosachings rgyal khab kyi tshogs pa zhig grub bo//hpha ran sis dbyin ji dang u ru si la gros chings rgyal khab tu sbrel b.li 360

dus mtshungs su/ nus rgu rtsal du bton te rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel gyi gyang rting slog ci thub bgyis shing / dmigs pa i ṭa li la gtad/1902lor/ hpha i gnyis lkog tu chings yig bkod de/ gal te 'jar os thog mar g.yul mgo bslangs pa yin na/ i ṭa li g.yul du mi gzhug par gros mthun byung ste/ i ṭa li rim bzhin rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel dang gyes/ 'jar man gyis ma gzhir hpha ran si chig rkyang du 'bud 'dod kyang /skabs der phyir ldog ste rang nyid chig rkyang gi gnas su gyar/ de bas thabs zad kyi sgo nas o rgyal dang dam du 'khyud do//'gal zlar langs pa'i dmag tshogs gnyis grub rjes/ phyogs gnyis nas phan tshun gnod thabs sna tshogs su gnyer zhing / ru mtshon ngoms 'phyar gyi sgo nas nyen tshabs la rgyun du 'phrad cing / 'khrug pa chung chung mang du byung /dper na 1905lo dang 1911lor thengs gnyis la mo ro ko (50 0000 ཿtshopo)yi nyen tshabs byung zhing / 1912lo dang 1913lor thengs gnyis la lpol khen g.yul 'khrug byung ba lta bu yin/ nyen tshabs dang g.yul 'khrug chung chung de dag gis/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi tshogs khag gnyis kyi mi ser spel yul dang stobs shugs mnga' khongs 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i thad kyi 'gal 'du de dmar 'dzing gi tshad du bslebs pa mngon par mtshon thub bo//mo ro ko ni hphe gling nub byang gi sner gnas shing / kri pu rol tho mtsho 'gag gis bar du chod de yo rob kyi si phen dang kha sprod du yod la/ nub kyi rgya mtsho nas sa dbus rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i 'a/ma sgo bcad yod pas/ g.yul 'thab thad gal gnad shin tu che/ mo ro ko la da dung phun sum tshogs pa'i gter kha'ang yod pas/ hpha ran si dang 'jar man gang gis kyang de 'thob 'dod byed/ 1905lor/ hpha ran sis dbyin ji'i rgyab skyor 'og mo ro ko la 361

bskyod dgos pa'i re ba bton la/ 'jar man gyis hpha ran sir gtogs pa'i kong sgo kho par ster rgyu'i cha rkyen bton/ skabs der phyogs gnyis khong khro 'bar zhing lag 'gul grabs byas/ skabs der dbyin jis rbad chod kyis hpha ran sir rgyab rogs byas te 'jar man dang g.yul sprod nges byas pas/thengs der 'jar man phyir nur dgos pa byung / rgyu mtshan ni dngos gnas g.yul bgyis tshe 'jar man gyis rang nyid g.yul 'thab kyi gra sgrig tshags su chud pa da dung byung med par bsam pas/ je gnyom du mi 'gro thabs med byung nas/ hpha ran sis mo ro ko la ‘4srung skyob nya byed rgyu khas blangs so//mo ro ko'i nyen tshabs gnyis ni phyogs gnyis gas gra sgrig 'thus tshang zhig byung med pa'i rkyen gyis g.yul 'khrug tu 'gyur ma thub/ lpol khen gyi g.yul 'khrug ni dpung khag gnyis kyis gzhan lag g.yar te bgyis pa'i g.yul 'khrug cig red/lpol khen sa khul ni yun ring bo'i nang tur ki ba'i o si man (03 3batsholo༅)btsan rgyal gyis dbang du bsgyur yod/ 1912lor/ ser we ya (bya0 61thaḥloḥ༅)dang/ yul ghi ri ya(87123713kṣamekhyalko/༅)/ ghi ri si(0 0000lkotsho)/ min tu ne ki lo (/ kayolaso༅)bcas rgyal khab bzhi yis grub pa'i tur rgol mna' 'brel gyis tur ki la g.yul brda sbran zhing / tur ki'i dmag dpung thung myur du pham par brgyab/ g.yul 'khrug byung rjes su/'jar man dang o hang btsan rgyal ()grutshe1lo1༅)gyis lpol khen gyi rgyal khab so so rang tshugs dang stobs ldan du 'gro ru 'jug mi 'dod pas/ tur ki la rgyab rogs byas shing / u ru sis skabs der bstun nas lpol khen la lag bsring 'dod pas/ lpol khen gyi rgyal khab so sor rogs skyor byas/ u dang o gnyis gas yul bye brag pa nas skul slong byas/ lpol khen gyi gnas babs 363

la dpung khag gnyis kyis the gtogs byas pas lhag par dza drag dang sne 'dzing du gyur/ thengs der yang phyogs gnyis kyis gra sgrig tshags su chud med pas g.yul 'khrug gi rgya che ru ma bskyed do// mthar lpor khen gyi gnad don la rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs 'tshogs te bar 'dum byas shing / tur ki'i stobs shugs mang shos lpol khen sa khul nas phyir 'then/ 1913lor/ lpol khen rgyal khab bzhi'i bar tur rgol rgyal kha las byung ba'i khe phan bgo bsha'i thad 'gal 'du byung / ser we ya gtso byas te/ ghi ri si dang ro ma ni ya/ (50la8ba1tha 7brakhu༅) min tu ne ki lo bcas kyi phyogs kyis/ yul ste ri ya la ngo rgol byas/ rjes su/ tur ki yang sgul ste ri ya la ngo rgol byed pa'i phyogs su langs la/ gnas babs lo sngon ma las kyang dza drag che bar gyur/ byul ste ri ya yis rgyal khab lnga bor ngo ya mi yong nges can yin/ser we ya yis skabs der bstun nas al bha ni ya'i ( 16thab13 0lo༅༅༅)mnga' khongs bdag tu bzung / thengs der o rgyal gyis ser we yas mnga' khongs bskyed pa la ngo rgol shugs chen byas la/ u ru sis ser we ya la rogs skyor byas/ o rgyal gyis ser we ya la mjug mtha'i tha tshig bsgrags te g.yul slong rgyu'i 'jigs skul nas/ ser we ya al bha ni ya nas phyir 'then rgyu'i 'dod mos bstan/ ser we ya'i ltag rgyab tu langs pa'i u ru si yisa'ajar man dang o rgyal gyi 'jigs skul la yang bskyar phyi nur byas pas/ ser we ya yang thabs zad de al bha ni ya nas phyir 'then/de ltar/ lpol khen sa khul du mdun sgo nas spyang ki bkag kyang ltag sgo nas stag mo 'dzul yong ba'i sne 'dzing gi gnas tshul byung / lpol khen gyi rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis tur ki ba'i stobs shugs phyir bskrad mod/ 'onakyang 'jar o u gsum gyi stobs shugs nang 'dzul byas byung / o rgyal dang 3yo

ser we ya'i 'gal 'khrug dang / o rgyal dang u ru sis sprul khen 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'gal 'du/ de'i ltag rgyab kyi dpung tshogs gnyis kyi 'phrog rtsod dang 'gran 'thab kyis/ zhol khen sa khul btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 'gal 'du'i lte ba dang g.yul 'khrug gi 'gas rdzas su gyur pas/ me stag chung chung zhig 'gas mdzod der lhung pas kyang g.yul 'thab chen po zhig tu 'gyur nges so//gong smos kyi nyen tshabs dang sa khul phyogs re ba'i g.yul 'khrug de dag gis g.yul 'thab chen po zhig ma bslangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni phyogs gnyis kyis gra sgrig tshags su chud pa zhig byas medapas red/ mo ro ko'i nyen tshabs dang lpol khen gyi g.yul 'khrug rjes su/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab tshang mas dmag bsdu g.yul grabs la shugs snone brgyab/ 1913lor bslebs tshe/ u ru sir dngos yod dmag mi khri phrag brgya dang sum cu dang /hpha ran ser khri phrag bdun cu don bdun/ dbyin jir khri phrag bzhi bcu zhe drug yod/ 'jar man la dngos yod dmag mi khri phrag bdun cu don drug yod/'khrug chen dang po'i yar sngon du/ 'jar o'i dmag don sngon rtsis mā khi dung phyur brgya dang bzhi bcu la bslebs yod cing / gros chings rgyal khab kyi sngon rtsis mā khi dung phyur bzhi bcu zhe bdun dang khri phrag drug stong la bslebs yod pas/ 'gas rdzas kyi mdzod du 'gas sman phyi phyir mang par gyur/ 1914lor me stag cig yo rob 'gas rdzas kyi mdzod du lhung pas/ 'dzam gling gi 'khrug chen zhig langs so 365

sotshobargyad pa/ mi'i6degs 'o rgyus steng gi gsod 'bab chenapha sngag med pa zhigadzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po/yu sgo si la lbi ya (556031tha718tshelo4za)yibhosani ya'i (603 1 3 oglokhursā)rgyal sa sā ra je lbo (3tha 83050 ༅4zatshi sto/ deng skabasarṣa4yozazer/)na a po lam(rsā1/4tsho1)zer ba'i srang lam zhig yod/ de'i bzhi mdo zhig gi 'gram du rdo gcal bting yod la/ steng du rkang rjes cha zhig bkod yod pa dang / 'gram gyi gyang ldebs su 661914lo'i zla 6tshes 28nyin/ skab ri lo phu ren zib (03 1/0 271ba019 zalkokhya༅ rdzo.oṃporsā)kyis 'di ru rangagi mdel gyis nga tsho'i mi dmangs kyis btsan gtum la ngo rgol dang rang dbang la re snyeg byed pa mngon par mtshon no ’ zhes yig 'bru chen po thig phreng 'ga' brkos yod/ 'gram logs kyi khang pa de ni bsham ston khang yin la/ched dmigs kyis rjes dran rdo ring de'i lo rgyus ngo sprod byas yod/ ma gzhir 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po ni 'di nas phu ren zib kyi mde'u 'ga' las byung ba zhig red/o hang btsan rgyal gyis blo sems gcig gis ser we ya khyur mid gtong 'dod la/ mnga' khongs yu sgo si la lbi ya la bskyed 'dod cing / o hang btsan rgyal de o hang yu btsan rgyal du bskyed 'dod do// o rgyal gyi rgyal khri'i rjes skyong ba hphu ran tshi hpher ti nan (kha0 61ba'ib6 lkoḥcho ༅7khye)ni gong smros 'dod tshul 'ud sgrog hur por byed mkhan zhig yin/ yu sgo si la lbi ya'i 366

mi rigs so so'i rgyal gces pa dag gis hpher ti nan ni rang mi rigs kyi dgra gter 'dzin/ 1914lo'i zla 6par/ o rgyal gyis bho si ni ya nas dmag zil rtsal ston byas te/ ser we ya dang min tu ne ki lo gnyis rtog btags kyi dgra bor byas/ hpher ti nan gyis mdzes sgeg ldan pa'i lcam mo zo hphe ya khrid nas bho si ni yar sku dngos su zil ston la mdzub ston byed du yong / zla 6tshes 28nyin/ hpher ti nan khyo shug gnyis kyis dmag dpung la gzigs rtog gnang rjes rlangs 'khor la bsdad de grong srid khang du dngos ma'i dga' bsu'i mdzad sgor phebs 'gro ba'i lam ni sā ra je lpo'i khrom tshogs che sa a po lam zhes pa brgyud dgos/ nyin der nyi 'od gsal zhing / sā ra je lpo'i srang lam gtso bo dag tu ltad mor yong ba'i mi tshogs 'tshang kha shigs shigs byed/ skabs der/ phu ren zib sogs ser we ya'i rgyal gces gzhon nu bdun srang 'gram du gab bsdad de/ skabs btsal nas hpher ti nan gsod rtsis byas/ hpher ti nan gyi rlangs 'khor ru khag a po lam gyi zam pa zhig gi sner thon pa na/ gzhon nu zhig mi tshogs khrod nas mchong yong ste 'gas 'bom g.yug rjes phyir mi tshogs khrod 'dzul song / 'gas 'bom hpher ti nan sdod sa'i rlangs 'khor gyi ltag rgyab tu lhung yang / 'gas ma song / mi chen de dngangs 'tshab ci yang med pa bzhin/ rlangs 'khor nas mar mchong ste/'gas 'bom de khro ba'i so 'tham bzhin lam 'gram du g.yug pas/ ltad mor lta mkhan mang tshogs skor zhig la rmas skyon phog tu bcug de nas kho klad khebs med pa'i rlangs 'khor steng mchong ste mu mthud mdun du bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ mi tshogs khrod 'dzul ba'i gzhon nu de cung tsam las ma 'gor bar bzung / hpher ti nan grong srid khang nas phyir thon rjes/ da dung lkog gsod byed 367

mkhan yod par dogs nas/ rlangs 'khor 'gro sa'i lam phyogs brjes/yin na'ang rlangs 'khor gyi kha lo bas lam phyogs brjes yod pa mi shes pas/rlangs 'khor ru khag a po lam gyi bzhi mdo zhig tu bslebs pa na sngar gyi lam phyogs der dkyogs pa na/ ltag rgyab tu tsog pa'i mis brel 'tshab ngang 8 nor song / mdun phyogs su drang mor song nya zer byung bas/ kha lo bas brel 'tshub ngang 'dug byed mnan te/ rlangs 'khor phyi la nur/ rlangs 'khor phyir nur ba'i skabs der/ lam 'gram du langs yod pa'i phu ren zib la go skabs ha cang bzang po zhig byin/ kho gom stabs chen pos mdun du mchong ste/thag thag ces mi mda' gnyis brgyab/ mdel dang po hpher ti nan gyi ske'i 'jags rtsar phog gler ti nan gyi lcam mo mar sgur te kho skyor skabs/ mdel gnyis pa kho mo'i lto bar phog rler ti nan khyo shug gnyis de ltar bsad/phu ren zib kyi mdel gnyis ser we ya'i mi rigs kyi dgra bo'i lus su phog la/ yo rob kyi me rdzas mdzod khang du yang phog gler ti nan lkog gsod byas pa'i don rkyen des 'jar o la g.yul 'khrug bslangs te ser we ya khyur mid gtong bar kha g.yar sa zhig byin par gyur/ o hpher ti nan khyo shug gnyis rgyal gyis lkog gsod kyi don rkyen de ser ka me mdas bsad pa/we ya'i srid gzhung la rag las yod pa'i kha tshon bcad de/ o rgyal gyi rgyal po yo ze hphu (ོ03096 tram̐1zaza)yis ser we ya'i chab srid kyi rgyu rkyen zhig yin pa'i ngos nas nges par du lbol khen gling phran phyed ma nas yal du 'jug dgos zhes skad cor chen po brgyab/ don dngos ni don rkyen de dang ser we ya'i 368

srid gzhung la thad gar gyi 'brel ba med/'jar man gyis don de thos rjes dga' spro chen po'i ngang go skabs der kha g.yar nas g.yul 'thab bslang rgyu'i blo thag bcad/ 'jar man rgyal po wi lim gnyis pas ‘ 'di ni bskal brgyar 'phrad dka' ba'i go skabs red do ’’zhes dang / 88da lta gal te lag ma 'gul na nam du yang g.yul slong ba'i go skabs med do ’ zhes 'ur brgyab pa dang / khos da dung o rgyal du sdod pa'i 'jar man gyi gzhung tshab chen mor ‘ nges par du ser we ya'i mi la rtsis bsher bgyi dgos par ma zad/ da lta nyid du lag 'gul dgos ’ zhes bkod gdams byas/ o rgyal gyis 'jar man rgyab shed du bzung ste khengs rgyags kyi 'jigs zil phyi phyir che bar gyur/ zla 1tshes 23nyin/ o rgyal gyis ser we ya la mjug mtha'i tha tshig bsgrags shing / ha cang thal che ba'i cha rkyen dag la dus tshod zhe brgyad nang lan ster dgos pa'i brda sbran/ u ru si'i phyi 'brel blon chen gyis mjug mtha'i tha tshig de'i nang don rtogs rjes 88'di ni yo rob kyi 'khrug chen red do ’ zhes ngag nas shor/ser we ya'i srid gzhung gi gnas babs shin tu sdug des phyogs gcig nas u ru si la rgyab rogs zhus zhing / phyogs gcig nas thabs zad pa'i sgo nas o rgyal gyi re 'dun dang du blangs/ o rgyal gyis 'thus mi mngags nas lhan cig tu lag dmar la khrims bsher byed par 'thad pa ma byung ba gcig pu las gzhan/ ser we yas ha lam o rgyal gyis bton pa'i re ba yod tshad dang du blangs mod/ 'on kyang o rgyal gyi pe'o ki rad (3008 36yoporṣa4o)du sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mos ser we ya'i srid gzhung gi lan der bltas rjes da dung yid ma tshim par/ de ma nyid du phyi 'brel bcad/ser we ya la thabs zad de dmag skul gyi brda sbyar cing / zla 1tshes 28nyin/ 369

o rgyal gyis ser we ya la g.yul brda sbran no//u ru sis ser we ya la rgyab rogs byas shing / hpha ran sis u ru si la mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi 'os 'gan lag tu bstar rgyu'i bsam pa bstan/dbyin jis g.yo sgyu'i ngang nas lag gnyis ma'i sbyor ba brtsams te/ gcig na u ru sis g.yul grabs gshom par skul lcag byas shing / gnyis na 'jar man gyis btsan 'dzul byed par yang skul lcag byas/ de las dbyin ji ni g.yul 'khrug slong rgyur mos pa shes thub bo// zla 1tshes 30nyin/ u ru sis spyi'i skul brda btang la/ 'jar man gyis u ru si la dmag skul gyi bka' brda phyir bsdu rgyu'i re ba bton mod/ u ru sis de dang du ma blangs/ zla 8tshes 1nyin/'jar man gyis u ru si la g.yul brda sbran pa dang / zla 8tshes 3nyin hpha ran si la g.yul brda sbran/ zla 8tshes 4nyin 'jar man gyis bhel jam la btsan 'dzul byas pa na/ dbyin jis skabs glags de spyad nas 'jar man la g.yul brda sbran no// dbyin ji btsan rgyal chen mo'i rang skyong mnga' khongs su/ a hphe ri ka lho ma'i mna' 'brel dang / khe na ṭa/ o si ṭi li ya( 03 lo3tshomatho1༅)/ ne'u dzi lan ḍi (507 70mgo6 molo༅)sogs yod pas/ de dag kyang chabs cig tu g.yul 'khrug nang khrid do// 'jar pan gyis skabs glags de bed spyad nas krung go'i jo kru wan 'phrog 'dzin byed ched zla 8tshes 23nyin 'jar man la g.yul brda sbran/ zla 11par/ tur ki mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs te gros chings rgyal khab la g.yul brda sbran/ g.yul 'khrug mgo rtsom skabs/ i ṭa li 88bar gnas ’ yin par khyab bsgrags byas mod/'on kyang 1915lo'i zla 5par/ khos rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel chings yig rtsis med du btang zhing / mdun rtse phyir bstan nas gros chings rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs te mna' 'brel rgyal khab la g.yul bkyes so// pi si mar 370

gyis i ṭa li ni ‘4'phar spyang ’ zhig yin pas/ de nam yang gcan gzan chen po'i rjes su rgyug ste de'i kha nang nas sha tshon po re gnyer bar byed do zhes bshad myong / lo der/ byul ste ri ya mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs te gros chings rgyal khab la g.yul bkyes/ a me ri kha ni 1917lo'i zla 4par da gzod 'jar man la g.yul brda sbran pa yin zhing / krung gos lo de'i zla 8par gros chings rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs te 'jar o la g.yul brda sbran pa yin/ g.yul 'khrug de yo rob nas e sha ya dang a hphe ri ba rgya mtsho chen po'i gling / (0003218nga rṇa tsho) a me ri kha bcas gling chen du mched de/snga gzhug rgyal khab sum cu lhag g.yul 'khrug der zhugs/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus steng gi thengs dang po'i 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyi gsod 'khrug chen po zhig yin la/ lo rgyus su de la 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po zer ro//'khrug chen mgo brtsams rjes/ 'jar man gyis thog mar nub khul nas rgol mgo brtsams/ 'jar man gyi g.yul 'gyed 'char gzhi ni gdong len jus chen pa hri le hphin ( 11 06 50ba bya06110110 otshozo)gyis lo ngo bcu lhag la yang dang bskyar du zhib bcos byas shing / mthar 1905lor gtan 'khel byas pa zhig yin/ khos 'jar man gyi skad grags che ba'i dmag don pa khi la'o ze we tshi (0tha 19511199 00 1 106 0ba 0185༅41 2mahoḥcho)yi 〈〈g.yul 'thab gleng ba 〉〉zhes pa'i khrod brjod pa'i g.yul 'thab kyi bsam blo ste/ dmag shugs hrag bsdus kyi sgo nas mgyogs 'thab myur chod byed pa'i rtsa don gzhir bzung yod/ kho'i 'char gzhi'i nang dmag shugs kyi bcu cha'i dgu nub khul du bkod yod/ nub khul nas mgyogs myur ngang hpha ran si'i dmag pham par brgyab rjes/ gtso shugs shar phyogs su spos te stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis u ru sir rdung rdeg byed rgyu byas la/ nub khul du'ang hri le 371
