hphin gyis gtso shugs g.yas ru la bkod sgrig byas yod de/ khos bltas na/'jar dmag gis lag snga brtsad de dmag shugs hrag bsdus kyi sgo nas bhel jam dang / lag dzem bhag ( 5 0 605 3 zorsā༅)'phred gshags kyis hpha ran sir dpung 'jug byed cing / logs ngos nas hpha dmag dum gcod dang bskor rdung byas te de'i gtso shugs rtsa med gtong ba dang / 'jar pho'i mtha' mtshams kyi g.yon ru yis bkag skyil byed pa'i 'gan tsam khur dgos so// hri le hphin 'chi khar yang 88kho bo'i g.yas ru'i stobs shugs gtan nas chung du bskyung mi 'os ’ zhes yang yang gdams so//'on kyang 1914lor bslebs skabs/ gnas babs la hri le hphin 'tsho skabs dang bsdur na 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/ shar khul du u ru si'i dmag stobs kho'i 'ol tshod byas pa las chen po yod pas/ 'jar man gyi jus chen pa mol chi chung ba (ma01 5 6 106bab03 5641rtsa 0sa 501 6071 cotsha1)yis dmag dpung hri bcu bzhi mi mngags thabs med byung la/ dang thog gi 'char gzhi ltar na hri dgu tsam mngags rgyu yin no// nub khul gyi g.yon ru la yang / 'jar dmag gis hri bdun mang du bsnan te khyon hri bco lnga bkod sgrig byas/ de bas/ g.yas ru'i dmag shugs de hri le hphin gyi 'char gzhir thag bcad pa las hri bcu gcig gis je nyung du song yod/ de ltar/ 'jar dmag gis mgo brtsams pa nas bzung dmag shugs thor du bcug par ma zad/ bhel jam gyi dmag ni 'jar man pas brjod pa ltar ‘ mngar zas kyi dmag’ (7ta77za)cig ma yin te/ 'jar dmag gis sgyel jam la btsan 'dzulakhyed skabs 'gog rgol shugs chen byas te/ le ru (༅1ce20 sto/1 khya)yi g.yul thengs gcig por 'jar dmag khri bzhi shi de dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i dmag shugs bkod sgrig legs po byas te g.yul gshom pa la shin tu phan 372

po byung /'jar dmag gis snyel jam dang / lag dzem bhag nas hpha ran ser 'dzul rjes/ rgol rdung bde blag byung ste thad kur pha ri si la bcar/ 'on kyang 1914lo'i zla 9pa'i mā en (537ba0 bra chu )gtsang bo'i g.yul thengs des g.yul babs bsgyur/ phyogs gnyis gas g.yul 'thab tu khyon dmag 'bor khri phrag brgya dang lnga bcu lhag bkol la/ hpha dmag gis 'jar dmag gi yongs khyab tshur rgol phyir bzlogs te/ nub khul gyi g.yul babs phyogs gnyis sra 'dzin gyi tshul du gnas par gyur/ 'jar man gyi mgyogs 'thab myur gcod kyi 'thab jus de ltar stongs so//shar khul du/ u ru sis skul slong byas pa cung mgyogs pas/ mgo brtsams ma thag nas rgyal kha phran bu re thob ste/ phu ro zi la rgol rdung byas/'jar man rgyal po wi lim gnyis pa dngangs 'tshab ngang gsar du thon pa'i dmag don mkhas grags can lu ten tor hphu (bu1105 kha7106 106 yo11501la6560060smo1(rkyu1tshochotshomi35)dang dmag spyi rgan pa hen ten pog (9tha51 15641rtsa53ba3 ba/0ba 50ba 80sa0khusmo0260 11 5ba6 50ba 51ba60 607rtsa 〉〈〉〉66)u ru si'i dmag 'gog tu btang / ṭhan nen pog (1thabab0ba༅1rtsa 73ཿljong)gi g.yul 'gyed skabs u ru si'i dpug khag gnyis pa yongs su tshar bcad/ u dmag khri phrag bcu gnyis lhag shi rmas su btang zhing / dmag spyi sam dzo no hphu ((99ba0tho 'a 519ma0755 (tha༅ 06 ljangayosnaho/ 76nyang)yis rang gsod byas pas/lu ten tor hphu shar khul dmag gi jus 'doms chen por 'phar ro//1915lor/ 'jar dmag gis lte gnad shar khul du spos/ hen ten pog dang lu ten tor hphu yi bkod 'dems 'og u dmag la phyogs yongs nas rgol rdung byas te u dmag khri phrag brgya dang bdun cu med par btang /373

u dmag la pham gyong chen po thebs mod/ 'on kyang 'jar dmag gis shar khul nas de mgo 'dogs su 'jug ma nus/ nub khul du/ 'jar dmag dang dbyin pho'i dmag phyogs gnyis kur pham rgyal yod pas g.yul babs la 'gyur ldog chen po ma byung /1916lo ni/ phyogs gnyis gas rgyal pham thag gcod pa'i lo zhig yin par bltas pas/ nub khul dang shar khul tshang ma nas g.yul 'khrug chen po thengs 'gar bgyis/ nub khul du/ hpha ran si'i wer ten (50 650 ༅lozo)du/ phyogs gnyis gas dmag shugs 'bor chen bsdus te yun ring bor g.yul 'khrug drag po bgyis/ g.yul sa'i sdong bo rnams thal bar bsregs shing ri'i rtse mo bsnyil la/ sa 'dam yang phyir slog pa'i tshad du bslebs/'jar dmag gis stobs shugs yod rgu byaton nas phar rgol byas la/ hpha dmag gis stobs shugs yod dgu bton nas 'gog rgol byas/ g.yul 'khrug de mjug rdzogs skabs/ phyogs gnyis la so sor dmag 'bor khri phrag lnga bcu re shi rmas byung yod mod/ 'on kyang / 'jar dmag gis wer ten len ma thub bo// g.yul 'khrug der bkod 'doms byed mkhan gyi hpha ran si'i dmag spyi ni phe ten ①yin/ wer ten g.yul 'khrug chen po ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i dkyogs mtshams shig yin te/ de nas bzung 'jar dmag nyams mgo brtsams so// 'jar dmag bkag skyil dang / wer ten 'khrug chen la rgyab rogs ④ phe ten/ 50sa 25 9༅20 lnga ba 7zoste/ khos 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyisapa'i skabs su ming ngan rlung ltar mched pa'i phe ten srid gzhung btsugs te/ 'jar man la mgo btags shing / ngo tsha med pa'i rgyal 'tshong mkhan du gyur pa ni phyis kyi gtam mo/374

byed ched/ zla 7pa dang 8par dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag gis sam gtsang bo'i (30la40 77kho)g.yul 'gyed bslangs shing phyogs gnyis gas rgyal pham thag ma chod/ dbyin dmag gis mi khri phrag bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang / hpha dmag gis mi khri phrag nyi shu/ 'jar dmag gis mi khri phrag drug cu re lnga shor/mnyam 'brel dmag gis 'jar dmag bkag skyil byed pa'i dmigs yul 'grub/ wer ten dang sam gtsang bo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi rjes su/ nub khul du phyogs gnyis gas 'thab ra brkos te srung sdod byas nas/ 'thab ra'i g.yul 'thab bgyis/shar khul du/ nub khul gyi dbyin tpa'i mnyam 'brel dmag la rgyab rogs byed ched/ u dmag gis zla 6pa nas zla 9pa'i bar phyogs yongs nas phar rgol byas/ thengs der u dmag la rgyal kha chen po thob ste/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi dmag mi khri phrag bzhi bcu zhe lnga bzung bas/ 'jar o la rdung rdeg tsha nan thebs/mtsho ngos su/ 1916lo'i zla 5par/ dbyin dmag dang 'jar dmag gis byang mtsho'i ḍin mag gi jod lan ḍi (/5 18ba6 khyaṣṭha༅)mtsho khul nas g.yul bkyes la/ de ni jod lan ḍi'i mtsho 'thab ces pa de'o// dbyin jis dmag gru brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig mngags shing / 'jar man gyis dmag gru brgya dang gcig tsam mngags/ mjug mthar dbyin jis dmag gru bcu bzhi dang / 'jar man gyis dmag gru bcu gcig— shor zhing / dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag drug stong lhag dang / 'jar man gyi mtsho dmag nyis stong lnga brgya lhag g.yul ngor shi/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag la gyong gud chen po thebs mod/ 'on kyang de la stobs shugs chen po yod pas/ g.yul babs spyi la shugs rkyen de 'dra med par ma zad/ de las ldog ste 'jar man gyi mtsho dmag de nas 375

bzung phyir g.yul ngor 'bud mi phod par gyur to// 'khrug chen gyi skabaso hril bor/ 'jar man gyis yang dang bskyar du dbyin jir chur 'dzul dmag gru la brten nas rgol rdung byas te dbyin lun gling phran gsum skor 'jug byed re bcangs mod/ 'on kyang dbyin ji ni mtsho ngos kyi btsan rgyal zhig yin pas 'jar man gyi re ham de mngon du 'gyur ma thub/ skabs der/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi blon chen khur mkhan ni chir chel red/ ༄'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su/ deng rabs can gyi gsod nus shin tu che ba'i mtshon cha mang po g.yul ngor thog dang por spyad/ dper na dug rlangs dang / gnam gru/ than khi sogs thog dang por spyad pa lta bu yin/ than khi ni dbyin ji'i mis gsar gtod byas pa yin la/ gsang bar bya ched 8 zo ba’ ⑦skor zhig bzo gin yod par smras/ phyis su tshab ming de drag chas gsar ba de'i dngos ming du gyur/ than khi thog dang por g.yul ngor spyod sa ni sam gtsang bo'i g.yul 'gyed yin/ skabs der ya mtshan gyi dngos po chen po de thog dang por g.yul ngor thon pa na 'jar dmag rnams shin tu dngangs par gyur/ 'on kyang skabs der than khi da dung legs po zhig grub med la/ dus tshod rer spyi le drug tsam las bgrod mi nus/ 'thab g.yul du don dngos su nus pa thon pa ni 1918lo'i 'khrug chen gyi mjug tu bslebs skabs yin la/ than khi yis nus shugs shin tu chen po thon skabs ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su bslebs skabs yin par snyam mo/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su/ me mda' sbag sbag dang skyogs chen gyi nus shugs shin tu che zhing / rta dmag gi nus pa sngon chad la mi do'o//① dbyin skad du ‘ than khi ‘‘zhes pa'i don ni zo ba'i don no/ 376

1916lo'i g.yul babs la bltas na/ 'jar man gyi pham ltas mngon yod la/ mgyogs 'thab myur gcod ces pa stong bsam du gyur/ 'jar man zhes glo bur du dar ba'i rgyal khab 'di'i mi shugs dang nom shugs la tshad nges can zhig yod pas/ yun ring bo'i 'dzad 'thab mi lcogs par ma zad/'jar dmag gis da dung phyogs gnyis nas g.yul bkyes te mdun rgyab gnyis nas dgra la thug pas dmag shugs hrag bsdus kyis re re bzhin pham par gtong thabs bral lo//1917lor bslebs pa na/ 'jar man g.yul gyis shin tu dub par gyur pas/ khos mtsho 'og gru gzings la brten nas dbyin ji mgo 'dogs su 'jug 'dod la/ de ni don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i stong bsam tsam las ma 'das so// 1917lor/ a ri mi shugs dang nom shugs chen po dang bcas g.yul du zhugs pa de ni 'jar man la mtshon na rdung rdeg ches che ba zhig yin par gdon mi za/ gzhi rgya snga na med pa'i dmag 'thab chen po 'dis rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs la gnod tshabs snga na med zhig bskyal la/ g.yul 'thab kyis gsar brje skul spel yang byas so// rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi g.yul 'thab la ngo rgol dang / mi rigs bcing 'grol/ 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje sogs las 'gul gcig 'jags gcig langs su byung / de'i khrod/ u ru si'i gsar brje'i shugs rkyen ches che/ 1917lo'i zla 2par (u lo)/ u ru sir zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje byung ste/ zar rgyal srid gzhung mgo rting bslogs/ phyis su/ zla bcu pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje la rgyal kha thob ste/ su'u we e srid dbang btsugs shing / g.yul 'khrug las phyir bud pa khyab bsgrags byas/ u ru si'i zla bcu pa'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob 377

pa yis rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs la skul lcag thebs te/ rgyal khab so so'i gsar brje'i las 'gul mtho rlabs gsar ba zhig tu bslebs la/ gsar brje yis g.yul 'khrug mu mthud du 'phel ba bkag go/1918lor/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po dus mjug tu bslebs te/ rgyu mtshan ni u ru si g.yul 'thab las phyir bud pas/ 'jar dmag gis skabs glags de spyad nas hri brgya dang go bdun gyi dmag shugs nub khul spyad cing / bstud mar thengs bzhi la dpung rgol byas te/ pham babs phyir bsgyur nas g.yul 'khrug thung myur mjug bsdu bar 'dod pa dang /gros chings rgyal khab phyogs su/ u ru si g.yul 'thab las phyir bud pas stobs shugs je chung du cung tsam song yod kyang / a ri g.yul la zhugs pas gros chings rgyal khab phyogs la mi shugs dang nom shugs rgya chen po gsar du bsnan yod de/ 1918lor hpha ran si na g.yul du zhugs pa'i a ri'i dmag mi khri phrag brgya yod/ gzhan/ gros chings rgyal khab phyogs kyis hphu khri (kha0761sa3 6 kha005 skyas)mnyam 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab tu bskos te gcig gyur gyis bkod 'doms byas la/ des gros chings rgyal khab kyi dmag gi g.yul 'thab nus pa bla lhag tu bskyed/ skabs der hphu khri'i mnga' 'og tu ṣpeten gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i hpha dmag dang / he ki (ba0061ཿ ma spya’/3 23 1 ༅4rtsa༅7)yis bkod 'doms byas pa'i dbyin dmag dhe si (mosgro lo)yis bkod 'doms byas pa'i i ṭa li'i dmag dpung / pher hrin (/05ba 103095 207351brtsa ༅)gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i a ri'i dmag dpung bcas yod do//zla 1tshes 18nyin/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis mā en gtsang bo'i khul nas phar rgol byas te/ 'jar dmag sum khri bzung / zla 8tshes 8nyin/378

mnyam 'brel dmag gis 'jar dmag gi hri bcu drug rtsa med btang zhing /de'i khrod kyi 'jar dmag nyis khri bzung / ten ten pog gis ya mtshan ngang ‘8zla 8tshes 8nyin ni/ 'jar dmag gi 'dzam gling 'khrug chen lo rgyus steng ches mun nag gtibs pa'i nyin mo zhig yin zhes brjod la/ zla 9par/mnyam 'brel dmag gis ‘ hen ten pog gi 'gog ra ’ brgal te 'jar dmag gi gtso shugs nyams dmas su btang /zla 11tshes 4nyin/ 'jar man gyi cel 'jug ngogs(lha'ilo tsho)gyi mtsho dmag 'os langs byas te su'u we e btsugs shing / 'jar man gyi zla 11pa'i gsar brje mgo brtsams/ zla 11pa'i tshes 9nyin/ leb khi ne khrid (53 1 1066ba005 zung khamalaspyan)dang leg dzem byug (5033 65 0la65ngapya (pa〉sdu༅)sogs gsar brje'i g.yon phyogs pa'i 'go khrid kyis per lin gyi bzo pa dang dmag mir mgo khrid de spyi'i las mtshams bzhag pa dang drag po'i 'os langs byas/ zla 11pa'i stod du/ 'jar man du shar byang las gzhan/ sa khul so so'i srid gzhung tshang ma su'u we e pa'i lag tu shor/ 'jar rgyal wi lim gnyis pa thabs zad de khri las babs pa khyab bsgrags byas nas ho lan ḍi la bros/ zla 11tshes 11nyin/ 'jar dmag gi 'thus mi dag pha ri si'i shar byang gi kham phen (00la916yus0 lo7)nags tshal du hphu khri yi me 'khor zhig nang g.yul mtshams 'jog pa'i gros chod dang du blangs te/ 'jar dmag mgo btags pa dril bsgrags/ de nas bzung / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug rdzogs song //'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po dus yun zla ngo lnga bcu nga gnyis 'gor zhing / nyin mo chig stong lnga brgya drug cu re lnga la rgyun bsrings/ g.yul 'khrug khrod lhung ba'i rgyal khab sum cu 'dus yod cing / mi grangs ha lam dung phyar 379 ༄

bcu gsum yod la/ des skabs dus 'dzam gling gi mi 'bor spyi grangs kyi brgya cha'i don lnga zin yod/ rgyal khab so sos 'thab g.yul du spyad pa'i mi grangs khri phrag bdun stong lnga brgya yod la/ khri phrag sum stong shi rmas byung / g.yul 'khrug gi gron dngul du khyon bsdoms a sgor dung phyur nyis stong bdun brgya spyad pa dang / 'khrug chen gyis 'dzam gling mi dmangs la bzos pa'i gnod 'tshe zab mo ni bgrang bar mi nus so//'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po ni/ ser we ya la mes rgyal srung skyob byed pa'i rang bzhin yod pa las gzhan/ spyi cha nas bshad na btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rang bzhin yod pa'i g.yul 'khrug cig yin/ g.yul 'khrug gis mi dmangs la bslab bya btang zhing gsar brje la skul lcag thebs/ g.yul 'khrug de brgyud nas btsan rgyal bzhi ste/ 'jar man btsan rgyal dang o hang btsan rgyal/ u ru si btsan rgyal/ o si man btsan rgyal nyams rgud du gyur te/ rgyal khab mang po zhig rang btsan byas/ nang sgos su u ru si'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa yis mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi glegs bu gsar ba zhig btod do// 380

so dgu pa/ zar rgyal tha ma khri las phab pa/u ru si'i lo man no hphu (tsolo'im02 lnga zo /zlorsā) rgyal rabs ni 1613lor mes ha yel lo man no hphu (yo༅zo3༅ma 06'a0༅255 ཿtsho/zo7 oṃtsho༅༅tram̐khri rsha)rgyal po byas pa nas bzung ne ku ra gnyis pa'i bar te zar rgyal bco lnga byung / lo man no hphu yi dbang sgyur ni ne ku ra gnyis pa nas mjug rdzogs/ lo man no hphu rgyal rabs kyis u ru ser dbang bsgyur ba ni 1613lor mgo brtsams te/ 1917lor mjug rdzogs reg tu lo ngo sum brgya dang bzhi lon/ krung go'i ching rgyal rabs de no'u ar ha khris 1616lor rgyab khab btsugs pa nas brtsis na/ lo man no hpho rgyal rabs dang krung go'i ching rgyal rabs gnyis ha lam dus mnyam mo//ne ku ra gnyis pa 1894lor zar rgyal gyi khri khar bud rjes/ khos don chen rabs dang rim pa mang po zhig brgyud myong bas/ kho'i mi tshe ni rlung char 'tshub ma'i khrod bskyal zhes brjod rung ngo // 1904lo nas 1905lor khos 'jar man dang u ru si'i g.yul 'thab bgyis te pham kha chen po myong /1905lo nas 1907lor/ u ru sir 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje byung ste/ kho rgyal phyir 'bro la khad du gtug la/ phyis su gsar brje thengs de khos gtum drag gis mgo mnan mod/ 'on kyang kho'i chab srid kyi rmang gzhi la g.yo 'gul byung / 'khrug pa de gnyis kyis nyams rgud du btang ba'i zungs bcud da dung slar ma sos gong khos slar yang u ru si 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i khrod sna drangs la/ thengs der khos rang nyid kyang dur sar sgyugs so//381

'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang pos u ru sir ci zhig khyer yong yod dam zhe na/ 'chi ba dang sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ 'khrug chen khrod/ u ru si'i mi grangs khri phrag chig stong bzhi brgya g.yul gyi gdong du bsdus shing / g.yul 'khrug gis mi grangs khri phrag brgya phrag du ma'i srog shor/ zhing sde'i sa zhing rgya chen po sa rgod du gyur zhing 'bru rigs kyi thon tshad mang du bskyung la/ dngos gong shugs cher 'phar/ me 'khor gyis dmag dpung 'dren skyel byed dgos pa'i rkyen gyis za'e pu re'u nas thon skyed byas pa'i 'bru rigs kyang grong khyer du 'dren thabs med par gyur/ phe thro ki rad (20 0rtsa tha6 726yoskya 'khrug chen rjes su phe ther pog gi ming de phe thro ki rad ces par brjes/ 88ki rad ’ ni grong khyer gyi don no//)dang / mo si kho sogs grong khyer chen po rnams su ltogs skom chen po byung /mi dmangs g.yul 'khrug la shin tu sdang zhing / zar rgyal lam lugs la'ang ha cang sdang bas/ kho tshos gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod rgyun chad med par bslangs/ 1914lo'i lo mjug tu/ u ru si nas thengs bdun cur las mtshams bzhag la/ der zhugs pa'i mi grangs khri phrag gsum lhag yod pa dang /1915lor thengs chig stong lhag la las mtshams bzhag cing / der zhugs pa'i mi grangs khri phrag lnga bcu la bslebs pa dang / 1916lor thengs chig stong lnga brgya la las mtshams bzhag la/ der zhugs pa'i mi grangs khri phrag brgya las brgal/ gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod de dmag mi'i khrod kyang bskyed de/1915lo'i zla 10par 88tso kun thi rtags can’ (༅ོskorhasta)gyi gtso shugs 'thab gzings kyi mtsho dmag gis 'os langs byas la/ 'os langs pham rjes zar rgyal srid gzhung gis 'os langs byed mkhan mtsho dmag rnams la gsod khrims sbyor rtsis byas/ phe thro ki rad kyi bzo pa khri phrag bcu gsum gyis las 382

mtshams bzhag ste ngo rgol byas pas/ zar rgyal srid gzhung gis de dag la gsod khrims spyod ma nus/ 1916lor/ zar rgyal gyi mtsho dmag bros byol byas pa khri phrag brgya dang lnga bcu la bslebs/ lo re bzhin ldab 'gyur gyis 'phar ba'i grangs 'bor de dag las/ zar rgyal sger gcod ring lugs kyi nyen tshabs yang rtser son te gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub cig langs nye ba mtshon thub bo//g.yul 'khrug byung rjes su/ le nyin gyis 88btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug de rgyal nang gi g.yul 'khrug tu bsgyur ba'i 'bod pa btang /1916lor/ le nyin gyis 〈〈btsan rgyal ring lugs ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi ches mtho ba'i dus rim yin 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos grags can de bris nas/gzhung lugs kyi steng nas btsan rgyal ring lugs la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dbye zhib gsal thag chod pa zhig byas shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs ni 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i snga nub yin par bzhed/ le nyin gyis mgo khrid pa'i pol hri web khi tang gis log spyod pa'i 'jigs zil gyi nyen 'tshe gdong gis bsus te mang tshogs khrod dril bsgrags dang rtsa 'dzugs kyi las don rgya chen por spel zhing / phul du byung ba'i tang yon mang po g.yul sa'i sngon gral du mngags te dmag mi'i gsar brje'i bya ba bsgrubs/ pol hri web khi tang gi dka' sdug dang grub 'bras gnyis cha nas che ba'i bya ba des/ gsar brje'i mtho rlabs bsus so//1917lo'i lo mgor/ gsar brje'i zil shugs byings dang mi 'dra ba byung yod/ zla 1tshes 9nyin (u lo)/ phe thro ki rad kyi bzo pas 1905lo'i 88khrag bzhur ba'i gza' nyi mar ’ rjes dran bya ched las mtshams bzhag ste khrom skor byas shing / 66g.yul 'khrug rtsa med gtong ba ’ dang / 66spyi mthun 383

rgyal khab khri lor shog ’ ces pa'i 'bod tshig bsgrags/ mo si kho dang / pa khu sogs grong khyer nas kyang de mtshungs kyi 'thab 'dzing byas/ de ni zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i sngon brda red/ zla 2tshes 23nyin (u lo)/ zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i mgo bslangs/nyin der/ phe thro ki rad kyi bzo pa khri phrag bcu gsum gyis las mtshams bzhag pa dang khrom skor zil ston byas/ nyin de ni tag tag spyi lo'i zla 3tshe sa 8nyin te 8 rgyal spyi'i bud med dus chen ’ yin pas/ khrom skor zil ston byed mkhan dpung khag khrod ngal rtsol bud med mi nyung ba zhig yod/ phyi nyin phe bro ki rad kyi khrom skor byed mkhan mang tshogs khri phrag nyi shur 'phar/ kho tshos ‘ zar rgyal pham par rgyob ’ dang / ‘6g.yul 'khrug med par gtong ’ /8 bag leb dgos nya zhes sogs 'bod tshig bsgrags/ nyin gsum pa ste/tshes 25nyin/ las mtshams bzhag pa dang khrom skor byed mkhan gyi mang tshogs mi grangs khri phrag sum cur 'phar/ zar rgyal ne ku ra gnyis pas phe bro ki rad kyi dmag khul gyi spyi khyab la bka' phab ste drag gnon byas la/ des mang tshogs kyi khong khro'i me lce bla lhag 'bar du bcug tshes 26nyin/ pol hri web khi tang gis drag chas la brten nas 'os langs byed pa'i 'bod skul btang bas/ bzo pas mtshon cha 'phrog cing / srang nas 'thab ra bzos te/ zar rgyal gyi dmag dpung la 'gran rgol byas/ tshes 27nyin (spyi lo'i zla 3tshes 12nyin)/ pol hri web khi'i tang krung dbyang gis 〈〈u ru si'i spyi dmangs yongs la spel ba'i yi ge 〉〉zhes pa bkram ste/ zar rgyal lam lugs mgo rting slog nas spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs rgyu'i 'bod pa btang / zar rgyal srid gzhung gis dmag mir me mda' brgyab nas drag gnon byed dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang / dmag mis me mda' ma brgyab par ma zad/ gsar brje'i 384

phyogs su langs par gyur/ nyin der 'os langs su zhugs pa'i dmag mi khri phrag drug la long pa yod/ nyin de'i dgong mor 'os langs byas pa'i dmag mi dang bzo pas lhan du dgun gyi pho brang la rgol rdung byas te/ zar rgyal gyi blon chen dang dmag dpon 'dzin bzung byas/ zar rgyal ne ku ra gnyis pa g.yul ngo'i bkod 'doms khang na yod pas lag tu ma chud/ de ltar/ zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje de glog dmar 'khyug pa ltar gyi rngam myur gyis u ru ser lo ngo sum brgya lhag la dbang bsgyur ba'i lo man no hphu rgyal rabs rgol thengs gcig gis mgo rting bslogs so// gal te 1905lo'i gsar brje thengs de'i spyi'i sbyong brdar med na/ zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje yang de ltar bde blag dang mgyogs myur zhig yong ga la srid/dgun gyi pho brang blangs pa'i dgong mo der/ phe bro ki rad nas su'u we e'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen 'tshogs/ meg hri web khi'i 'thus mi chi hi tsi zhes pa su'u we e'i lag bstar kru'u zhi ru bdams zhing / spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mi khi lun si ci (sam054 49 0༄'a07355 5095055tho mkhyaloḥ)zhes pa dang meg hre web khi'i 'thus mi gzhan zhig kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams/phe bro ki rad kyi zla gnyis pa'i gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa'i cha phrin de mgyogs myur ngang rgyal yongs su khyab/ sa khul so so nas gcig rjes gcig gis mthud de su'u we e btsugs pas/ zar rgyal gyi sa gnas srid dbang de ma nyid du thor/ pol hri web khis 'go khrid pa'i mang tshogs kyis srang lam du 'thab 'dzing bgyi ba'i skabs su/ su'u we e'i rim pa so so'i 'go khrid kyi dbang cha meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs tang mi'i lag tu shor/ meg hri web khi ni u ru si'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso bzo tang gi g.yas phyogs pa yin/ spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang ni 1902lor tshugs shing zhing pa phyug po dang 'byor 385

ldan pa chung 'bring gi khe phan gyi tshab byed pa'i srid tang zhig yin pas/ chab srid kyi steng nas meg hri web khi dang gzhi rtsa'i thog gcig mthun yin/ kho tshos su'u we e'i nang mang che shos zin don ni/ skabs der u ru si'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa chung 'bring gi stobs shugs che ba dang 'brel ba yod/ zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i skabs/ g.yul 'khrug gis 'byor ba stongs pa'i 'byor ldan pa chung 'bring dag kyang 'thab 'dzing du zhugs/ kho tsho zar rgyal lam lugs la mi mos mod/ 'on kyang gsar brje mtha' 'khyol byed mi 'dod pa'am yang na de lta bu'i bsam blo'i gra sgrig cig med pa dang / chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi nyams myong yang med/ meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mi ni kho tsho'i khe phan gyi mgrin tshab yin par smras te su'u we e'i khongs su 'dzul/ pol hri web khi phyogs nas bshad na yang nyams myong med/gsar brje'i gnas babs kyi 'phel rgyas shin tu mgyogs te/ gza' 'khor gcig nang zar rgyal gyi srid dbang mgo rting slog thub pa ni tshang ma'i blo ngor 'char ma myong ba zhig yin pa gdon mi za/ de lta bu'i gnas babs 'phel 'gyur shin tu mgyogs pa'i gnad 'gag gi dus skabs su pol hri web khi'i nyams myong can gyi mgo 'dzin pa skor zhig yul der med/ le nyin phyi rgyal du sdod dgos pa byung zhing / pu ha len zla 5par da gzod a ri nas 'jar man brgyud de phyir mo si kho ru bsleb thub pa dang / si ta lin (5ཿ༅khye2༅00'i9༅0༅0ba5504yam sprilo༅mkhri27yiloma.oṃ)dang si web ti lo hphu (5502764mtshem07550༅9'am02loḥlatshotshoza)sogs rgyang 'bud du btang yod la/ de las gzhan gyi las byed pa phul byung can mang shos btson du chud yod/ de yang meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mis kho pa tsho'i chab srid kyi lkog g.yo bshams par shin tu phan po yod do// 386

su'u we e'i 'go khrid dbang cha 'dzin mkhan meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mi rnams nas rang nyid kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs spel bar brjod mod/ 'on kyang / kho pa tshos bltas na u ru si'i 'byor med gral rim mi grangs nyung la rig gnas chu tshad dma' bas/ rgyal khab kyi don chen la do dam byed mi nus shing / logs nas 88lta rtog ’ tsam las mi nus par brjod do// de bas kho pa tshos 'byor ldan gral rim pa gdan drangs nas srid gzhung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ 'byor ldan gral rim pa dag gis snga mo nas rang gi kha phyogs lkog 'dems byas yod pas/ meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mi'i bya spyod de kho pa tsho'i dgos 'dun dang tag tag mthun po byung yod do// zla 3tshes 2nyin/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi skabs thog srid gzhung tshugs/ srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin ni sa bdag chen po dang sku drag hu jo'i thob yod pa lib pob (2②9ba྾༅247tsho7༅5maca༅2ca moza)yin/skabs thog srid gzhung tshugs rjes kyi las ka thog ma ni zar rgyal dang gros mol byed pa yin/ nyin de'i dgong mor kho pa tshos 'thus mi mngags te brel ba'i ngang nas ne ku ra gnyis par mjal te/ kho pa rang 'gul gyis khri kha nas 'bab pa'i re ba bton/ skabs der ne ku ra gnyis pas rang nyid la 'gran rgol byed pa'i nus pa med par rtogs pas/ phyir nur khul gyis rgol ba'i thabs bzung ste khri sa nas 'bab rgyu khas blangs mod/ 'on kyang rgyal po'i go sa kho rang gi nu bo mes ha yel la sprod rgyu'i re ba bton par/ skabs thog srid gzhung 'thad mos byung / bzo pas don de shes rjes shin tu khros pas/gros mol byed mkhan 'thus mi rnams 'dzin dgos pa'i re ba bton/ nyin gnyis par/ mes ha yel gyis rang nyid go sa nas 'bab rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas so//387

de ltar/ zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su/ u ru sir srid dbang gnyis lhan gnas kyi lo rgyus snang tshul mthong dkon pa 'di 'dra zhig byung yod de/ gcig ni su'u we e yin la/ de la drag chas spras pa'i bzo pa dang dmag mis rgyab skyor thob yod cing / de'i 'go khrid las khag tu meg hri web khi dang spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mis mang shos zin yod pa dang / gzhan zhig ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi skabs thog srid gzhung yin la/ de ni srid dbang 'dzin pa'i las khungs gtso bo yin mod/ 'on kyang de'i lag tu yid rton 'khel ba'i drag chas kyi stobs shugs med/ gnas babs de lta bu zhig yun ring bor gnas mi srid nges can yin no//skabs der srid dbang gnyis lhan gnas kyi rnam pa zhig chags mod/'on kyang zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i grub 'bras la ngos len byed 'os/gsar brje thengs de'i sgul shugs gtso bo ni bzo pa dang dmag mi/ zhing pa bcas yin la/ des lo man no hphu rgyal rabs kyi mgo rting bslogs te/ spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs pa de ni/ bkas bkod kyi khyad chos rngam mthug pa'i mnga' bdag lam lugs kyi btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab cig la mtshon nas bshad na rgyal kha ches chen po zhig yin no//mthar mtshams sbyor byed dgos pa zhig ni/ zar rgyal mtha' ma'i mjug 'bras yin/ zla 3tshes 3nyin ne ku ra gnyis pas khri las babs pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ ma gzhir skabs glags btsal te yang bskyar slar gso yong thabs byed par snyam mod/ 'on kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni gnas babs kyi 'phel 'gyur de kho par phyi phyir mi phan par gyur/ drag chas spras pa'i bzo pa dang dmag mis re ba 'gyur med bton 'og 'byor ldan gral rim pa dag gis zar rgyal dang kho'i khyim mi rnams mi 'dzin ka med byung /388

skabs thog srid gzhung gis ne ku ra gnyis pa khyim mi dang bcas phyi rgyal du bskyal 'dod kyang / bzo pa dang dmag mis ngo rgol mtha' 'khyol byas pas/skabs thog srid gzhung gis kyang mthar ni ku ra gnyis pa khyim gang bo za'e pu re'u'i tho pol zi khi (༅lololo༅)ru btson 'jug byas/ zla bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su/ ne ku ra gnyis pa sogs wolal ri rgyud('u7lola.o)kyi ye kha thi ren pog (70khu8 071ba60 rtsa 0/tshe༈rha ༅)tu gnas spor byas/1918lo'i dbyar khar/ srung dmag dkar po dang cheg si lo lba khi ya (02006031053khu1 tha663146snyespo/yurte1)yi dmag tshogs mnyam 'brel sgos gyen log byas te/ zar rgyal 'jug sa'i le kha thi ren pog la bcar ba na/ sa gnas de'i su'u we e yis ne ku ra gnyis pa gyen log dmag gis 'phrog par dogs te myur bka' phab nas/ zar rgyal dang btsun mo/ kho'i sras mo/zhabs g.yog bcas de ga'i sa 'og khang par bsad la/ bem po bsregs rjes gter 'obs rnying ba zhig tu dor/ 1998lor/ ne ku ra gnyis pa'i khyim mi dag gi pur thal phe thro ki rad la drangs shing / tsung thung yi li chen pur thal gdan 'dren pa'i mdzad sgor zhugs/ 1918lor ne ku ra gnyis pa khyim gang bo bsad de pur thal gter 'obs rnying bar dor ba nas/ 1998lor kho pa rgyal po byed skabs kyi rgyal sa phe bro ki rad du gus 'jug byas pa'i bar lo ngo brgyad cu song yod cing / de'i ring la u ru si'i chab srid gnas babs la 'gyur bcos gnam sa brjes pa lta bu byung ba yis mi rnams ya mtshan du 'jug pa dang / lo rgyus smra ba dang bsam blo ba dag la bsam gzhigs zab mo byed du 'jug 'di ni zhar gyi gtam mo// 389

bzhibacu pa/ mi'i'ags 'o rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar༄'i mgongartsams pa/u ru si'i zla bcu pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa/1917lo'i zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob rjes/ u ru sir lo rgyus thog mthong dkon pa'i srid dbang gnyis lhan gnas kyi snang tshul zhig byung / sne 'dzing che ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'gag gnad de'i skabs su/ pol hri web khi dang gsar brje'i mi dmangs kyis le nyin phyir log ste gsar brje la thad kur du 'go khrid byed pa'i re ba chen po byed la/ skabs thog srid gzhung shin tu dngangs te/ dbyin ji dang hpha ran sir lag 'brel gyis le nyin phyir u ru sir log par bkag 'gog ci nus bgyis/ yin na'ang skabs de'i 'jar man gyis gsar brje la brten nas u ru si'i nang khul nas 'khrug zing byung ste/rang nyid kyi dgra bo'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i dmigs yul 'grub re 'chang bas/ u ru si'i phyi rgyal du sdod mkhan dag phyir rgyal nang du log rgyur re mos yod/ le nyin gyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dag gi bar gyi 'gal ba de bed spyad nas/ su'e ten dang hphin lan ḍi brgyud de phyir mes rgyal du log1917lo'i zla 4tshes 3nyin ①gyi dgong mor/ le nyin phe thro ki rad la bslebs/ bzo pa dang dmag mi khri stong mang po 'bab tshigs su song ste 'tshang ① u ru si'i lo lugs te/ gsham du de dang mtshungs so/ 390

kha shigs shigs kyis rang gi gtso 'dzin la dga' bsu byas/ khwa lang hri tha ti'i mtsho dmag gis gzab sbreng ru khag bsgrigs la/ rol mo'i ru khag gis 〈〈ma se'i gzhas 〉〉mtho ru btang / le nyin me 'khor las babs rjes/ mi rnams kyis khong mthon por bkyags te sngon chad zar rgyal gyis ngal gso sa'i ched dmigs tshoms chen du bkod/ le nyin 'bab tshigs kyi thang chen du yong ste/ khrab ldan 'khor lo zhig gi steng bud de spro bag 'khol ba'i gsung bshad gnang la/ de'i mjug bsdu ba'i tshig ni ‘ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje khri lor shog ’ ces pa yin/nyin gnyis par/ le nyin gyis tang gi tshogs 'du'i thog 〈〈gsar brje 'di'i khrod kyi 'byor med gral rim gyi 'gan khur 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan zhu phul la/de ni skad grags che ba'i 〈〈zla bzhi pa'i rtsa 'dzin 〉〉zhes pa de'o// le nyin gyis bstan don/ zar rgyal gyi sger chod srid 'dzin lam lugs mgo rting bslogs pa yis 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i gsar brje grub pa mtshon la/da ni gsar brje'i dus rim gnyis par bslebs song / dus rim 'di'i gsar brje'i las 'gan ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi skabs thog srid gzhung mgo rting bslog ste/ srid dbang 'byor med gral rim dang zhing pa dbul po'i lag tu 'thob par byas te/ su'u we e spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs pa yin gsungs la/ le nyin gyis mang tshogs rnams da dung skabs thog srid gzhung gi ngo bo rgyus mi lon pa'i gnas tshul 'og dang / su'u we e yis da dung skabs thog srid gzhung la rogs skyor byed pa'i gnas tshul 'og skabs thog 'dir drag po'i thabs lam gyis skabs thog srid gzhung mgo rting bslog mi nus/gal te de ltar byas tshe su'u we e dang kha gtad du 'gyur zhing / mang tshogs dang kha bral bar 'gyur bar snyam/ de bas/ le nyin gyis bton pa'i 'bod 391

tshig ni/ ‘6skabs thog srid gzhung la rogs skyor ci yang mi byed pa ’ dang /6 srid dbang thams cad su'u we e la gtogs ’ zhes pa yin/〈〈zla bzhi pa'i rtsa 'dzin 〉〉gyi bsam blo'i khrid ston 'og sol hri web khi tang gis las byed pa mang po mang tshogs khrod mngags te/ mang tshogs kyis ches do snang byed pa'i zhi bde dang sa zhing / bag leb kyi gnad don yang dang bskyar du dril bsgrags byas shing / skabs thog srid gzhung ni ma rtsa can dang zhing bdag gi khe phan la ched du srung skyob byed mkhan yin la/ des mi dmangs kyi phan khe'i gnad don thag mi gcod pas/ srid gzhung de dor nas srid dbang thams cad su'u we e yi lag tu 'jog dgos tshul dril bsgrags byas/ le nyin dang je lo tru(༅/tram̐za)/ je'in si ji (0༄ma5503'a྾ 'a0ba༅5'dzi9 550nga5smocholo/1loḥ)sogs 'go khrid pa rnams dngos su bzo grwa dang dmag sgar du zab 'jug byas te/ mang tshogs la gtam bshad gnang zhing / gsar brje'i spobs sems skul slong byas la/ dril bsgrags dang slob gso'i bya ba gzab nan bsgrubs/'byor ldan gral rim gyi skabs thog srid gzhung gi tshul dang mi mthun pa'i spyod stangs dag ges kyang ldog phyogs nas mi dmangs la de'i phyin ci log gi ngo bo mthong du bcug skabs thog srid gzhung gis dbang bzung ma thag tu rang 'dod ci drags byas shing / mu mthud du btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug slong ba dril bsgrags la/ zar rgyal gyis dbyin ji dang hpha ran si sogs rgyal khab la bkod pa'i lkog chings lag tu bstar te g.yul 'khrug mtha' 'khyongs byed rgyu gsal bsgrags byas/ pol hri web khi tang gis skul slong hur thag byas 'og mi dmangs mang tshogs rim bzhin go rtogs sad mgo bcoms/zla 4tshes 20nyin nas tshes 21nyin bar/ mang tshogs khri phrag bcu lhag phe bro ki 392

yul la 'gro dgos zhes lan btab/g.yul ngo'i pham kha yis gsar brje'i mtho rlabs gsar ba zhig 'byung ba'i myur tshad je mgyogs su btang / zla 1tshes 4nyin/ phe thro ki rad nas mang tshogasakhri phrag lnga bcus slar yang khrom skor byas te/ srid dbang thams cad su'u we e la dbang dgos pa'i re ba bton/ skabs thog srid gzhung gis phyi tshul bcos ma yongs su dor te me mda' la brten nas drag gnon byas shing /de ma nyid du mang tshogs bzhi brgya lhag shi rmas su btang pa dang / 〈〈bden lugs tshags par 〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gtor bcom byas nas le nyin 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' phab/zla bdun pa'i khrag bzhur don rkyen des srid dbang gnyis lhan gnas kyi ngang tshul mjug sgril ba mtshon/ zhi bde'i sgo nas dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i bgrod lam khegs par brten drag po'i 'thab 'dzing gi lam du bskyod mgo brtsams/ pol hri web khi tang go rim ma 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas mngon nas lkog gi las la zhugs shing / le nyin hphin lan ḍi'i mtha' mtshams la nye ba'i lā tsi le hphu (4rsā༅za)yi rtswa spyil zhig tu gnas spor te gab sdod byas/ de nas khos 〈〈rgyal khab dang gsar brje 〉〉zhes pa bris te/ gzhung lugs kyi steng nas drag chas la brten nas rgyal khab kyi 'phrul chas rnying ba ①gtor ba dang /'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'dzugs pa'i dgos gal rang bzhin gsal bshad byas la/ de'i mtshungs su/ le nyin gyis gnas babs kyi 'pho 'gyur la rtog dpyod zab mo gnang /thengs shig la/ ol krung ne chi tsi (4lo tso༅༅ ṭha)zhes pa lā tsi le hphu ④ dmag dpung dang khrims 'dzin sogs la'o/ 394

ru le nyin la bya ba'i gnas tshul zhu ru yong / byis pa zhig gis kho khrid nas mtshe'u zhig brgal zhing nags tshal zhig brgyud pa na/ thang zhig tu bslebs la glo bur du rtswa phung zhig gi rgyab nas mi zhig rgyug yong ste/ ol krung ne chi tsi la 'tshams 'dri byas/ ol krung ni chi tsi yis lan mdor bsdus 'ga' btab rjes 'gro grabs byas pa na/ mi cha med des kho'i phrag par rdeb kyin 88blo mthun ol krung ne chi tsi/ khyod kyis nga mi shes sam nya zhes dris byung / de ni rdzus chos spras pa'i le nyin yin 'dug le nyin gyis da ni 'os langs la phyi 'gyangs byed mi rung zhing / 'os langs ches 'phyi na'ang zla dgu pa nas bcu bar bslangs dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang / le nyin gyis si ta lin dang si web ti lo hphu sogs 'go khrid pa rnams brgyud de tang gi skabs drug pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs chen 'tshogs nas/ drag po'i 'os langs kyi byed phyogs gtan 'khel byas pa dang / bzo pa'i dmar srung ru khag mu mthud rgya bskyed dar rgyas su btang /zla bdun pa'i khrag bzhur ba'i don rkyen gyi rjes su/ khi lun si ci yis skabs thog srid gzhung gi tsung li'i 'gan khur/ khos ‘8lcags dang khrag ’ gi lag thabs kyis rgyal nang gi sgrig srol bskyar bcos byed rgyu'i khyab bsgrags spel la/ log spyod dmag don gyi 'go pa khir ne lo tru (2ma2'a5 9sam050༅3ya5509 ༅ma02sko /lokhu༈slolko)yis dmag don sger 'dzin lag tu bstar rgyu'i kha pho brjod/ zla 8tshes 25nyin/ khir ne lo hphu yis ‘6mes rgyal srung skyob nya la kha g.yar nas/ log spyod dmag dpung gi kha phyogs phe thro ki rad kyi phyogs su bsgyur/ gsar brje ngo rgol pa'i mdun du/ pol hri web khi'i tang mi rnams 'jigs dngangs ci yang mi byed par mgyogs myur ngang bzo pa khri phrag drug rtsa 'dzugs byas te khir ne lo hphu yi zing cha zhi 'jags su 395

btang /khir ne lo hphu yi zing cha rdul du brlags rjes/ skabs thog srid gzhung de sngar bas kyang dka' tshegs la 'phrad cing / skabs de'i gnas babs gsar brje la lhag par je phan du gyur/ g.yul 'khrug gi rkyen gyis/ skabs de'i dpal 'byor shin tu nyams par gyur te/ 'bru rigs ha cang dkon pas grong mi rnams bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba dang / bzo grwa 'bor chen sgo rgyag dgos pa byung bas bzo pa mang po las med du gyur pa dang / dngos gong ches cher 'phar te dngul lor shog bu ltar rin thang chung bar gyur nas/ mtshams la lar shog sgor gyi ngo thang ltar rtsis mi rgyag par shog sgor gyi ljid tshad gzhal te rtsis rgyag pa'i gnas tshul yang byung / gnas babs de ltar ya nga bas mi dmangs la 'tsho thabs shig ci la yod ang / de bas bgrod lam nyag gcig ni gsar brje yin/ bzo pas las mtshams 'jog pa dang khrom skor byed pa'i mtho rlabs phyi phyir je rgyas su gyur pa dang / zhing pa'i las 'gul rgyal yongs kyi brgya cha'i dgu bcu yan gyi rdzong khag la mched pa dang / dmag mi rnams la 'thab blo med par gyur nas dmag dpung 'thor mgo brtsams shing / dmag mi mang shos su'u we e yi phyogs su langs par gyur/le nyin gyis gnas babs la dbye zhib byas rjes sdom tshig cig thob pa ni/gsar brje'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms par gyur pas nges par mgyogs myur ngang 'os langs la gra sgrig byed dgos pa de'o// zla 9pa'i dkyil du/ le nyin gyis tang krung dbyang la 'phrin yig thengs gnyis bris te/ gsar brje'i skabs glags bzang bo dam 'dzin sgos mgyogs myur du drag po'i 'os langs bslang ste srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i re ba bton/ zla 10tshes 7nyin/ le nyin tang krung dbyang gi 'grim 'grul pas srung skyel byas te/ skra rdzun gyon zhing smra ra bzhar/ 396

ngang lce'i dbyibs kyi zhwa mo zhig mnabs nas gsang stabs kyis phe bro ki rad la phyir log zla 10tshes 16nyin/ le nyin tang krung dbyang gis bsdus pa'i tshogs chen du zhugs te/ 8 nges par du ches rbad thag chod cing ches hur shugs che ba'i srid jus shig gtan 'bebs byed dgos shing / srid jus de ni drag po'i 'os langs yin pa ’ gsar por bstan/ tshogs chen steng drag po'i 'os langs byed rgyu'i gros gzhir mos mthun byung zhing / 'os langs la 'go khrid byed pa'i gsar brje'i dmag don spyi khyab khang btsugs la/ de'i khongs mi la si wer ti lo hphu (7507 yo5ma'ithoyo065nga 0༅9'am02 ༅ཿloḥlkoza)dang si ta lin/ je rin si ji sogs yod/ gzhan/ le nyin gyi bsam 'char ltar du phe thro ki rad su'u we e nang khul nas dmag don gsar brje'i u yon lhan khang tshugs/ 'on kyang / 'gag gnad kyi skabs der/ zla 10tshes 18nyin/ tang krung dbyang gi u yon ji no we ye hphu (dngha oṃḥkhriza)dang kya mi nye hphu (me0tsho tshoza)yis 〈〈'tsho gsar tshags par 〉〉steng mngon gsal sgos bsgrags yig spel te drag po'i 'os langs bya rgyur ngo rgol byas/ de ni don dngos thog gsang don gal chen dgra bo la phyi gyar byas pa yin pas/ le nyin gyis ngo tsha bral ba'i log spyod der dgag pa tsha nan brgyab/dgra bos pol hri web khi yis 'os langs bya rgyu'i gnas tshul thos rjes/myur mgyogs kyi byed thabs lag tu bstar te/ log spyod dmag dpung 'dzugs bskrun dang dgun gyi pho brang gi nyen srung la shugs snon/ gnad che ba'i 'grim 'grul 'gag mdo dang zam kha/ rgyal khab kyi las khungs sogs la dmag shugs bsnan te srung skyob byas pa dang / sbag sbag me mda' dang skyogs chen btsugs shing / srang lam du gang sar so khang btsugs la/ khrab ldan 'khor lo phar bskyod tshur bskyod kyis nyen rtog byas pas/ phe thro ki rad skabs 397

shig ring 'jigs ye rer bzos/zla 10tshes 24nyin/ skabs thog srid gzhung gis slob dmag dpung khag mngags te pol hri web khi'i tang krung dbyang las khungs kyi tshags par 〈〈bzo pa'i bgrod lam 〉〉gyi par skrun khang bkag nyar byas pa na/ su'u we e dmag don u yon lhan khang gis dmar srung dmag mngags nas par skrun khang phyir 'phrog nyin gung / 〈〈bzo pa'i bgrod lam 〉〉par 'grem byas te/ mi dmangs la de ma nyid du 'os langs byas nas skabs thog srid gzhung mgo rting slog rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / dgong mo der/ le nyin si mol ne pho brang du phebs te dngos su 'os langs la 'go khrid mdzad cing / 'os langs la 'go 'khrid pa'i spyi khyab khang si mol ne pho brang du btsugs/ mtshan mo nas phyi nyin zhogs pa'i bar/ dmar srung dmag ru dang dmag mi/ pol this khi rgya mtsho'i dpung ru'i mtsho dmag ru khag re re bzhin gnas 'di nas dmigs bkod kyi g.yul gnas su phyin/ zla 10tshes 25nyin/ phe bro ki rad kyi 'grim 'grul lam 'gag dang zam pa/ 'bab tshigs/ glog gtong sa tshigs/ kha par spyi khyab khang / sbrag tar spyi khyab khang / mdzod khang / rgyal khab kyi dngul khang sogs g.yul 'thab kyi gtso gnad dag 'os langs dmag gis blangs/ dmar srung dmag gi grangs 'bor nyis khri sum stong tsam nas mgyogs myur ngang bzhi khri lhag la 'phar snon byung / de'i khar nyen srung dmag dpung dang pol this khi rgya mtsho'i dmag ru'i mtsho dmag bsnan na/ 'os langs kyi spyi'i darma ga shugs khri phrag nyi shu yas mas la bslebs/ skabs thog srid gzhung gi khongs mi rnams dgun gyi pho brang du gab sdod byas pas rdza khog gi rus sbal bzhin thar sa med par gyur/ de la blo dkar ba'i ki za khi (thorṣam)dmag dpung dang bud med 66'chi phod ru khag ’ ces pa zhig yod pa'ang skabs der dur rdzas byed mi 398

'dod pas thor gyes su song / dgun gyi pho brang la dmag dpung slob grwa'i slob dmag nyis stong tsam gyis srung skyob byed do//zla 10tshes 25nyin ⑦gyi dgong mo'i dus tshod 9dang skar 45steng / nye wa gtsang 'gram du sdod pa'i ‘ a hphu lel ’(la༅lolo)rtags can gyi dmag gzings las me skyogs 'brug sgra bzhin ldir bar gyur te/ phe bro ki rad kyi 'khyag rub kyi mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings khyab/ dgun gyi pho brang la dpung 'jug byed pa'i skyogs sgra grag pa na/ 'os langs dmag gis skad gseng mthon por ‘ u la zhes sgrog gin mtsho rlabs brdol ba ltar dgun gyi pho brang gi phyogs su bshar/ thog rim so so bzhin gdong thug dmar 'dzing dus tshod gcig tsam byas rjes/ dgun gyi pho brang gi khang tshoms chig stong lnga bcu bo tshang ma blangs shing / skabs thog srid gzhung gi pu'u krang tshang ma gson bzung byas/ khi lun si ci gcig po phar rgol ma byas gong a ri'i rgyal dar btsugs yod pa'i gzhung tshab khang gi rlangs 'khor la bsdad de bros byol byas/ 'os langs la de ltar rgyal kha thob/nyin de'i dgong mor/ u ru si yongs kyi su'u we e 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa 'tshogs mgo brtsams/ phyi nyin/ 〈〈zhi bde'i bka' khrims 〉〉dang 〈〈sa zhing bka' khrims 〉〉la gros mthun byung / 〈〈zhi bde'i bka' khrims 〉〉su btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug la dgag pa tsha nan brgyab ste/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i rgyal khab so sos mgyogs myur gros mol byas te sa khul bcad ster dang 'jal stong mi rgyag pa'i zhi chings 'god rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang / 〈〈sa zhing bka' khrims 〉〉su sa zhing sger la dbang ba'i lam ① spyi lo'i zla 11tshes 7nyin/ 399

lugs med par btang nas/ sa zhing rgyal khab la dbang zhing / zhing pa la bgos nas bed spyod du 'jug rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas/ tshogs chen gyis mi dmangs u yon lhan khang btsugs shing / le nyin kru'u zhi ru bdams/ mi dmangs u yon lhan khang gis su'u we e srid dbang gi 'gan dbang spyod par byed do// phe bro ki rad kyi 'os langs la rgyal kha thob rjes/ pu ha len (oṃtsho7)sogs zhugs pa'i mo si kho'i drag po'i 'os langs la'ang zla 11pa'i tshes 3nyin rgyal kha thob/ der mthud nas gsar brje'i mtho rlabs rgyal yongs kyi zhing grong kun tu mched de sa khul so sor gcig rjes gcig mthud du su'u we e srid dbang btsugs/u ru si'i zla bcu pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje yi rgyal khas 'dzam gling hril bor yom 'gul btang zhing / de ni dus rabs 'byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi don snying gal chen dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis 66des 'dzam gling hril bo'i lo rgyus kyi kha phyogs bsgyur la/ 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus hril bo'i dus mtshams phyes ’ zhes bstan pa ltar ro// ‘ a hphu lel ’ rtags can gyi skyogs sgras mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar ba zhig mgo brtsams pa bsgrags so//mthar brjod dgos pa zhig ni/ rgyal spyi'i 'byor med gral rim gyi 'thab mo ba mi nyung ba zhig zla bcu pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing du zhugs yod de/ dper na u ru sir bzo gla rgyag tu song ba'i krung go'i bzo pa mi nyung ba zhig phe bro ki rad kyi skabs thog srid gzhung mgo rting slog pa'i g.yul 'thab dang mo si kho'i zla bcu pa'i drag po'i 'os langs khrod zhugs pa lta bu yin te/hrin dbyang(tsho༅)pa li hphu chin (ཿtshi lo)zhes pas da dung le nyin gyi sku srung 400

ru khag gi ru dpon khur te/ nyin mtshan res med du si mol ne pho brang gi le nyin las shag gi mtha' skor du so srung byas so// phe bro ki rad kyi drag po'i 'os langs kyi 'go khrid la dngos 'gan 'khur mkhan je rin si ji ni po lan ḍi'i mi yin/ yu sgo si la lbi ya'i thi tho (11 ༷ ṣṭha༅)dang / hang gha ri gung khran tang 'dzugs mkhan pe la khu yun(77 ṭha lca)yang zla bcu pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing la thad khar du zhugs myong / zla bcu pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing la zhugs mkhan gyi rgyal spyi'i 'thab mo ba las/ la la ni ngal rtsol pa yin te/ dper na krung go'i bzo gla rgyag mkhan lta bu dang / de las kyang mang po zhig ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs u ru si'i dmag gis bzung ba'i rgyal khab gzhan gyi dmag mi yin te/ dper na 'jar man dang o si khri ri ya/ byul ghi ri ya/ tur ki cheg sogs kyi mi mi nyung ba zhig yod pa ni u ru sis dmag gis bzung ba'i bzung dmag yin pa lta bu ste/ de tshos pol hri web khi'i dril bsgrags slob gso dang du blangs shing / u ru si'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing gis nyams sad theg la/ le nyin dang pol hri web khi tang gi yang dag pa'i lam phyogs la dngos myong yod pas/ spro bag che ba'i sgo nas u ru si'i 'os langs 'thab mo ba dang dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis 'thab 'dzing du zhugs pa yin zhing / de tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig gis rang gi gces pa'i srog kyang btang ngo // de las 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje ni 'byor med gral rim gyi rgyal spyi'i las don zhig yin pa rtogs thub/rgyal khab gang dang gang zhig yin rung de'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje dngos ma zhig yin phyin rgyal spyi'i gsar brje'i stobs shugs kyi rogs skyor 'dra min sna tshogs dang 'bral thabs med de/ zla bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rgyal kha yis de la gsal bshad byas yod do// 401

zhe gcig pa/ 'o ngonyi shur dmag mtshamos bzhag pa///sgo〈nyer se le zhi chings〉〉bkod pa/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po mtshams bzhag rjes/ dmag mi rnams sos dal bar gyur la/ chab srid pa rnams brel ba che bar gyur te/btsan rgyal ring lugs dag gi 'khrug rtsod de g.yul sa nas gros mol sgrog tse'i steng spor/1919lo'i zla 1tshes 18nyin/ rgyal kha thob pa'i rgyal khab kyis pham par gyur pa'i rgyal khab kyi gnad don thag gcod pa'i pha ri si'i zhi tshogs zhes pa de wer se le pho brang gi me long tshoms chen du 'tshogs/ lo rgyus kyis kyang lan rer ku re mtshar mo ston/ lo ngo zhe brgyad sngon gyi nyin mo 'di la/ 'jar man rgyal po wi lim dang pos kyang tag tag gnas 'di nas 'jar man btsan rgyal tshugs pa khyab bsgrags byas/ lo ngo zhe brgyad rjes kyi nyin mo de dang sa gnas de ru/ 'jar man btsan rgyal gyis de las ldog ste hpha ran si sogs rgyal kha thob pa'i rgyal khab dag gi khrims gcod dang len zhu dgos pa byung song /pha ri si'i zhi tshogs de'i gzhi rgya snga na med par che zhing / rgyal khab so gnyis tshogs 'dur zhugs yod/ pha ri sir 'dus pa'i rgyal khab so so'i 'thus mi khyon tshig stong lhag yod pa'i khrod/ tshogs 'du la zhugs rung ba'i 'thus mi dngos ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod la/ de las gnad don thag gcod byed mkhan ni 66mi bcu'i gros tshogs ’ yin no// 88mi bcu'i gros tshogs ’ zhes pa ni dbyin ji dang a ri/ hpha ran si/ i ṭa li/ 'jar pan lnga'i gtso 402

'dzin dang de dag gi phyi 'brel pu'u krang yin/ zhi gros la kha lo sgyur mkhan ni ‘‘mgo pa chen po gsum ste/ a ri'i tsung thung khril son (yo006 00 yo1130batsholom)dang / hpha ran si'i tsung li khi le meng zo(40 223 30ba)3 1bamozloṣṭha) dbyinaji'idab blonala'ordi joraje ((110pa'i0sa00tha7 bra / rab ———— 1)3 1(1༅1076000 rtsa0༅tshe—rsātsho)bcas yin/ i ṭa li'i dbu blon o lan to (51/ 0710 bu4thas5016 0 130604༅za)yang ma gzhir btsan rgyal mgo ba'i gras su yod mod/ 'on kyang i ṭa lis g.yul ngor rgyun du pham kha myong bas gzhan dag gis mthong gzos de 'dra mi byed par khros te zhi gros las phyir bud pas/ 66mgo pa chen po bzhi ’ las ‘ mgo pa chen po gsum ma gtogs ma lhag go/‘8mgo pa chen po gsum nang / dang thog a ri'i tsung thung wil son snyan grags ches mtho/ a rir g.yul 'khrug khrod nom pa chen po thob ste/ bu lon chad pa'i rgyal khab cig nas bun bdag gi rgyal khab cig tu gyur/ yo rob kyi rgyal khab so sos a ri la a sgor dung phyur brgya yas mas kyi bu lon chags yod/ khril son gyis a ris go la hril bo kha lo sgyur ba'i cha rkyen ‘4yongs su rdzogs ’ par 'dod de/ skyabs mgon gyi ngang tshul bzung nas/sngon mar khos ‘ rtsa don bcu bzhi ’ zhes pa zhig bton zhing / ya rabs bag yod kyi rdzus chos shig bstan/ don dngos thog kho'i 6 zhi bde ’ dang 88dmangs gtso’ / 88drang bden sogs rna bar snyan pa'i tshig de dag gi lkog tu a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgya bskyed pa'i ham sems sbas yod/wil son gyis sne khrid pa'i a ri'i 'thus mi'i tshogs pa dang las zhabs pa mi grangs chig stong sum brgya lhag yod la/ de las kho'i gsus khog ji 'dra che ba dpog nus so// khril son gyis thog mar zhi gros kyis rgyal spyi'i mnya4/ 3'brel

'dzugs rgyu'i re ba bton/ khos rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel gyi mi ser spel yul mngags bkod dbang sgyur lam lugs la brten nas g.yul pham rgyal khab kyi mi ser spel yul bdag 'dzin byed pa ste/ g.yul pham rgyal khab kyi mi ser spel yul ming thog nas rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel la tshab gnyer byed du 'jug pa'i re ba bton la/ don dngos thog de ni a ri'i lag tu bdag 'dzin byed bsam pa zhig red/ 'on kyang skabs der a ri stobs shugs che nas dbyin ji dang hpha ran si la mgo dud de bka' bkod nyan rkyang byed du 'jug nus pa'i tshad du bslebs med/ rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel zhes pa btsugs mod/ 'on kyang gtso khrid kyi go gnas 'dzin mkhan ni sngar mus su dbyin ji dang hpha ran si yin/ a ri'i rgyal tshogs kyis phyis su a ri la dge kha chen po ci yang thob med pa shes pas/ 〈(wer se le zhi chings 〉〉la chog mchan ming rtags ma bkod pas/ wil son gyi ngal ba don med du zad do// 'di ni phyis kyi gtam yin pa ni smros ma dgos/hpha ran si'i tsung li khi le meng zo yis sgo bsten sman pa dang / gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan byed myong la/ chab srid thad drag po dang gtum por grags la/ 'thab la dga' bas mtshang la 6‘stag rgan ’ tsung li zhes thogs yod do// khos thengs der 'jar man las rgyal ba ni 'jar man la gnod skyin len pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig tu bsam/ 1871lor 'jar man gyis hpha ran si la brnyas bcos dang gnod 'tshe byas myong pas/ da ni hpha ran sis phyir lan gnag po zhig sprod cing chad pa chen po zhig bcad de nam yang yar langs mi nus pa zhig tu gtong dgos te/ 'jar man gshags bcos byas pa na hpha ran sis yo rob skam sa chen mor bdag dbang spyod chog par snyam/ de bas/ khi le meng zo yis al sa si dang lo ren phyir len rgyu ma zad/ 'jar 404

man gyis dngul stong chen po 'jal dgos pa dang / 'jar man gyi sal rdo sol gter kha yang hpha ran si la dbang ba ma zad/ re yin gtsang bo hpha ran si dang 'jar man gyi sa mtshams su byed rgyu'i re ba bton/ yin na'ang khi le meng zo yi skyin lan sprod pa'i 'char gzhi'am/ yang na ham thob kyi 'char gzhi la rgyal khab gzhan dag dang nang sgos su dbyin jis ngo rgol byas/dbyin ji'i dbu blon la'o rdi—jor je ni g.yo thabs la nang byan chud pa'i chab srid pa zhig yin/ 1916lor khos mkhregs srung tang gi dbu blon e si khu si (tsho༅༅7)yis g.yul 'doms byas pa mi 'tshams par skyon brjod byas te nang srid las khungs slog pa'i las 'gul bslangs la/ e si khu si go gnas las phab nas rang nyid dbu blon gyi stegs bur 'dzegs so// 'khrug chen mjug bsgril nas zla gcig lon ma thag tu/ khos dmangs sems spyod nus pa rtogs te snga snur gyi sgo nas 'dems bsko byas te dbu blon bstud 'khur byas pa sogs las/ kho'i chab srid kyi rmang gzhi brtan pa mtshon nus so//nang khul gyi las don bkod sgrig byas nas nyin mang po ma song bar kho pa blo khengs yid tshim ngang nas pha ri sir thon/ la'o rdi—jor je yis nus dgu bton nas 'jar man dang tur ki'i mi ser spel yul thob thabs byas mod/'on kyang khos 'jar man gyi stobs shugs nyams rgud du chen po gtong mi 'dod la/ hpha ran si stobs shugs che ru rgyas su 'jug kyang mi 'dod/ de bas khos yang bskyar dbyin ji spyod goms su song ba'i 8 skam sa do snyoms ’ srid jus lag tu bstar/ khos re yin gtsang bo hpha ran si dang 'jar man gyi rang byung sa mtshams su byed rgyur ngo rgol byas te/ 'jar man sngar mus bzhin yo rab skam sa chen po'i mi rigs chig rkyang rgyal khab ches chen po yin pa rgyun 'khyongs yong thabs byas/ de ltar byas na skam sa'i do snyoms yong bar phan 405

zhing / 'jar man bed spyad de gsar byung su'u u la yang rgol rung ngo //'jar pan gyis tan tan tig tig gi sgo nas 'jar man gyi rgyang shar sa khul gyi mi ser spel yul dang stobs shugs mnga' khongs lag tu 'thob 'dod pas/ yo rob dang hphe gling gi don la bsam 'char mi 'don te/ btsan rgyal gzhan dag la 'gal 'du 'byung ba g.yol thabs byas pas/ 'jar pan la 8 kha mi grag pa'i grogs po ’ zhes pa'i ming zhig thogs/rgyalakha thob pa'i btsan rgyal so so'i gtso 'dzin ni de ltar rang rang gi ham re dang / rang rang so sos bkod pa'i 'khrug chen rjes kyi dpe gzhi re khyer nas zhi gros su zhugs pa yin pas/ de dag gi blo 'thab dpung gtug dang gcig mgo gcig bskor/ phan tshun ham thob byed pa'i gnas tshul ji lta bu zhig yin pa ni rtogs dka' ba zhig ma yin no// pha ri si'i zhi tshogs ni 8 'phrog nor bgo bsha'i tshogs 'du zhig dang / 'dzam gling gi mi ser spel yul yang bskyar bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i tshogs 'du zhig red ces brjod na mi 'tsham pa ci yang med/zla ngo 'ga'i mngon rtsod lkog 'thab brgyud de/ mthar 〈(wer se le zhi chings 〉〉zhes pa bkod/ zhi chings la khyon don tshan bzhi brgya bzhi bcu yod la/nang don gtso bo ni/ rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel 'dzugs pa dang / 'jar man gyis al sa si dang lo ren phyir hpha ran si la sprod pa/ 'jar man gyi sal rdo sol gter kha hpha ran si la sngog tu 'jug cing / de'i srid 'dzin thad rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel la lo ngo bco lngar tshab gnyer byed du 'jug rgyu dang / dus tshad long pa na sa gnas de ga'i sdod mir mos shog 'phen du bcug ste bdag dbang gang la gtogs pa thag gcod rgyu/ 'jar man gyis u pin (o )dang mal me ti (dnghalo.oṃ7)sogs sa khul bhel jam la ster ba/ po sin (o 406

chu)gyi sa khul yongs dang phu ro zi nub ma'i sa khul mang shos dang phu ro zi shar ma'i sa khul skor zhig po lan ḍi la ster ba/ tan tse grong khyer (/bra༅lta)zhes pa rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel gyi do bdag byed pa'i rang mos tshong rar bsgyur ba/'jar man gyi hphe gling sogs sa khul gyi mi ser spel yul yongs su rdzogs pa ‘ bkod mngags dbang sgyur ’ gyi rnam pas dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ bhel jam/ 'jar pan sogs rgyal khab la bgo bsha' byed du 'jug pa/ dmag shugs thad nas/ 'jar man gyi skam dmag khri phrag bcu las brgal mi chog pa dang / mtsho dmag chig khri lnga stong las brgal mi chog pa/ mkha' dmag yod mi chog pa/ dmag dpung gi jus gtong khang 'dzugs mi chog pa dang / re en gtsang bo'i shar rgyud du spyi le lnga bcu'i nang du/ 'jar man gyis so tshigs 'dzugs mi chog la/ re en gtsang bo'i nub rgyud ni gros chings rgyal khab kyi dmag gis 'dzin pa dang de'i yun tshad lo ngo bco lnga yin pa/ 'jar man gyis dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ a ri bcas la dngul stong 'bor chen sprod dgos la bye brag gi grangs 'bor phyis su gros thag gcod rgyu yin kyang /a ri la thog mar a sgor khri phrag lnga stong 'jal rgyu sogs yin no// mdor na/〈〈ler se le zhi chings 〉〉kyis lan thengs gcig tu 'jar man la yo rob gling gi rang sa'i brgyad cha'i gcig dang / mi grangs bcu gnyis cha'i gcig 'chor du bcug pa dang / mtsho phyi'i mi ser spel yul yod tshad dang mtsho phyi'i ma rtsa btang ba yod do cog 'chor du bcug 'jar man gyi tshong gru g.yul 'khrug sngon gyi tun khri phrag lnga brgya dang bdun cu nas tun khri phrag lnga bcu la babs pa dang / skam dmag ni hpha ran si'i dmag gi brgyad cha'i gcig la 'bab tu bcug la/ mtsho dmag dang mkha' dmag gzhi rtsa'i steng nas med par byas so//'jar man rim pa dang por gtogs pa'i btsan rgyal zhig nas rim pa gnyis slo1

par gtogs pa'i rgyal khab cig tu glo bur lhung / 〈〈nyer se le zhi chings 〉〉kyi rjes su/ zhi gros kyis da dung o si khri ri ya dang / tur ki bhul ste ri ya sogs g.yul pham rgyal khab skor la'ang de mtshungs kyi zhi chings bkod la/ de dag gi spyi ming la ‘ wel se le zhi chings ma lag ces zer ba yin/〈〈spel se le zhi chings 〉〉kyis 'jar man dmag rgyal ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi rmang gzhi la g.yo 'gul ma btang par/de'i mi ser spel yul yod do cog dang mnga' khongs skor cig 'phrog song bas/de'i dmag don la tshod bkag chen po thebs par ma zad/ dmag stong 'bor chen yang 'jal du bcug pa ni/ 'jar man gyis ci la 'khur nus/ de bas 〈〈lel se le zhi chings 〉〉kyis 'jar man mi rigs kyi sems khams la shin tu gnod pa gdon mi za la/ de yis hpha shi si (1ཿ013 tsho.olo)'khon lan ring lugs pa la zhing sa gshin po zhig 'don sprod byas so// 〈〈wel se le zhi chings 〉〉kyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i gyod kyi sa bon btab pas/mi la las de la ‘4rgyal kha thob mkhan gyi blun spyod ’ ces zer zhing / de la gnas lugs kyang yod do// don dngos su'ang de 'dra yin te/ 〈〈phel se le zhi chings 〉〉gi yig snag da dung skam thag ma chod gong / 'jar man gyi 'khon lan ring lugs pas ‘ wel se le zhi chings med par gtong nya ba'i 'bod tshig bsgrags/ gros chings rgyal khab kyi spyi khyab dmag spyi hphu khri yis 〈〈phel se le zhi chings 〉〉bkod pa'i gnas tshul thos ma thag tu 66'di ni zhi bde ma red/ 'di ni lo ngo nyi shur dmag mtshams bzhag pa red nya ces bshad/ hphu khri yis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i langs phyogs bzung ste 〈〈phel se le zhi chings 〉〉la bltas pa ni smos ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang khos 'jar man dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bskyar gson 'byung ba'i tshod dpag de shin tu yang dag po byung 408

yod de/ 1919lor 〈〈wel se le zhi chings 〉〉bkod pa nas 1939lor 'jar man gyis yang bskyar 'dzam gling gi 'khrug chen gsar ba zhig bslangs pa'i bar lo ngo nyi shu yod do//pha ri si'i zhi tshogs de krung go'i gnad don dang yang rag las yod/krung go ni 1917lor gros chings rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs te 'jar man la g.yul brda sbran pa yin pas/ rgyal kha thob pa'i rgyal khab cig yin/ de bas/skabs de'i krung go'i byang mtsho'i dmag shed can ton chi re'u (ṣṭharsālko)srid gzhung gis kyang 'thus mi mngags nas zhi gros la zhugs/ 'jar man ni g.yul pham byung ba yin pas/ des krung go nas ham thob byas pa'i hran tung gi khe dbang phyir krung go la sprod 'os mod/ 'on kyang 'jar pan gyis snga mo nas zas zhim po de blor babs yod pas/ dbyin ji dang a ri sogs la ngan 'brel gyis 'jar man gyi krung go'i hran tung gi khe dbang btsan thabs kyis 88dang len ’ byed rgyu byas/ btsan rgyal gyi 'jigs skul 'og rul sungs kyi byang mtsho'i dmag shed can srid gzhung gis zhi chings steng ming rtags 'god grabs byas/ gnas tshul de thos rjes/ thog mar pe cin gyi rgyal gces slob ma rnams khong khro ches cher skyes la/ 1915lo'i zla 5tshes 4nyin/ na gzhon slob ma stong phrag du ma srang du 'dus te khrom skor byas nas gnam bde sgo mo cher phyin zhing / kho tshos 8 phyi phyogs su rgyal dbang rtsod pa dang nang khul du rgyal 'tshong la chad pa gcod dgos ’ sogs btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi 'bod tshig bsgrags la/ de las rgyal khab phyi nang du skad grags che ba'i ‘4lnga bzhi'i las 'gul mi’zhes pa byung / ‘8lnga bzhi'i las 'gul ’ gyi gnon shugs chen po la 'jigs te krung go'i zhi gros la zhugs mkhan 'thus mis 〈〈wel se le zhi chings 〉〉steng ming rtags 'god ma phod do// 6 lnga bzhi'i las 'gul mi gyis 409

krung go'i lo rgyus kyi shog lhe gsar ba zhig kha phyes par gyur zhing / de nas bzung krung go'i dmangs gtso ring lugs rnying ba'i gsar brje de dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar ba'i gsar brje ru 'pho 'gyur byung ngo //410

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ sgrol ma skyid/cho po ༅ chu za chodeb gzhi'i bzo 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /rngeskye pho /thi // tsho ༅ ༄༅ / / 'dzamagleng nye rabs lo rgyas kyi gtam rgyud/rtsom sgrig mkhan/ cin yung hwa/sgyur pa po/ mgon po skyabs/dpe skrun mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems thekha mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod yig rtsom sgrig khang /gnas yul/ pe cin ho phing li byang lam yang 14pa/sbrag srid yang grangs/ 100013kha par ang grangs/ 010—64275311par 'debs mkhan/ pe cin dbyi hu'e par 'debs tshad yod kung sis par btab/brgyud 'chong mkhan/ rgyal yongs sa gnas so so'i zhin hwa dpe tshong khang /deb tshad/ 850)glo ma1168parab 1 732par shog 13par gzhi'i sgrig thengs/ 2009smo'i zla 2par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2009lo'i zla 2par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/par grangs/ 0001—1000rin gongaka sgor 16 001325 978—7— 105—09859—0 75 1572(bod/ 149)
